31389.s: The bill (Wet dieren) creates an integrated framework for rules on kept animals, animal products, animal feed, veterinary medicines and the practice of veterinary medicine, replacing and consolidating the GWWD, Kaderwet diervoeders and related laws. It sets general prohibitions and care duties, and delegates detailed rules on animal handling, identification, transport, breeding, trade, slaughter, veterinary acts, feed and medicines, and disease control measures to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
31389.j: The memorandum justifies broad delegation by the need for technical, frequently amended and urgently adjustable rules to meet EU obligations and respond quickly to disease outbreaks and feed incidents.
q: As things stand, the present bill provides sufficient basis to implement such a European framework.
Zoals het zich laat aanzien, biedt het onderhavige wetsvoorstel voldoende basis om aan een dergelijk Europees kader uitvoering te geven.
d: housing, keeping and care of animals
purposes and activities for which animals may be used
breeding of animals and pedigree rules
killing, stunning and handling of animals
admission of persons to perform veterinary acts
measures against animal diseases and zoonoses
administrative measures on animals, products, feed and premises
p: The Minister may impose binding administrative measures, including bans on removing animals, on precautionary grounds before a substance is confirmed in an animal, reducing the evidentiary threshold for restrictions on owners.
Emergency procedure allows a regulation to take effect immediately in urgent situations, bypassing normal pre-adoption procedures.

parties: Asks whether the bill will actually improve animal protection and why no evaluation of the existing GWWD was carried out before drafting new legislation.
Is it not premature, and at least a missed opportunity, to develop a new law without knowledge of the effectiveness of the existing law?
Is het niet voorbarig en op zijn minst een gemiste kans om een nieuwe wet te ontwikkelen zonder kennis over de effectiviteit van de bestaande wet?
Asks that differentiation of rules be based on objectified scientific differences and that principles like intrinsic value be firmly anchored in the law.
It is therefore necessary to explicitly record in the law that differentiation must be based on objectified differences.
Het is daarom zaak om in de wet expliciet vast te leggen dat differentiatie moet zijn gebaseerd op geobjectiveerde verschillen.
Wants the intrinsic value of animals worked out in a normative framework and asks how the bill will ensure a timely, complete filling-in of implementing rules.
would like to see the concept of intrinsic animal value elaborated further in a normative framework.
zouden het begrip «intrinsieke waarde van het dier» graag nader uitgewerkt zien in een normerend kader.
Argues the bill is a framework law offering few guarantees, doubts timely implementation, and opposes dropping preventive testing of housing systems and the nee-tenzij principle for competitions.
Unfortunately the bill offers no guarantees for a policy leading to prevention and elimination of animal suffering.
Het wetsvoorstel biedt helaas geen waarborgen voor een beleid dat leidt tot preventie en uitbanning van dierenleed.
Rejects the bill as an empty framework whose content remains open, demanding withdrawal until all articles and AMvBs are filled in and preventive testing is restored.
cannot agree with a new bill meant to protect animals as long as its content remains open.
kunnen niet instemmen met een nieuw wetsvoorstel dat zou moeten dienen ter bescherming van dieren zolang de inhoud hiervan nog open ligt.
Supports integration and performance-based rules but notes legal certainty risks from broad delegation to lower regulation and asks for evidence-based criteria.
The disadvantage is that legal certainty for entrepreneurs may be at stake.
Het nadeel is dat de rechtszekerheid voor ondernemers in het geding kan komen.
Supports an integrated act but doubts whether it is normative enough, since much concrete regulation is left to lower rules that reduce stability.
Asks for analyses supporting the claim that self-regulation works in animal competitions and whether the statutory wording on intrinsic value should be adopted.
ask the government to indicate which analyses or studies were carried out and used.
vragen de regering om aan te geven welke analyses of onderzoeken gedaan en gebruikt zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet dieren, a framework law integrating rules on kept animals, warning that vague normative concepts such as 'intrinsic value of the animal' lack sufficient precision for delegated regulation and criminal liability, and raising concerns about EU law compatibility, lex silencio positivo, and veterinary disciplinary law. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, revising the text on several points while rejecting or defending others such as the intrinsic value clause and the werkgebieden system.
concerns: The Afdeling found the intrinsic-value norm too vague as a basis for delegated rules and criminal offences; the government moved it to a duty-of-care provision but kept the principle.
Open-ended delegation for implementing EU measures in article 6.4 was insufficiently limited; the government narrowed the provision.
Werkgebieden for rendering services may restrict exports contrary to EC law; the government defended the system on public and animal health grounds under article 30 EC.
Lex silencio positivo permits without decision raise legal uncertainty and bypass public notice; the government limited its use to cases without health, welfare or environmental risk.
Overlap of fines under criminal, administrative and disciplinary law was questioned; the explanatory memorandum was clarified rather than the regime changed.
Disciplinary damages power and griffierecht were questioned; the government capped damages at 5000 euro and dropped the court fee.
Multiple redactional and technical remarks on cross-references, structure and terminology were adopted.

31479.s: The bill amends the Mijnbouwwet to let the minister shrink a mining or storage licence area by removing inactive parts after two years without significant activity, and to remove the overlap between gas extraction and storage licences. It also adds notification duties, invitation procedures for competing storage applications, and a storage plan obligation.
31479.j: The memorandum justifies the new shrinking power by arguing that withdrawing whole licences is often ineffective and that unused gas fields should become available to third parties for supply security and market competition.
d: reducing licence area of inactive parts
p: The minister may shrink an existing licence area without a licence-holder request, subject to written notice and a six-month window for the holder to show significant activity.
Artikel I, E (art. 27, eerste lid, onderdeel h)
The minister may refuse a storage licence where the general interest requires the area to be used for other substances.
Licence amendments by the minister are limited to requests from the holder but made subject to article 32c, with publication in the Staatscourant.

parties: Asks whether the bill affects coal concessions held by companies such as DSM and whether that is justified, given that other activities may follow.
The CDA members ask whether the bill could affect concessions in, for example, South Limburg, where a company such as DSM owns a coal mining concession.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of het wetsvoorstel gevolgen kan hebben voor concessies in bijvoorbeeld Zuid-Limburg, waar een bedrijf als DSM eigenaar is van een concessie inzake kolenwinning.
Raises legal certainty and damages risks: the reduction takes effect before the decision is final, leaving objections meaningless, and compensation liability is unclear.
This would mean that once the minister's decision reducing the area takes effect, the withdrawn part is open and the licence holder loses it permanently, making an objection pointless.

Dit zou betekenen dat op het moment dat de beschikking van de minister tot verkleining van het gebied in werking is getreden het ingetrokken deel van het gebied open is en de vergunninghouder dit definitief kwijt is.
Questions the undefined term 'activities', the lack of a legal deadline, and the basis for compensation, and proposes an alternative of indefinite licences.
Should these activities not be described in detail in the bill to prevent unclarity and related legal proceedings?
Moeten deze activiteiten niet uitvoerig worden beschreven in het wetsvoorstel om onduidelijkheden en hiermee samenhangende juridische procedures te voorkomen?
Asks how the minister will weigh external factors and expropriation costs, and whether restrictions attached to decisions are sufficiently guarded.
The VVD members want to know to what extent external factors are taken into account, such as the length of the licensing process and dependence on available infrastructure capacity.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag weten in hoeverre er rekening wordt gehouden met externe factoren, zoals lengte van vergunningsproces, afhankelijkheid beschikbare capaciteit infrastructuur.
Asks for justification of the 25% instrument, a calculation showing the state budget benefits overall, and the expected EU approval and convenant conditions.
The CDA members want a detailed justification for the choice of this specific instrument.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben behoefte aan een uitgebreide onderbouwing van de keuze voor dit specifieke instrument.
Asks about the timing of the CCS directive implementation, whether stored CO2 counts as emission reduction, and whether gas released by CO2 injection may be used commercially.
These members ask whether, conversely, gas could still be released by CO2 injection after the extraction licence has lapsed, and if so whether that gas may be used commercially.
Deze leden vragen of het, andersom, mogelijk is dat als de winningsvergunning is vervallen en er door CO 2 -injectie, primair bedoeld om CO 2 op te slaan, toch gas vrijkomt?
Questions the government's revenue calculation, asks for the fiscal cost of the deduction, and asks why the scheme was not made budget-neutral.
These members raise some question marks about the calculation the government makes in the explanatory note to the amendment.
Deze leden zetten enkele vraagtekens bij de rekensom die de regering in de toelichting bij de nota van wijziging maakt.
Supports the main lines but asks about unused licences, safety criteria for CO2 storage licensing, and the timing of entry into force.
These members also ask whether licensing for storage also examines the safety of storage methods, and what the criteria are for that.
Ook vragen deze leden of er bij de vergunningverlening voor opslag ook wordt gekeken naar veiligheid van opslagmethoden en wat de criteria daarvoor zijn.
Asks the government to substantiate that the incentive will deliver the expected production, given oil price uncertainty and other factors, and when the Commission's opinion is expected.
Can the government further substantiate why this incentive measure will achieve the expected production?
Kan de regering nader onderbouwen waarom door deze stimuleringsmaatregel de verwachte productie wordt behaald?

31569.s: The bill makes permanent the rules on transfer of employees when a public transport concession changes hands, by deleting the sunset provision of the Wet personenvervoer 2000. It also lets the Spoorwegwet set a reduced 3-metre building-restriction boundary for freight-only 'stamlijnen' in port and industrial areas, and grants existing permits and rail-yard approvals continued legal effect.
31569.j: The memorandum justifies the reduced boundary for freight lines mainly by avoiding about 5 million euro in extra administrative burden from additional permits, and notes low train speeds on those lines.
q: If the stamlijnen were designated as main railway without setting a different boundary for them, this would lead to a considerable number of additional permits that would have to be granted.

Wanneer de stamlijnen aangewezen zouden worden als hoofdspoorweg zonder voor deze stamlijnen een afwijkende begrenzing vast te stellen, zou dat leiden tot een aanzienlijk aantal extra vergunningen dat verleend moet worden.

parties: Asks whether the personnel clause should apply only within tendered areas, given possible unequal employment conditions after in-sourcing, and asks about consultation and effects on freight rail capacity.
The CDA members want to know from the government whether the above should not lead to an amendment of the WP 2000 so that the personnel clause applies only to taking over staff within tendered areas.

De leden van de CDA-fractie willen van de regering weten of het vorenstaande niet zou moeten leiden tot aanpassing van de WP 2000 met als doel dat de personeelsparagraaf alleen van toepassing is voor het overnemen van personeel binnen aanbestede gebieden onderling.
In principle supportive of the amendments but asks questions on the 11-metre boundary basis, speed limits on former stamlijnen, and the meaning of serious incidents.
The PvdA members are in principle in favour of these amendments but still have some questions.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn in beginsel voorstander van deze aanpassingen maar hebben nog wel enkele vragen.
Welcomes the extended personnel clause but asks to broaden the definition of covered staff and to protect working conditions further.
The SP members are pleased with the extension of the personnel clause in the Wet Personenvervoer 2000.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn verheugd met het verlengen van de personeelsparagraaf in de Wet Personenvervoer 2000.

Strongly objects to making the personnel clause permanent, notes the explanatory memorandum is very brief as the Raad van State observed, and asks for justification of the changed government position.
The VVD members have serious objections to the proposed amendment to keep the personnel clause of the WP 2000 beyond the planned expiry date of 1 January 2010.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben grote bezwaren tegen de voorgestelde wijziging om de personeelsparagraaf van de WP 2000 ook na de geplande vervaldatum op 115januari 2010 te behouden.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill making the transitional staff-transfer scheme of the Wet personenvervoer 2000 permanent is insufficiently justified, since the explanatory memorandum does not explain why the original reasons for a temporary regime no longer apply. The government's reply adds three arguments (legal certainty for workers, less barrier effect for new entrants than foreseen, broad parliamentary and sector support) and amends the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacks compelling arguments for abandoning the temporary character of the staff-transfer scheme and must explain why the original reasons no longer apply.
Redactional remarks on the wording of the Spoorwegwet articles 20 and 21 were incorporated.

31578.s: The bill approves amendments adopted in Geneva in 2001 to the 1972 Vienna Convention on the assay and marking of precious metal articles. It also amends the Waarborgwet 1986 to extend hallmarking and assay rules to palladium articles.
d: Artikel II, onderdeel B (artikel 23, eerste lid)
assay and marking by a guarantee institution at the request of the supplier, under the chapter's rules

31596.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 861/2007 on the European small claims procedure in Dutch law, assigning these claims to the kantonrechter and excluding appeal while keeping cassation open. It also sets rules on fees, cost orders, reconsideration requests by defendants, enforcement of foreign certificates, and withdrawal of claims outside the regulation's scope.
31596.j: The memorandum justifies the appeal exclusion by the low financial stake of these claims relative to the time and cost of appeal, and notes that cassation remains available.
q: Article 2 of the bill excludes appeal against the kantonrechter's decision, but cassation under Article 80 of the Judiciary Organisation Act remains open.

In artikel 2 van het wetsvoorstel wordt hoger beroep tegen de beslissing van de kantonrechter uitgesloten, maar beroep in cassatie op grond van artikel 80 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie wordt in dat artikel wel opengesteld

parties: Asks whether excluding appeal against the small claims judge's decision is compatible with the right to a second factual instance, and whether the reconsideration request is legally sound.
They ask how this choice relates to the generally held view that every litigant should have the right to have their case heard by a second factual instance.

Zij begrijpen het kostenaspect, maar vragen hoe deze keuze zich verhoudt tot de algemeen heersende opvatting dat iedere rechtszoekende het recht moet hebben op een behandeling van zijn zaak bij een tweede feitelijke instantie.
Doubts that excluding appeal and allowing only limited reconsideration gives both parties sufficient legal protection, and worries about defending against unjust claims.
Does the government think that both parties are thereby offered sufficient legal protection?
Vindt de regering dat beide partijen hiermee voldoende rechtsbescherming wordt geboden?
Supports the aim of simplifying cross-border small claims and asks about preparation for the extra burden on the judiciary.
These members nonetheless wish to ask the government how the Council for the Judiciary and the cantonal courts should prepare for the possible extra burden.

Deze leden willen de regering toch vragen aan te geven hoe de Raad voor de Rechtspraak in het algemeen en de kantongerechten in het bijzonder zich dienen voor te bereiden op de mogelijke extra belasting.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill implementing EU regulation 861/2007 on the European small claims procedure but advises aligning the four-week deadline for requesting review with the regulation's 'onverwijld' wording, adding an evaluation clause, and assessing the burden on the cantonal judge. The minister's reply adopts the advice on the court burden and adds reasoning to the memorandum on the deadline and evaluation, keeping the four-week term.
concerns: The Council advised replacing the fixed four-week review deadline with the regulation's flexible term 'onverwijld' to ensure harmonisation; the minister kept four weeks but explained the choice in the memorandum.
The Council advised a parallel evaluation clause in the bill; the minister declined, pointing to the existing reporting obligation under Article 28 of the regulation.
The explanatory memorandum did not address the burden on the cantonal judge; the minister added a passage on this in paragraph 8.

31758.s: The bill replaces the Wet tarieven in burgerlijke zaken with a new court-fee regime for civil cases, setting fixed fee tables by court level, party type and claim value, with a low flat fee for indigent persons. It also introduces procedural consequences for late payment of fees and amends numerous other statutes to reference the new law.
31758.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies indexation by ministerial regulation as giving certainty on timing and simplifying implementation compared to an administrative order.
q: The amounts stated in this law and in the table annexed to it may be changed annually with effect from 1 January by ministerial regulation, insofar as the consumer price index gives reason to do so.

De bedragen die genoemd zijn in deze wet en in de tabel die als bijlage bij deze wet is gevoegd, kunnen jaarlijks met ingang van 1 januari bij regeling van Onze Minister worden gewijzigd, voor zover de consumentenprijsindex daartoe aanleiding geeft.
d: annual indexation of fee amounts by ministerial regulation
categories of cases exempt from court fees
further rules on free copies of judgments
fees for copies and extracts of judgments and records
further rules on necessary copies of acts and decisions
allowances for document holders, experts and witnesses
p: Fee amounts may be indexed annually by ministerial regulation instead of a general administrative order, linked to the consumer price index.
The minister may by regulation designate categories of cases in which no court fee is charged.

parties: Asks whether the fee system may encourage misuse, whether it complies with Article 6 ECHR, and whether low-income persons with minor claims are adequately protected.
The CDA members state that if the court-fee system can be simplified, that opportunity should not go unused.
De leden van de CDA-fractie stellen dat als het griffiestelsel vereenvoudigd kan worden, die kans niet onbenut moet blijven.
Worries that the reform burdens less affluent citizens with higher fees, removes exemptions for low-income groups, and may deter appeals.
These members ask whether sufficient account was taken of the ability to pay of certain groups in society, for example people receiving social assistance.
Deze leden vragen of bij de totstandkoming van dit voorstel voldoende rekening gehouden is met de draagkracht van sommige groepen in onze samenleving, bijvoorbeeld bijstandsgerechtigden.
Objects that fixed fees increase costs for small claims and that removing the distinction for low-income persons creates a financial barrier to the courts.
For the SP members, access to the judge must be possible for everyone and must not be obstructed by raising financial barriers.
Voor de leden van de SP-fractie staat voorop dat de toegang tot de rechter voor een ieder mogelijk moet zijn en dat die toegang niet belemmerd mag worden door het opwerpen van financiële drempels.
Asks for clarification on the interaction with the planned expansion of the kantonrechter's competence, on cost orders against losing parties, and on enforcement of fees.
These members are not yet fully convinced by the argument for not taking into account in this bill the imminent expansion of the competence threshold.
Deze leden zijn echter nog niet geheel overtuigd van de argumentatie om niet vast in voorliggend wetsvoorstel rekening te houden met de op handen zijnde verruiming van de competentiegrens.
Asks whether the system adequately considers effects on natural persons, particularly debtors in collection procedures against creditors.
For the SGP members the question is whether the proposed system sufficiently takes into account the possible consequences, particularly for natural persons.
Voor de leden van de SGP-fractie is het de vraag of het voorgestelde stelsel in voldoende mate rekening houdt met de mogelijke gevolgen in het bijzonder voor natuurlijke personen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised the government to re-examine the Wet griffierechten burgerlijke zaken, in particular the exemption for filing a defence at the kantonrechter, the deletion of article 243 Rv on cost recovery for legally aided parties, and to explain how access to justice is safeguarded. The minister's nader rapport accepts the access-to-justice explanation, reconsiders the exemption in a separate bill, justifies deleting article 243 Rv, and reports the change to a four-week payment term.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for an explanation in the memorie van toelichting that access to justice remains guaranteed under the new fee system, including with regard to article 6 ECHR, and the government added a new paragraph 1.5.

The Afdeling advised re-examining the exemption from court fees for filing a defence at the kantonrechter and pachtkamer, and the government will reconsider it in a forthcoming bill rather than amend it now.

The Afdeling was not convinced that deleting article 243 Rv, leaving no statutory protection against the collection risk for on- and minvermogenden, is reasonable, and advised reconsidering; the government argued the risk remains with the winning party as before.
The Afdeling warned that the upfront collection of fees could burden court registries, and the government introduced a four-week payment term aligned with the administrative law regime.
The Afdeling made several redactional remarks in an annex, which were incorporated into the bill.

31767.s: The bill amends the Unemployment Insurance Act (Werkloosheidswet) to strengthen work incentives for long-term unemployed by introducing income offsetting that partly reduces benefits when they take up work after 52 weeks of benefit receipt, and by adjusting work obligations and benefit suspension rules. It also amends the Wet SUWI so that the UWV intensifies job brokering with employers for people who have received unemployment benefit for at least 52 weeks.
31767.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to restore productivity and employability of long-term unemployed and to provide an extra incentive to resume work, with the general administrative measure defining income details.
q: The delegation provision in the second paragraph of current article 35aa also applies to this new situation, so that a general administrative order can further define what is understood by 'income' in this context and to which period it can be attributed.

De delegatiebepaling uit het tweede lid van het huidige artikel 35aa wordt ook van toepassing op deze nieuwe situatie zodat in een algemene maatregel van bestuur nader kan worden uitgewerkt wat in dit kader onder «inkomsten» wordt verstaan
d: I.D (amendment of article 35aa, first paragraph; referencing second paragraph delegation)
defining income and attribution period for income offsetting
p: Introduces income offsetting for long-term unemployed that reduces benefit entitlement when they take up work, with statutory thresholds rather than discretionary administrative decisions.

parties: Asks government to justify rejecting the Commission's advice, specify participation goals and criteria for the UWV work offer, and how individual circumstances are weighed.
These members would like further explanation of why the government chose not to adopt this advice.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vernemen graag in een nadere toelichting waarom de regering er voor heeft gekozen om dit advies niet over te nemen.
Welcomes the shift from hours-based to income-based offsetting so work always pays financially; asks about costs and evaluation.
This bill ensures that resuming work yields a financial benefit for long-term unemployed in all cases, regardless of the new wage level.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt geregeld dat werkhervatting voor langdurig werklozen in de WW in alle gevallen een financieel voordeel oplevert, ongeacht de hoogte van het nieuwe loon.
Opposes accepting work below qualification level and dilution of the WW insurance character; asks for minimum quality of offers to be written into the law.
The SP members ask what the minimum quality of the work offer should be and whether the government is willing to write this into the law.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen wat de minimale kwaliteit van het werkaanbod moet zijn en of de regering bereid is dit in de wet op te nemen.
Asks for quantification of goals, criteria for work offers, consequences of refusal, and relation to a court ruling.
How does this proposal relate to the Arnhem district court ruling of October 2008 (LJ Number BF7284)?
Hoe verhoudt zich dit voorstel tot het vonnis van de rechtbank van Arnhem van oktober 2008 (LJ Nummer BF7284)?
Asks whether workseekers can object to offered vacancies, and whether the change will be evaluated.
The ChristenUnie members want to know whether job seekers still have a say in the vacancy offered (and mandatorily accepted).
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie willen weten of werkzoekenden zelf nog inspraak hebben in de vacature die aangeboden (en verplicht aangenomen) wordt?

31857.s: The bill amends the Aviation Act and several other laws on aviation, including ministerial exemption powers, airport licensing and investment approval, noise-zone rules and a voorhang procedure for AMvBs on airport decisions. It also removes obsolete provisions from three earlier amending acts and makes technical corrections to cross-references and terminology.
31857.j: The memorandum justifies the new ministerial and AMvB powers mainly as corrections of earlier omissions and alignment with EU directives and the Algemene wet bestuursrecht, and it explains the voorhang procedure as fulfilling a commitment made in the Senate.
q: Parts J and K implement the commitment made by the then State Secretary during the plenary debate to include a voorhang procedure in articles 8.25d and 8.25g of the Aviation Act.

Met de onderdelen J en K wordt uitvoering gegeven aan de tijdens voormelde plenaire behandeling door de toenmalige Staatssecretaris van Verkeer en Waterstaat gedane toezegging met betrekking tot het doen opnemen van een voorhangprocedure in de artikelen 8.25d en 8.25g van de Wet luchtvaart.
d: exemptions from aviation rules with conditions and attached requirements
rules on terrains used temporarily by aircraft and related notifications
general administrative orders on airport licensing and operation
airport decision to follow rules set under 8.44 and 8.47
II, A (art. V Wet geluidhinder / art. X)
noise measurement points around residential areas near airports
p: Decisions on certain aviation matters are formally made by ministerial decision and published in the Staatscourant instead of being issued by the ministry generally.
Supervision of the licence obligation is given to designated supervisors, with terminology aligned to the Algemene wet bestuursrecht.
Clarifies which minister acts under the Wet luchtvaart in a given provision.
Adds shareholder approval for airport operator investments above a threshold, giving the shareholders' meeting a check on the operator's board.

parties: Asks for the promised note on the state's steering role as shareholder and how voting rights in the shareholders' meeting are arranged.
They ask whether there is any indication of when this will be sent to the House.
Zij vragen of er enig zicht is op wanneer deze naar de Kamer gezonden zal worden.
Asks whether the amendment to Article 8.70 removes appeal and objection rights against national airport decisions beyond the minimum requirements.

Is it true that for national airports appeal and objection remain possible against, for example, the absence of more than two monitoring points, against the limit values and against the rest of the relevant airport decision?

Is het waar dat er bij nationale luchthavens nog wel beroep en bezwaar mogelijk is tegen bijvoorbeeld het ontbreken van meer dan twee handhavingspunten, tegen de grenswaarden en tegen de rest van het desbetreffende luchthavenbesluit?
Welcomes an active state shareholding at Schiphol and asks in which areas the government expects to apply it.
The SP members welcome the government's wish to make possible an active shareholding in Schiphol.
De leden van de SP-fractie juichen het toe dat de regering een actief aandeelhouderschap bij Schiphol mogelijk wil maken.
Asks the government to justify the active shareholder role, the entanglement of public and private domains, and the one-tenth balance-sheet threshold.
These members particularly ask for attention to the entanglement of the public and private domains.
Deze leden vragen met name aandacht voor de verstrengeling van het publieke en private domein.
Asks why appeal is possible against national airport decisions but not against the Schiphol decision, and how noise standards are substantiated.
These members finally ask how to justify that under the Aviation Act appeal is possible against an airport decision for national airports, but not against an airport decision for Schiphol.

Deze leden vragen ten slotte hoe te motiveren is dat volgens de Wet luchtvaart wel beroep mogelijk is tegen een luchthavenbesluit voor nationale luchthavens, maar niet tegen een luchthavenbesluit voor Schiphol.

31875.s: The bill amends Book 8 of the Civil Code and related laws to implement the 2001 Bunkers Convention on liability for pollution damage from bunker oil, establishing strict shipowner liability, compulsory insurance or financial security with direct action against insurers, and a certificate regime administered by the Minister of Transport. It also centralises appeals against related decisions in the Rotterdam district court, with further appeal to the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.
31875.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and discretion by the need for quick adjustment of fees by ministerial rule and the Convention's requirements, while routing appeals through the courts.
q: It was chosen to regulate the fees due by or pursuant to a general administrative order (AMvB), so that changes can be implemented more quickly.
Gekozen is voor nadere regelgeving van de verschuldigde vergoedingen bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur waardoor wijzigingen sneller zullen kunnen worden doorgevoerd.
d: fees for issuing or endorsing certificates of financial security
assessing financial capacity of insurers/financial security providers (in consultation with Finance Minister)
p: The Minister may withdraw a certificate after consultation with the Finance Minister if the insurer's financial capacity is insufficient or funds cannot become available in the Netherlands, subject to a suspension pending appeal and appeal to court.
The Minister must refuse certificate applications with insufficient or incorrect documents or non-compliant financial security, with appeal available.

parties: Asks why the shipowner definition is broader than in the Oil Tanker Liability Act, and whether victims bear losses above the liability limit.
Asks whether case law exists on the exceptions in the proposed article 8:641(3) and what happens if recourse against third parties fails for lack of funds.
The VVD members ask whether case law has already been developed on the listed exceptions in proposed article 8:641(3) of the Civil Code.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of er al jurisprudentie is ontwikkeld over de genoemde uitzonderingen in het voorgestelde artikel 8:641, derde lid, BW.

31893.s: The bill introduces the Wet inkomensvoorziening oudere werklozen (income provision for older unemployed) and amends related social security laws, including the IOW benefit calculation and the WW/IOW interaction. It also extends existing social security and implementing provisions to cover the new benefit and adjusts the Toeslagenwet and WWB-related references.
31893.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying that, as in most other social security laws, rules on sanctions policy are set by general administrative order, and the existing Maatregelenbesluit socialezekerheidswetten is extended to cover the IOW.
q: Further rules concerning the third and fourth paragraphs will be set by general administrative order.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld met betrekking tot het derde en vierde lid.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 19, achtste lid IOW)

parties: Asks why the first-granted benefit prevails in overlap cases and whether the IOW should prevail given it has no partner test.
Can the government explain further why it was chosen that the benefit granted first prevails?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom is gekozen voor het uitgangspunt dat de uitkering die het eerst is toegekend, prevaleert?
Asks how many beneficiaries may face financial disadvantage and requests a comparison of options including the favourability principle.
The PvdA members ask the government how many benefit recipients may face negative financial consequences.
De leden van de PvdA vragen de regering hoeveel uitkeringsgerechtigden mogelijk nadelige financiële consequenties kunnen ondervinden.
Criticises the rule that the first benefit prevails as a possible serious worsening for claimants and asks for justification and adjustment.
The SP members are disappointed that where the IOW and IOAW overlap, the benefit granted first prevails.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn teleurgesteld over het voorstel dat bij samenloop van de IOW en IOAW de uitkering die het eerst is toegekend prevaleert.
Asks about the effects of the IOW on work incentives for older unemployed people and on the poverty trap.
Can the government explain the effects on incentives for older unemployed people to find work from the IOW and how the poverty trap is affected?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten wat de gevolgen zijn voor de prikkels voor oudere werklozen om vanuit de IOW werk te vinden en hoe de armoedeval beïnvloed wordt door de introductie van de IOW?
Asks whether fraud controls are increased and what the added value of the IOAW is given the sollicitatieplicht, raising oversight and administrative burden.
With this amendment, is there additional checking for fraud?
Wordt er met deze wetswijziging wel extra gecontroleerd op fraude?
Asks for the extra implementation and benefit costs if the most favourable benefit rather than the first granted prevailed, and which income components are deducted.
These members ask the government how high the extra implementation costs and possible extra benefit costs are if the most favourable rather than the first-granted benefit prevails.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe hoog de extra uitvoeringskosten en de eventuele extra uitkeringlasten zijn, wanneer niet de eerst toegekende, maar de meest gunstige uitkering prevaleert.

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill introducing the IOW (unemployment benefit for older workers) but raises two points: the effects of a priority rule between IOW and IOAW/WIA benefits, and the redefinition of 'income related to work' which would broadly reduce benefits. The government reply clarifies the financial effects in the explanatory memorandum and states the redefinition was not intended to change the IOW design, while not adopting the drafting suggestion on paragraph numbering.
concerns: The Raad asks that the financial consequences of the priority rule between benefit schemes be explained, which the government addressed by adding a passage to the explanatory memorandum.

The Raad objects that replacing 'income related to work' with 'other income components' broadly reduces benefits without adequate justification and advises deleting or substantively motivating it; the government clarifies that no change in design was intended and clarifies the memorandum.
Redactional remarks on articles and the explanatory memorandum, with the renumbering suggestion not adopted but justified by a pending amendment act.

31924-X.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statutes (departmental budget of the Ministry of Defence and the budget of three defence operating units) by adopting a supplementary and closing budget, changing expenditure and revenue figures to match realised outcomes. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers, and no explanatory memorandum text on delegation.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2008 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

31929.s: The bill amends the General Child Benefit Act, General Surviving Dependants Act, General Old Age Pensions Act, Allowances Act, and the income-support laws for older partly disabled and unemployed former self-employed and employees, plus the Work and Assistance Act, so that benefit claimants who refuse a home visit to verify their living situation can have benefits set, reduced or withdrawn at the lower single-earner level. It also adds a general duty to cooperate with the implementing agencies and lets the SVB or UWV request proof of living situation, including entry into the home with consent.
31929.j: The memorandum justifies the home-visit powers by the need for lawful benefit payment and fraud control (pressing social need under Article 8 ECHR), and says the measure is subsidiary and proportionate because it applies only when other data cannot establish the facts.
q: If the client, although given the opportunity, does not prove he is single, the benefit is set or revised to the level for which this fact is not relevant.
Indien de cliënt, hoewel daartoe in de gelegenheid gesteld, niet aantoont dat hij alleenstaand is, wordt de uitkering vastgesteld of herzien naar het niveau waarvoor dit gegeven niet relevant is.
d: requesting proof of living situation and home visits by SVB
p: Artikel I, onderdeel A (art. 14a AKW) and onderdeel B (art. 15a AKW)
Benefit child allowance can be set, reduced or withdrawn when the claimant does not prove the child's living situation after a home-visit request, and the SVB may request entry into the home.
Allowance is granted or reduced to half the difference if the claimant does not prove single status on request, with home-visit entry requiring consent.
Artikel III, onderdeel B en D (art. 17, 19, 50 AOW)
The SVB may suspend old-age pension payments on reasonable suspicion and lower pension to the single-earner rate if the pensioner does not prove status on request.
Artikel V and VI (art. 14 WIOAZ / WIOW)
The municipality may pay benefits at half the basis if the claimant does not prove former self-employed or unemployed status on request.
The municipal board may reduce assistance to half the basis if the claimant does not prove eligibility status after a home-visit request, with entry only with consent.

parties: Supports home visits to fight fraud but insists on legal safeguards for the home right and privacy, proper conduct by officials, and proportionality, citing Ombudsman criticism.
On the other hand, the greatest possible care must be exercised regarding the intrusion into personal privacy.](evidence translated)
Anderzijds moet de grootst mogelijke zorgvuldigheid betracht worden ten aanzien van de inbreuk in de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Asks the government to justify the necessity and proportionality of home visits without any suspicion of fraud, given case law requiring a reasonable ground and the infringement of Article 8 ECHR.
Why does the government choose to infringe fundamental rights when it concerns a group for whom there is in advance no suspicion of fraud?
Waarom kiest de regering voor een inbreuk op grondrechten terwijl het een groep betreft waarbij op voorhand geen vermoeden van fraude bestaat?

Warns that home visits are a heavy instrument intruding on privacy protected nationally and internationally, and questions why visits can be enforced without suspicion of fraud and what the bill adds.
A home visit, however, is a heavy instrument that infringes on a person's private life, which enjoys national and international protection.
Een huisbezoek is echter een zwaar middel waarbij inbreuk wordt gemaakt op iemands persoonlijke levenssfeer die nationale en internationale bescherming geniet.
Asks about concrete sanctions for incorrect benefits, whether visits are announced, and how inspectors can establish fraud if refusal has no benefit consequences.
Since no benefit consequences can be attached to refusing a home visit, what means can the inspector then use to establish possibly fraudulent conduct?
Aangezien er geen uitkeringsgevolgen kunnen worden verbonden aan het weigeren van een huisbezoek, wat voor middelen kan de inspecteur dan aangrijpen om eventueel fraudeleus gedrag vast te stellen?

Questions whether mandatory home visits without suspicion of fraud are the appropriate means, asks about the balance with Article 8 ECHR and Article 10 Constitution, subsidiarity, and legal certainty for claimants.
Can it happen that someone has handed over all kinds of documents and evidence to the best of their ability, but is then nevertheless confronted with a home visit?
Kan het voorkomen dat iemand naar vermogen allerhande documenten en bewijsstukken heeft overhandigd, maar vervolgens alsnog geconfronteerd wordt met een huisbezoek?
Asks about the discretion of implementing agencies in judging evidence, the scope and practice of home visits, and whether the measures are compatible with the Constitution and the ECHR.
Supports a firm fraud approach and home visits but questions whether the scheme meets Article 8 ECHR, the definition of reasonable suspicion, risk profiles, data matching, and the need for protocols.
These members find fraud unacceptable and favour a firm approach.
Deze leden vinden fraude niet acceptabel en zijn voorstander van een stevige aanpak.
Asks about sanctions for non-cooperation, the treatment of benefit levels when visits are refused, the status of related motions, and the conflict with the data protection regulator.
The PVV members ask what happens if the client does not turn up for the check.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen wat er gebeurt als de cliënt niet komt opdagen voor de controle.

Argues the infringement on private life and the reversal of the burden of proof may be disproportionate and questions the measure's effectiveness, asking for consultation with client councils and unions.
The SP members ask the government to respond to the view that there is disproportionality if a client has no way other than a home-visit offer to prove compliance.

De leden van de SP-fractie verzoeken de regering om een reactie op de stelling dat er van onevenredigheid sprake is als er geen mogelijkheid voor een cliënt is om op een andere wijze dan via het aanbod tot huisbezoek het bewijs te leveren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the nota van wijziging to a bill allowing home visits to verify living situation in social security benefits, raising doubts on necessity and proportionality under Article 8 ECHR and advising changes before submission. The government's nader rapport defends necessity and proportionality, accepts the redactional remarks, and partly adjusts the explanatory note while declining to legally codify an alternative route to proof.
concerns: The Afdeling held that a home visit is disproportionate unless the client can prove the living situation by other means, and the government argued alternatives remain available in practice though it did not add them to the statute.

The Afdeling found the necessity of home visits insufficiently justified, citing unquantified savings and recent CRvB case law; the government maintained necessity and supplemented the explanatory note.
The Afdeling considered the home visit an unjustified interference with the home under Article 8 ECHR; the government argued the regime balances privacy with the public interest in lawful benefits.
The Afdeling gave redactional remarks on wording in the ANW amendment, which the government adopted.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the proposed bill allowing benefit bodies to offer home visits to verify single-person status, and to reduce or end benefits if refused, needs further consideration on necessity and proportionality given the constitutional home right. The government's reply accepts the points partly, supplements the explanatory memorandum, but largely keeps the core of the bill.
concerns: Home visits interfere with the constitutional and ECHR home right; the Afdeling doubts the bill offers sufficient guarantees that its application will be proportionate in individual cases.
The Afdeling finds no demonstrated urgent need, since no savings are expected and the bill's necessity and the effectiveness of home visits are not sufficiently evidenced.
Refusal of a home visit should not automatically lead to benefit consequences where other evidence is available; the bill lacks sufficient safeguards and alternatives are insufficiently considered.
The wording 'aanbod van een huisbezoek' suggests voluntariness that does not match the bill's purpose; a formulation about refusing requested consent is suggested.
The explanatory memorandum should clarify how home visits abroad would be carried out, and two cross-references in the drafting annex are corrected.

31956.s: The bill amends the Kieswet to extend Dutch electoral law to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba as new public bodies within the Netherlands, adding a new section on their elections, including eilandsraad voting rights for non-Dutch residents and Senate elections via the island councils. It also sets special registration deposits, appeal routes to the Gemeenschappelijk Hof, and transitional rules.
31956.j: The memorandum justifies the new arrangements by the geographic distance of the islands from the European Netherlands and the need to align electoral procedures with the new constitutional status, and it notes that a circular will provide guidance.
q: Given the distance, the bill makes electronic transmission of documents possible.
Gelet op de afstand is in het wetsvoorstel de elektronische verzending van stukken mogelijk gemaakt
d: Ya 4 to Ya 9 (ministeriële regeling model begeleidingsverklaring)
model certification form for candidate lists
separate model voter notification card for the public bodies
p: Appeals against electoral decisions for the island councils are routed to the Gemeenschappelijk Hof rather than the Council of State, with procedural adjustments that shorten deadlines for registration disputes.
Compressed timetables for registration decisions and appeals in the first island council election, with the Gemeenschappelijk Hof required to rule within seven days.

parties: Asks whether the Eerste Kamer procedure, which deviates from the Constitution's wording, will remain a one-off exception and whether a constitutional amendment will be proposed.
Can the government give the assurance that this will remain limited to this one exception?
Kan de regering de verzekering geven dat het tot deze ene uitzondering beperkt zal blijven?
Raises the Raad van State's warning about the unreadable statute and about the risk of influencing voters when US polls close later, and asks for justification.
Should not the interests of the users in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba be put first, now that such a far-reaching change of the electoral system is introduced for them?
Moet niet juist het belang van de gebruikers in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba voorop worden gesteld, nu voor hen zo'n ingrijpende verandering van het kiesstelsel wordt ingevoerd?
Favours uniform electoral rules for all voters and asks about the timing of island council elections relative to provincial elections.
The SP members would like as much uniformity as possible in the Kieswet, so that equal rights apply to all voters.
De leden van de SP-fractie zien graag zoveel mogelijk uniformiteit in de Kieswet, zodat voor alle kiezers gelijke rechten gelden.
Has mixed feelings and asks whether identification for proxy voting should be mandatory rather than discretionary to prevent fraud.
Would opting for an obligation not be preferable from the point of view of preventing fraud?
Zou het kiezen voor een verplichting uit een oogpunt van het voorkomen van fraude niet de voorkeur verdienen?
Asks why the required deposit amounts differ between the current Netherlands and the new public bodies.
These members ask to address the difference in amounts, since the aim is to give citizens in the future public bodies and in the current Netherlands the same opportunities.
Deze leden vragen om in te gaan op het verschil in bedragen, daar juist gepoogd wordt om burgers op de toekomstige openbare lichamen en in het huidige Nederland dezelfde mogelijkheden te geven.
Asks about the five-year residence requirement for non-Dutch voters, the weighting of island votes for the Eerste Kamer, and whether proxy voting rules create fraud risk.
Is the risk not great that fraud may arise precisely because the system is not clear to citizens and could be abused?
Is het risico niet groot dat hierdoor juist wel fraude kan ontstaan, omdat het systeem niet duidelijk is voor burgers en daar misbruik van gemaakt kan worden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Kieswet to regulate voting rights for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, supporting its aim but raising objections on Eerste Kamer elections, vote weighting, proxy voting, legislative structure and ballot design. The government's reply accepted some points (e.g., separate vote weighting per island, limiting strict proxy rules to island council elections, adding language information) and rejected others such as the reorganisation of the statute and the Article 55 reading.
concerns: Island council members electing the Eerste Kamer deviates from Article 55 of the Constitution, which requires provincial states; the Raad argues the constitutional provisions on general suffrage must be weighed and the justification must be expanded.
Vote weighting computed for the three islands jointly does not respect proportional representation under Article 53; the Raad advised calculating the weight separately for each public body.
Restrictions on proxy voting apply only to the BES islands, creating unequal voting conditions for the electorate; the Raad advised minimising this inequality.
The chosen legislative technique produces a hard-to-read statute with reconstructed procedures; the Raad advised moving the provisions into the relevant chapters of the Kieswet.
Ballot design should provide voting information in the languages commonly used locally, such as Papiamentu and English.
Appeal provisions referring to the WarBES 'where necessary' by analogy are imprecise; the Raad advised declaring the WarBES directly applicable to the decisions.

31965-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget of the Dutch States General (the parliament), raising its total spending by about 7.9 million euro through a first supplementary budget tied to the Spring Memorandum. The increases go mainly to the Eerste Kamer and Tweede Kamer apparatus, ICT and migration projects, and unforeseen expenditure.
q: The budget statement for the States General for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat inzake de Staten-Generaal voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

31974.s: The bill adds a transitional rule to the Dutch Overgangswet nieuw Burgerlijk Wetboek allowing a person who acted as owner on 1 February 2007 to register the construction of a network and to transfer or encumber it, and lets third-party claims lapse after one year following publication. It also amends the Kadasterwet so that a notary's statement on publication can be registered.
31974.j: The memorandum justifies the rule by legal certainty concerns and the practical difficulty network companies face in proving ownership, and it notes third parties keep their damages claims.
q: A third party who believes it has a better right to the network may summon the owner referred to in paragraph 1 within the one-year lapse period.
Een derde die meent een beter recht te hebben op het netwerk, zal de eigenaar als bedoeld in lid 1 binnen de vervaltermijn van één jaar kunnen dagvaarden

parties: Asks whether the one-year forfeiture period for third-party ownership claims goes too far at the expense of the third party's rights, and how it squares with Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR.
These members ask whether, because of the economic interests involved, the bill does not tilt too far in favour of the person who 'behaved' as owner on 1 February 2007.
Deze leden vragen of het wetsvoorstel vanwege de economische belangen die ermee zijn gemoeid niet teveel overhelt ten faveure van de degene die zich op 1 februari 2007 als eigenaar «gedroeg».
Asks how supply security, monopolies, price increases, maintenance and cost of clean-up of unclaimed networks are safeguarded, including whether the community bears costs.
Is there a chance that network operators, by not registering, simply get rid of their unused networks and shift the clean-up costs onto the community?
Bestaat de kans dat netwerkbeheerders door zich niet aan te melden eenvoudig van hun ongebruikte netwerken afkomen en de kosten voor sanering op de gemeenschap afwentelen?
Asks how third parties' rights to revindicate are protected under the one-year rule, the risk of misuse by the provisional owner, and the limitation period for damages claims.
Has the government taken into account the possible risk of abuse by the provisional owner?
Heeft de regering rekening gehouden met het mogelijke risico op misbruik van de voorlopige eigenaar?

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill on registering networks in the public registers but advises revising the protection of third-party rights in the proposed article 155a(3), arguing the requirement to file a summons before registration and the short time window may be unreasonable. The government's nader rapport declines to follow the main suggestion, arguing the existing arrangement was the result of careful consultation with practice, but accepts the editorial remarks.
concerns: Third parties may be given too little time to file a summons and protect their property rights, and a reasonable period between registration and transfer should be considered, but the government did not follow this suggestion.
Editorial remarks on wording in article 155a(3) and the explanatory memorandum were adopted.

31992.s: The bill replaces Article 243 of Book 7 of the Dutch Civil Code to give tenants a broader right to propose home improvements to landlords, with a court-enforceable obligation for landlords to accept reasonable proposals. It also allows collective proposals by 70% of tenants in complexes of ten or more dwellings and amends Article 305 to refer to energy-saving provisions.
31992.j: The memorandum justifies the new tenant initiative right by noting that the current provision is narrow and that a broader right was found acceptable in surveys of social and private landlords.
q: The bill establishes a tenant initiative right by replacing Article 243 of Book 7 with a new regime that considerably expands tenants' power to make proposals for home improvement.

Het wetsvoorstel regelt een initiatiefrecht van de huurder door artikel 243 van Boek 7 te vervangen door een nieuwe regeling, die de bevoegdheid van huurders om voorstellen ter zake van woningverbetering te doen aanzienlijk uitbreidt.
p: Tenants gain a broader right to propose renovations that landlords must accept or contest, with disputes decided by a court rather than left to landlord discretion.

parties: The CDA asks the government for a more convincing justification that a real problem exists and questions the undefined term 'redelijk' and open-ended grounds for refusal, which could lead to juridification.
The CDA-fractie invites the government to provide a more convincing further justification for the existence of a real problem.
De leden van de CDA-fractie nodigen de regering uit te komen met een meer overtuigende nadere onderbouwing van het bestaan van een reëel probleem.
The PvdA welcomes the enforceability of tenant proposals through the court, which it sees as a check on landlords while noting the bill already takes landlords' interests into account.
The PvdA-fractie considers it right that this bill regulates this enforceability.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vinden het juist dat in dit wetsvoorstel deze afdwingbaarheid geregeld wordt.

The SP questions the proportionality of the bill, proposes a lighter procedure with a feasibility study, asks for a limited list of refusal grounds, and endorses the government's view that a societal problem justifies legislation.
The SP-fractie wonders whether the bill is balanced, particularly regarding proportionality.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen zich af of het wetsvoorstel evenwichtig is, met name op het punt van proportionaliteit.

The VVD questions whether the initiative right infringes landlords' property rights and investment discretion, asks whether the bill is superfluous, and raises concerns about subjective terms like 'esthetisch' and court-based disputes.
To what extent is the proposed tenant initiative right to be seen as an infringement on landlords' property rights.
In hoeverre is het voorgestelde initiatiefrecht van huurders te beschouwen als een aantasting van het eigendomsrecht van verhuurders.

The ChristenUnie supports a balance between tenant and landlord initiative but asks why grounds for refusal are non-exhaustive and whether tenants can realistically prepare the required renovation proposals.
These members consider it a good thing that there is a balance between the possibilities for initiative by tenants and landlords.
Deze leden vinden het een goede zaak dat er een balans is tussen de mogelijkheden tot initiatief van huurders en verhuurders.
Questions whether the bill addresses a real problem and calls it regulation of property that may infringe landlords' ownership rights, since voluntary arrangements already exist.
They also question to what extent there is actually a problem that this bill addresses.
Ook vragen zij zich af in hoeverre er nu daadwerkelijk sprake is van een probleem dat met dit wetsvoorstel wordt verholpen.
Asks how many initiatives have been or will be made, how many would reach the judge, who bears legal costs, and whether the non-exhaustive list of refusal grounds gives landlords too much room.
Does the government share the PVV members' view that landlords thereby gain more grounds to reject renovation proposals?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de PVV-fractie dat verhuurders hierdoor meer gronden krijgen om renovatievoorstellen af te wijzen?
Asks how the rent increase is determined and what the burden on tenants is in preparing renovation proposals, and whether tenants can realistically gather the necessary information.
Does the government consider tenants sufficiently able to gather the information needed for a renovation proposal?
Acht de regering de huurders in voldoende mate in staat om de benodigde informatie voor een renovatievoorstel te vergaren?

Questions the proportionality of extending the initiative right to purely comfort-enhancing renovations, which may not justify infringing landlords' property rights, and warns of legal uncertainty and juridification; asks why the bill was not postponed pending experience with the 2007 extension.
They ask to what extent the government recognises tenants' responsibility to look for alternatives on the market when their living comfort does not match their wishes.
Zij vragen in hoeverre de regering de verantwoordelijkheid van huurders erkent om op de markt te zoeken naar alternatieven wanneer het woon genot niet aansluit bij hun wensen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill giving tenants a right to propose renovations enforceable in court was insufficiently motivated: the need for the measure, the representativeness of the Cebeon study, the effects on private landlords and the vague term 'voorschriften van de overheid' required further justification and revision. The government's reply largely accepted these remarks by adding requirements for the tenant's proposal, clarifying the policy-law terms and the enforceability wording, while rejecting the claim that the Cebeon study was unconvincing and rejecting the proposed rewording of the enforcement provision.
concerns: The Raad doubted that a real problem existed justifying an enforceable renovation right; the government maintained the limits of the existing rule and added explanation to the memorie van toelichting.
The proposal lacked clarity on what a reasonable tenant proposal contains, placing the burden on the landlord; the government added content requirements for the tenant's proposal to article 243(2).
The Raad found the Cebeon study unrepresentative and its effects on private landlords and rental housing availability unaddressed; the government rejected this and did not amend the bill.
The term 'voorschrift van de overheid' and 'afspraken met de overheid' were unclear; the explanatory memorandum was amended to clarify their meaning.
The Raad preferred the existing wording of article 7:243 on enforceability; the government kept the 'gebondenheid' wording, explaining it in the explanatory memorandum.

32289.s: The bill amends the Railways Act, the Passenger Transport Act 2000 and the Economic Offences Act to implement EU railway directives on safety, interoperability, locomotive driver certification and cross-border passenger transport. It shifts many technical and procedural rules to ministerial regulations and general administrative orders, while also adding licensing, certification and cross-border rail transport oversight by the NMa and the Minister.
32289.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to implement detailed technical EU directive requirements and to allow quick adjustments and exemptions, referring to the directives' flexibility provisions.
q: The bill has no consequences for administrative burden for businesses regarding the implementation of the Interoperability Directive.
Het wetsontwerp heeft voor wat betreft de implementatie van de Interoperabiliteitsrichtlijn geen gevolgen voor de AL voor het bedrijfsleven.
d: Artikel I, D (art. 8, lid 2 onder b-d, lid 6 Spoorwegwet)
conditions for putting new railway lines into service and exemptions
rules on EC verification certificates and vehicle authorisation
priority criteria for capacity allocation with subdelegation to ministerial regulation
data required for registration and deregistration of rolling stock
licence and certificate rules for train drivers
rules for recognition of training institutes
exemption from licensing requirements under EU directives
Artikel II, C (art. 19 lid 6-7 Wet personenvervoer 2000)
criteria for main purpose and economic balance of cross-border rail services
designation of notified bodies by the Minister on request
p: Artikel I, D (art. 8 lid 3 en 6 Spoorwegwet)
The Minister may exempt new railway lines from interoperability technical specifications on request, with conditions set by ministerial regulation.
The Minister may waive technical specifications for upgrades or renewals on grounds broader than the directive's listed grounds, referring to art. 20 of the directive.
Priority rules for capacity allocation on overloaded lines can be set by ministerial regulation, allowing quick adjustments favouring rail freight or regional passenger transport.
Artikel II, C en D (art. 19 lid 5-7, art. 19a Wet personenvervoer 2000)
The competition authority NMa decides on cross-border passenger rail exemptions from concession requirements, and the Minister may impose route restrictions by regulation.
The Minister designates notified and inspection bodies on request, using annexes of the directive as criteria.

parties: Asks whether the government goes beyond what the directives require and why it deviates from them on driver age and psychological fitness requirements, and asks for justification of ministerial rule-making scope.
These members ask why the government, when introducing driver licences, goes further than the directive prescribes, regarding both age requirements and psychological fitness requirements.

Machinistenrichtlijn De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom de regering bij de invoering van de machinistenvergunningen verder gaat dan de richtlijn voorschrijft, ten aanzien van zowel leeftijdseisen als eisen rond psychologische geschiktheid.

Asks whether the minister's ministerial regulation power to admit other carriers on new track is a change from current powers, and whether safety standards will not be lowered by recognising other member states' drivers.
Furthermore, they ask whether the government can guarantee that no lower safety requirements will be applied than those currently in force in the Netherlands.
Verder vragen zij of de regering kan garanderen dat op het gebied van veiligheid geen lagere eisen worden gesteld dan de momenteel in Nederland geldende eisen.

Worries that EU minimum safety criteria are lower than Dutch standards, risking a downward spiral in safety and employment conditions, and that foreign drivers may displace Dutch workers under CAO terms.
However, the European minimum criteria are lower in terms of safety than the criteria the Netherlands sets.
De Europese minimumcriteria liggen echter qua veiligheid lager dan de criteria die Nederland stelt.
Supports liberalisation and extra competition, opposes restrictions on cabotage, and asks how far the minimum requirements differ from current Dutch rules.
These members are of the opinion that any restrictions on cabotage transport are not desirable.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat eventuele beperkingen van cabotagevervoer niet gewenst zijn.

Asks what the liberalisation means concretely for short cross-border rail services and coupling of cross-border and domestic services, and requests justification of the rules from the passenger's perspective.
These members request further justification of the proposed rules from the perspective of the passenger.
Deze leden vragen om een nadere onderbouwing van de voorgestelde regels vanuit het perspectief van de reiziger.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill implementing four EU railway directives, raising objections on the hierarchy of EU rules, the driver licence register lacking a statutory basis for special personal data, and the justification of administrative fine levels. The government followed the main advice, deleting the hierarchy provision and adding a statutory basis for the register, and supplemented the explanatory memorandum on fines.
concerns: The Afdeling said the hierarchy provision in article 6(4) of the Spoorwegwet was unnecessary and not a correct implementation, and advised deleting it; the government deleted it.

The Afdeling said the driver licence register may contain special personal data requiring a statutory basis under article 10 of the Constitution and the Wbp; the government added a statutory basis and explained the safeguards.
The Afdeling argued that keeping the register is an EU obligation not fulfilled by factual conduct and needs a legal basis; the government accepted this.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to justify the chosen amounts of administrative fines per provision; the government supplemented the memorandum.
The Afdeling offered a list of editorial comments on the articles, which the government adopted.

32379.s: The bill amends the Dutch Meteorological Institute (KNMI) Act to allow the KNMI to provide meteorological information to decentralised authorities only when public order or safety is at stake, at full cost, and to set general weather-bulletin rules by ministerial regulation. It also restructures the KNMI supervisory council and creates a new programme council, with membership and operating rules delegated to ministerial regulation.
32379.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying they make regulation more flexible so changes can be made quickly to keep pace with technological developments and market needs.
q: The revised description of the general weather bulletin combined with the delegation basis makes the regulation more flexible.
De aangepaste omschrijving van het algemeen weerbericht in combinatie met de delegatiegrondslag maakt de regelgeving flexibeler
d: manner of making general weather bulletin available and its content
rules on costs and separate accounting for meteorological information to decentralised authorities
rules on costs and accounting for research commissioned by third parties
composition, functioning and appointment rules of KNMI supervisory council
functioning, composition and appointment rules of KNMI programme council
p: Composition of the KNMI supervisory council moves from statute to ministerial regulation, while appointment and dismissal grounds remain in the law.
Formalises a programme council that steers KNMI implementation within frameworks set by ministerial regulation.

parties: Opposes the proposed amendments and argues that KNMI should perform only tasks serving the public interest, with others transferred to private parties.
Asks whether technological developments could lead to a reallocation of tasks between KNMI and private parties while safeguarding public safety interests.
These members ask whether technological developments could lead to a reallocation of tasks between KNMI and private parties in the short term.
Deze leden vragen of de technologische ontwikkelingen niet op korte termijn tot een herschikking van taken tussen het KNMI en de private partijen kunnen leiden.
Asks for information on the number of private weather firms, the necessity of the general forecast, and the parties involved in regional weather alerts.

Asks how the basis for providing meteorological information to decentralised authorities clarifies responsibilities, and whether the KNMI will consult other meteorological firms before issuing alerts and whether the cost price and financing are secured in law.

The SP members ask whether the proposed basis for providing meteorological information to decentralised authorities on request provides the intended clarity on the separation of responsibilities between KNMI and market parties.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de voorgestelde grondslag voor het op verzoek verstrekken van meteorologische inlichtingen aan decentrale overheden wel de beoogde duidelijkheid oplevert voor de scheiding van verantwoordelijkheden van KNMI en marktpartijen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill amending the KNMI Act following its evaluation, objecting to delegating the content and availability of the general weather forecast to ministerial regulation, asking for clarity on exclusive responsibility for extreme weather warnings, decentralised authorities' access to meteorological information, and conflict of interest in the KNMI Programme Council. The minister's reply largely accepts the advice by restoring the core rules in the Act, adding justification and clarifications, and inserting cost-allocation and separate-accounting principles into the statute.
concerns: The Afdeling objects to delegating the content and availability of the general weather forecast to ministerial regulation and advises keeping the core rules in the Act; the minister restores the scope in the statute but keeps availability details for ministerial regulation.

The Afdeling asks for clarification of what exclusive governmental responsibility for extreme weather warnings means and why it is not anchored in law; the minister adds justification and protocol references to the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum be made consistent with article 8c on information provided to decentralised authorities, which the minister does.

The Afdeling flags possible conflict of interest and competition-law issues from private weather bureaus sitting on the Programme Council and market-division effects; the minister adds explanatory passages addressing these.
Redactional comments are largely adopted, including merging provisions on decentralised authorities and amending the title and cost-allocation rules.

32397.s: The bill clarifies and simplifies the rules on workplace risk inventory and evaluation under the Working Conditions Act, allowing employees access to the risk inventory and easing the model-and-instrument route for small firms. It also removes article 34(7) and article 40 of that Act and replaces a term in the Minimum Wage Act with 'overtreding'.
q: it is desirable to clarify and simplify the provisions on risk inventory and evaluation to improve compliance and reduce administrative burdens
het wenselijk is de bepalingen met betrekking tot de risico inventarisatie en evaluatie te verduidelijken en te vereenvoudigen om de naleving te verbeteren en de administratieve lasten te verminderen
d: ARTIKEL I B (artikel 14, twaalfde lid, onderdeel b, 1°-2°)
models and instruments for risk inventory and evaluation

parties: Asks about expected compliance rates for small firms, budgetary consequences, Arbeidsinspectie implementation costs and whether the law will be evaluated.
Does the government intend to evaluate the operation of this law in due course?
Is de regering voornemens de werking van deze wet op termijn te evalueren?

Supports reinstating the duty to inform workers and reducing burdens but asks how success is measured, how enforcement of RI&E duties works in practice, and whether the burden-reduction calculation assumes unrealistic coverage.
They consider it important to work on reducing administrative burdens for small firms, but believe this must not lead to worse working conditions.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vinden het belangrijk dat er werk wordt gemaakt van het terugdringen van administratieve lasten van kleine bedrijven, maar vinden dat dat niet mag leiden tot verslechterde arbeidsomstandigheden.

32469.s: The bill amends the Meststoffenwet to reinstate restrictions on transferring livestock production rights between concentration areas and non-concentration areas, primarily to manage manure surpluses for environmental reasons. It adds transitional provisions that apply the restrictions retroactively from 23 April 2010 and bars moving pig, poultry or turkey farming into concentration areas after 22 April 2010.
32469.j: The memorandum justifies the reinstated restrictions by the environmental effects of manure surplus and the need for efficient manure disposal, and notes the government is examining alternative instruments to steer total manure production.
q: the importance of efficient disposal of manure surpluses, given the environmental effects of this surplus
het belang van een doelmatige afvoer van mestoverschotten, in verband met de effecten van dit overschot op het milieu

parties: Supports the bill but asks the government to explain whether her度 expansion involved actual animal places or only paper production rights and where manure is being disposed of illegally.
The VVD members are curious whether this actually involved an expansion of animal places or whether it concerns paper production or animal rights.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn benieuwd of dit daadwerkelijk ook uitbreiding van dierplaatsen is geweest of dat het om papieren productie- c.q. dierrechten gaat.
Supports the bill and asks whether the law can be tightened to reduce animal rights in concentration areas near Natura 2000 sites and whether rights movements should be monitored.
Finally, the PvdA members would like to see the movement of animal rights to and from concentration areas monitored, so that intervention can be timely if concentrations recur in vulnerable areas.

Tot slot zouden de leden van de PvdA-fractie graag zien dat de beweging van dierrechten van en naar concentratiegebieden wordt gemonitord, zodat in geval van opnieuw voorkomende concentraties in kwetsbare gebieden tijdig ingegrepen kan worden.

Opposes reintroducing the old compartmentalisation as it does not solve the mega-stables problem, asks for an overview of compartment models and their effects per province, and presses for a delayed manure-processing incentive.
The CDA members are not against compartmentalisation, but are against the proposal to reintroduce the 'old' compartmentalisation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn niet tegen compartimentering, maar wel tegen het voorstel om de «oude» compartimentering opnieuw in te voeren.
Welcomes the bill as a step in the right direction but thinks it may not go far enough and asks how the extra environmental pressure and fraud will be addressed.
The question is whether it goes far enough.
