De vraag is of het ver genoeg gaat.
Asks about consequences for individual entrepreneurs, whether environmental pressure is merely spread out, and whether Natura 2000 goals were considered.
Can the government explain exactly what the reduction in environmental pressure looks like?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe de verlaging van de milieudruk er precies uitziet?
Supports reintroduction but misses the promised incentive for manure processing and asks the government to send it, with an evaluation of pilot projects, within three months.
The SGP members support reintroducing compartmentalisation, but miss the elaboration of the aforementioned incentive.
De leden van de SGP-fractie steunen de herinvoering van de compartimentering, maar missen de uitwerking van de hiervoor genoemde prikkel.
Doubts the bill will suffice, asks many questions about manure surpluses, inspection results showing 74 of 108 farms over their rights, sanctions, and the need to regulate manure after 2015.
Is the government willing, with an amendment note to the present proposal, to remove the expiry term of animal rights from the Fertiliser Act?
Is de regering bereid met een nota van wijziging bij het voorliggende voorstel de vervaltermijn van de dierrechten uit de Meststoffenwet te halen?
Asks whether transferring production rights from the southern compartment to the eastern and other compartments can be made simpler and less administratively burdensome.
The VVD members see that even temporarily transferring production rights from South to East and Other is accompanied by a great many administrative steps.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zien dat het eventueel zelfs tijdelijk overhevelen van productierechten van Zuid naar Oost en Overig met heel veel administratieve handelingen gepaard gaat.

Questions the justification for reintroducing compartmentalisation, the imbalance it creates, and the retroactive effect of the bill, which it argues conflicts with legal certainty and past Eerste Kamer positions.

Furthermore, the CDA members note that the Eerste Kamer has argued many times in the past that retroactive effect of bills after adoption by parliament conflicts with the foundations of the rule of law.

Verder merken de leden van de CDA-fractie op dat de Eerste Kamer al vele keren in het verleden heeft betoogd dat een terugwerkende kracht van wetsvoorstellen na aanname door het parlement in strijd is met de fundamenten van de rechtstaat.

32565-V.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statements of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the CBI agency, reflecting the autumn budget review (Najaarsnota). It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and specifies the entry-into-force date of 1 December 2010.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for 2010 is amended
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd

32577.s: The bill approves for the Netherlands the Stabilisation and Association Agreement concluded on 29 April 2008 between the European Communities and their member states and the Republic of Serbia, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
32577.j: The memorandum justifies the suspension mechanism as a response to insufficient administrative cooperation, irregularities or fraud, mirroring EU coordination rules.
q: When insufficient administrative cooperation has been provided and/or irregularities or cases of fraud have occurred, the preferential arrangement may be temporarily suspended.
Wanneer onvoldoende administratieve samenwerking is verleend en/of onregelmatigheden of gevallen van fraude zijn voorgevallen, kan de preferentiële regeling tijdelijk worden opgeschort.
d: suspension of preferential treatment for administrative cooperation failures or fraud
Stabilisation and Association Council rules on export of social insurance benefits
p: Temporary suspension of preferential treatment is permitted where administrative cooperation is insufficient or fraud occurs, giving the executive discretion to act.

parties: Asks how implementation of the agreement will be monitored and what consequences follow if essential obligations such as human rights and rule of law are not met.
In what ways will the implementation of the association agreement be checked and what happens if that check turns out negatively?
Op welke manieren wordt de invoering van de associatieovereenkomst getoetst en wat gebeurt er wanneer deze toets negatief zal uitvallen?
Welcomes the bill as marking full cooperation with the ICTY and sees no reason for further questions.
That this bill is now before us means that full cooperation with the Yugoslavia tribunal is a fact.
Dat dit wetsvoorstel nu voorligt betekent dat de volledige samenwerking met het Joegoslavië tribunaal een feit is.
Doubts Serbia meets the rule-of-law and minority rights criteria and argues ratification is premature.
How can there be respect for human rights and minority rights if the police cannot protect participants against violence?
Hoe kan er sprake zijn van de eerbiediging van mensenrechten en rechten van minderheden als de politie niet in staat is om de deelnemers tegen geweld te beschermen?
Asks whether suspension clauses exist if ICTY cooperation lapses and how continued cooperation, witness protection and a political dialogue framework will be guaranteed.
Are clauses built into the SAO so that the agreement does not enter into force or can be partly frozen if the ICTY prosecutor indicates there is no longer full cooperation with the ICTY?

Zijn er in de SAO clausules ingebouwd waardoor de overeenkomst niet in werking treedt of gedeeltelijk kan worden bevroren indien de aanklager van het ICTY aangeeft dat er geen sprake meer is van volledige coöperatie met het ICTY?
Insists on strict compliance with EU criteria, asks whether satisfactory ICTY cooperation remains a condition, and questions the sequencing of the Commission's opinion relative to entry into force.
Does the government share the view of these members that it would be logical to first await full entry into force of the SAO before considering granting candidate membership?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat het logisch zou zijn om eerst het volledig in werking treden van het SAO af te wachten alvorens te overwegen het kandidaat-lidmaatschap te verlenen?

32586.s: The bill amends the Housing Consultation Act (Overlegwet huurders verhuurder) and the Housing Rent Prices Implementation Act so that disputes under the consultation act can be brought before the rent commission (huurcommissie) as well as the cantonal judge. The rent commission may issue findings, suspend landlord policy in limited cases, and set fees, with decisions binding parties unless challenged in court within eight weeks.
32586.j: The memorandum justifies the new rent commission route as a lower-threshold, cheaper alternative to the cantonal judge, and leaves policy details to delegated rules on fees and hearing locations.
q: The number of disputes under the Consultation Act brought before the cantonal judge has so far been relatively small.
Het aantal geschillen met betrekking tot de Overlegwet dat bij de kantonrechter aanhangig wordt gemaakt, is tot nog toe relatief gering.
d: amount of fee for commission rulings on consultation disputes
cases in which chair may grant fee exemption
board designates hearing locations via bestuursreglement
p: The rent commission may order suspension of landlord policy or block implementation of a decision departing from tenant or residents' advice, subject to the landlord's failure to justify the departure.](The bill gives a quasi-judicial body new tools against landlords, a limited shift in favour of tenant protection rather than executive power.)
Sets an eight-week decision deadline for consultation disputes, a procedural rule without power transfer.

parties: Supports low-threshold enforceability of tenant rights, arguing that the rent commission can review substance and weigh interests, unlike the costly court route.
These members find it of great importance that the rights of tenants and tenant organisations are enforceable in a low-threshold manner.
Deze leden vinden het van groot belang dat de rechten van huurders en huurdersorganisaties op een laagdrempelige wijze afdwingbaar zijn.
Asks about the number of court cases under the Overlegwet, expected growth in disputes, how tenants will be informed, and the costs to the state budget.
The PVV members ask what costs are involved in the total implementation of dispute resolution under the Overlegwet and the Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte.
Deze leden vragen zich daarom af welke kosten gemoeid zijn met de totale uitvoering van geschillenbeslechting in de zin van de Overlegwet en de Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte.

Supports accessible dispute resolution but asks whether the committee may review the legitimacy of recognised tenant bodies and raises concern about landlord influence through direct funding, proposing an independent fund.
The SP members are of the opinion that tenant representatives who are disregarded in their position must be able to obtain their right in a simple, low-threshold and affordable way.

De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat vertegenwoordigers van huurders die miskend worden in hun positie op een eenvou dige, laagdrempelige en betaalbare manier hun gelijk moeten kunnen behalen.

32658.s: The bill amends the Visserijwet 1963 to give the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation power to impose administrative measures, including a fishing ban, on fish contaminated with harmful substances or at risk of contamination, in agreement with the Minister of Health. It makes violations economic offences and provides a transitional arrangement linking the power to the future Wet dieren.
32658.j: The memorandum justifies the power by risks to public health that exceed voluntary fishing halts or private certification, and by the need for swift, differentiated action pending the Wet dieren.
q: These risks exceed the possibilities of the initiatives shown so far of voluntary fishing halts or private certification.
Deze risico's overstijgen de mogelijkheden van de tot nu toe getoonde initiatieven van vrijwillige staking van de visserij of private certificering.
d: administrative measures including fishing ban for contaminated fish
conditions and restrictions attached to measures
rules on implementation, exemptions and research exemptions
p: The minister may impose fishing and possession bans on specified fish species, individually or generally, for all or parts of the Netherlands, when a serious health risk is suspected.
Measures must be taken in agreement with the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport.
Measures under art. 54c are transferred to the Wet dieren and art. 54c is repealed upon its entry into force, with transitional provisions preserving earlier measures.

parties: Asks about financial effects on fishers who share gear for eel and wolhandkrab, and about continuing the controleovereenkomst approach.
The members of the VVD faction have a number of questions regarding the consequences of the proposed amendments.
Er bestaan bij de leden van de VVD-fractie een aantal vragen met betrekking tot de gevolgen van de voorgestelde wijzigingen.
Questions whether the Minister of VWS, responsible for public health, is involved and asks for cooperation given the consumer-protection focus of the Jacobi motion.
Is the Minister of VWS involved in the measures to be taken? If not, why not?
Is de minister van VWS betrokken bij de te nemen maatregelen? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Supports the bill while stressing individual responsibility of fishers and traders, and asks how water and soil quality is monitored and what policy follows from improvement.
Therefore, although the CDA members oppose higher administrative burdens and extra regulatory pressure, the bill can count on the CDA members' support.
Daarom kan, hoewel de leden van de CDA-fractie tegen verhoging administratieve lasten en extra regeldruk zijn, het voorliggend wetsvoorstel op steun van de leden van de CDA-fractie rekenen.

Asks why the state State Secretary rather than the health minister signed, questions the government's past tolerance of pollution and the granting of fishing rights in known contaminated waters, and asks about compensation and bankruptcies.
Why did the government issue fishing rights for areas it knew were unsuitable for fishing due to dioxin pollution?
Waarom heeft de regering visrechten uitgegeven voor gebieden waarvan zij wist dat deze wegens dioxinevervuiling ongeschikt waren om te vissen?

Supports the health aim but questions the proportionality of a far-reaching ban where contamination is not certain, asks for a justified norm and for a clear compensation standard for affected fishers.

Imposing a catch ban can be effective, but according to these members it is also a far-reaching measure in cases where it cannot be stated with certainty that the eel (or other fish) exceeds the legal dioxin norm.

Het opleggen van een vangstverbod kan effectief zijn, maar is volgens genoemde leden ook een vergaande maatregel in gevallen waar niet met zekerheid gesteld kan worden dat de paling (of andere vis) met dioxine en andere verontreinigingen boven de wettelijke norm uitkomt.

Insists that emergency legislation be carefully and restrictively designed, questions the breadth of the ban, asks about its geographic scope, criteria and compensation for fishers who did not cause the pollution.
They believe that emergency legislation, even after demonstrated necessity, must be designed carefully and with restraint.
Zij vinden dat gelegenheidswetgeving, ook na aangetoonde noodzaak, zorgvuldig en terughoudend vormgegeven moet worden.
Welcomes the bill and the rapid route to a legal basis, but asks why the Wet dieren wording differs and why the added condition of serious danger was inserted, and what criteria define it.
Why was the phrase 'and thereby may pose a serious danger to humans, animals and the environment' added to article 54c paragraph 1 of this bill?
Waarom is artikel 54c lid 1 van de voorliggende wet de zin «en daarmee een ernstig gevaar voor mens, dier en milieu kan opleveren» toegevoegd?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the aim of a temporary bill giving the minister of EL&I power to impose administrative measures such as a ban on catching dioxin-contaminated eels, but asks for better justification of necessity, EU free-movement compatibility, enforcement, placement in the Visserijwet, avoidance of double criminalisation, and drafting. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks by amending the explanatory memorandum and bill, while declining to move the provision to chapter V and rejecting one drafting remark.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must justify why a catch ban is needed now, why existing Warenwet enforcement is insufficient, and what EU aal-plan options exist.
The bans must be shown compatible with the prohibition on quantitative export restrictions in Article 35 TFEU, justified on public health grounds.
Enforcement and supervision of the bans, including disposal of illegally caught stock, must be explained in the memorandum.
The provision should be placed under chapter V paragraph 3 of the Visserijwet, which the government declined in favour of chapter VI.
Double criminalisation of the same conduct as common offence and under the Wet op de economische delicten should be removed.
Several editorial remarks on the wording of articles 54c and the reference to feeding and consumption risks were adopted, except one clarification that was rejected.

32667.s: The bill amends the Dutch Environmental Management Act to implement EU rules on greenhouse gas emission allowance trading for phase III (2013-2020), including auctioning, free allocation via a national allocation decision, monitoring and verification, and legal remedies. It also makes related changes to the Economic Offences Act and transitional provisions.
32667.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations mainly by the technical, detailed and changing nature of the rules and the need for flexibility, as well as the need to implement EU regulations.
q: By ministerial regulation, rules are laid down to implement this section concerning notification to the emissions authority of
Bij ministeriële regeling worden ter uitvoering van deze paragraaf regels gesteld met betrekking tot het melden aan het bestuur van de emissieautoriteit van
d: reporting and approval of changes to monitoring plan
rules on free allocation and calculation of allowances
amendment or withdrawal of allocation decisions; recovery of allowances
determining average market price of allowances
p: The executive may amend, supplement or attach new conditions to permits when it deems this necessary for the functioning of the trading system.

Allocation decisions may be amended or withdrawn with retroactive effect, and the executive is excluded from the usual public-participation procedure in certain cases, with appeal to the administrative court retained.
Discretionary power to recover unduly granted allowances, offset them against future allocations, and collect by enforcement order, with an eight-year limitation period.
The start of the appeal period for national allocation decisions is set differently from the general rule, delaying the point at which challenges can be made.

parties: Asks how the harmonised EU cap affects Dutch competitiveness compared with the old system and international systems.
But what does this harmonised European situation mean for our competitive position?
Maar wat betekent deze geharmoniseerde Europese situatie voor onze concurrentiepositie?
Asks whether free allocation is fixed for the whole period or updated annually, and what the auction revenues will amount to.
Are the free allocated rights set for the entire period or adjusted annually based on more recent figures (2009 onwards)?
Worden de kosteloos toegewezen rechten voor de gehele periode vastgesteld of worden ze jaarlijks aangepast en wel op basis van recentere cijfers (2009 en verder)?

Asks whether the Netherlands retains influence over Commission decisions and whether appeal is possible; also wants the EU not to impose the 50% auction-revenue recommendation and asks for protection against distortion of the level playing field.
The question from the CDA members is to what extent the Netherlands as a member state still has authority over the Commission's decisions.
De vraag van de leden van de CDA-fractie is in hoeverre Nederland als lidstaat nog zeggenschap heeft over de besluiten van de Commissie.
Considers the 50% auction-revenue earmark too low and the purpose too vague, and asks how premature sale of rights by companies closing down will be prevented.
As far as the SP members are concerned, this is too low a percentage and the purpose of the spending is still described very vaguely.
Wat de leden van de SP-fractie betreft is dit een te laag percentage en is het doel van de besteding nog erg vaag omschreven.

Questions whether the bill conflicts with the letter and spirit of the Directive by not earmarking auction revenues, following the Council of State's doubts, and asks for an overview of other member states' implementation; also questions the broad ministerial discretion to make rules on auctions and newcomers by ministerial regulation rather than by general administrative measure.
These members share this doubt for now, and ask whether the bill, based on the chosen wording, does not conflict with both the letter and spirit of the European directive.
Deze leden delen vooralsnog deze twijfel, en vragen of het wetsvoorstel op basis van de gekozen formulering niet strijdig is met zowel letter als geest van de Europese richtlijn.
Only states that it has taken note of the bill in its introductory remarks.
The ChristenUnie members have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill implementing EU Directive 2009/29 on the EU ETS but raises objections on the use of auction revenues and on the recovery and offsetting of wrongly issued allowances, advising adaptation of the bill. The government's reply accepts the points on the non-binding nature of auction revenue use and on valuation and adds clarifications, while defending the discretionary offsetting mechanism as a technical measure.
concerns: The Council doubts that Article 10(3) of the Directive is merely non-binding and advises explaining the nature of the obligations and how they can be met now and in future; the government added a passage to the explanatory memorandum but maintained the revenues are not earmarked under Dutch budgeting.

The Council asks how the value of wrongly issued emission allowances is determined for recovery under Article 16.35c; the government now uses the average market price at the time of recovery, with further criteria to be set by ministerial regulation.

The Council notes offsetting against future allocations may act as a sanction or confer a benefit depending on price movements and asks whether this was intended; the government defends the offsetting as a technical correction and clarifies the explanatory memorandum.

The Council asks whether the operator may request use of a particular power and under what conditions the authority may agree; the government says the general principles of good administration apply and clarifies the wording.
Redactional comments on the withdrawal of permits, the scope of recovery powers, and cross-references in Article 16.1 were adopted in the bill, with one suggestion not followed.

32676.s: The bill amends the Bibob Act to extend integrity screening (Bibob advice) to public-law and private-law dealings, including real estate transactions, gaming licences, environmental permits and Kwalibo recognition, and to allow the Bureau Bibob to share more information with administrative bodies and the public prosecutor. It also amends the Gaming Act, the Judicial and Criminal Procedure Data Act and the Environmental Management Act to match, and requires an evaluation report within five years.
32676.j: The memorandum justifies the extensions by the need for expert support for administrative bodies, a better quality of Bibob advice, proportionality and subsidiarity, and the reduced burden of information-gathering compared with requesting advice.
q: The proposed extension of the power to provide information to RIECs, the triangle, the quality committee, the public prosecution service and other administrative bodies cooperating regionally is necessary for more expert use of the Bibob instruments by the administration.

De voorgestelde uitbreiding van de verstrekkingsbevoegdheid aan RIEC's, driehoek, kwaliteitscommissie, openbaar ministerie en andere bestuursorganen waarmee in regionaal verband wordt samengewerkt is noodzakelijk voor enerzijds een deskundiger gebruik van het Bibob-instrumentarium door het bestuur
d: designating autonomous administrative bodies as legal persons with a public task
further rules set by ministerial regulation under the Bibob Act
ARTIKEL I, I.2 (art. 9 lid 3-4) / ARTIKEL IV (Wet milieubeheer, art. 9.2.2.3 lid 2 onder b and lid 6 onder b)
permit refusal or withdrawal under Bibob conditions where the general administrative order so provides
ARTIKEL I, Q (art. 20) / ARTIKEL I, X.6 (art. 27 lid 6)
data provision and registration rules set by or under general administrative order
p: ARTIKEL I, K (art. 11a) and ARTIKEL I, Z (art. 28)
Administrative bodies may obtain information on whether a person has recently been subject to Bibob advice, widening the information base for permit and contract decisions affecting citizens.
ARTIKEL I, F (art. 5a) and ARTIKEL I, I (art. 9 lid 3)
Public legal persons may request Bibob advice before or during real estate transactions, extending integrity screening into private-law dealings with citizens and firms.
ARTIKEL I, J (art. 11) and ARTIKEL I, Q (art. 20)
The Bureau may pass information to the public prosecutor in more cases, including where no serious danger was found, widening the link between integrity screening and criminal investigation.
Judicial and criminal procedure data may be provided directly to persons or bodies with a public task performing private-law acts, bypassing the closed data regime.
ARTIKEL I, Y (art. 27a) and ARTIKEL I, Z (art. 28 lid 2)

Court judgments and hearing records in administrative cases must be provided to the Bureau on request, and several new recipients may receive Bibob data, including regional cooperation partners and a quality committee.
ARTIKEL I, FF (art. 45); ARTIKEL I, EE (repeal of art. 44)
The minister must report to the States General within five years on the effectiveness of the Bibob Act; the repealed delegation to deviate by lower regulation is removed.

parties: Asks how applicants can check the Bureau Bibob's expertise and impartiality and whether exculpatory facts were used, seeing the advice-access improvement as a rights gain.
They do ask how those involved can check how expertly and impartially the Bureau Bibob works and which information was and was not used.
Wel vragen zij hoe betrokkenen kunnen controleren hoe deskundig en onbevooroordeeld het Bureau Bibob te werk gaat en welke informatie wel en niet is gebruikt.
Supports the Bibob approach but worries about legal protection of those affected and asks about access to justice records and the scope of information used.
They do, however, have some concerns about the legal protection of those involved.
Wel maken zij zich enigszins zorgen over de rechtsbescherming van betrokkenen.
Asks whether applicants should get a right to inspect their file to contest decisions and whether longer advice periods will harm entrepreneurs.
For the applicant, the justification of the decision may be important.
Voor de aanvrager kan de onderbouwing van het besluit van belang zijn.

Supports the extension but stresses citizens must be able to defend themselves adequately against Bibob-based decisions and asks about tension with confidentiality, plus concern about officials' safety and capacity.
These members attach importance to citizens confronted with Bibob-based decisions being able to defend themselves as adequately as possible.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hechten eraan dat burgers die geconfronteerd worden met op de Wet Bibob gebaseerde besluiten zich hiertegen op een zo adequaat mogelijke wijze kunnen verweren.

Welcomes the Bibob extension but insists applicants get an effective chance to defend themselves; questions whether the advice copy and confidentiality duty sufficiently widen rights and warns of arbitrariness and waterbed effects.
However, the person concerned must be given a fair chance to effectively defend themselves against accusations that in their view have no basis.
Echter, de betrokkene moet een eerlijke kans krijgen zich effectief te kunnen verdedigen tegen aantijgingen die naar zijn/haar mening geen hout snijden.
Remains worried about legal protection given opaque underlying documents, asks about safeguards for staff handling secret information, CBP oversight, and the Groningen liability ruling.
These members note that they remain concerned about legal protection in the Bibob test, particularly because the underlying documents and data are poorly transparent.
Deze leden merken op dat zij zich zorgen blijven maken over de rechtsbescherming bij de Bibob-toets, met name vanwege het slecht inzichtelijk zijn van de achterliggende documenten en gegevens.
Asks how the expanded information-sharing regime fits with privacy protection given the previously very strict regime, and why the law's purpose was broadened.
These members ask the government to explain further how this expansion relates to the protection of private life, now that the very strict regime appears to be being relaxed.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten hoe deze uitbreiding zich verhoudt tot de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, nu het zeer stringente regime lijkt te worden losgelaten.

Supports sector expansion but asks whether broadening the purpose makes Bibob powers harder to apply and what evidentiary consequences municipalities face, and asks about inspection scope for third parties.
What consequences are there for the municipal government regarding the evidentiary position?
Welke consequenties zijn er voor het gemeentebestuur voor de bewijspositie?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised substantial reconsideration of the Evaluatiewet BIBOB, criticising the broadening of the Bibob Act's purpose toward criminal prevention, the proposed mayoral closure power, the expanded information sharing, the national register, the wider 'zakelijk samenwerkingsverband' concept and the longer advice period. The government's reply (nader rapport) reports that the advice was largely followed on the purpose broadening, closure power and register, but not followed on the past business partnership extension and the advice period.
concerns: The Afdeling warned that broadening the Bibob purpose toward criminal prevention could bring Article 6 ECHR guarantees into play and weaken legal certainty of Bibob decisions; the government reconsidered and limited the extension.

The Afdeling argued the mayoral closure power for non-licensed premises is a far-reaching measure that lacks necessity and should be limited to sectors with a legal relationship with government; the government largely dropped it.

The Afdeling said the criterion 'bevordering van de leefbaarheid' is too vague and should be limited to nuisance; the government's reply addresses the closure power but the criterion's formulation is only partly adjusted.

The Afdeling objected that the broader information sharing from Bureau Bibob advice ignores the restrictive disclosure regime and privacy protection; the government added clarifications in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling advised that the national register lacks a statutory description, clear rights of data subjects and a maximum retention period; the government adopted a lighter register variant and added a two-year period to the text.

The Afdeling advised tying the extension of the 'zakelijk samenwerkingsverband' concept to past relationships to a time limit, since it is not foreseeable and could catch good-faith former partners; the government did not follow this advice.
The Afdeling advised against extending the Bureau Bibob advice period from four to eight weeks, as it would risk exceeding decision deadlines; the government retained the extension.
The Afdeling questioned the need for a national register and the RIEC's competence to request advice; the government clarified RIEC positions but maintained the register in lighter form.

32694.s: The bill lets the subsidy percentages for the quality discount in the Dutch rent allowance act (Wet op de huurtoeslag) be set by general administrative order (AMvB) instead of in the statute itself. The explanatory memorandum says this allows budget cuts to be implemented without a statute change, with an 8-week parliamentary pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure for the AMvB.
32694.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to decide budget cuts quickly and adjust percentages to the future budget situation without a statute change.
q: by setting those percentages by general administrative order. The aim is to create the possibility of filling in necessary cuts to the rent allowance budget without a statute change

door die percentages bij algemene maatregel van bestuur vast te stellen. De bedoeling hiervan is de mogelijkheid te scheppen om noodzakelijke bezuinigingen op het budget huurtoeslag zonder wetswijziging in te vullen
d: percentage of rent subsidised above quality discount threshold (art. 21(1)(b))
percentage of rent subsidised for quality discount (art. 21(1)(c))
percentage in art. 21(2) tied to art. 21(1)(b) percentage
p: Key subsidy percentages move from statute to executive decree, letting the government change the quality discount without a law, though an 8-week voorhang procedure gives parliament a say.

parties: Accepts the AMvB route because of the voorhang procedure, but asks whether a new AMvB with current percentages is needed after the statute changes and when and how far the percentages will rise.
The House is therefore given the opportunity to express its view on the level of the quality discount.
De Kamer krijgt dus de gelegenheid om zich uit te spreken over de hoogte van de kwaliteitskorting.
Warns that raising the quality-discount percentages is a far-reaching change that will seriously increase housing costs for the lowest-income tenants, and asks for data on net rent ratios.

These members believe that raising the quality-discount percentages is a far-reaching structural change to the housing allowance with major consequences for the housing costs of tenants with the lowest incomes living in more expensive rental homes.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat verhoging van de kwaliteitskortingspercentages een ingrijpende stelselwijziging van de huurtoeslag is en dat dit grote gevolgen heeft voor de woonlasten van huurders met de laagste inkomens die in een duurdere huurwoning wonen.
Asks whether easier amendment by AMvB justifies limiting the House's influence, whether new percentages apply to sitting tenants, and how the changes are substantiated.
The PVV members ask whether the easier amendment of the percentages through a general administrative order justifies limiting the House's right to participate.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of het makkelijker kunnen wijzigen van de percentages via een algemene maatregel van bestuur de beperking van de inspraak van de Kamer rechtvaardigt.

Understands the government's wish for flexibility to make savings, but warns a generic discount could fall disproportionately on elderly and disabled people in adapted homes with no alternative housing.
A generic discount, as the proposed measure intends, may affect this group disproportionately.
Een generieke korting, zoals via de voorgestelde maatregel beoogt, treft deze groep mogelijk onevenredig.
Opposes the bill, arguing that the vulnerable group relying on the allowance needs statutory protection against political whims, budget mechanics and government arbitrariness.

These members believe that precisely this vulnerable group dependent on the housing allowance must be protected on a statutory basis against political whims, the blunt axe of budgetary systematics and government arbitrariness.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat juist deze kwetsbare groep mensen die afhankelijk is van huurtoeslag op wettelijke basis moet worden beschermd tegen politieke grillen, de botte bijl van de begrotingssystematiek en willekeur van de regering.

Accepts easier adjustment of the percentages but finds frequent large changes uncertain for recipients, and therefore values the eight-week voorhang procedure and asks about limiting changes to once a year.

However, these members find it undesirable that this change leads to a great deal of uncertainty for recipients of the housing allowance, because the percentages could be adjusted too often and in large steps.

Deze leden vinden het echter onwenselijk dat deze wijziging leidt tot een grote mate van onzekerheid voor de ontvangers van huurtoeslag, doordat de percentages te vaak en met grote stappen kunnen worden aangepast.

Notes the bill is driven by the government's wish to fill budget cuts without statutory change and asks about effects on the care of decision-making, the criteria for changes, and tenants' legal certainty.
Can the government make clear what influence this statutory amendment has on the care taken in the decision-making process?
Kan de regering inzichtelijk maken wat voor invloed deze wetswijziging heeft op de zorgvuldigheid van het besluitvormingsproces?
Asks what considerations led to fixing the percentages in statute in the past and whether legal certainty was weighed alongside the wish for flexibility.
These members ask to what extent, alongside the wish to make changes more easily and flexibly, the importance of legal certainty has also been weighed.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre naast de wens om gemakkelijker en flexibeler wijzigingen te kunnen doorvoeren ook het belang van rechtszekerheid is meegewogen.

32766.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to let the RDW set vehicle emission classes, allow type approval and a recognition scheme for in-fitted vehicle components not required for road admission, and enable a maximum fee for driving licences by general administrative order. It also makes violation of the new recognition-impersonation ban punishable by a third-category fine.
32766.j: The memorandum justifies the RDW's emission-class power by the need for a classification for the planned 2013 milieuzone for vans and by missing emission data for older vehicles, and justifies the recognition scheme as flexibility to act quickly when needed.
q: The determination of emission classes is not a decision within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act, because it is not aimed at a legal effect.
De vaststelling van de emissieklassen is geen besluit in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht, omdat deze vaststelling niet gericht is op een rechtsgevolg.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 35b, lid 1 and 5)
categories of vehicles subject to emission classes and detailed rules on classification
categories of vehicle components eligible for type approval without road-admission requirement
Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 92, lid 1 and 3)
categories of components that recognised firms may fit into vehicles
Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 92, lid 3; artikel 93, lid 2; artikel 94, lid 3; artikel 95, lid 4)
conditions attached to recognition, application rules, inspection sampling and revocation procedures
maximum fee for driving licence and its indexation via ministerial regulation
p: The RDW gains power to assign emission classes to vehicles, with a fallback to first registration date, and the civil courts rather than administrative courts are the only review route for such classifications.
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 35b, lid 2 and 3 with explanatory memorandum on civil-court review)
The memorandum states that the emission-class decision is not an administrative decision, so no appeal lies to the administrative judge, though civil-court access remains.
The RDW may grant, condition, suspend and revoke recognition for component fitting and may conduct sample inspections with escalated oversight, within rules set by ministerial regulation.
A maximum driving-licence fee set by general administrative order can cap municipal tariffs and be indexed by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks why existing rules are insufficient, why the Council of State's advice for a transparent classification was not followed, and how the maximum licence price will be set so it does not raise average prices.
These members ask why the government does not follow this advice and why this transparency is not provided.
Deze leden vragen waarom dit advies door de regering niet wordt opgevolgd en waarom deze transparantie niet geboden wordt.
Asks about RDW costs, practical problems with emission classification, and timing of milieuzones for delivery vans relative to classification.
These members want to know whether the RDW realising emission classes is a necessary step for introducing milieuzones for delivery vans from 1 July 2013.
Deze leden willen weten of het realiseren van emissieklassen door de RDW een noodzakelijke stap is voor de invoering van de milieuzones voor bestelauto’s vanaf 1 juli 2013.

Prefers assessment based on actual emissions rather than manufacturer test data, asks how old cars with new registrations are classified, and asks whether vehicle classes could be banned from roads and how exemptions for special vehicles would work.
The SP members prefer an assessment based on actual emissions.
De leden van de SP-fractie zien liever een beoordeling op daadwerkelijke emissie.
Asks how the government will use the opportunities of the emission classes for city measures and how far municipalities will be free to apply class-based measures.
They ask how the government will use the opportunities this proposal offers, and to what extent municipalities will be given freedom to apply measures based on emission classes.
Zij vragen hierbij op welke wijze de regering de kansen die dit voorstel biedt, zal benutten, en in hoeverre gemeenten de vrijheid krijgen om maatregelen gebaseerd op emissieklassen in te zetten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill amending the Road Traffic Act 1994 (emission classes, non-mandatory vehicle parts, rijbewijs price cap) but advises revisions, notably a missing legal basis for the classification and for designating vehicle parts, a delegation of the price cap that should be by general administrative order, and legal protection gaps. The minister's reply accepts most remarks, adding statutory bases, clarifying legal protection via civil courts, and consulting the VNG.
concerns: Lack of a statutory basis for an emission-class classification and for designating vehicle parts, and delegation to the minister was considered unsuitable; the bill was adjusted accordingly.
Legal protection against emission-class determinations is unclear since they are not appealable administrative decisions; the reply clarifies civil court access and explains the position.
Price cap for rijbewijs should be regulated by general administrative order rather than ministerial regulation; adopted, with an added ministerial adjustment mechanism tied to the CPI.
The VNG consultation under the Code Interbestuurlijke Verhoudingen was insufficiently documented in the explanatory memorandum; the memorandum was supplemented.
Inconsistent use of the phrase on non-mandatory parts and type approval across provisions; redactional remarks were incorporated.

32784.s: The bill replaces the transitional financial supervision ordinances in the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba with a single integrated Wet financiële markten BES, covering market access licensing, prudential and conduct supervision by DNB and the AFM, and related enforcement. It also introduces new conduct rules, a deposit guarantee scheme, and general provisions for financial undertakings.
32784.j: The memorandum justifies the new framework by the need for harmonisation, functional supervision and consumer protection tailored to the special position of the islands.
q: The bill regulates supervision of the financial markets in the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
Inleiding Dit wetsvoorstel regelt het toezicht op de financiële markten in de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba (hierna:
d: categories of financial undertakings excluded from the act
charging supervisory costs to supervised firms
rules on assessing reliability of policymakers
p: Freedom of information and ombudsman laws are made inapplicable to data the minister holds under the research provision.
The minister may take necessary measures if the supervisory authority seriously neglects its tasks.

parties: Asks whether activities routed through the BES islands can escape stricter rules and whether supervision by DNB and AFM is hampered by differing legislation.
Is supervision by DNB and AFM hampered because there is a difference in legislation?
Wordt het toezicht door DNB en AFM bemoeilijkt doordat er sprake is van verschil in wetgeving?
Objects to the large number of delegated rules by general administrative order and asks for reporting on use of those powers within two years.

The PvdA members ask the government to report within at least two years of the act's introduction on its implementation and on the use of the powers 'by or pursuant to a general administrative order'.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering om in ieder geval binnen twee jaar na invoering van de wet te rapporteren over de implementatie van de wet en over het gebruik van de bevoegdheden «bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur».
Asks how supervision and the shift to the final model fit the islands' capacity, and how supervisors are equipped for additional tasks and powers.
To what extent are DNB and AFM adequately equipped for these additional tasks?
In hoeverre zijn DNB en AFM voldoende geëquipeerd voor deze additionele taken?
Opposes a fully separate supervisory regime for the islands and asks why exemptions from supervision are set by ministerial regulation rather than in the act itself.
Why was it chosen not to lay down exemptions from supervision in the act itself, but to regulate them by ministerial regulation?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen om vrijstellingen van toezicht niet in de wet vast te leggen, maar te regelen bij ministeriële regeling?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the draft Wet financiële markten BES, which sets up a standalone financial supervision regime for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, but raises points on harmonising supervision with Aruba, the scope of ministerial exemptions in article 1:27, and related drafting issues. The government's nader rapport reports that most points were followed by amending the bill and explanatory memorandum, including specifying the exemption provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address harmonisation of supervisory regimes across the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, including Aruba, and whether the differences justify different treatment.
Article 1:27 allows ministerial regulations to exempt from rules of the Act in a general and open way; the Afdeling asks that the rules subject to exemption be specified.

32838.s: The bill creates administrative fines for subsidy recipients who fail to meet special reporting obligations attached to ministerial subsidies, such as reporting failure to complete activities, deviations of 25% or more in cost periods, and child or forced labour abroad. It also amends the Wet bestuursrechtspraak bedrijfsorganisatie so that appeals on such fines go to the College van beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.
32838.j: The memorandum justifies the fines as the necessary sanction completing a high-trust subsidy system, after the Tweede Kamer demanded punitive sanctions beyond clawback.
q: The closing element of this trust-based approach is risk-oriented control.
Sluitstuk van deze – op vertrouwen gebaseerde – benadering is een risicogeoriënteerde controle.
d: minister sets child-labour exemptions and conditions in subsidy decision
p: The minister may, in the subsidy decision, redefine child labour for specific cases and attach conditions, giving discretion to depart from the statutory definitions in the Verdrag-based scheme.
The minister may impose administrative fines up to statutory caps, with discretion over amount, subject to full proportionality review by the courts.
Appeals on fines are routed to the College van beroep voor het bedrijfsleven instead of the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak, preserving judicial review.

parties: The VVD supports the bill's aims and high-trust principle but asks how far the reporting duty and its enforcement by the government actually reach, and whether it is proportionate.
Although these members support the aims of the law and the high-trust principle, the bill, the explanatory memorandum and the advice of the Council of State still give rise to some questions.

Hoewel deze leden de doelstellingen van de wet en het principe van high trust ondersteunen, geven het wetsvoorstel, de memorie van toelichting en het advies van de Raad van State nog aanleiding tot het stellen van enkele vragen.

The PvdA shares the Council of State's doubts, asks why the scope is limited to child and forced labour rather than all four fundamental labour rights, and calls for broader government effort and clearer sanctions and controls.
At the same time, the members of the PvdA parliamentary group share the doubts of the Council of State.
Tegelijkertijd delen de leden van de fractie van de PvdA de twijfels van de Raad van State.

The PVV asks whether the discretionary reclaiming of subsidies can be made mandatory, whether subsidies can be withheld for a minimum period after fraud, and whether a central database of offenders can be set up.
They prefer a mandatory provision to a discretionary one.
Zij hebben liever een moet-bepaling dan een kan-bepaling.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised reconsidering the proposed administrative fine for failing to report child or forced labour indications in government-subsidised projects, citing doubts about effectiveness, the vagueness of 'aanwijzingen' and the child/forced labour definitions under legality principles, and the need to include the act in the subsidy concentration review. The government's reply accepted the core points, redefining 'aanwijzingen' as 'feiten en omstandigheden die duiden op', adding definitions, and committing to include the act in the 2012 evaluation, while maintaining the instrument's rationale.
concerns: The advisory body found the reporting duty and administrative fine insufficiently defined (terms 'aanwijzingen', child and forced labour) under the legality principle, and the government replaced 'aanwijzingen' with 'feiten en omstandigheden' and added definitions.

The advisory body questioned whether the reporting duty and fine would effectively reduce child and forced labour given limited enforcement abroad and the mainly international nature of the problem; the government clarified the instrument's narrower goal but kept the approach.
The advisory body noted the national approach places Dutch firms at a disadvantage relative to foreign competitors, which the government's reply does not address directly.
The advisory body advised including the act in the review of subsidy regulation concentration; the government added a passage committing to include it in the 2012 evaluation.
Several technical drafting corrections were proposed in an annex and the government incorporated them.

32874.s: The bill inserts a new article 8a into the Wet informatie-uitwisseling ondergrondse netten, allowing an general administrative order (AMvB) to exempt categories of excavators from the duty to file an excavation notification for shallow digging up to 50 cm on land they own or manage. The exemption leaves other duties of care intact and is aimed mainly at agricultural operators.
32874.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying a statutory procedure is disproportionate for certain categories, such as agricultural operators, whose knowledge of the subsoil is adequate and whose compliance costs are high, and that an AMvB is needed to cover similar cases.
q: By general administrative order, certain categories of excavators can be designated as exempt from the obligation to file an excavation notification.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen bepaalde categorieën grondroerders worden aangewezen die zijn vrijgesteld van de verplichting om een graafmelding te doen
d: designation of excavator categories exempt from excavation notification

parties: Wants the exemption not to undermine the legal duty to dig carefully and investigate the exact location of cables and pipes.
The VVD members naturally want the exemption not to detract from the legal obligation to dig carefully and investigate the precise location of cables and pipes.

De leden van de VVD-fractie willen natuurlijk dat de vrijstelling geen afbreuk doet aan de wettelijk verplichting zorgvuldig te graven en onderzoek te doen naar de precieze ligging van kabels en leidingen.
Asks whether an excavator exempt from notification remains fully liable for damage caused.
The PvdA members have one question, namely whether the groundworker exempted from the notification duty remains fully liable for any damage he causes.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hebben één vraag, namelijk of de grondroerder die is vrijgesteld van meldplicht nog steeds volledig aansprakelijk is voor eventuele door hem aangerichte schade.
Asks who is responsible for excavation damage when notification is not required, whether free area information is limited to farmers, and how netbeheerders' safety objections are answered.
In addition, the CDA members ask the government which party is responsible for any excavation damage from unreported excavation work under the legally permitted exemption.

Daarnaast vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie de regering welke partij verantwoordelijk is voor eventuele graafschade bij niet gemelde graafwerkzaamheden op grond van de wettelijk toegestane vrijstelling.
Questions why the depth was raised from the 40 cm previously deemed safe to 50 cm and whether safety can be guaranteed.
Can the government guarantee safety during excavation work at this working depth?
Kan de regering bij deze bewerkingsdiepte de veiligheid bij graafwerkzaamheden garanderen?

32892.s: The bill creates a legal basis allowing unfunded (onbekostigde) secondary schools to send pupils, especially 16- and 17-year-olds at risk of not obtaining a diploma, to unfunded adult secondary education (vavo) institutions, under a cooperation agreement. It mirrors existing rules for funded schools and extends them to the Caribbean Netherlands (BES) laws, with details to be set by general administrative order (AMvB).
32892.j: The memorandum justifies the new room for tailored education by the same need for customised provision seen in funded schools, and says the AMvB will restrict cooperation to 16- and 17-year-olds in line with existing rules.
q: By general administrative order, in line with the scheme for funded secondary education, it will be set that the outsourcing may only concern 16- and 17-year-old pupils.

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur zal, ook in aansluiting bij de regeling voor het bekostigde voortgezet onderwijs, worden geregeld dat de uitbesteding alleen betrekking mag hebben op 16- en 17-jarige leerlingen.
d: which pupils and under which conditions cooperation with vavo may apply
Artikel III B (art. 114a lid 4 WVO BES)
which pupils and under which conditions cooperation with vavo may apply (BES)

parties: Supports aligning the law with existing practice and asks technical questions about the legal basis of outsourcing and whether the Rutte-regeling applies.
The said members express their support for the decision to bring legislation in line with the existing practice that 16- and 17-year-olds follow adult secondary education at a non-funded institution.

De genoemde leden spreken hun steun uit voor het besluit de wetgeving in overeenstemming te brengen met de bestaande praktijk dat 16- en 17-jarigen voortgezet algemeen volwassenenonderwijs aan een niet-bekostigde instelling onderwijs volgen.
Worried that schools may transfer pupils for the institution's benefit, such as better inspectorate exam figures, rather than the pupil's interest, and asks how the bill prevents this.

Can the government explain how the bill prevents unfunded educational institutions from transferring pupils to vavo not in the pupil's interest but in the institution's interest, for example to show a better picture to the Inspectorate with exam results?

Kan de regering toelichten hoe het wetsvoorstel voorkomt dat onbekostigde onderwijsinstellingen leerlingen overplaatsen op het vavo niet in het belang van de leerling, maar in het belang van de instelling, bijvoorbeeld om met de examenresultaten voor de Inspectie met een fraaier beeld tevoorschijn te komen?
Supports the bill as giving 16- and 17-year-olds who must repeat a year a useful alternative, and asks why pupils prefer vavo and what consequences follow for school quality.

The members are of the view that this bill does justice to this group of pupils who need a different educational environment than the vo school, in order to ultimately complete their vo career with a diploma.

De leden zijn van mening dat dit wetsvoorstel recht doet aan deze groep van leerlingen welke behoefte hebben aan een andere onderwijsomgeving dan de vo-school, om uiteindelijk hun vo-carrière af te sluiten met een diploma.
Doubts whether widening unfunded providers' powers is wise given doubts about exam quality, notes earlier findings of rule violations, and asks whether enforcement has followed through.
Asks whether it is wise to expand the powers of unfunded education now that the quality of exams is under discussion.-
Vragen of het verstandig is om de bevoegdheden van onbekostigd onderwijs uit te breiden nu de kwaliteit van de examens ter discussie staat.
Asks how parents are involved in and informed of the decision to outsource a pupil, and how long outsourcing may last.
The members ask in what way the parents of the pupil concerned are involved in the decision to outsource the pupil to unfunded adult secondary education.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen op welke wijze de ouders van de betrokken leerling worden betrokken bij het besluit de leerling aan het onbekostigde voortgezet algemeen volwassenenonderwijs uit te besteden?

33240-IV.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement for Kingdom Relations (IV) through a supplementary budget, adjusting obligations and expenditure for the policy articles on guarantee function and autonomy of Kingdom partners. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33240-VI.s: This supplementary budget law amends the 2011 departmental budget and the baten-lastendiensten budget of the Ministry of Security and Justice, as set out in attached schedules. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: More appeals were lodged against the decisions sent by the CJIB to the Public Prosecutor than expected.
Er is namelijk meer beroep aangetekend tegen de door het CJIB verstuurde beschikkingen bij de Officier van Justitie dan verwacht.

33280-III.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs and the Cabinet of the Queen by adding supplementary appropriations, expressed in thousands of euros, effective from 1 June 2012. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers, and no accompanying explanatory memorandum.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs and of the Cabinet of the Queen (III) for the year 2012

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken en van het Kabinet der Koningin (III) voor het jaar 2012

33288.s: The bill raises the mandatory own risk in health insurance to 350 euro per year for adults aged 18 and over, and adds a means-tested allowance administered by the CAK to soften the out-of-pocket costs for specialist mental health care. It also sets transitional rules and effects the changes from 1 January 2013.
33288.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to general administrative orders as a way to implement the remaining budget measures quickly and to set exact income limits that the statute itself does not fix.
q: The exact income limits above which there is no entitlement to the allowance are set by general administrative order.
De exacte inkomensgrenzen waarboven geen recht bestaat op de tegemoetkoming, worden bij algemene maatregel van bestuur vastgesteld.
d: timing, income threshold and partner rules for the mental health allowance
further rules on sharing and processing personal data by the CAK

parties: Asks whether the GGZ softening targets specific vulnerable groups beyond low income, and whether the healthcare allowance compensates costs people never incur.
The proposal spares people with low incomes, while income alone is not an indicator of vulnerability among people in mental health care.
Met het voorliggende voorstel worden mensen met een laag inkomen ontzien, terwijl het inkomen alleen geen indicator is van de kwetsbaarheid van mensen in de GGZ.
Objects to speed and to a flat deductible increase instead of income-dependent contributions; asks about sustainability after elections and burdens on patients.
They have strong reservations about the pace at which, and the manner in which, this law is now being implemented.
Zij hebben sterke bedenkingen bij het tempo waarmee, en de wijze waarop deze wet nu doorgevoerd wordt.
Opposes the deductible increase as a tax on illness and asks for justification of the GGZ compensation and cost control.
These members do not understand why this caretaker cabinet feels compelled to introduce an extra levy on being ill by raising the deductible.
Deze leden begrijpen niet waarom dit demissionaire kabinet zich geroepen voelt om een extra heffing op ziek zijn in te voeren door het verhogen van het eigen risico.
Supports the bill, welcomes that Council of State recommendations were followed, and asks about the AWIR deviation, partner income rules and data use by the CAK.
These members are, incidentally, pleased to read that the government has followed the recommendations of the Council of State.
Genoemde leden zijn overigens verheugd te lezen dat de regering de aanbevelingen van de Raad van State heeft opgevolgd.
Argues the deductible burdens the sick and undermines solidarity, questions the rationale and stigma of the GGZ contribution, and doubts the CAK can execute it.
These members note that by raising the deductible, healthcare costs are increasingly shifted onto people who need a lot of care.
Deze leden constateren dat met de verhoging van het eigen risico de zorgkosten in toenemende mate worden afgewenteld op mensen die veel zorg nodig hebben.
Supports reversing the GGZ cut and asks for monitoring of effects and communication to patients.
When the GGZ own contribution was introduced, at the request of the House of Representatives, a monitor was set up to map the effect of this measure.
Bij het instellen van de eigen bijdrage GGZ is op verzoek van de Tweede Kamer een monitor ingesteld om het effect van deze maatregel in kaart te brengen.
Understands urgency but asks about the number of beneficiaries, pre-financing, CAK powers over income and bank data, and whether compensation applies only when the deductible is used.
These members understand the urgent nature of the legislative amendment.
Deze leden begrijpen het spoedeisend karakter van de wetswijziging.
Welcomes the GGZ relief as implementing a motion, but questions the fixed income thresholds set by general administrative order and the income year used.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a temporary bill allowing the government to deviate by general administrative order from several statutory health provisions to implement 2013 cost-cutting measures from the Spring Agreement, finding the necessity of such a broad delegation not demonstrated and raising concerns on personal data processing, transposition of AMvBs into statute, and the sunset clause. The minister's reply accepts the advice in full, drops the delegation and sunset provisions, and amends the bill to amend the Zorgverzekeringswet directly.
concerns: The broad delegation to deviate from statutory provisions by AMvB was not shown to be necessary, and specific parts could be written directly into the bill; the government dropped the delegation and amended the Zvw directly.
The urgency and necessity of an exceptional delegation were insufficiently justified given that the legislative route was feasible in other health and tax bills.
Processing of health data for compensation lacked a substantive justification and a sufficiently specific purpose and data scope under the Wbp.
The sunset clause would have caused AMvBs to lapse with the Act on 1 January 2013, and the transposition duty lacked a timing link; both were resolved by removing the temporary delegation.
Statements in the explanatory memorandum about necessity for AWBZ, WTCG and Wet op de zorgtoeslag amendments were insufficient or unsupported.

33297.s: The bill repeals the Wet overleg minderhedenbeleid, the statute that structured government consultation with minority organisations on integration policy. Article II keeps the existing ministerial regulation under that Act in force until the Minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum sets a withdrawal date by regulation.
33297.j: The memorandum justifies the withdrawal by saying that a statutory structure for government participation of minority groups no longer fits the government's reliance on individual civic responsibility, but does not justify the delegated withdrawal date.
q: A statutory structure for government support of this participation no longer fits with this government's appeal to the individual responsibility of all citizens.
Een wettelijke structuur ten behoeve van deze participatie vanuit de overheid niet meer strookt met het beroep dat deze regering doet op de individuele verantwoordelijkheid van alle burgers
d: date of withdrawal of the ministerial regulation under the repealed Act
p: The minister is empowered to fix by regulation the date on which the surviving ministerial regulation ceases, without any parliamentary step or statutory deadline.

parties: Asks why repeal took so long and how subsidy phase-out obligations and the open wording of article II will be settled, raising concern about open-ended subsidy rights.
Does the government share the VVD concern that the open wording of article II risks the right to subsidy lasting longer than desirable?
Deelt de regering de zorg van de leden van de VVD-fractie dat door de open formulering van artikel II het risico bestaat dat het recht op subsidiëring langer doorloopt dan wenselijk?
Questions the government's haste in repealing the Wom under a demissionary cabinet, argues the choice should be left to the next cabinet, and asks how the motion Van Dam/Sterk will be implemented.
Would it not be more decent to leave the decision on whether and how consultation with minority representatives is organised to the new cabinet?
Zou het niet fatsoenlijker zijn om de beslissing of en hoe het overleg met vertegenwoordigers van minderheidsgroeperingen wordt vormgegeven over te laten aan het nieuwe kabinet?
Supports the shift toward shared citizenship and a flexible dialogue, but asks how knowledge and expertise of migrant organisations will be secured and supported.
These members do, however, explicitly ask for attention to securing knowledge and expertise.
Wel vragen deze leden nadrukkelijk om aandacht voor het borgen van de kennis en de expertise.

Asks how signals from the population and less mobilised groups will be captured in the flexible dialogue, how the amendment on parental involvement will be implemented, and how vulnerable groups with disadvantages are protected.
How will the government ensure continued attention for citizens who are not vocal?
Hoe gaat de regering ervoor zorgen dat er ook aandacht blijft voor de burgers die niet mondig zijn?

Asks the government to substantiate its claims about diversity and division, to explain why repeal is preferred over amendment, why no evaluation is planned, and what replaces the four LOM functions before any alternative exists.

33400-IX.s: This bill sets the 2013 budget statements for the Ministry of Finance (IXB), the National Debt (IXA) and certain operating-expense agencies, in thousands of euros. It also makes temporary departures from the Comptability Act 2001, including merging the two budget statements into one law, skipping the interim account, and creating a commitment-cash agency model.
33400-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary departures as administrative burden reduction and as implementing cabinet decisions after the evaluation of the agency model, with the Tweede Kamer informed in advance.
q: The departures from the Comptability Act 2001 made in articles 5 to 9 of this budget act are temporary arrangements.
De afwijkingen van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 die in de wetsartikelen 5 tot en met 9 van deze begrotingswet worden doorgevoerd, zijn tijdelijke voorzieningen.
d: Minister of Finance may set further rules on commitment-cash agencies
p: Merges budget statements into one law, omits the interim account to parliament and moves in-year changes into the closing laws, reducing parliamentary scrutiny for 2013.
Allows a minister, with the Finance Minister's agreement, to decide that a unit becomes a commitment-cash agency and allows a cash reserve, under conditions set by the Finance Minister.

33558.s: The bill gives statutory footing to the tasks of the national curriculum body SLO and the test developer Cito, and replaces the old SLOA subsidy act with a new subsidy framework for national education support activities. It lets the minister set detailed subsidy rules by ministerial regulation, set annual subsidy ceilings, refuse subsidies, and appoint supervisors who lack certain inspection powers.
33558.j: The memorandum justifies the subsidy delegations as implementing the fixed public tasks of curriculum and test development and the need for a coherent, efficient subsidy relationship; it notes that the supervisor's excluded powers are unnecessary for mainly administrative subsidy oversight.
q: Supervision will be mainly administrative in nature, and inspection of premises, samples or vehicles and their cargo (Articles 5:18 and 5:19 General Administrative Law Act) is not relevant to checking compliance with these education-support subsidies.

Het toezicht zal overwegend van administratieve aard zijn, waarbij onderzoek aan zaken of monsterneming (artikel 5:18 Awb) of het onderzoeken van voertuigen en hun lading (artikel 5:19 Awb) bij de controle van de naleving van subsidies voor onderwijsondersteunende activiteiten niet aan de orde is.
d: detailed rules on subsidy applications, conditions, obligations, payment and evaluation
minister sets annual subsidy ceiling and allocation
minister may refuse subsidy if application does not fit framework letter or goals unlikely met
minister issues biennial framework letter (Kaderbrief SLOA) setting subsidy priorities
minister designates supervisors by decision published in Staatscourant
ministerial rules or subsidy decisions may exempt data and results from publication
p: Ministerial regulation or subsidy decision may exempt data and results of publicly funded tasks from public disclosure, limiting openness.
Designated supervisors are denied the powers to inspect premises, samples and vehicles under the General Administrative Law Act, narrowing oversight of subsidised bodies.

parties: Asks whether the Algemene Rekenkamer's concerns about ministry officials on NRO bodies and the government's oversight of SLO and Cito are adequately addressed.
The VVD members note that the government is responsible for supervising the organisations that carry out the tasks described in the proposal.
De leden van de VVD-fractie merken op dat de regering verantwoordelijk is voor het toezicht op de organisaties die de taken uitvoeren zoals beschreven in het voorstel.
Supports the bill as a step forward but asks for better monitoring and evaluation of SLO and Cito and raises the Rekenkamer's loyalty-conflict concern about ministry officials in NRO bodies.
The Algemene Rekenkamer does however express concern about the vulnerable position and loyalty conflicts the government could be burdened with.
De Algemene Rekenkamer uit echter zorgen met betrekking tot de kwetsbare positie en loyaliteitsconflicten waar de regering mee belast zou kunnen worden.
Asks whether the bill gives sufficient powers to intervene if shortcomings arise at SLO and Cito, including instruction powers and a task-neglect rule.
The members ask whether the bill provides sufficient powers to intervene if shortcomings are identified.
De leden vragen of het wetsvoorstel voldoende bevoegdheden biedt om te interveniëren in het geval er tekortkomingen zouden worden gesignaleerd.
Wants the position and financing of other test providers regulated together with this bill, and objects to mixing public and private tasks at Cito.
The said members therefore want the position and funding of the other final-test providers to be regulated at the same time as this bill.
De genoemde willen daarom dat de positie en financiering van de overige eindtoetsaanbieders gelijktijdig wordt geregeld met het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.
Asks whether statutory monopolies for Cito and SLO block innovation by other providers and whether the exclusive choice of Cito is legally sound.
These members ask whether the government can state what the advantage of this is. Are possible (innovative) developments by other providers not being blocked?
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan aangeven wat hiervan het voordeel is. Worden eventuele (innovatieve) ontwikkelingen van andere aanbieders niet geblokkeerd?
Questions the feasibility of other providers developing an alternative final test in time and the fairness of direct subsidy only to Cito.
Challenges the claim that centralised testing is constitutionally required and asks how equal chances between Cito and other providers are guaranteed.
These members ask whether the government recognises that differentiation in tests can also have advantages.
Deze leden vragen of de regering erkent dat differentiatie in toetsen ook voordelen kan hebben.

33640-III.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services by adjusting amounts in thousands of euros, with the changes taking effect from 1 June 2013. It is a purely technical budget adjustment that does not delegate rule-making power or alter oversight arrangements.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2013 to the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services.

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2013 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet van de Koning en de Commissie van Toezicht betreffende de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten.

33675.s: The bill lets the Zorginstituut pay subsidies to care providers for short-term general psychological treatment of anonymous insured persons, and pays care costs for persons in the Openbaar Ministerie's Bewaken & Beveiligen protection scheme, with both schemes set by ministerial regulation. It also adds a contribution provision to the Zorgverzekeringswet, the Algemene wet bijzondere ziektekosten and the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen.
33675.j: The memorandum justifies the scheme by saying anonymous care cannot be billed to insurers without distorting the market, and that the contribution is set by the NZa against predefined care criteria.
q: By ministerial regulation it may be determined that the Zorginstituut provides a subsidy to care providers
Bij ministeriële regeling kan worden bepaald dat het Zorginstituut een subsidie verstrekt aan zorgaanbieders
d: subsidy for anonymous short-term psychological care, conditions and ceiling
reimbursement of care for Bewaken & Beveiligen persons, conditions
reimbursement of care for Bewaken & Beveiligen persons under AWBZ, conditions
p: ARTIKEL I, B (art. 70a and 70b); ARTIKEL II (art. 44a)

Core terms of the subsidy and reimbursement schemes, including eligibility and funding, are left to ministerial regulation without parliamentary involvement, though conditions and a ceiling are specified in outline.

parties: Asks how providers' necessity assessments of anonymity are checked, what sanctions apply, and how the Inspectie can supervise quality without a contractual relationship.
So how is quality monitored and how can the Health Care Inspectorate supervise?
Hoe wordt dan kwaliteit bewaakt en hoe kan de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg toezicht houden?
Supports the goal but asks how anonymity's necessity can be verified and how fraud is prevented given that the Zorginstituut cannot check subsidy use against insured persons.
These members do ask how it can be checked whether anonymity is truly a necessary condition for treatment, and not other motives such as relieving the own risk.

Genoemde leden vragen wel hoe er kan worden gecontroleerd of anonimiteit daadwerkelijk een noodzakelijke voorwaarde voor behandeling is, en niet andere motieven zoals het ontlasten van het eigen risico.
Asks about evidence of need, proven effectiveness, possible pull effects toward primary psychological care, and how repeat applications and outcomes are monitored.
Is the government not afraid of a pull effect toward first-line psychological care?
Is de regering niet bang voor aanzuigende werking naar de eerstelijns psychologische zorg?
Asks for hard figures on the use of internet interventions, whether they replace human therapy, how providers can demonstrate necessity, and whether insurers could take over decisions on access.

To what extent does the sentence 'the government is of the opinion that anonymous e-mental health is not exclusively a responsibility of the government' open the door to external financiers setting their own conditions?

In hoeverre zet de zin «de regering is van mening dat anonieme e-mental health niet uitsluitend een verantwoordelijkheid is van de overheid» de deur open naar externe financiers die hun eigen voorwaarden gaan stellen?
Asks who supervises that providers offer care only to eligible persons and not fictitious users, and questions the subsidy design and its evaluation.
Who supervises that the provider offers the care to the right persons and that fictitious persons do not use the care?
Wie houdt er toezicht op dat de desbetreffende zorgaanbieder de zorg ook aan de juiste personen aanbiedt en dat niet fictieve personen van de zorg gebruik maken?
Asks whether the legal anonymity safeguards are enforceable, which body supervises them, what sanctions apply, and whether the budget is adequate.
Are these legal frameworks enforceable in court and which body supervises compliance with these frameworks?
Zijn deze wettelijke kaders in rechte afdwingbaar en welke instantie houdt toezicht op de naleving van deze kaders?
Asks how providers check that anonymous treatment is limited to patients who would otherwise not seek care, which providers qualify, and how quality requirements are controlled.
In what way do care providers check this?
Op welke wijze controleren zorgaanbieders dit?

33684.s: The bill transfers responsibility for prevention, support, care for youth growing-up and parenting problems, child protection measures and youth probation to municipalities, aiming for integrated, demedicalised youth care. It sets quality requirements, complaint and participation rights, transparency duties, and national inspection oversight, with ministerial powers to issue binding directions to municipalities.
