33684.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to define quality standards, certification and deskundigheid requirements that can change with insights, and to allow flexible updating through lower-level rules.
q: As soon as voluntary assistance proves unable to solve the problems and a child is threatened in its development, the AMHK immediately hands the case over to the child protection board.

Zodra blijkt dat vrijwillige hulpverlening de problemen niet kan oplossen en een kind bedreigd wordt in zijn ontwikkeling, draagt het AMHK de casus onmiddellijk over aan de raad voor de kinderbescherming.
d: competence requirements and service-provision categories for youth care
further quality rules and governance requirements for providers
register of youth care providers and certified institutions
certification norms and withdrawal grounds for certified institutions
designation of qualified behavioural scientist categories
quality framework and cooperation rules for certified institutions
p: Ministers may issue binding directions to municipalities for serious shortcomings, without intervening in individual cases, after an eight-week right to respond.
General administrative orders may limit or extend municipal responsibility for categories of foreign residents, departing from the Aliens Act.

parties: Supports municipal policy freedom but asks questions about who the single coordinator is and whether financing separation adds bureaucracy.
They endorse the aim of the law: strengthening the young person's own strength and the caring and problem-solving capacity of the family and social environment.
Zij onderschrijven het doel van de wet, het versterken van de eigen kracht van de jongere en van het zorgend en probleemoplossend vermogen van diens gezin en sociale omgeving.
Supports transformation under municipal responsibility but asks how regional cooperation stays under council control and how expertise is secured.
How is the control by the municipal council guaranteed?
Hoe wordt de controle door de gemeenteraad gewaarborgd?
Sees more steps back than forward and asks whether municipalities can overrule expert advice and whether appeal routes are adequate.
Why do municipalities get the power to make the final decision? Why do they get the power to set aside an expert's advice?
Waarom krijgen gemeenten de macht om de uiteindelijke beslissing te nemen? Waarom krijgen zij de macht om het advies van een deskundige naast zich neer te leggen?
Fears rights loss, municipal discretion producing unequal care, cost-driven rationing, and weak central systemic responsibility.
Thus children lose the right to care.
Zo verliezen kinderen het recht op zorg.
Supports municipal responsibility but questions the replacement of legal entitlement, independent advice and the many delegated regulations.
In effect, the CDA members can only give a definitive judgement once the new Social Support Act is before the House.
Feitelijk kunnen de leden van de CDA-fractie pas een definitief oordeel geven wanneer de nieuwe Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning in de Kamer voor ligt.
Worries about children's rights under the UN Convention and legal inequality arising from municipality-dependent care.
Furthermore these members are concerned about the extent to which children's rights, partly arising from the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, are safeguarded.
Daarnaast leven er bij deze leden zorgen over de mate waarin de kinderrechten, zoals die mede voortvloeien uit het VN-Kinderrechtenverdrag, zijn geborgd.
Asks how parents keep control via a family group plan and why the amendment on it was not included in the law.
These members ask in what way parents themselves have control over the help their child receives.
Deze leden vragen op welke manier ouders zelf regie hebben over de hulp die hun kind krijgt.
Concerned about continuity of care, the split financing for 18-year-olds, loss of personal budgets and privacy of youth care clients.
With the split in financial responsibility for youth mental health (municipalities) and adult mental health (Zvw) a gap arises between care for under-18s and over-18s.
Met de splitsing in financiële verantwoordelijkheid voor de jeugd-ggz (gemeenten) en volwassenen-ggz (Zvw) ontstaat er een schot tussen de zorg voor 18-minners en 18-plussers.
Asks about the meaning of medicalisation and the effect of growing childcare on parents' time with children.
Municipalities would override expert professional advice and control access and funding, with unclear accountability and weak appeal routes for children and parents.
Why do municipalities get the power to set aside an expert's advice? To what extent is this in the child's interest?
Waarom krijgen gemeenten de macht om het advies van een deskundige naast zich neer te leggen? In hoeverre is dit in het belang van het kind?

Municipal gatekeeping creates a financial incentive to choose cheaper care, risking rights and quality; the SP demands guarantees that professionals decide and asks for safeguards against regional inequality and rechtsongelijkheid in coercive care.
The members want a guarantee from the government that municipalities will always leave care decisions in the hands of youth care professionals.
De leden willen een garantie van de regering ontvangen dat gemeenten te allen tijde de beslissing voor zorg in handen geven van professionals in de jeugdzorg.

Asks whether the Jeugdwet law gives municipalities authority over medical decisions of physicians and whether the professionalism of the child psychiatrist is safeguarded; questions the scope of the home-entry power of inspectors.
The CDA members cannot shake the impression that municipalities are taking the medical seat of the child psychiatrist.
De leden van de CDA-fractie kunnen zich niet aan de indruk onttrekken dat gemeenten op de (medische) stoel van de kinderpsychiater gaan zitten.
Asks whether the law was independently reviewed against the IVRK and equality principles, and whether privacy safeguards for shared data are adequate before tasks are transferred.
The D66 members note the government sees no reason for an independent legal review of whether the bill complies with the UN Children's Rights Convention.
De leden van de D66 -fractie constateren dat de regering geen aanleiding ziet voor een onafhankelijke juridische toets of de voorliggende wet in lijn is met het IVRK.
Asks whether the personal budget (pgb) tariff is sufficient for quality care and whether the client's perspective is taken into account, to make real free choice possible.
The ChristenUnie members ask why amending article 8 did not include that the personal budget rate offered by municipalities must also be sufficient to buy good-quality care.

De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen waarom met het wijzigen van artikel 8 niet is meegenomen dat het door gemeenten geboden pgb-tarief ook toereikend moet zijn voor het inkopen van kwalitatief goede zorg?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises on the draft Jeugdwet (Youth Act) transferring youth care responsibilities to municipalities, raising concerns about limited municipal control over costs, referrals by doctors, specialised and closed youth care, the VIR risk-index, the parental contribution, and the lack of a hardship clause. The government's nader rapport accepts some points (hardship clause, pgb conditions, closed-care safeguards, samenwerking as stok achter de deur) but rejects others, including dropping the VIR and the gezinsfunctionaliteit and aligning closed-care safeguards with the Bjj.
concerns: The Council doubts municipalities can control costs given doctor referrals, specialised care and child-protection measures outside their control; the government says the law gives sufficient policy room and will monitor spending.

Closed youth care safeguards should be aligned with the Beginselenwet justitiële jeugdinrichtingen; the government aligned some provisions on medical treatment and body searches but did not fully harmonise.
The Council advises dropping the VIR risk-index because its added value is small relative to the privacy intrusion; the government keeps it and adds a family functionality.
Parental contribution rules need a hardship clause in line with Afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak case law; the government adds such a clause.
The broad regulatory power in article 2.10 should be limited; the government removes several subsections and narrows the remainder.
Mandatory inter-municipal cooperation should be justified; the government keeps article 2.7 as a last-resort measure and adjusts the explanatory memorandum.
Data transfer of medical and personal data to municipalities without consent needs better justification under article 8 ECHR; the government provides a fuller necessity and proportionality argument.
Various drafting points on definitions, the considerans, article 2.1 and the scope of youth care are raised and largely addressed in the reply.

33729.s: The bill inserts article 1:93d into the Wft allowing DNB and the AFM to share confidential supervisory information with the Algemene Rekenkamer when necessary for its efficiency audits of supervision. The Rekenkamer must keep such information confidential and may only disclose it in non-identifiable form.
33729.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the Rekenkamer needing access to supervisory information to carry out its efficiency audit of DNB and AFM supervision, following a commitment to the Tweede Kamer.
q: As a result, the Algemene Rekenkamer is insufficiently able to properly carry out its efficiency audit of the supervision by DNB and the AFM under the CW.
Hierdoor is de Algemene Rekenkamer onvoldoende in staat om haar doelmatigheidsonderzoek naar het toezicht van DNB en de AFM op grond van de CW 3 naar behoren uit te voeren.
p: Confidential supervisory information may be passed to the Algemene Rekenkamer, an oversight body, where necessary for its audit, with the Rekenkamer deciding necessity case by case.

parties: Asks what an efficiency audit by the Rekenkamer adds, how it differs from a quality-of-supervision review, and what its relevance is once CRD IV and ECB supervision apply.
What is the concrete added value of an efficiency audit?
Wat is de concrete meerwaarde van een doelmatigheidsonderzoek?
Supports Rekenkamer access to supervisory information under confidentiality, but asks who judges the necessity test, whether DNB/AFM can object, and the administrative burden.
Does the Algemene Rekenkamer receive guidelines or suggestions from the government or minister on how to apply this necessity test?
Krijgt de Algemene Rekenkamer richtlijnen of suggesties mee vanuit de regering of de minister hoe zij deze noodzakelijkheidtoets moet invullen?
Asks whether the Rekenkamer's necessity assessment is accounted for and whether objective criteria exist for the non-identifiability requirement on disclosure.
Are there objective assessment criteria for this, ask the members of the PVV fractie.
Zijn hier objectieve toetsingscriteria voor, zo vragen de leden van de fractie van de PVV.
Asks whether DNB or AFM can refuse a Rekenkamer request, whether refusals must be argued and disclosed, and why foreign-supervisor information is excluded.
Can DNB or the AFM refuse an information request from the Algemene Rekenkamer?
Kunnen DNB of de AFM een informatieverzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer afwijzen?
Welcomes removing barriers to Rekenkamer access, but asks about the reviewer of necessity motivations, response deadlines, and European cooperation on the Rekenkamer mandate.
They are pleased that the government now removes the obstacles for the Algemene Rekenkamer to obtain access to supervisory-confidential information from supervisors.
Zij zijn verheugd dat de regering de belemmeringen voor de Algemene Rekenkamer om toegang te krijgen tot toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie van toezichthouder nu wegneemt.

Welcomes the bill but raises the Council of State's concerns about the vague article 91 CW mandate, disclosure non-identifiability, and tension with the minister's ministerial responsibility to parliament.
This may lead to tensions in the accountability relationship between the minister and the States General.
Dit kan leiden tot spanningen in de verantwoordelijkheidsrelatie tussen de minister en de Staten-Generaal.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill allowing DNB and AFM to share confidential supervisory information with the Court of Audit is not yet sufficiently justified, because the Court's statutory mandate is not clearly specified and strict necessity is not shown, and asked for the bill to be reconsidered. The Minister's reply disagrees that the mandate is unclear and explains necessity, but largely clarifies the explanatory memorandum and leaves the advice on ECB developments unfollowed.
concerns: The Council considered that the Court of Audit's mandate under article 91 Cw is not sufficiently precise to meet the CRD IV condition of a precisely defined mandate, which the Minister rejected.

The Council doubted that access to confidential supervisory information is strictly necessary for the Court's efficiency audit and asked for substantiated justification, which the Minister answered by explaining case-by-case necessity without fully reshaping the bill.

The Council noted the CRD IV provision applies only to banks and investment firms, leaving insurers under stricter rules; the Minister responded that the principle should be expressed in other directives and pledged to pursue it at EU level.

The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to address whether Court of Audit review of supervisors' individual decisions could intensify supervision and create tension with the Minister's accountability, which the Minister addressed by clarifying the memorandum.
The Council asked for explanation of how the bill relates to the shift of prudential bank supervision to the ECB; the Minister declined because the outcome of European developments is not yet clear.

33738.s: The bill raises the maximum administrative fine for violating the smoking ban under the Tobacco Act from €4,500 to €19,500 and adds a new administrative-fines section. It also renumbers the subsections accordingly, with the actual fine levels to be set later by general administrative order.
33738.j: The memorandum justifies the higher ceiling by arguing that repeat offenders, especially café operators, need stronger deterrence than the current doubling system allows.
q: The government wants the legal room to substantially increase the fine for violating the smoking ban in the future if the hard core of repeat offenders, especially café operators, persists in its norm-deviating behaviour.

De regering wil de wettelijke ruimte hebben om de boete voor het overtreden van het rookverbod in de toekomst substantieel te verhogen als de harde kern van veelplegers – met name uitbaters van cafébedrijven – persisteert in zijn normafwijkend gedrag.
p: Raises the statutory ceiling for administrative fines on smoking-ban violations, giving the executive room to set higher fines by general administrative order, which is subject to advance submission to parliament.

parties: Asks for evidence and a decision framework justifying why EUR 19,500 is sufficiently deterrent and how fines will actually be raised by general administrative order.
On what figures and with what justification has the government assessed the deterrent effect of the fines?
Op grond van welke cijfers en met welke onderbouwing heeft de regering de afschrikwekkendheid van de boetes beoordeeld?
Supports strict enforcement and tripling fines for recidivists in principle, but asks whether higher maximum fines will be effective if existing fines are uncollectable or rarely imposed.
However, these members ask the government whether raising the statutory maximum fine will have the desired effect if existing fines prove uncollectable or are only imposed to a limited extent.

Wel vragen deze leden de regering of een verhoging van het wettelijk maximumboetebedrag het gewenste effect heeft, als zou blijken dat de bestaande boetes oninbaar zijn of slechts in beperkte mate worden uitgedeeld.
Asks for detailed enforcement and fine statistics, the detection probability, and whether higher fines would deter a very small group of recidivists.
The SP members ask the government to express the detection probability once more in figures and to explain how it interprets these figures.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering de pakkans nog een keer in cijfers uit te drukken en daarbij aan te geven hoe zij deze cijfers duidt.
Supports tougher fines for repeat offenders and asks whether a separate repeat-offender scale should be introduced, plus data on fines imposed 2010-2012.
These members believe people must abide by the law and that repeat offenders may also be fined more heavily.
Deze leden vinden dat mensen zich aan de wet moeten houden en dat veelplegers ook zwaarder beboet mogen worden.
Agrees current fines are not deterrent enough but questions the claimed low compliance evidence, the enforcement capacity, and why the fourth fine category was chosen.
These members share the government's view that the current maximum fine has insufficient deterrent effect and that this can lead to calculating behaviour by operators.
Deze leden delen de mening van de regering dat van de hoogte van de huidige maximumboete onvoldoende afschrikwekkende werking uitgaat en dat dit kan leiden tot calculerend gedrag bij uitbaters.
Asks how large the repeat-offender group is, how often the maximum fine was imposed, and whether first offenders' fines should also rise since the tripling method does not reach EUR 19,500.
Would it not be more logical to also raise the fine for first offenders?
Zou het niet logischer zijn om de boete voor «first offenders» ook te verhogen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill raising the maximum administrative fine for smoking-ban violations from €4,500 to €19,500, but asks the government to explain why actual fines remain €600 for a first offence rising to €4,800 for recidivism. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that the memorie van toelichting was supplemented with passages on variants for setting fine tariffs, including keeping the current system if compliance improves.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to justify why actual fines for first and repeat offences are not raised proportionally to the higher statutory maximum, to make the case for the bill convincing.

The Afdeling notes that the explanation on actual fine levels strictly belongs in the amending general administrative order setting the fine tariffs, and the government added passages on tariff variants to the memorandum instead.

33747.s: The bill amends the Code of Criminal Procedure and the Code of Civil Procedure to streamline police procedures: it lets wiretap orders and authorisations be issued in the name of a person rather than per number, simplifies requests for camera footage, and removes the notification duty for less intrusive special investigative powers. It also lets the mayor delegate supervision of bailiff entry into dwellings to a designated municipal official instead of a police officer.
33747.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the growing administrative burden on police and prosecution and the need to improve police capacity, with efficiency gains estimated in FTEs.
d: mayor may appoint official to represent him when bailiff enters a dwelling
p: Police may demand footage from private camera owners orally, with later written record and limited exclusions for sensitive data, reducing formalities before the executive obtains private information.
Artikel I D (art. 126bb, tweede en vierde lid)

Notification duty to persons affected by special investigative powers is removed for entry into non-residential closed places and for several ancillary powers, reducing citizens' ability to challenge their use afterward.
Artikel I A (art. 126m en 126t, tweede en vijfde lid)

Wiretap orders and examining-magistrate authorisations may be issued in the name of a person covering all numbers used by that person during the order's validity, with judicial review at the hearing preserved.

Replacing a police officer with a municipal official as the supervising witness at bailiff entry reduces police involvement while the proportionality test remains with the mayor's representative and the bailiff.

parties: Supports reducing administrative burdens and asks about expected time savings in the chain, without raising checks concerns.
Reducing administrative burdens is a priority of the VVD and every proposal contributing to it can count on VVD support.
Reductie van administratieve lasten vormt een speerpunt van de VVD en elk voorstel dat hieraan een bijdrage levert kan rekenen op steun van de VVD.
Worries that taps on a name weaken judicial control over wiretaps and that notification duties should not be eroded for the sake of administrative relief.
The PvdA members, partly in light of the above, attach importance to judicial review of the use of wiretaps.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie hechten, mede in het licht van het bovenstaande, aan de rechterlijke controle op de inzet van taps.

Questions how the lawfulness of tapped numbers is checked once no longer individually submitted to the examining magistrate, and whether the infringement of legal protection is justified by the gain in performance.
How is it prevented that conversations of persons who ultimately have nothing to do with the investigated facts can be tapped?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat de gesprekken van personen die (uiteindelijk) niets met de onderzochte feiten te maken hebben, getapt kunnen worden?
Asks questions about the scope of the camera-footage rules and how the notification duty relates to the ECHR.
These members ask how this relates to Article 13 of the ECHR.
Deze leden vragen hoe dit zich verhoudt tot artikel 13 EVRM.

Supports the reduction of burdens but asks whether dropping notification and wider access to footage affects citizens' knowledge of data collection and the bailiff's ability to judge the need to enter homes.
Shares the Council of State's concerns about infringements of fundamental rights, questions whether the workload reduction justifies weakening safeguards, and asks for data on the effects.
These members share the end goal of lowering administrative burdens at the police and prosecution, but this must not come at the expense of civil rights.
Deze leden delen het einddoel om de administratieve lasten bij de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) te verlagen, maar dit mag niet ten koste gaan van burgerrechten.

Supports the aim but asks whether abolishing notification is the only solution, since citizens should be able to bring rights infringements before a judge, and questions the lack of criteria for name-based taps.
After all, a citizen must be able to bring infringements of his fundamental rights before a judge.
Een burger moet immers inbreuken op zijn grondrechten kunnen voorleggen aan de rechter.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill reducing police and prosecution workload, which removes notification duties for some special investigative powers, allows wiretap orders on a person's name, and lets municipal officials assist bailiffs. The government reply partly followed the advice: notification is kept for powers requiring a rechter-commissaris warrant, the wiretap-on-name explanatory memorandum was clarified, and some drafting points were adopted while others were rejected.
concerns: Selection of powers for which notification is dropped lacks a clear basis in the intrusiveness of privacy infringement and should be consistently aligned with the existing graded safeguards.
Wiretap orders on a person's name without specifying numbers weaken the safeguards of necessity and proportionality, and the scope of 'in gebruik zijn' versus third-party phones needs clarification.
Redactional points on the wiretap provision and the new article 126nda Sv, where one suggestion was adopted and another was not.

33756.s: The bill introduces a levy on landlords of rental homes in the regulated sector from 2014 (verhuurderheffing), with a conditional reduction mechanism for investments in rental housing. It also gradually reduces the tax deduction for owner-occupied home costs above the fourth bracket rate and adjusts related mortgage rules.
33756.j: The memorandum justifies the flexible investment-reduction mechanism by the need to keep reductions in balance with the budget amounts in the state budget.
q: Depending on the (estimated) amount of investment reduction to be granted or granted, the Minister for Housing and Government Service may by ministerial regulation raise, lower or set to zero the amounts in article 1.11, first paragraph.

Afhankelijk van het (vermoedelijke) bedrag aan toe te kennen of toegekende heffingsvermindering kan de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst bij ministeriële regeling de in het artikel 1.11, eerste lid, opgenomen bedragen hoger, lager of op nihil stellen.
d: raising, lowering or zeroing investment reduction amounts
detailed rules on scope of investment reduction categories
compensation rules for services of general economic interest
content and procedure of investment notifications
annual adjustment of deduction correction rate
p: Minister may change investment reduction amounts by ministerial regulation to match the budget line, without a statutory amount change.
Compensation details and overcompensation recovery are left to ministerial regulation.
Annual change of the deduction correction percentage is set by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks for quantified distributional effects of the mortgage deduction reform and clarity on WOZ valuation, objections and administrative burden in the landlord levy.
Can the government specify this qualitatively and quantitatively?
Kan de regering dit kwalitatief en kwantitatief specificeren?
Supports the gradual phase-out of mortgage interest deduction and the pace chosen, while raising questions on transitional rules and effects on tenants.
These members firmly support this necessary housing market reform and are satisfied with the chosen pace of adjustment.
Deze leden staan vierkant achter deze noodzakelijke hervorming van de woningmarkt en zijn tevreden over het gekozen tempo van aanpassing.
Argues the levy burdens social tenants unfairly, asks whether tenants can object to WOZ valuations, and questions the design and consistency of the levy and its exemptions.
Will the government make it possible for tenants to object to an excessively high WOZ valuation of the home?
Gaat de regering het voor huurders mogelijk maken om bezwaar te maken tegen een te hoge WOZ-waardering van de woning?
Opposes the landlord levy as an investment-restricting tax and wants the mortgage interest deduction restriction reversed.
As far as the PVV members are concerned, the three options for housing corporations to qualify for a levy reduction can be scrapped
Wat de leden van de PVV-fractie betreft kunnen de drie opties voor woningcorporaties om in aanmerking te komen voor een heffingskorting worden geschrapt
Asks why the bill was not presented as a coherent whole, questions the basis for amounts and possible EU state-aid problems, and raises long-term legal certainty and proof issues.
Why did the government not seize the opportunity to present all housing market interventions to the House in coherence with each other?
Waarom heeft de regering de kans niet gegrepen alle ingrepen in de woningmarkt in samenhang met elkaar aan de Kamer aan te bieden?
Supports integrated housing reform but asks for justification of the levy reduction amounts, risks of free-riding and fraud, and the basis for the tax rate changes.
To what extent does the government expect there to be room for fraud within the application process?
In hoeverre verwacht de regering dat binnen het aanvraagproces ruimte is voor fraude?
Asks about implementation, the split of energy-saving funds between landlords and owners, and how the WOZ objection procedure and multi-owner rules affect equal treatment.
These members ask for a response to the proposal to amend article 1.3 so that rental homes with more than one owner are counted pro rata for each owner

Deze leden vragen een reactie op het voorstel om artikel 1.3 zodanig aan te passen dat huurwoningen waarvan meer dan één genothebbende krachtens eigendom bestaat, deze huurwoning pro rata voor iedere genothebbende in aanmerking wordt genomen
Doubts that tenants with lower incomes are adequately protected and asks how to prevent the levy being passed on to tenants.
How can it be avoided that the landlord levy is passed on to the tenant?
Hoe kan vermeden worden dat de verhuurderheffing doorbelast wordt aan de huurder?

Expresses surprise at the inclusion of owner-occupier cost changes, questions the equal-treatment basis for the shrinkage-area investment deduction, and asks about administrative costs relative to the benefit.

These members ask how it can be defended, in the interest of equal treatment, that municipalities with a greater shrinkage challenge than those included in the bill nevertheless do not qualify for the investment deduction.

Deze leden vragen hoe het vanuit het belang van rechtsgelijkheid te verdedigen is dat gemeenten die een grotere krimpopgave hebben dan de gemeenten die in het wetsvoorstel zijn opgenomen desondanks niet voor de investeringsaftrek in aanmerking komen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the aims of the Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 but advises reconsidering the heffingsvermindering in the landlord levy, dropping the distinction between large- and small-scale renovation, removing a reference to general tax law, and shortening the 28-year mortgage-interest cut period. The government's nader rapport largely rejects these remarks, keeping the heffingsvermindering and the distinction (with a future AMvB), adding EU state aid (DAEB) elements, and adjusting the formal provisions and the text.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the effectiveness of the €70 million heffingsvermindering as a fiscal subsidy and advises a separate financial arrangement instead; the government keeps the construction as a direct investment facility.
The Afdeling advises dropping the distinction between large-scale and small-scale renovation as hard to apply in practice; the government keeps it and will set limitative lists by AMvB.
The heffingsvermindering may be state aid under Article 107 TFEU; the government adds a DAEB definition and entrustment under the Vrijstellingsbesluit and does not notify the Commission.

The Afdeling asks for attention to the supply of income data for income-dependent rent increases; the government says this is addressed in a forthcoming evaluation rather than the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling advises deleting the reference to articles of the AWR and clarifying supervision in the formal provisions; the government adopts these changes, while rejecting the redactional rename to verhuurderbelasting.
The 28-year period of the mortgage-interest cut offers little real certainty, so a shorter period is advised; the government keeps the long-term package as a basispad.

33805-X.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, changing the 1st supplementary budget figures in thousands of euros with effect from 1 December 2013. It contains only budget amounts and standard entry-into-force provisions, with no explanatory memorandum available.
q: is amended, as appears from the budget statement attached to this law
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

33819.s: The bill introduces a levy on landlords of regulated rental dwellings from 2014 (the verhuurderheffing), with a reduction mechanism through investment declarations, and amends the Dutch income tax act to cap the tax deduction for mortgage interest on owner-occupied homes by gradually lowering the rate, alongside changes to mortgage debt rules. It also makes related adjustments to loon- and inkomstenbelasting tariffs and transitional provisions.
33819.j: The memorandum excerpt provided gives no justification for the ministerial delegations beyond the advice of the Raad van State being non-public, so no justification is stated.
q: If in the Minister's judgment there is or comes to be insufficient balance between the levy reductions and the amount budgeted for them, the amounts in the first and third paragraphs may by ministerial regulation be raised, lowered or set to zero from 1 January, 1 April, 1 July or 1 October of any year.

Indien naar het oordeel van Onze Minister op enig tijdstip onvoldoende evenwicht bestaat of komt te bestaan tussen de heffingsverminderingen en het daarvoor in de rijksbegroting opgenomen bedrag, kunnen bij ministeriële regeling met ingang van 1 januari, 1 april, 1 juli of 1 oktober van enig jaar de in het eerste lid en derde lid genoemde bedragen worden verhoogd, verlaagd, dan wel op nihil worden gesteld.
d: definition of investment and related terms
changing investment amounts and eligible areas
further rules on scope of heffingsvermindering
rules on compensation for services of general economic interest
annual adjustment of tax rate for deduction of owner-occupied home costs
p: The minister may by ministerial regulation raise, lower or zero the investment amounts and change the eligible municipalities depending on budget balance, with no parliamentary approval required.
The annual correction percentage for the deduction of owner-occupied home costs is set by ministerial regulation within a statutory bandwidth.

33837.s: The bill amends the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 to create a new category of expenditure-commitment agencies (verplichtingen-kasagentschappen), centralise government audit in a single Auditdienst Rijk, and extend the parliamentary pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure to certain private-law transactions by the State, while adding sunset requirements for subsidy schemes. It also abolishes the Voorlopige Rekening and reallocates ministerial responsibility for managing surplus movable and immovable state property.
33837.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as administrative efficiency and fitting management arrangements to agency needs, while the voorhang extension is justified as a parliamentary check on State transactions.
q: The purpose of the pre-consultation procedure is that the States General can express a view in advance on the correctness of the government's intention to carry out a certain private-law legal act.

Het doel van de voorhangprocedure is dat de Staten-Generaal vooraf een oordeel kunnen uitspreken over de juistheid van het voornemen van de regering om een bepaalde privaatrechtelijke rechtshandeling te verrichten.
d: budget statement for national debt set via departmental budget law
minister decides a unit operates as a commitment-cash agency
rules on audit by central Auditdienst Rijk
Minister of Finance prescribes relevant aspects for budget explanation
I.M (art. 34b, first paragraph, opening and point e)
Minister of Finance sets monetary threshold below which voorhang does not apply
subsidy schemes that expire under statutory horizon, extension via decree
p: Ministers may set up agencies with deviating financial management rules, subject to voorhang and Finance Minister consent.

Several categories of State private-law transactions are exempted from voorhang, including where a specific statutory basis exists or a financial threshold is not met, and the threshold is set by ministerial decision.
Appointment of audit head moves to the Finance Minister in consultation with other ministers, removing the per-ministry audit services and their appointment arrangements.
The Voorlopige Rekening sent to parliament each year is abolished, reducing an early information flow to the Staten-Generaal.
Adds a mandatory sunset horizon of up to five years for subsidy schemes, with a draft submitted to the Tweede Kamer before renewal, strengthening parliamentary control.

parties: Asks whether the lack of a statutory requirement for advance budget information in urgent cases can be mitigated by explicitly stating in law that written information alone is insufficient for the budget right.

The VVD members ask whether this concern could not be addressed by explicitly stating in the law that written advance budget information alone is not sufficient in urgent situations to satisfy the Staten-Generaal's budget right.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of dit zorgpunt niet te ondervangen is door in de wet expliciet op te nemen dat enkel schriftelijke vooruitlopende begrotingsinformatie in spoedeisende situaties niet voldoende is om te voldoen aan het budgetrecht van de Staten-Generaal?

Welcomes strengthening of parliament's budget right and asks how the pre-consultation procedure fits with confidentiality rules for market-sensitive information and whether the capital-contribution definition is too limited.
They are pleased that parliament's budget right is strengthened by the present amendment.
Zij zijn verheugd dat het budgetrecht van het parlement met voorliggende wijziging wordt versterkt.

Questions why urgent-case definitions were dropped in favour of a procedural approach, and notes the bill lacks an accountability protocol for breaches of the budget right and an information protocol.
The SP members miss a reference in the law to an accountability protocol in case the budget right is breached.
De leden van de SP-fractie missen in de wet een verwijzing naar een verantwoordingsprotocol indien het budgetrecht is geschonden.
Asks questions about the bill's provisions, including the transfer of surplus property to the Minister of BZK and its financial consequences, without taking a clear position on checks.
The D66 members note that the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK) becomes responsible for managing surplus immovable property.
De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) verantwoordelijk wordt voor het beheer van overtollige onroerende zaken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against the proposed article 14a Cw, which would formalise notification to parliament of urgent expenditure changes, arguing it adds no real value to the established material budget right and cannot replace formal budget authorisation, and recommended reconsidering it and its scope. The government's reply states it has withdrawn article 14a from the bill and adopted most other technical and drafting suggestions, while not following several on terminology and placement for reasons of the planned modernisation of the Comptabiliteitswet.
concerns: The Afdeling argued the proposed notification procedure cannot replace parliament's formal ex ante budget authorisation under article 105 of the Constitution, and the government withdrew article 14a.
The Afdeling was not convinced of the need for article 14a given the established material budget right practice, and the government dropped the provision.
The Afdeling found the criteria for urgent expenditure changes too broad and the examples not fitting, and asked for a narrower scope; this was moot after withdrawal.
The Afdeling suggested combining budget acts of Financiën and nationale schuld, or a broader approach; the government did not adopt this in the bill, citing the planned modernisation.

The Afdeling asked for additional explanation on verplichtingen-kasagentschappen criteria and placement of provisions in article 52 and 18 Cw; the government supplemented the explanation but kept the provisions where they were.
The Afdeling noted terminology on 'vermogen' in the voorhang provisions was unclear and asked for clarification, which the government adopted by using 'solvabiliteit' and 'eigen vermogen'.

The Afdeling advised clarifying the voorhang procedure regarding price-sensitive information and placing the Algemene Rekenkamer consultation rule in article 96 Cw; the explanation was supplemented but the placement advice was not followed.
The Afdeling advised transitional provision III(2) be recast as an instruction to adapt subsidy schemes, and the government moved it into article 24a.

33846.s: The bill establishes a statutory framework for public libraries, creating a network of local libraries, provincial support institutions and the Koninklijke Bibliotheek, and tasks the national library with running a national digital library, a shared collection plan, data delivery and tariff-setting. It gives the Minister and the national library new delegation, subsidy and data-collection powers while leaving most implementation to ministerial regulations and internal rules.
33846.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need for effective steering and cohesion of the library network and the desire for efficiency, while noting that statutory supervision would not fit a decentralised system.
q: This public authority is necessary to steer the network of public library facilities effectively and to achieve a certain degree of unity in the network.
Dit openbaar gezag is noodzakelijk om het netwerk van openbare bibliotheekvoorzieningen effectief aan te kunnen sturen en een zekere mate van eenheid in het netwerk te bewerkstelligen.
d: nature of data and rules on timing and manner of delivery (national library)
nature of data and rules on timing and manner of delivery (Minister)
subsidy rules, procedures and criteria of national library
tariffs for access to digital works (national library)
other groups of natural persons may become members
p: Ministerial supervision of subsidy recipients is limited to designated supervisors who lack the statutory investigative powers of the General Administrative Law Act.
Minister and municipal and provincial authorities jointly responsible for a network, with consultation before decisions that end library provision.
The national library may own and manage the national digital library and its infrastructure, drawing up its own access rules and plan.

parties: Asks why functions were expanded to culture and debate and whether this crowds out private providers, and questions the continued role of the province in the network.
Can the government provide a detailed explanation of this?
Kan de regering hier een uitgebreide toelichting op geven?
Worries about closures under budget cuts and asks whether a minimum distance to a library should be legally guaranteed.
They ask the government whether it shares the view that a much further reduction in the number of branches could undermine the intended coherent level of library provision.
Zij vragen de regering of ze de mening deelt dat een veel verdere afname van het aantal vestigingen het beoogde samenhangende niveau van bibliotheekvoorzieningen aan kan tasten.
Asks how guarantees for accessible libraries in every region will be secured and who will supervise this, given municipal budget cuts.
What guarantees are there to provide sufficient fully functioning libraries that are accessible to everyone?
Welke garanties zijn er om te voorzien in voldoende volwaardig functionerende bibliotheken die voor iedereen toegankelijk zijn?
Asks what is legally mandatory for municipalities regarding accessible libraries and whether a municipality may keep a library open in only one of its villages.
Is the municipality obliged to have sufficiently accessible libraries?
Is de gemeente verplicht om voldoende toegankelijke bibliotheken te hebben?

Asks how the five functions are to be applied, whether they apply per branch or per organisation, and what follows if an organisation cannot meet them; also asks whether municipalities keep policy freedom.
Can the government further clarify, including with examples, how the functions 'meeting and debate' and 'art and culture' are to be filled and with what frequency?
Kan de regering nader toelichten, ook met het gebruik van voorbeelden, hoe invulling gegeven moet worden aan de functies «ontmoeting en debat» en «kunst en cultuur» en met welke frequentie?
Asks how many municipalities currently lack a library, whether municipalities that already closed their libraries must participate, and how restricting out-of-town use fits the bill.
Are also the municipalities that have already decided to close the library provision in their municipality obliged to participate in this?
Zijn ook de gemeenten die reeds besloten hebben om de bibliotheekvoorziening in hun gemeente te sluiten verplicht hieraan deel te nemen?
Asks whether the regulation offers enough room for tailored solutions and questions the necessity of a single membership registration alongside the national catalogue.
They have questions about whether the proposed regulation is the most effective and whether sufficient scope for tailored solutions is provided.
Zij hebben vragen of de voorgestelde regeling het meest doeltreffend is en of voldoende ruimte voor maatwerk wordt geboden.
Supports keeping physical libraries and proposes a reduced membership rate for over-65s and legal guarantees for people with reading disabilities.
These members consider it important to give specific attention to the position of and provisions for people with a reading disability in the bill, to secure accessibility.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk om de positie van en de voorzieningen voor mensen met een leesbeperking specifieke aandacht te gunnen in het wetsvoorstel, om de toegankelijkheid te borgen.

33855.s: The bill clarifies that the single-parent tax credit (alleenstaande-ouderkorting) is taken into account when calculating survivor benefits for single parents and when computing benefits under the Civilian War Victims Act, and that employers who are self-insured for sickness benefits pay premiums on benefits they pay themselves under the Unemployment Act. It also contains a conditional amendment to the Civilian War Victims Act tied to a pending child-benefit reform bill and sets entry-into-force and retroactivity dates.
q: it is desirable to clarify that the calculation of the survivor benefit for single parents takes the single-parent tax credit into account
het wenselijk is te verduidelijken dat bij de berekening van de nabestaandenuitkering voor alleenstaande ouders rekening gehouden wordt met de alleenstaande ouderkorting

parties: Asks what the legal consequences are of giving the inspector power to revise decisions under the Wfsv, and whether the distinction between employers and withholding agents is removed.
The VVD members ask what all the legal consequences of this amendment are, now that the Inspector can revise decisions?
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen wat alle rechtsgevolgen zijn van deze wijziging, nu de Inspecteur beschikkingen kan herzien?
Asks why only the income-independent part of the single-parent allowance is taken into account, why the Werkloosheidswet clarification was needed, and about total benefit costs.
The PvdA members ask why it was chosen to take into account only the income-independent part of the single-parent allowance and not the income-dependent part.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom ervoor is gekozen om alleen rekening te houden met het inkomensonafhankelijke deel van de alleenstaande-ouderkorting en niet het inkomensafhankelijke deel.
Asks whether the SVB has informed those affected about the wrong calculation and how beneficiaries will be informed about the changes.
Can the government explain how those concerned will be further informed about the changes arising from this bill, these members want to know.
Kan de regering toelichten hoe de betrokkenen verder geïnformeerd gaan worden over de wijzigingen die uit dit wetsvoorstel voortvloeien, zo willen deze leden weten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports a technical bill restoring the single-parent deduction (alleenstaande-ouderkorting) in the Anw and WUBO benefit calculations, but asks that the text match the explanatory memorandum on the income-independent part only and that the link to the Wet IB 2001 be removed when the Hervorming kindregelingen bill takes effect. The government's reply accepts the points, amends the bill accordingly, and adds a technical Werkloosheidswet change and redactional corrections.
concerns: The bill's reference to article 8.15 Wet IB 2001 covers both the income-independent and income-dependent parts, contrary to the explanatory memorandum, so the text must be aligned with the memorandum.
The bill must provide that the reference to article 8.15 in the WUBO lapses when the Hervorming kindregelingen bill enters into force, to avoid overlap between the two bills.
Redactional comments on the entry-into-force provision are incorporated into the bill text.

33882.s: The bill amends the Municipalities Act and the Dutch Criminal Code to widen mayors' powers to impose area bans, group bans and reporting duties, including against first offenders and on the basis of private-body sanctions such as KNVB stadium bans, and to let courts impose area bans and extend the maximum duration of freedom-restricting measures from two to five years. It targets football hooliganism and other public-order disturbances.
33882.j: The memorandum justifies the expansion by evaluation findings that current measures are too short and that mayors cannot act against first offenders in football-related disorder, and it stresses proportionality and judicial review as safeguards.
q: This bill therefore contains a new second paragraph of article 172a of the Municipalities Act, whereby conduct sanctioned by the KNVB or a football club with a stadium ban can sometimes be a sufficient basis for the mayor to impose an area ban, reporting duty or group ban.
Dit wetsvoorstel bevat om die reden een nieuw (tweede) lid van artikel 172a van de Gemeentewet, waardoor een gedraging die door de KNVB of een voetbalclub is gesanctioneerd met een stadionverbod
d: sanctions by private organisations that can ground a mayoral order
p: Artikel I, A.1 and A.2 (art. 172a Gemeentewet)
Mayors may impose area bans, group bans and reporting duties on first offenders and on persons sanctioned by private organisations, lowering the threshold from repeated disturbance.
Courts gain power to impose area bans and the maximum duration of freedom-restricting measures rises from two to five years.

parties: Asks whether a mayoral order based on a club-imposed stadium ban will withstand judicial review and whether evidentiary weaknesses arise.
Will this construction hold up before a judge?
Zal deze constructie bij een rechter standhouden?

Wants restrictive rules and prudent use of mayoral powers over first offenders and private sanctions to avoid disproportionate or automatic application, and asks about procedural minimum requirements.
They consider it undesirable if the formulated requirements are set aside in practice, so that every first offender would automatically fall under article 172a of the Gemeentewet.

Zij achten het onwenselijk als de geformuleerde vereisten in de praktijk terzijde worden geschoven en daarmee iedere first offender automatisch onder de werking van artikel 172a Gemeentewet zou komen te vallen.
Questions how the 'aannemelijke kans' on repetition is assessed for first offenders and asks for a critical review of generic supporter measures harming law-abiding fans.
Given that there is little or no file-building for first offenders, these members ask how the 'reasonable chance' is established.
Gezien het feit dat er bij first offenders niet of nauwelijks sprake is van dossieropbouw, vragen deze leden hoe de «aannemelijke kans» wordt vastgesteld.

Asks what distinguishes serious from less serious disturbances of public order, how first-offender measures fit the definition, and how mayoral and prosecutorial decisions are coordinated to avoid duplication.
These members ask the government to explain what it considers the distinction between 'serious' and evidently less serious disturbances of public order.
Deze leden vragen de regering aan te geven wat volgens haar het onderscheid is tussen «ernstige» en klaarblijkelijk minder ernstige verstoringen van de openbare orde.

Worries about the breadth of the gebiedsgebod, its tension with article 5 EVRM on deprivation of liberty, and the risk of automatic mayoral measures based on private sanctions; suggests parliamentary involvement via a voorhang procedure.
They ask which additional measures the KNVB is taking and whether those could have the same or even better effect than the measures in this bill.
Zij vragen welke aanvullende maatregelen de KNVB neemt en of die maatregelen niet een zelfde of zelfs beter effect kunnen hebben dan de maatregelen in dit wetsvoorstel.
Questions whether another evaluation of the law will be carried out, given the early evaluation and the risk of an overloaded toolbox of overlapping instruments.
Is the government willing to carry out another evaluation of the bill?
Is de regering bereid om nog een evaluatie van het wetsvoorstel te laten uitvoeren?
Asks how a judge would treat a bevel based on a single serious incident and how the 90-day cumulative orders and mutual mayoral orders would operate in practice.
In cases like this, could a mayor's order withstand substantive review by the judge?
Kan een bevel van de burgemeester in dit soort gevallen na inhoudelijke toetsing door de rechter wel stand houden?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised against proceeding without further justification: it found the need for amending the Wet mbveo insufficiently motivated, objected to dropping the repeat-offence requirement for mayoral orders, to using private stadium bans as a basis, and to the broad criminal home-confinement order which may amount to deprivation of liberty under ECHR Article 5. The government's reply largely accepted the repeat-offence and private-ban concerns (amended text, explanatory memorandum) but kept the home-confinement order and rejected narrowing it, while defending the need for the amendment.
concerns: The need for amending the Wet mbveo so soon after its introduction is not convincingly motivated; the government defends the amendment on the basis of knockout problems from evaluation and municipal requests.
Dropping the repeat-offence requirement removes a proportionality safeguard; the requirement is retained and first offences are only covered for serious disturbances.

Private stadium bans as grounds for a mayoral order are legally questionable; the mayor must independently assess reliability and motivation, and the private-sanction basis is deferred to a general administrative order.

The criminal home-confinement order can amount to deprivation of liberty under ECHR Article 5 and is not limited in duration or intensity; the government declined to narrow it, pointing to the court's case-by-case proportionality assessment.
The explanatory memorandum did not address the relationship between the home-confinement order and ECHR Article 5; a passage was added but no narrowing of the measure was made.
A reference to the Labita v. Italy case in the explanatory memorandum was removed as an inapt illustration.

33891.s: The bill replaces the AWBZ with a new Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz), a mandatory long-term care insurance covering the whole population, with eligibility limited to people with lasting need for permanent supervision or 24-hour care nearby. It sets out the insured package, the roles of Wlz-insurers, the CIZ, CAK and Zorginstituut, eigen bijdragen, and delegates much detail to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations.
33891.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to regulate detailed and changing care matters that cannot be fixed in the statute itself, such as tariffs, budgets and care profiles.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, the nature, content and scope of the insured care may be further regulated.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen aard, inhoud en omvang van de verzekerde zorg nader worden geregeld.
d: aard, inhoud en omvang van verzekerde zorg
voortzetting zorg na beëindiging verzekering en weigering of uitstel van zorg
zorg buiten Nederland en eigen bijdrage
indeling in regio's en aanwijzing administratie-uitvoerder
uitbreiding of beperking van de kring van verzekerden
wijze van indicatiestelling en geldigheidsduur indicatiebesluit
vaststelling voorbereiding Wlz-uitvoerder door zorgautoriteit bij amvb-regels
uitkering aan Minister van Defensie uit Fonds langdurige zorg
p: The CIZ may ask the court to grant a compulsory-care authorisation for a person under the Wet zorg en dwang.
The Wlz-insurer decides whether care may be provided without residence, based on its own judgement of responsible delivery and tariff limits.
The CIZ may revise or withdraw an indication decision where the insured person is no longer dependent on the care.
The Minister may prohibit insurers from outsourcing work to a named Wlz-insurer and withdraw its designation.

parties: Asks for an overview and justification of all delegation provisions (algemene maatregel van bestuur) in the bill, including why matters are not regulated in the law itself.
Can the government provide an overview of all delegation provisions in the bill?
Kan de regering een overzicht geven van alle delegatiebepalingen in het wetsvoorstel?
Asks how clients can effectively act when dissatisfied with care quality, given limited choice and dependence on providers, and how the client's position is protected.
How can clients, when they are not satisfied with the quality of care delivered in an institution, concretely bring about an improvement in the care provided?
Hoe kunnen cliënten, wanneer zij niet tevreden zijn over de kwaliteit van geleverde zorg in een instelling, concreet een verbetering in geleverde zorg tot stand laten komen?
Criticises the splitting of the AWBZ across laws and the forced relocation of vulnerable elderly, and questions whether the government has a fallback scenario if decentralisations fail.
These members ask whether the government has a contingency scenario ready in case the decentralisations turn into a fiasco.
Genoemde leden vragen of de regering een noodscenario heeft klaarliggen in het geval de decentralisaties op een fiasco uitdraaien.
Demands clarity on the financial consequences for clients, families and middle incomes, and on the eigen bijdrage regime before the bill is debated.
This information is necessary before the bill is debated, since these members must be able to assess whether the client's position is in balance with the financial consequences.

Deze informatie is noodzakelijk voordat de wetsbehandeling plaatsvindt aangezien deze leden moeten kunnen beoordelen of de positie van de cliënt in relatie tot de financiële consequenties in evenwicht is.
Argues the reform undermines solidarity and access to care for lower-income people, and objects to the medical confidentiality implications of data sharing with the CIZ.
Is the patient's explicit consent not required here? Is this not simply an erosion of medical confidentiality?
Is hier niet expliciet toestemming van de patiënt voor nodig? Is hier niet gewoon sprake van uitholling van het medisch beroepsgeheim.
Sees the bill as a modest first step, regrets limited innovation, and questions whether the 1 January 2015 date is realistic for providers and insurers.
These members ask to what extent the government considers this date realistically achievable.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre de regering deze datum realistisch gezien haalbaar acht.
Worries about the speed of the reforms and the risks involved, and questions whether care can be delivered at home amid budget cuts.
They are very worried about the way this is taking shape, the haste with which the reforms are being introduced and the risks that accompany this.
Zij maken zich grote zorgen over de manier waarop dit vorm krijgt, de haast waarmee de hervormingen worden ingevoerd en de risico's waarmee dit gepaard gaat.
Asks how access to in-kind care for complex cases is guaranteed and how pgb ceilings and reallocation of unused funds will work.
Can the government again answer this question, specifically regarding in-kind care?
Kan de regering nogmaals antwoord geven op deze vraag, specifiek ten aanzien van zorg in natura?
Worries about the sharing of medical data with the CIZ without patient consent, undermining doctor-patient trust and privacy.
The fact that medical data can in that case be passed to the CIZ without consent and possibly breaching professional confidentiality worries these members greatly.
Het feit dat de medische gegevens in dat geval zonder toestemming en eventueel met een doorbreking van het beroepsgeheim aan het CIZ kunnen worden vertrekt, baart deze leden veel zorgen
Objects to the budget cuts and the lack of data on forced relocations, and doubts continuity of care after the transfer to Wmo and Zvw.
Questions the premium level, financial sustainability, and whether clients retain enforceable rights when care shifts to Wmo and Zvw.
Says the government did not answer many questions and insists medical data may only be shared with the client's consent.
The PVV members maintain that any transfer of medical data may only take place with the client's consent.
De leden van de PVV-fractie blijven van mening dat iedere overdracht van medische gegevens alleen met toestemming van de cliënt mag plaatsvinden.
Regrets the limited shift toward client self-direction and asks how care planning will be guaranteed in practice.
How is it ensured that this is actually realised?
Op welke wijze wordt geborgd dat dit ook daadwerkelijk wordt gerealiseerd
Says the proposal still places the starting point with the system and institutional care rather than client self-direction.
Asks what the legal status of the zorgkantoor's judgment is and whether a client can stay at home against the office's view, stressing citizens' own control over the choice.
These members believe people should themselves have control over the choice whether or not to live in an institution.
Genoemde leden vinden dat mensen zelf zeggenschap moeten hebben over de keuze om al dan niet in een instelling te wonen.
Worries about bureaucracy, complexity, and providers shifting responsibility; asks how the new package protects clients and why zorgkantoren rather than professionals assess intake.
These members note that the government earlier stated the AWBZ had become too complicated and that reforms were partly necessary for that reason.
Deze leden constateren dat de regering eerder heeft aangegeven dat de Algemene Wet Bijzondere Ziektekosten (AWBZ) te ingewikkeld is geworden en dat mede hierdoor hervormingen noodzakelijk zijn.
Asks why the zorgkantoor, not the independent CIZ, assesses multi-care requests and how independent indication is guaranteed.
It is good that the Wlz is based on independent needs assessment.
Het is goed dat de Wlz uitgaat van een onafhankelijke indicatiestelling.
Questions unclear figures on savings and transfers, the readiness of zorgkantoren, and whether the law should take effect on 1 January 2015 without proper preparation.
If the zorgkantoren are not yet ready for their tasks, why does the government still choose to have this law take effect on 1 January 2015 and be rushed through the House?

Als de zorgkantoren nog niet klaar zijn voor de taken die ze krijgen, waarom kiest de regering er dan toch voor om deze wet per 1 januari 2015 in te laten gaan en wordt deze wet zo door de Kamer gejast.
Requests a clear overview of entitlements per delivery form and asks on what criteria the Wlz-uitvoerder decides verantwoord and doelmatig, and who has the final word in disputes.
Who ultimately has the 'last word', how are the client's own control and freedom of choice safeguarded, and how does this relate, also legally, to the Wlz-uitvoerder's duty of care?

Wie heeft uiteindelijk het «laatste woord», hoe worden de eigen regie en keuzevrijheid van de cliënt daarbij geborgd, en hoe verhoudt dit zich – ook juridisch – tot de zorgplicht van de Wlz-uitvoerder?
Asks whether the modulair pakket thuis removes barriers to combining care forms and the financial consequences for budget holders.
The GroenLinks members would like more clarity on what this will actually mean for budget holders.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie krijgen graag meer duidelijkheid wat dit feitelijk voor budgethouders gaat betekenen.
Asks whether clients should be free to choose vpt, mpt or pgb when legal guarantees are met, rather than the zorgkantoor being able to override the choice, and whether the CIZ must be independent.
They ask whether the government intends to amend the statutory provisions so that the zorgkantoor no longer has the freedom to ignore the client's choice.
Zij vragen of de regering voornemens is de wettelijke bepalingen in die zin aan te passen, namelijk dat het zorgkantoor niet langer de vrijheid heeft de keuze van de cliënt te negeren.
Asks how it is guaranteed that everyone entitled to a pgb receives one if demand exceeds the regional ceiling and whether people could fall between chairs.
Is it possible that people fall between two stools?
Is het mogelijk dat er mensen tussen de wal en het schip gaan vallen?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the aim of the Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz) but raises concerns about its unclear long-term perspective, the boundary with the Wmo 2015 and Zvw, the processing of health data (including an 'irrevocable consent' it deems not valid consent), and implementation issues, advising revision. The government's reply accepts most points, amends the bill on data processing and consent, clarifies the boundaries, and rejects or explains away some points on the long-term perspective and implementation.
concerns: The unclear description of the Wlz's long-term perspective and the mixed signals about a shift toward a voorzieningenstelsel should be clarified; the government clarified the explanatory memorandum.

The 'irrevocable consent' regime for processing health data is not valid consent and is disproportionate; the government replaced it with a statutory obligation for providers to supply data, specifying recipients and content.

Data exchange of health information between Wlz actors and municipalities needs a specific purpose, necessity and proportionality; the government narrowed exchanges to 'that' information and specified purposes.
Automatic notification to municipalities of every indication decision is not proportionate; the government limited notification to cases where coordination is needed.

The Wlz-uitvoerder's duty of care, client support and pgb tasks were not clearly formulated in law; the government clarified the zorgplicht but client support is only partly regulated and state-aid compliance was addressed.

Application of Article 106 TFEU (services of general economic interest) and the Altmark criteria to the Wlz uitvoering needed explanation; the memorandum was corrected and the Services Directive note added.
Broad delegation to lower regulation on pgb conditions and entitlement criteria was flagged as needing clearer statutory anchors; the reply largely defers to later ministerial regulation.

33918.s: The bill amends the Wft and related financial-markets legislation: it extends fit-and-proper testing and the oath or pledge to more bank and insurer staff, lets DNB request data from government bodies and private parties for macroprudential purposes, and makes other technical changes on covered bonds, fund managers, concern finance companies and accountant oversight. Most of the new powers are conferred by general administrative order (AMvB) or ministerial regulation, with DNB given new information-gathering powers.
33918.j: The memorandum justifies the new DNB data powers by the need to detect systemic risks and meet international data requests, and it limits use and cost of the data collected.
q: To carry out those tasks properly, DNB must be able to identify and analyse developments relevant to financial stability in time and must be able to advise on them.

Om die taken naar behoren te kunnen uitvoeren moet DNB ontwikkelingen die relevant zijn voor de stabiliteit van het financiële stelsel tijdig kunnen signaleren en analyseren en zij moet daarover kunnen adviseren.
d: fitness requirement for staff below policymaker level
details of the oath or pledge for financial staff
procedures and conditions for notifying changes by central counterparties
rules ensuring covered bond payments are secured and conditions for registration
information duties of banks issuing registered covered bonds
professional competence rules, diplomas and examinations
details of the oath or pledge for investment and payment firms staff
further rules on fund management conduct
business operations rules including payment traffic reliability
designation of bodies and categories from which DNB may request data
fees and cost rules for data provision to DNB
p: DNB obtains a new power to request non-personal data from government bodies, semi-public bodies and private firms, with use restricted to statistics and analysis and confidentiality limited.
The AFM may share confidential information with DNB where necessary for DNB's supervisory tasks, subject to consent rules for information from other supervisors.
The AFM may request court dissolution or liquidation of investment companies or funds in defined cases, through the court rather than administratively.

parties: Asks how the government can make good on the state's responsibility for suitability screening, whether DNB's risk-based supervision works in practice, and whether the oath extension is necessary given sector initiatives.

How does the government intend to make good on the government's responsibility, given that compliance with the norm can be properly carried out by the firm itself, placing the ball effectively with the sector, and supervision is only risk-based?

Hoe denkt de regering de verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid waar te kunnen maken, ook al omdat aangegeven wordt dat de naleving van de norm door de onderneming zelf naar behoren kan geschieden en de bal dus feitelijk bij de sector wordt gelegd en het toezicht alleen risicogebaseerd wordt ingericht?

Supports extending suitability and integrity screening to persons with major influence on risk profiles, but asks which supervisor is responsible and why the screening is limited to banks and insurers, which could encourage avoidance.
The PvdA members favour extending suitability and integrity screening to persons who can exert major influence on the risk profile of a financial firm.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn voorstander van uitbreiding van de geschiktheids- en betrouwbaarheidstoetsing naar personen die grote invloed uit kunnen oefenen op het risicoprofiel van een financiële onderneming.
Asks which groups fall under the screening extension, whether traders should be covered, and which authority will enforce the advertising ban abroad.
Which authority will monitor this ban, and what resources will it be given to do so?
Welke instantie gaat dit verbod controleren? En welke middelen krijgt zij mee om deze controle te doen?
Welcomes the screening extension provided costs for lower staff remain proportionate, and asks about the cumulative burden of new regulation on competitiveness.
Can the government also address employer associations' concerns about extending the banker's oath to lower-level staff, particularly for very small financial institutions?
Kan de regering ook ingaan op de zorgen van werkgeversverenigingen op de gevolgen van het verbreden van de bankierseed naar lager personeel voor met name (hele) kleine financiële instellingen?
Asks why the screened group is not extended beyond banks and insurers and what DNB's data-collection powers entail, including safeguards for data protection.
In what way will DNB ensure that data protection is guaranteed when providing information to international organisations?
Op welke wijze gaat DNB ervoor zorgen dat gegevensbescherming bij het verstrekken van informatie aan internationale organisaties gewaarborgd blijft?
Supports the screening extension in general but asks why DNB rather than firms should assess skills and knowledge, and why the extension is limited to banks and insurers.
Why does the government consider it desirable that responsibility for assessing the required knowledge and skills lies with DNB rather than with the firm itself?
Waarom acht de regering het wenselijk dat de verantwoordelijkheid om de vereiste kennis en vaardigheden te beoordelen bij DNB komt te liggen in plaats van bij de onderneming zelf?
Positive on the screening and oath extension but wants safeguards against dilution, asks about enforceability, and asks whether the banker's oath introduced in 2013 has been evaluated.
Has an evaluation of this instrument already taken place, these members ask.
Heeft er reeds een evaluatie van dit instrument plaatsgevonden, zo vragen deze leden?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against the proposed statutory obligation for banks to introduce disciplinary law for staff and to extend the oath or pledge to all bank employees, arguing the disciplinary regime is essentially private-law, self-regulation exists, and the oath would lose meaning. The minister's nader rapport rejects most objections, keeps the proposal, and amends the explanatory memorandum on DNB/AFM roles, consultation and transitional law.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the necessity of a statutory disciplinary obligation given existing sector self-regulation and adequate supervision under Wft article 3:10; the government rejected this, citing sector demand and added effectiveness.
The Afdeling said the bank disciplinary law must be private-law in nature under article 113(2) Grondwet; the explanatory memorandum was adjusted accordingly.
The Afdeling advised against extending the oath or pledge to all bank employees because its symbolic value would diminish with a massive, heterogeneous group; the government maintained the extension.
The Afdeling held that DNB and AFM lack a statutory basis to refer cases to a private disciplinary body; the government deleted that passage from the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of whether supervisors were consulted; the government reports consultation and adjusted the memorandum.
Redactional comments were incorporated, except the request for a three-month transitional period, and a wrong cross-reference was corrected.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2015 criminalising benchmark manipulation should be reconsidered: it anticipated EU regulation without sufficient justification, its scope was unclear relative to the EU Market Abuse Regulation, and the increase in maximum penalties needed proportionality reasoning. The minister's reply accepted the scope point and widened the bill to cover benchmarks used in non-platform instruments, and defended the penalty increase and the anticipation of EU rules with added explanation.
concerns: Anticipating the EU Market Abuse Regulation requires adequate justification and caution, which the government defended while adding explanation in the explanatory memorandum.
The scope of the national benchmark ban was narrower than the EU regulation, so the scope was widened to include benchmarks used in instruments not traded on a regulated platform.

The increase in the maximum prison sentence from two to six years must be proportionate to the nature and gravity of the offence, which the government justified by reference to seriousness and EU developments.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2015, raising concerns about the broadened suitability and integrity requirement for staff below policymaking level at banks and insurers, the shift of responsibility to the state, EU-law aspects of the advertising ban, and forwarding of accountancy complaints to the AFM and NBA. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the remarks, narrowing the scope of the suitability requirement, adding explanations and amendments, and removing or clarifying several provisions, though it did not drop the broadened requirement or the accountancy-complaint notification scheme in full.
concerns: The Afdeling warned that the broadened suitability requirement shifts the balance between the responsibility of financial firms and that of the state, and that the state takes on responsibility that may not be deliverable; the government narrowed the scope to a limited group but maintained the shared-responsibility approach.

The Afdeling found the scope of persons covered by the suitability and integrity requirement too broad and inconsistent with the explanation; the government limited it to a small number of senior persons directly below policymaking level.

The Afdeling noted that the advertising ban on systemic relevance applies also to foreign undertakings offering services in the Netherlands, requiring explanation of compatibility with EU law; the government restructured the article and clarified its scope.

The Afdeling considered that forwarding complaint files from the accountancy chamber to supervisors could infringe the privacy of complainants and advised deleting article 25a; the government amended the scheme so complainants can request anonymised transmission.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the consequences of deregistration of covered bonds and of the open-ended DNB power to amend registration; the government clarified the explanation and removed the unclear provisions.
The Afdeling made numerous redactional remarks on the draft text, which the government adopted in the revised bill.

33927.s: The bill amends the Statistics Netherlands Act so that CBS can assist the European Commission in inspections into manipulated statistics under Delegated Decision 2012/678/EU. It lets the director-general designate officials who receive the Commission's inspection powers and makes data collected for such assistance available only to the Commission.
33927.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to implement the EU delegated decision, which requires national statistical authorities to assist the Commission, and grants officials the same powers as Commission inspectors.
q: CBS provides assistance at the request of the European Commission in an inspection under Article 5(4) of Delegated Decision 2012/678/EU.
Het CBS verleent op verzoek van de Europese Commissie bijstand bij een inspectie op grond van artikel 5, vierde lid, van Gedelegeerd besluit 2012/678/EU
d: designating CBS officials to provide inspection assistance
p: Data collected for inspection assistance are exempted from the confidentiality rule of Article 37 and may be passed to the European Commission.

33940-X.s: The bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, adjusting expenditure, commitments and revenue across operational and non-operational articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2014, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this law.
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.
