33954.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2011/99/EU on the European protection order by adding a new Title 4 to the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, under which the public prosecutor (officier van justitie) may recognise and enforce protection orders issued by other EU states and may issue such orders for Dutch protected persons. It also empowers police to order compliance with enforced measures and sets out the prosecutor's powers to modify, extend, or withdraw measures.
33954.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as required by the directive, arguing that the prosecutor is the appropriate authority given existing competences and that civil summary proceedings provide a safeguard.
q: I therefore propose giving the police the power, in case of a violation or threatened violation of the measures, to order the dangerous person to comply with the relevant measure or measures.

Ik stel daarom voor om de politie de bevoegdheid te geven om in geval van een overtreding of dreigende inbreuk op de bedoelde maatregelen -en deze inbreuk als zodanig niet strafbaar is- een bevel te geven aan de persoon die gevaar veroorzaakt om de desbetreffende maatregel of maatregelen na te leven.
d: rules for collecting and providing data on enforcement of the title
p: The public prosecutor may refuse recognition of a foreign protection order on several grounds, with the protected person only informed and able to seek relief via civil summary proceedings.
The prosecutor imposes and modifies restrictive measures on the dangerous person, with notification to the affected parties and the issuing authority.
Police are empowered to order a person to comply with protection measures, backed by criminal liability for non-compliance.

parties: Asks whether there is discretion beyond the limited refusal grounds, and raises the risk that the endangering person could misuse the right to be heard to delay the decision.

Does the phrase "in principle" refer to the exception where a member state does not know the measures and to the exhaustive list of refusal grounds, or are other exceptions possible for not recognising or enforcing an EPO?

Ziet de formulering «in beginsel» op de uitzondering wanneer een lidstaat de betreffende maatregelen niet kent en op de limitatieve lijst weigeringsgronden of zijn er ook nog andere uitzonderingen mogelijk voor het niet erkennen of ten uitvoer leggen van een EB?
Questions how the hearing of the endangering person fits the directive's premise of no new procedure, the possibility of refusal, and whether the protected person must initiate the request.

While the hearing of the endangering person by the authority of another member state appears careful, to what extent does it fit with the starting point of the directive and bill that no new procedure in another member state is needed for a protection measure?

Het komt de leden van de PvdA-fractie weliswaar als zorgvuldig over dat de persoon die gevaar kan veroorzaken door de autoriteit van een andere lidstaat gehoord wordt, maar in hoeverre verhoudt zich dit tot het uitgangspunt van de richtlijn en het wetsvoorstel dat er geen nieuwe procedure in een andere lidstaat nodig is voor een beschermingsmaatregel?
Asks where objection and appeal against a protection measure can be lodged, given it restricts liberty, and whether recognition principles leave such challenges unavailable in practice.

This raises for the SP members the question in which member state objection and appeal can be lodged against the protection measure, which nonetheless entails a (albeit light) form of restriction of liberty.

Bij de leden van de SP-fractie roept dit vervolgens de vraag op in welke lidstaat bezwaar en beroep kan worden aangetekend tegen de beschermingsmaatregel, die toch een (weliswaar lichte) vorm van vrijheidsbeperking inhoudt.
Asks whether the receiving state will inevitably have to make a limited assessment, and whether converting a measure into another type requires judging offence seriousness and circumstances.

Does converting the imposed measure into another measure not also require an assessment of the seriousness of the offence the endangering person is suspected or convicted of, the personal situation, and the other current facts and circumstances of the case?

Vraagt een omzetting van de opgelegde maatregel in een andere maatregel ook niet om een inschatting van de ernst van het delict waarvan de gevaar veroorzakend persoon wordt verdacht of is veroordeeld, de persoonlijke situatie en de overige (actuele) feiten en omstandigheden van het geval?
Asks which prosecution office will issue orders, the financial and administrative consequences, and the necessity of the directive for Dutch citizens given low expected use.
These members therefore want to know what the necessity is for the Dutch citizen to regulate this matter at European level.
Deze leden willen daarom graag weten wat de noodzaak is voor de Nederlandse burger om deze aangelegenheid in Europees verband te regelen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill implementing Directive 2011/99/EU on the European protection order, but raises concerns about the lapse of implementing measures after the maximum duration and asks for clarification of their status. The government's nader rapport accepts most points, agrees to clarify the explanatory memorandum on the validity period and to amend the notification provision and the definition, and explains why certain other points do not require changes.
concerns: The status of implementing measures that remain in force after their maximum duration has expired is unclear, creating a risk the protected person goes unprotected; the explanatory memorandum should clarify this.
The definition in article 5:4:1(b) should refer to the measures listed in article 5:4:3(a) to align with the directive.
Notification of changes or withdrawal of the protection order should also be sent to the person posing the danger, which the government will add to article 5:4:16(4).
The treatment of the theoretical situation under article 9(2) of the directive should be explained; the government adds clarification to the explanatory memorandum rather than the bill text.
Several redactional points are adopted in the bill and explanatory memorandum.

33972.s: The bill amends the Pensioenwet and the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling to tighten the financial supervision framework for pension funds, replacing the short-term and long-term recovery plan system with a single recovery plan regime, tying conditional indexation and premium reductions to a policy coverage ratio, and replacing the continuity analysis with a feasibility test. It also sets transitional rules and makes the recovery plan and actualisation rules subject to ministerial and general administrative order (AMvB) regulation.
33972.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need to correct weaknesses exposed by the financial crisis and rising life expectancy, and to make the supervisory framework more consistent and realistic.
q: The required own funds amount to about 21.7% of nominal pension obligations and ensure that rights need not be directly affected if setbacks occur.
Het vereist eigen vermogen bedraagt circa 21,7% van de nominale pensioenverplichtingen 22 en zorgt ervoor dat de rechten niet direct aangetast hoeven te worden als er tegenvallers zijn.
d: rules on premium-related matters and risk appetite
consistency requirements for insurer conditional indexation
premium discount and policy coverage ratio rules
further rules on reduction of accrued pension rights
conditions and measures in recovery plans
further rules on updated recovery plans
further rules on minimum required own funds measures
exemption from recovery period in exceptional economic situation
further rules on premium discount and refund conditions
p: I, T (Art. 142 Pensioenwet); II, R (Art. 137 Wvb)

The Minister may by ministerial regulation, after consulting the supervisor, exempt funds from the statutory ten-year recovery period and the five-year minimum-own-funds deadline in exceptional economic situations.
I, N (Art. 134 Pensioenwet); II, L (Art. 129 Wvb)

Funds may reduce accrued pension rights when the coverage ratio is below required levels and other measures are exhausted, with the nominal reduction now possible even above minimum required own funds, while the supervisor retains consultation role.
I, A/Art. 1 and II, A (afkoop definition); I, C (Art. 65)
Reductions of pension rights under the recovery provisions are excluded from the definition of buy-out, narrowing the legal category of cases covered by buy-out protections.
The continuity analysis is replaced by a feasibility test, with the supervisor's harder standard removed and reliance placed on fund boards and social partners communicating mismatches.
Premium discounts and refunds are tied to the policy coverage ratio, giving funds discretion over premium and refund decisions within statutory conditions.

parties: Requests an overview of all matters left to lower regulation with timelines and whether they will be pre-submitted to parliament, and questions the generational neutrality of the framework.

They therefore request an overview of all matters still to be elaborated in lower regulation, with a timeline per elaboration and the form of lower regulation, including whether it will be pre-submitted to the Chamber.

Daarom vragen ze een overzicht van alle zaken die nog in nadere regelgeving uitgewerkt moeten worden, met een tijdspad per uitwerking en de manier van lagere regelgeving inclusief het antwoord op de vraag of deze al dan niet bij de Kamer wordt voorgehangen.
Supports advance clarity on risk sharing and asks whether DNB should be involved beforehand and whether a generational balance test should apply to crisis plans.
They see a possibility for a generational balance test for the financial crisis plan, modelled on the test in the Witteveen legislation.
Deze leden zien een mogelijkheid in een generatie-evenwichtstoets voor het financieel crisisplan, naar voorbeeld van de toets in de Witteveenwetgeving.
Strongly opposed to the near impossibility of compensating price increases and undoing cuts, and asks the government to answer the 44 questions from unions and pensioner organisations.
They note that compensation for price increases over the coming five to ten years is made almost impossible.
Zij stellen vast dat compensatie van prijsstijgingen voor de komende vijf tot tien jaar vrijwel onmogelijk wordt gemaakt.

Disappointed that the reform has stalled; argues nominal guarantees are unrealistic for young participants and fears pension funds being tied to a strict nominal framework under very low interest rates.
In these circumstances the CDA sees it as a real danger to place pension funds in a very tight nominal framework and to hold them accountable solely on that basis.
In deze omstandigheden zien de leden van de CDA-fractie het als een reëel gevaar om de pensioenfondsen in een zeer strak nominaal kader te zetten en hun enkel en alleen daarop af te rekenen.
Questions how near-impossible indexation fits a reliable long-term pension ambition and asks about the effect on all generations.
What do stakeholders gain from the new framework, which turns out badly for all generations, both young and old?
Wat schieten de belanghebbenden op met het nieuwe toetsingskader dat op deze manier slecht uitpakt voor alle generaties, zowel jong als oud?
Supports stricter indexation conditions for intergenerational fairness and asks about individual fund effects and the timing of DNB's generational test; also questions the five-year deficit period.
For these members it is paramount that the financial assessment framework must safeguard the interests of all parties affiliated with a pension fund.
Voor deze leden staat voorop dat het financieel toetsingskader moet leiden tot het borgen van de belangen van álle bij een pensioenfonds aangesloten partijen.
Asks how the tension between protecting nominal rights and the indexation ambition is resolved, and whether the indexation rules create perverse incentives sensitive to interest rates.
Asks whether the recovery method with yearly re-set ten-year plans ever reaches the required level and why no final deadline is set.
The SGP members wonder whether the government realises that this method mathematically never leads to reaching the required own funds.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen zich af of de regering zich ervan bewust is dat deze methode wiskundig gezien nooit tot het bereiken van het vereist eigen vermogen leidt?
Supports the aims of stability and fair burden-sharing but fears the rules go too far in maximising nominal security at the expense of inflation-proof pensions, and asks for deeper analysis.
A more shock-resistant pension system is also urgently desirable, but the government appears in this bill to have gone too far in maximising nominal 'security'.

Het streven naar een schokbestendiger pensioenstelsel is eveneens dringend gewenst, maar de regering lijkt in dit wetsvoorstel té ver doorgeschoten in het streven naar maximalisatie van nominale «zekerheid».

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the aim of the bill amending the financial assessment framework (FTK) for pension funds but raises objections on its link to the broader pension-system debate, balance of the proposal, effectiveness of the recovery-plan rules, the exceptional-economic-situation extension, and effects on existing deficits. The government's reply accepts many points, adjusts the explanatory memorandum and wording, but declines to separately regulate the current recovery problem and maintains the discretionary extension.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for quantified substantiation of claims that the bill improves stability and generational balance, and the CPB note was supplemented but effects of individual components remain partly unclear.
Premium damping on expected return may be inconsistent with guaranteed defined-benefit commitments and weaken solvency supervision; government adds conditions and a buffer in lower regulation.
The recovery-plan system lacks a safety valve for repeated shocks, and the five-year trigger may not give sufficient guarantees; the government maintains the rule is adequate.
The exceptional-economic-situation extension risks postponing crisis consequences and should be more strictly conditioned; the government rejects tighter clauses to keep discretion.
The Afdeling asks to separately regulate the current recovery problem of existing deficits to avoid mixing past distribution issues with future FTK design; the government declines.
The explanatory memorandum should avoid suggesting the bill prejudges the future pension system; the memorandum was adjusted.
Definitions of pensioenvermogen and toeslagdrempel and the wording on incidental indexation should be clarified; the bill was amended.
Deletion of 'in beginsel' in the recovery-plan article was requested; the government kept it while clarifying the explanatory memorandum.
The ultimate forward rate concept was undefined in the Pensioenwet; the reference and transitional provision were removed and the Parameters Commission is asked to assess it.
The Afdeling asked how the IORP directive relates to the bill; the government explains the proposed amendment does not affect the quantitative requirements.

33981.s: The bill introduces a quota levy on employers in the public and private sectors that fail to meet a target share of hours worked by people with disabilities, with the levy activated only if the agreed job guarantee is not met. It creates a disability register maintained by UWV, sets the levy amount at EUR 5,000 per shortfall position, and bars employers from invoking non-registration in objections while temporarily excluding the penalty-payment remedy for late decisions.
33981.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial activation of the levy as allowing quick action if the job guarantee is not met, and says the register and the lower rules are needed for workable administration.
q: The levy was chosen to be activated by ministerial regulation because, if monitoring shows the job agreements are not met, the need may arise to introduce the levy shortly afterwards.

Er is gekozen voor activering van de quotumheffing bij ministeriële regeling omdat, wanneer uit de monitoring blijkt dat de baanafspraken niet worden gehaald, de noodzaak kan blijken dat op korte termijn daarna de quotumheffing wordt ingevoerd.
d: categories of employees excluded from quota hours; rules for determining average hours and conversion
register set-up, data set, validity period, and disclosure of data to employers
Artikel 38f, eerste, derde en vierde lid
quota percentages per sector, variables, and treatment of hired workers
categories of disabled workers placed with employers and method of determining shortfall
activation of the quota levy for each sector after assessment of job growth
transfers of funds from the disability fund to the Werkhervattingskas and the State
p: Employers are temporarily barred from claiming a penalty payment when the tax authority is late deciding an objection, with the exclusion lapsing after a fixed period.
UWV may disclose on request whether an identified person is in the disability register, with details left to lower regulation and a later evaluation required.
Employers cannot challenge a levy on the ground that a worker was wrongly left out of the disability register, so registration errors are removed from the scope of appeal.
The quota levy is activated by ministerial regulation rather than by statute, with only cabinet-level consultation before adoption.

parties: Asks how the government monitors public-sector job targets, the consequences of missing them, and how the levy and baseline measurement will operate.
These members ask who monitors this progress and what the exact consequences are if the government does not meet this job guarantee?
Deze leden vragen wie deze voortgang monitort en wat de exacte consequenties zijn als de overheid deze baangarantie niet haalt?
Supports the quota as a stick behind the door if the jobs agreement is not honoured, while asking about implementation details.
Questions whether the measure is a budget cut in disguise, the removal of sheltered jobs, and whether people with disabilities gain equal job chances.
Does the government share the view of these members that this measure is rather a plug for the cut in work and income of people with a work disability?
Deelt de regering de mening van deze leden dat deze maatregel eerder een sluitpost vormt op de bezuiniging op werk en inkomen van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking?
Supports the goal but doubts whether the levy is the right instrument and asks why positive incentives such as a performance ladder were not chosen.
The CDA members ask why the government did not choose an alternative system with positive incentives, such as a PSO?
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom de regering niet heeft gekozen voor een alternatief systeem met positieve prikkels, zoals een PSO?
Warns that pricing a social norm through a fine may turn it into a purchasable market norm, and asks for justification of the 5,000 euro levy.
Is the government aware of this and how large does the government consider the risk that employers will massively pay the quota levy instead of hiring people with a work disability?
Is de regering zich hiervan bewust en hoe groot acht de regering het risico dat werkgevers massaal de quotumheffing zullen betalen in plaats van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking in dienst te nemen
Asks about stigmatisation of the target group and displacement of other groups in the labour market.
These members want to know how it is prevented that the bill leads to displacement of other groups on the labour market.
Deze leden willen weten op welke wijze voorkomen wordt dat het wetvoorstel leidt tot verdringing van andere groepen op de arbeidsmarkt
Wants a real law with teeth, objects to the levy functioning as an indulgence, and asks why activation is left to lower regulation.
What is the reason that the quota levy is activated in lower regulation, the members ask.
Wat is de reden dat de quotumheffing wordt geactiveerd in lagere regelgeving, zo vragen de leden.
Prefers encouraging employers first and warns the bill could displace one vulnerable group with another and create unequal job chances.
Is it not, from the point of view of care and proportionality, required to first go to the utmost to stimulate employers and only then come with proposals for penal measures?

Is het vanuit het oogpunt van zorgvuldigheid en proportionaliteit niet geboden om eerst tot het uiterste te gaan om werkgevers te stimuleren en pas daarna met voorstellen voor strafmaatregelen te komen
Asks whether baseline data will be available before the bill is debated and what happens if the measurement differs from the 25-hour assumption.
Is it not important that the baseline measurement is available before the bill is debated?
Is het niet van belang dat de nulmeting beschikbaar is vóór de behandeling van de wet?
Asks for more insight into business cases, baseline data, re-integration instrument coordination, and breakdowns of results by sector.
Can the data from the baseline measurement become available before the bill is debated?
Kunnen de gegevens uit de nulmeting voorafgaand aan de behandeling van voorliggend wetsvoorstel beschikbaar komen?

Worries the bill worsens the labour market position of people with disabilities who can earn the minimum wage, and asks for more data to monitor and evaluate the scope of the target group under the Potters motion.
These members expect that the relative labour market position of this group will worsen because of this bill, and see their expectation confirmed in the response to the report.
Deze leden verwachten dat de relatieve arbeidsmarktpositie van deze groep verslechtert door dit wetsvoorstel en zien hun verwachting bevestigd in de nota naar aanleiding van verslag.

Questions the basis and enforcement of the quota levy, the non-punitive character of the levy, and the refusal to publish employers who receive it, and asks about the transfer of levy funds to the state against Council of State advice.
Why is the government not willing to examine the possibility of making public which employers have been imposed a quota levy?
Waarom is de regering niet bereid de mogelijkheid om openbaar te maken welke werkgevers een quotumheffing opgelegd hebben gekregen te onderzoeken?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Wet quotum arbeidsbeperkten, which imposes a levy on employers failing to meet disability employment quotas, raising concerns on labour market effects, the zero measurement, legal certainty, the target group and the Aof financing. The Secretary of State's reply in the nader rapport accepts several points, amends the bill (renaming it Wet banenafspraak en quotum arbeidsbeperkten, clarifying timing and delegation) and defends the remaining choices.
concerns: The levy of EUR 5,000 may be too low to induce employers to hire disabled workers rather than pay, and the government replies it considers the amount sufficient while leaving room to raise it later.
The timing of quota percentage, shortfall and levy calculation was unclear; the government added a new article 38f and a separate paragraph explaining the timeline.
Treatment of temporary agency and secondment workers was unresolved; the government commits to a system at individual employer level and adds delegation grounds for it.

Revenue of the levy is directed to the Arbeidsongeschiktheidsfonds while the target-group programmes are publicly financed; the government rejects this objection, arguing the fund finances disability benefits for this group.
Displacement of other vulnerable groups such as WAO/WIA beneficiaries and young or older unemployed; the government responds with monitoring and existing measures.
The target group definition is inconsistent between Participatiewet, Wsw and Wajong; the government justifies the choices by reference to the social accord and the transition of these schemes.
Coordination between UWV assessments for the banenafspraak, beschut werk and loonkostensubsidie needs clarification; the government explains differences and encourages consultation.

33990.s: The bill amends the Equal Treatment on Grounds of Disability or Chronic Illness Act to remove the separate sections on education and to extend the prohibition of discrimination in goods and services to education, and it amends the Electoral Act so that polling stations must be accessible 'as far as possible' with a 25% minimum. It implements the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities.
33990.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as implementing the UN Convention and states that the non-discrimination duty applies to government and private actors, with a disproportionate-burden test retained.
q: In this situation the Convention does not oblige the taking of a general provision.
Het verdrag verplicht in deze situatie niet tot het treffen van een algemene voorziening.

parties: Asks whether the convention has binding provisions and questions the scope of accommodation duties and the role of local authorities in permits for adaptations.
The VVD members note that the convention contains no provisions binding on everyone. Can the government explicitly confirm this?
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat het verdrag geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen kent. Kan de regering dit expliciet bevestigen?
Finds the proposals insufficiently ambitious, objects to the exclusion of education and polling-station targets, and wants the convention's normative force to be enforced rather than left voluntary.
However, they stress that it must be prevented that the implementation of the convention is handled in too non-committal a way.
Echter, zij benadrukken dat voorkomen moet worden dat er te vrijblijvend met de uitvoering van het verdrag omgegaan wordt.
Asks how far universal provisions reach versus individual assessment, and how citizens can find and appeal the outcome of accommodation requests.
Can the government indicate how it ensures that people or their representatives also know how to find their way in requesting adaptations
Kan de regering aangeven hoe zij er zorg voor dragen dat mensen of diens vertegenwoordiger ook de weg weten te vinden bij het aanvragen van aanpassingen
Asks whether political accessibility goes beyond physical access to polling stations and whether the no-cost assumption is sound.
Does the government share the view that political accessibility is more than only physical accessibility of polling stations?
Deelt de regering de mening dat politieke toegankelijkheid meer is dan alleen fysieke toegankelijkheid van stemlokalen?

Asks for justification of excluding design and production, presses on oversight of the 25% polling-station target and on assistance for voters with intellectual disabilities, and questions the government's stance on general provisions.
The D66 members ask the government to show its utmost effort to enable better control over a higher percentage of polling stations
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering haar uiterste inzet te tonen om betere controle mogelijk te maken op een hoger percentage van de kieslokalen

Supports the extension but questions exclusions such as design and production and building adaptations, the lack of enforceable rights in the Wmo, and oversight of government's own conduct as a provider.
The GroenLinks members would like more clarity on the choice not to include the government's own unilateral conduct in this bill.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie krijgen graag meer duidelijkheid over de keuze om eenzijdig overheidshandelen niet in voorliggend wetsvoorstel op te nemen.
Worries about societal costs and business burdens, asks for concrete examples of disproportionate burden, and questions how far providers must go in adapting goods and services.
On the other hand, they still have questions about the societal costs this bill entails.
Anderzijds hebben zij nog vragen over de maatschappelijke kosten die dit wets voorstel met zich meebrengt.
Supports ratification and broader accommodation duty but asks whether the bill is clear enough for those affected, how to inform rights and duties, and how to avoid more legal proceedings.
They ask whether it will be sufficiently clear to those involved what may be expected of them under the law.
Zij vragen of straks voldoende duidelijk is voor betrokkenen wat van hen op grond van de wet mag worden verwacht.

Asks whether the Convention is directly effective and whether courts could declare its provisions directly applicable, contrary to the legislature's intent, and asks about the scope of the reasonable-accommodation duty.
Finds the implementation plan lacks concrete goals, timelines and clear allocation of responsibility, and asks for monitoring and reporting to parliament.

Says the plan lacks concrete measures and timelines, questions who is legally responsible for claims, asks for publication of consultation reports and periodic reporting so parliament can exercise oversight, and raises concerns about budget cuts and individual rights in care.
Furthermore, it is unclear to these members what the Platform Inclusie would base itself on to conclude whether the Netherlands is or is not complying with the Convention.
Verder is het deze leden onduidelijk waarop het Platform Inclusie zich moet baseren om te constateren dat Nederland zich goed of niet goed houdt aan het verdrag.
Asks for quantitative goals so parliament can track progress, questions the narrower reading of the Convention in the explanatory memorandum, and asks who is responsible and who decides.
These members believe it must be clear in advance who is responsible for what and who can ultimately make a decision.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn van mening dat het vooraf helder moet zijn wie waarvoor verantwoordelijk is en wie er uiteindelijk een beslissing kan nemen.

Asks how the government will inform the Chamber on progress, the bureau and consultation structure, and coordination with municipalities, and asks for enforcement of accessible voting and assistance dog rules.
In what way will the government inform the Chamber about progress?
Op welke wijze zal de regering de Kamer informeren over de voortgang?
Finds the plan minimal and non-binding, questions the vagueness of voluntary 'pledges', asks for a budget overview and an impact assessment of new legislation against the Convention.
Is het doen van «plechtige beloften» niet te vrijblijvend?
Wants the government to take a more active role, asks how new and existing legislation will be tested against the Convention and how results will be reported to the Chamber.
The current implementation plan contains no concrete measures or accompanying timeline.
Het voorliggende plan van aanpak heeft geen concrete maatregelen of bijbehorend tijdpad.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 17 March 2014 on the bill implementing the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (extension of the Wgbh/cz to goods and services) objects to the financial services exception, asking for better justification under Article 1 of the Constitution and the Convention, and asks for clearer account of the financial costs. The government's reply of 15 July 2014 deletes the financial services exception and revises the cost explanation, and adopts the drafting remarks.
concerns: The exception for financial services lacked adequate justification under Article 1 of the Constitution and the relation to the Convention, and was deleted by the government.
The relation of the financial services exception to Articles 5 and 25 of the Convention was insufficiently motivated; the government reinterpreted Article 25 and dropped the exception.
The financial consequences of extending the prohibition to goods and services were insufficiently explained; the government revised the passage on costs linked to complaints.
Redactional remarks on article numbering and wording were incorporated.

34098.s: The bill amends the Dutch Aviation Act to introduce a new norms-and-enforcement system for Schiphol airport, replacing fixed noise limits at enforcement points with strict preferential runway use rules and an annual maximum noise amount set by ministerial regulation. It also creates a new independent Schiphol Environmental Council with advisory roles on usage forecasts and experiments.
34098.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by pointing to the two-year experiment, the advisory outcome of the 2013 final report, and the need for a durable, effective enforcement system with adequate legal protection.
q: The final advice of 8 October 2013 forms the starting point for the bill.
Het eindadvies van 8 oktober 2013 4 vormt het uitgangspunt voor het wetsvoorstel.
d: exemptions from zoning plans via verklaring van geen bezwaar
preferential runway rules, annual maximum noise amount, noise and emission limits as equivalent protection criteria
content and procedure of the usage forecast
content and procedure of the usage evaluation
exemption from rules in the airport traffic decree during major maintenance or incidents
experiments deviating from prescribed rules, up to two years
municipalities represented on the Environmental Council
appointment of members of the defence-airport consultation commission and its rules of procedure
p: The Inspector-General may impose measures for breaches of the shared duty of care and must lift them only when no longer needed, broadening enforcement discretion over sector parties.
The minister may grant exemptions from airport traffic rules during maintenance or incidents without parliamentary or public review, and maintenance now covers installations, not only runways.
Experiments can deviate from traffic rules for up to two years, and the public comment procedure on the draft experiment regulation is removed.

Exemptions from zoning plans may be granted through a ministerial no-objection statement, and the Awb rule on the no-objection statement is disapplied, reducing municipal and public review of plan deviations.
The chair of the Environmental Council is appointed and dismissed by the minister, with other members appointed by the chair, shifting composition control toward the executive.
Annual noise amounts and equivalence criteria are set by ministerial regulation, with the enforcement focus shifting from fixed output limits to input rules and less legal certainty for residents.

parties: Asks why the Omgevingsraad Schiphol is only now given a legal basis, how its involvement in decisions is structured, and whether term limits should apply to its members.
On what legal basis are the current activities of the Omgevingsraad then based?
Op welke rechtsgrond zijn de huidige activiteiten van de Omgevingsraad dan gebaseerd?

Questions whether the new noise cap offers the same legal protection against uneven noise distribution as the old enforcement points, and how the ILT enforces the four rules and whether residents can appeal to the administrative court.
So there is no longer any legal protection against an uneven spatial distribution of noise nuisance?
Er is nu toch geen rechtsbescherming meer tegen een onevenredige ruimtelijke verdeling van de geluidshinder?
Welcomes greater transparency for residents but raises practical problems, including whether preferential runway use will overburden the Aalsmeer runway and whether growth assumptions are realistic.
These members wonder whether preferential runway use in practice will not lead to excessive use of the Aalsmeer runway, which in their view would then lead to more people being affected.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen zich af of het preferent baangebruik in de praktijk niet zal leiden tot een overmatig gebruik van de Aalsmeerbaan dat naar mening van de leden dan juist tot meer gehinderden zal leiden.

Objects that the Staatssecretary may set detailed criteria for equivalent protection by ministerial regulation without parliamentary involvement, and asks for a shorter evaluation period and parliamentary information on the sound-test and runway-related decisions.

The members of this group find it highly remarkable that the Staatssecretaris can herself set further rules for the criteria for equivalent protection, without having to involve the House of Representatives.

De leden van deze fractie vinden het hoogst merkwaardig dat de Staatssecretaris, zonder daarbij de Kamer te hoeven betrekken, zelf nadere regels kan stellen voor de criteria voor gelijkwaardige bescherming.

34197.s: The bill amends the Aviation Act (Wet luchtvaart) on the operation of Schiphol airport, revising how the airport sets tariffs and conditions every three years, adding annual adjustments, investment programme consultation, project-group procedures, and new Autoriteit Consument en Markt review of compliance and of investment-project procedures. It also adds transitional rules and an Algemene wet bestuursrecht exception for the new review article.
34197.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of detailed tariff, consultation and efficiency rules to a general administrative order by the need for technical specificity and implementation of the EU airport charges directive.
d: detailed rules on airport tariff setting, consultation, compensation accounts and efficiency thresholds
draft delegated decree submitted to Parliament only after four weeks
rules on notification, information content and benchmark process for tariff proposals
rules on applications to the regulator and tariff setting after regulatory decision
validity period, structure and approval of the cost allocation system
rules on applications for review of investment project procedures
entry into force by royal decree, possibly differing per article
p: The airport operator, rather than a public body, sets tariffs and conditions every three years and adjusts them annually and operationally, with only consultation by users as a check.
The airport operator may set new tariffs mid-period in cases of security changes, exceptional circumstances or regulatory decisions, subject to notification and consultation only.[NOTE_ON_EXTRA]
Cost allocation, offsets and efficiency incentives are determined by the airport operator based on financial reports, with detail deferred to delegated rules.
Users and project-group participants gain consultation rights and a limited review route, but the airport operator keeps discretion over final tariffs and project specifications.
Users may apply to the regulator for review of tariffs, which can suspend them, but the regulator's decisions are not open to standard appeal under the Algemene wet bestuursrecht.
Decisions under the new regulator review article are excluded from ordinary appeal, limiting judicial control over tariff disputes.

parties: Questions whether statutory regulation of day-to-day business at Schiphol is necessary and proportionate given the state's shareholding and the Council of State's warning that the minister would be more directly accountable.

Can the government respond to the Council of State's remark that through this bill the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment would become more directly responsible and accountable for Schiphol's business operations than at present?

Kan de regering ingaan op de opmerking van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State dat de Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu door dit wetsvoorstel directer verantwoordelijk en aanspreekbaar zou worden op de bedrijfsvoering van de luchthaven Schiphol dan thans het geval is?
Asks about the limited role of the ACM, which can only review procedure rather than substance, and about the definition of public interest in network quality.
The ACM's role in clarifying this in practice is, however, limited: the ACM is only competent to review procedurally and not substantively.
De rol van de ACM om hier in de praktijk duiding aan te geven wordt echter beperkt: de ACM is alleen bevoegd om procedureel te toetsen en niet inhoudelijk.
Asks whether the minister should have ex-post supervisory influence over tariffs and conditions within the operating licence, and about the ACM's enlarged role.

These members are further curious what the disadvantages would be if the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment were given the possibility, through ex-post supervision under the operating licence, to influence the setting of tariffs and conditions.

Deze leden zijn verder benieuwd wat de nadelen zouden zijn wanneer de Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu wel de mogelijkheid krijgt om via het toezicht achteraf in het kader van de exploitatievergunning invloed uit te oefenen op de totstandkoming van tarieven en voorwaarden.
Demands a stronger justification for further regulating Schiphol's business operations, given possibly significant economic consequences.
Given the heavy intervention, a firmer justification is necessary, these members believe.
Gezien de zware ingreep is een steviger motivering noodzakelijk, zo menen deze leden.
Asks whether mandating the non-aviation contribution amounts to systematic interference in the operator's business and questions the mandatory character and lack of minimum amounts.
Is the mandatory requirement not in fact systematic interference in the operator's business management?
Is de verplichtstelling niet in feite een stelselmatige inmenging in de bedrijfsvoering van de exploitant?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Aviation Act concerning Schiphol airport, questioning the justification for legally anchoring network quality as a public interest, the necessity and proportionality of detailed regulation of Schiphol's operations, and EU-law and ACM competence issues. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely disagreed, defending the bill while making some textual adjustments such as replacing 'beoordelen' with 'inschatten' and clarifying the ACM role and the mandatory non-aviation contribution rationale.
concerns: The Afdeling found the detailed regulation of Schiphol's operations (consultation duties, benchmarks, efficiency incentives, mandatory contribution) insufficiently justified as necessary and proportionate; the government defended each element and made only limited changes such as clarifying benchmark rationale.

The Afdeling was not convinced the mandatory financial contribution from non-aviation activities was proportionate; the government argued the voluntary system caused undue interference and clarified the rationale in the memorie van toelichting.

The Afdeling asked for justification of whether 'mainport' interest fits the public-interest differentiation under the airport charges directive and of restrictions on free provision of services; the government denied new restrictions and added explanatory text.

The Afdeling noted the minister's new role made her more directly accountable for Schiphol's operations and questioned overlap with ACM powers; the government rejected increased accountability but changed wording to avoid appearance of influence.

The Afdeling asked for justification of why legal anchoring of network quality as a public interest is needed given the state's existing shareholder influence; the government rejected the need, stating the anchoring only requires transparency.
Two redactional remarks on wording of articles 8.25de and 8.25df were adopted.

34210-IX.s: This bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) through a first supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations, expenditure and revenue lines. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force retroactive to 1 June 2015 if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34287.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2014/52/EU on environmental impact assessment by amending the Crisis- en herstelwet and the Wet milieubeheer, including new exemption powers for defence and emergency activities and for ministerial exemptions from EIA obligations. It also adds transitional and commencement rules, with entry into force set by royal decree.
34287.j: The memorandum justifies the exemption powers by the Directive's allowance for exemptions where application would harm a project's purpose, and by the need for defence and emergency exceptions.
q: Article 2.4 of the EIA Directive allows exemptions from its provisions in exceptional cases where application would adversely affect the project's purpose, provided the Directive's objectives are met.

Artikel 2.4 van de mer-richtlijn biedt de mogelijkheid om vrijstelling te verlenen van de bepalingen in de richtlijn in uitzonderlijke gevallen, waarin toepassing van de richtlijn nadelige gevolgen zou hebben voor het doel van het project, mits aan de doelstellingen van de mer-richtlijn wordt voldaan.
d: exemption from EIA obligations for defence or emergency activities
exemption from EIA obligations for projects with adverse effects on purpose
rules on the exemption request procedure and documents
p: The competent authority and the minister gain discretion to exempt defence, emergency and other projects from EIA obligations, with notification to the European Commission as the main safeguard.
The competent authority may reject an application when the environmental report is deficient, after first giving the applicant a chance to supplement it.
Requires a functional separation between conflicting roles when the competent authority itself undertakes the activity.

parties: Asks whether the directive adds administrative and financial burden and whether the Crisis and Recovery Act's speed gains are undone, and how detailed EU rules affect flexibility.
How have the concerns of these members been addressed that this change leads to higher administrative and financial burdens and that the level of detail results in less flexibility and efficiency?

Op welke wijze is er aan de zorgen van deze leden tegemoetgekomen dat deze wijziging leidt tot hogere administratieve en financiële lasten en dat de mate van detail resulteert in minder flexibiliteit en efficiency?
Asks how 'competent experts' are defined and whether certification should be required, and whether the commission m.e.r. was consulted on the amendment.
Can the government explain when one can speak of 'competent experts' and what requirements these experts must meet?
Kan de regering toelichten wanneer over «bekwame deskundigen» kan worden gesproken en aan welke eisen deze deskundigen moeten voldoen?

Stresses that the competent authority must avoid conflicts of interest when it is also the initiator, and that the bill gives no conditions for a functional internal separation, urging a mandatory independent review by the commission m.e.r.
Neither the bill nor the explanatory memorandum says anything about how a separation within one organisation can actually work and under which conditions.
Het wetsvoorstel, noch de memorie van toelichting (MvT), zegt iets over de wijze waarop een scheiding binnen één organisatie echt kan werken en onder welke randvoorwaarden.

Asks whether the impartiality safeguard in article 2:4 Awb suffices for small municipalities, whether commission m.e.r. advice should be mandatory, and how independent monitoring by initiators is checked.

These members ask whether the government can explain how it is ensured that monitoring is carried out independently, so that there can be no insufficient monitoring or reporting in favour of the initiator.

Deze leden vragen of de regering kan uitleggen hoe ervoor gezorgd wordt dat de monitoring onafhankelijk gebeurt, zodat er geen sprake kan zijn van onvoldoende monitoring of verslaglegging ten gunste van de initiatiefnemer.

Questions making commission m.e.r. advice optional rather than mandatory, doubts that the separation of functions can be realised in small municipalities, and warns about conflicting interests of the deciding body, citing the Groningen gas case.
These members ask why a mandatory advice from the commission m.e.r. would lead to more bureaucracy or longer procedures.
Genoemde leden vragen waarom een verplicht advies van de commissie m.e.r. zal leiden tot meer bureaucratie of langere procedures.

34296.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Schijndel, Sint-Oedenrode and Veghel into a new municipality called Meierijstad, effective on a date set by royal decree. It makes conforming changes to the judicial districts law and the safety regions law and designates Veghel for certain transitional rules under the municipal reorganisation act.
34296.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the municipalities' inability to meet social, economic and spatial challenges effectively, and does not justify any delegation of power.
q: The municipal councils have found that the individual municipalities will in the medium to long term be insufficiently able to effectively address social, economic and spatial challenges and fully seize opportunities.

De gemeenteraden hebben geconstateerd dat de individuele gemeenten op de (middel)lange termijn onvoldoende in staat zullen zijn om maatschappelijke, economische en ruimtelijke opgaven op effectieve wijze het hoofd te bieden en kansen volledig te benutten.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: The merger is voluntary and driven by the municipalities' wish to strengthen administrative capacity; no remarks or questions raised.
They note that this concerns a voluntary merger arising from the wish of the municipalities involved to strengthen administrative capacity.
Zij constateren dat het hier gaat om een vrijwillige samenvoeging, voortkomende uit de wens van de betrokken gemeenten om de bestuurskracht te versterken.
Asks why no referendum was held among residents, since such a far-reaching decision should be taken by the population itself.
These members wonder why no referendum was held among residents of the 3 municipalities, especially since a far-reaching decision like a merger should be taken by the population itself.

Deze leden zijn benieuwd naar de redenen waarom er geen referendum onder de inwoners van de 3 gemeenten is georganiseerd, vooral omdat een ingrijpende beslissing als herindelen genomen dient te worden door de bevolking zelf.
Stresses that village and neighbourhood councils and business associations were consulted before the definitive decision, and values the careful process.

These members find it important that village and neighbourhood councils and business associations were consulted prior to the definitive decision of the municipal councils to opt for municipal merger.

Deze leden vinden het van belang, dat de dorps- en wijkraden en ondernemersverenigingen zijn geconsulteerd voorafgaand aan het definitieve besluit van de gemeenteraden om te kiezen voor gemeentelijke herindeling.
Asks about the breadth of administrative support, inconsistent vote figures between the merger advice and the province's reaction, and the implications of a possible national advisory referendum.
In the merger advice there seems to be some confusion about this.
In het herindelingsadvies lijkt hier wat verwarring over.

34300-IX.s: This bill fixes the 2016 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the budget of the National Debt (IXA) at the amounts set out in its schedules, in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January 2016, or retroactively on the day after publication if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) attached to this law for the year 2016 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34359.s: The bill creates temporary administrative measures against persons posing a national security threat, including reporting duties, area and contact bans, and a ban on leaving the Schengen area, enforced by the Minister of Security and Justice for up to six months at a time. It also allows authorities to refuse or withdraw subsidies, permits and recognitions where there is serious risk they will be used for terrorist activities; the measures lapse five years after entry into force.
34359.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the inadequacy of existing tools against terrorism, the preventive purpose of protecting national security, and UN Resolution 2178 obligations on foreign fighters.
q: It has become apparent that the instruments for combating terrorism need supplementing with measures of a preventive nature.
Gebleken is namelijk dat het instrumentarium ter bestrijding van terrorisme aanvulling behoeft met maatregelen die een preventief karakter hebben
d: temporary exemption from obligations of an imposed measure, with conditions
extension of measure period by six-month increments
imposing movement restriction measures on persons linked to terrorism
exit ban from Schengen area for persons intending to join listed organisations
p: The Minister may impose freedom-of-movement restrictions on persons based on conduct linked to terrorism, without prior criminal suspicion, subject to necessity, proportionality, appeal to the district court and a five-year sunset.
Administrative bodies may refuse or withdraw subsidies, permits and recognitions where there is serious risk of terrorist use, a new ground beyond existing integrity rules.
In urgent cases the Minister may announce decisions without prior written form, to be recorded afterwards.
Courts must consider facts arising after the contested decision (ex nunc review), and objection procedures are bypassed, limiting ordinary legal protection.

parties: Asks whether the exit ban conflicts with EU free-movement law and whether punitive character could lead courts to find double punishment.
If an administrative measure would in a given case conflict with EU law, in particular free movement of persons, the measure will not be imposed.

Indien een bestuurlijke maatregel in een voorkomend geval in strijd zou komen met het EU-recht, meer in het bijzonder met het vrij verkeer van personen, wordt van de oplegging van de maatregel afgezien.
Doubts proportionality of freedom-restricting measures and asks how the executive's interpretive latitude on national security fits legal certainty for citizens.
These members have hesitations about legally establishing freedom-restricting measures whose proportionality to the stated aim is not clear in advance.
Deze leden hebben aarzelingen bij het wettelijk vastleggen van vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen waarvan niet op voorhand duidelijk is of die proportioneel zijn ten aanzien van gestelde doel.
Argues the bill undermines separation of powers by giving the executive powers that belong exclusively to the judiciary, and asks why criminal law proved insufficient.

Are we not moving ever further from the original principle of separation of powers in the rule of law, namely that the judiciary has exclusive competence over adjudicating criminal offences among other things?

Raken wij niet steeds verder verwijderd van het oorspronkelijke uitgangspunt van de machtenscheiding in de rechtsstaat, namelijk dat aan de rechterlijke macht een exclusieve competentie toekomt op het terrein van de berechting van onder andere strafbare feiten?

Supports preventive administrative tools but questions why an essentially unchanged bill is resubmitted, the choice of minister rather than local authorities as competent body, and the temporary design with evaluation.
Why then did the government not also assign the imposition of freedom-restricting measures to local authorities themselves?
Waarom heeft de regering dan vervolgens ook niet de oplegging van vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen neergelegd bij de lokale gezagsdragers zelf?
Asks for a more precise statutory definition of 'terroristische activiteiten' to ensure legal certainty given the intrusive powers granted to the minister.
Is the government willing to include an explicit definition in the law itself or provide more clarification of the term 'terrorist activities or support thereof' in the memorie van antwoord?
Is de regering bereid in de wet zelf een expliciete definitie op te nemen of in de memorie van antwoord meer duiding aan de term «terroristische activiteiten of de ondersteuning daarvan» te geven?
Asks why no prior judicial review is provided, whether the bill strikes the right balance with judicial safeguards, and how broad the terrorism concept is.
Why was no prior judicial review chosen?
Waarom is niet gekozen voor een voorafgaande gerechtelijke toets?
Questions the temporary nature of the law and whether the discretionary latitude and enforcement of exit bans are workable.
They note that the government chooses to introduce a temporary law and ask whether this is a fortunate choice.
Zij constateren dat de regering ervoor kiest een tijdelijke wet in te dienen. Zij vragen of dit een gelukkige keuze is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Temporary Act on administrative measures against terrorism (Tijdelijke wet bestuurlijke maatregelen terrorismebestrijding), raising serious objections on necessity, foreseeability, the exit ban and the broad refusal/revocation power, and advising not to submit the bill unless these were addressed. The government's reply largely disagreed on necessity, partly accepted the foreseeability and consultation points (dropping the second paragraph of article 6, adding a maximum-duration note, and extending the mayor consultation duty), and kept the core measures.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for the necessity of the new measures, given existing criminal and administrative powers, to be substantively justified or the bill withdrawn; the government disagreed and maintained necessity.

The exit ban is questioned as redundant to the passport measure in the Paspoortwet, of limited deterrent effect for dual nationals, and possibly disproportionate, including under EU free movement law; the government defended it while noting exemptions can be granted.

Vague terms such as 'terroristische activiteiten of de ondersteuning daarvan' and 'in verband kan worden gebracht met' lack foreseeability; the Afdeling advised precision, which the government largely did not adopt beyond explanation in the memorie.

Article 6 gives a broad, near-unlimited refusal and revocation power across many decisions without time limits, bypassing the specialty principle; the government kept it, dropping the second paragraph on voorschriften.
Concern that the Minister rather than the burgemeester decides on exit bans while the Paspoortwet assigns that to mayors; government justified centralisation but addressed consultation with mayors.
The absence of a maximum duration for the measures and their repeated extensions was questioned; the government clarified proportionality review at each extension but kept no maximum.
The bill was amended so the Minister must consult all relevant burgemeesters, not only the one of residence, with emergency exception.

34377.s: The bill abolishes the possibility for political groups to form list combinations (lijstencombinaties) in Dutch elections, removing related provisions from the Kieswet and the Algemene wet bestuursrecht. It also amends the rules on residual seat allocation and the handling of list defects, with entry into force set by royal decree.
34377.j: The memorandum justifies abolishing list combinations by arguing they do not contribute to the intended bundling of political forces and that seat allocation should be as transparent as possible.
q: the possibility of list combinations does not contribute to the intended bundling of political forces
de mogelijkheid van lijstencombinaties geen bijdrage levert aan de beoogde politieke krachtenbundeling
d: date of entry into force of the act

parties: Welcomes the bill, arguing list combinations no longer serve bundling of parties but mainly yield unjust extra seats.

The VVD members believe that the purpose of list combinations, namely contributing to further consolidation of political parties, has disappeared from view and that the main aim now is gaining extra seats.

De leden van de VVD-fractie menen dat het doel van lijstencombinaties, te weten het bijdragen aan verdere bundeling van politieke partijen, uit het zicht is verdwenen en dat nú het hoofddoel is het behalen van extra zetelwinst.
Opposes abolition, arguing many small factions weaken effective parliamentary control of the government and that party mergers should not be frustrated.
Many small parties in parliament means less 'striking power' in parliamentary control, which is a democratic problem, according to the PvdA members.
Veel kleine partijen in het parlement betekent minder »slagkracht» bij de parlementaire controle en dat is een democratisch probleem, zo menen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.
Questions the necessity of the bill and which problem it solves, and asks about the consultation outcome.
These members do not see the necessity of the bill or which problem it solves.
Deze leden zien niet in wat de noodzaak is van het wetsvoorstel en welk probleem hiermee wordt opgelost.
Argues list combinations promote substantive cooperation and representativeness and that the problem the bill solves is unclear.
It tends to produce more rather than less representativeness within the seat-allocation system.
Het zorgt eerder voor meer, dan voor minder representativiteit binnen het systeem van restzetelverdeling.
Urges caution with electoral system changes and challenges the Kiesraad's advice as partly incorrect, asking for local-level research.
Does the government consider these logical outcomes of the model?
Vindt de regering dit logische uitkomsten van het model?
Asks how the bill relates to the Constitution and the seat-allocation system, and raises the constitutional review motion.
How does the government assess the bill in relation to the Constitution?
Hoe beoordeelt de regering het wetsvoorstel in relatie tot de Grondwet?

34458.s: The bill anchors the professional role and discretion of teachers in the Dutch sectoral education acts and creates a mandatory teacher register (lerarenregister) and a pre-register (registervoorportaal) for teachers not yet meeting qualification requirements. It sets herregistration criteria developed by the teaching profession and attaches consequences such as loss of teaching responsibility for teachers who fail to meet them.
34458.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations by the need for technical detail and by the profession's expertise in setting herregistration criteria, with the aim of improving teaching quality.
d: Artikel 38c (WPO, parallel in WEC, WVO, WEB)
herregistration criteria and rules for activity validation
authorisation rules for processing personal data in the register
timing and manner of data delivery, correction, and proof of qualifications
manner of disclosure of teacher data and further specification of data
p: Teachers not meeting herregistration criteria lose the right to bear teaching responsibilities, with a decision subject to objection and appeal.
Herregistration criteria are set by general administrative order and largely shaped by the teaching profession's representative body rather than by parliament.

parties: Asks whether the bill is consistent with the Dijsselbloem advice on education reform and how the criteria leave room for individual teachers and school philosophies.
Can the government explain further whether this bill is Dijsselbloem-proof, they ask.
Kan de regering nader toelichten of dit wetsvoorstel Dijsselbloem-proof is, zo vragen zij.
Supports the register as a means of creating professional space and statutory teacher control over their profession, while questioning school-level safeguards for teacher co-determination.
They are of the view that statutorily anchoring teachers' control over their profession is of great importance for strengthening the occupational group.
Zij zijn van mening dat het wettelijk verankeren van de zeggenschap van leraren over hun beroep van groot belang is voor de versterking van de beroepsgroep.

Questions the timing and necessity of a statutory register, asks whether the government will reconsider given Council of State criticism and unresolved shortages, and whether the register serves quality or becomes an end in itself.
Is the government willing to reconsider the bill in its current form?
Is de regering bereid het wetsvoorstel in zijn huidige vorm te heroverwegen?
Asks who decides on register criteria and on removing teachers from the register, and how representatives of the profession participate in decisions.
Is it correct that the government ultimately decides whether a teacher is removed from the register, the members want to know.
Klopt het dat de regering uiteindelijk het besluit neemt of een leraar uit het register wordt gezet, willen de leden weten.

Critical of imposing from above a register that began as a voluntary bottom-up initiative, of publishing personal data, and of increased administrative burden and rigid formal eligibility excluding skilled practitioners.
Why is it necessary to impose from above and make mandatory an initiative that came from the bottom up?
Waarom is het nodig om een initiatief van onderop juist van bovenaf vast te leggen en te verplichten?

Argues that the serious infringement on freedom to provide education under Article 23 of the Constitution is insufficiently justified, that benefits are unclear, and that dismissal and sanction consequences are inadequately addressed.
These members consider it essential, however, that a further infringement on the freedom to provide education be firmly substantiated.
Deze leden vinden het echter van wezenlijk belang dat een verdere inbreuk op de vrijheid om onderwijs te geven stevig wordt onderbouwd.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised against proceeding with the teacher register bill as premature, citing unmet preconditions, disproportionate sanction of losing teaching authority, and weak effectiveness. The government's reply rejects most objections, accepts a phased introduction, and defends the register as a necessary steer for the profession.
concerns: The Council considers the register premature without preconditions such as teacher shortage remedies, adequate training supply and time; the government accepts phased introduction but maintains the register is needed.
The sanction of losing teaching authority for failing re-registration is judged unworkable and disproportionate; the government introduces a phase without sanction first.
Broad delegation of regulatory powers with subdelegation lacks justification; the government drops one delegation basis and retains others with explanation.
Registration of teachers without a fully formed professional standard and disciplinary law is not comparable to the BIG model; the government rejects adopting that model.
The bill's limits on school boards' individual assessment of teacher competence are contested; the government says responsibility lies with the teacher and existing powers remain.
Multiple technical points on article structure, definitions, data retention and disclosure are addressed by amendments.

34475-IIB.s: This bill, a Slotwet, amends the 2015 departmental budget statements of the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij der Nederlandse Orden and the Governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint-Maarten to reflect supplementary budgets and realised outcomes. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2015 to the departmental budget statements of the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, the Nationale ombudsman and others.
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2015 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Raad van State, de Algemene Rekenkamer, de Nationale ombudsman.

34485-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget of the Dutch States General (parliament), raising the spending authority by about EUR 5.2 million in commitments and EUR 6.0 million in expenditure, mainly for the Tweede Kamer and the Eerste Kamer. It has no delegation of rule-making power to the executive and no changes to oversight or review arrangements.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment of the budget of the States General (IIA) for the year 2016
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2016

34494.s: The bill amends the Works Councils Act so that in companies with at least 100 employees the works council must, at least once a year in the consultation meeting, discuss the level and content of executive pay arrangements and the development of pay ratios across employee groups. It also adjusts a cross-reference so the new consultation duty is applied to the relevant article.
34494.j: The memorandum justifies the expansion by citing recurring public debate on widening gaps between executive pay and average employee pay, and the government's stated aim of more openness.
q: The recurring public debate is therefore, for the government, a reason to expand and sharpen the powers of the works council in large companies.

De steeds terugkerende maatschappelijke discussie is dan ook voor de regering aanleiding om de bevoegdheden van de ondernemingsraad (OR) bij grote ondernemingen uit te breiden en scherper vast te leggen.
p: Adds a mandatory annual works council discussion of executive pay and pay ratios, expanding employee-side information and consultation rights rather than shifting power to the executive.

parties: Questions the necessity and added value of the bill, asking whether the problem is defined clearly enough to justify new legislation.
The VVD members question the added value of this proposal in relation to the size of the supposed problem.
De leden van de VVD-fractie stellen vraagtekens bij de toegevoegde waarde van onderhavig voorstel in relatie tot de omvang van het veronderstelde probleem.
Asks how the bill breaks the hierarchical relationship, how it avoids being read as acceptance of pay differences, and about entry into force and evaluation.
Furthermore, the PvdA members are curious whether the bill will be evaluated and within what timeframe?
Tot slot zijn de leden van de PvdA-fractie benieuwd of het wetsvoorstel geëvalueerd wordt en binnen welke termijn?
Argues the bill is too marginal and asks whether works council consent or advisory rights over executive pay should be granted instead.
Has the government considered, in addition to requiring a discussion on pay ratios, establishing those ratios with a works council consent right?
Is naast het verplichten van een gesprek over beloningsverhoudingen het vaststellen van die verhoudingen met instemmingsrecht door de OR door de regering overwogen?
Sees no added value since the law already requires discussing working conditions, and suspects the bill is window-dressing.
What is the added value of this bill?
Wat is de toegevoegde waarde van dit wetsvoorstel?
Doubts the bill's added value, notes it could weaken the works council's position if pay is discussed without objection, and asks why an advisory right was not chosen.
Why has the government refrained from this?
Waarom heeft de regering hiervan afgezien?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill requiring large companies to discuss pay arrangements annually with the works council, questioning the problem definition, added value and effectiveness, and advising against submission unless reasoned. The government's reply partly addressed the concerns by clarifying the statutory text and motivation, but maintained the measure as a step toward awareness.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the nature and scale of the problem and the added value and effectiveness of the measure were clear, given existing obligations, and advised against submission unless justified.

The statutory text did not oblige discussion of the ratio between pay of different groups as the explanatory memorandum intended, and the Afdeling advised aligning the text with the memorandum; the government redrafted the text accordingly.
The option of merging functions for groups under five persons undermines effectiveness, which the government acknowledged while pointing to public annual report data as a fallback.

34548.s: The bill amends the Wet maatregelen woningmarkt 2014 II on the landlord levy: it raises the tax-free threshold from ten to twenty-five rental dwellings, adjusts investment-reduction rules and eligibility categories, and changes the levy rate. It also lets the minister, by ministerial regulation, lower or zero out investment reductions if demand threatens to exceed the budget and allows the minister to amend municipality lists by ministerial regulation.
34548.j: The memorandum justifies the threshold increase by reducing administrative burden and implementation costs, and the budget-related delegation by the need to manage budget overruns without a new law.
q: The bill makes it possible to implement this through a ministerial regulation.
Het wetsvoorstel biedt de mogelijkheid dit bij ministeriële regeling door te voeren.
d: further rules on exemption for purchased dwellings in shrinking areas and application procedure
supplement area boundaries and amend listed municipalities after municipal mergers
lower or zero out new investment reductions if the budget is at risk of being exceeded
p: Minister may amend the list of municipalities eligible for reductions by ministerial regulation following municipal mergers, without a change to the statute.
If applications threaten to exceed the budget, the minister may reduce or eliminate investment reductions by ministerial regulation, with no statutory threshold or parliamentary approval.

parties: Asks how housing market regions relate to investment in Rotterdam-Zuid and sparsely populated areas and whether regions hinder corporations from building there.
The VVD members wonder how the formation of housing market regions relates to investment in Rotterdam-Zuid and sparsely populated areas.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen zich af hoe de vorming van woningmarktregio's zich verhoudt tot investeringen in Rotterdam-Zuid en in dunbevolkte gebieden.
Asks the government to publish how the scheme will be implemented as early as possible, preferably before plenary debate, and questions why a broader acquisition exemption was not followed.
These members ask the government to make public as soon as possible, preferably during the plenary debate, exactly how it intends to implement the scheme.
Deze leden vragen de regering zo snel mogelijk, liefst nog tijdens de plenaire behandeling, openbaar te maken hoe de regering voornemens is de regeling precies uit te voeren.
Criticises reliance on the minister's own evaluation rather than the COELO evaluation, asks for an overview of objections raised, and requests annual progress reports to the Chamber.
The SP members ask why the COELO evaluation commissioned by Aedes, the VNG and the Woonbond was not used by the government.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen waarom de evaluatie van COELO die is uitgevoerd in opdracht van Aedes, de Vereniging Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en de Woonbond niet is gebruikt door de regering.
Asks for further justification of the threshold of 25 dwellings and the effects of raising it to 50.
The CDA members would like a further justification of why the increase of the tax-free threshold was set at 25.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zien graag nader onderbouwd waarom de verhoging van de heffingsvrije voet vastgesteld is op 25.
Welcomes the reductions, especially for affordable housing and restructuring, and asks about the effect of the higher threshold on the number of levy-liable landlords.
Especially the levy reduction for affordable housing and restructuring is, in the view of these members, very desirable.
Vooral de heffingsvermindering voor betaalbare woningen en herstructurering is wat deze leden betreft zeer gewenst.

Disappointed that the levy is raised to compensate instead of finding alternative funding, questions why a reduction for nearly-zero-energy renovation was not chosen, and challenges the justification for lower reductions outside scarcity areas and retroactive lowering of grants.
The GroenLinks members are disappointed that the government chooses to raise the landlord levy to compensate for the measures in this law rather than seeking alternative funding.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn teleurgesteld over het feit dat de regering ervoor kiest de verhuurderheffing te verhogen om de maatregelen in deze wet te compenseren.
Asks why the government uses a fixed list of municipalities rather than substantive criteria equal for all municipalities, and whether new municipalities could later qualify.
The SGP members ask why the government retains the approach of including a list of municipalities in the law instead of substantive criteria from which all municipalities can derive equal rights.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen waarom de regering vasthoudt aan de systematiek om in de wet een lijst met gemeenten op te nemen in plaats van inhoudelijke criteria waaraan alle gemeenten gelijke rechten kunnen ontlenen.
Opposes the levy as in effect a tenant tax burdening lower incomes disproportionately, and asks for incentives for housing for older people.
This is in fact a tenant tax, which indirectly falls disproportionately hard on people with lower incomes.
Dit is in feite een huurdersbelasting, die indirect, onevenredig zwaar neerkomt bij mensen met lagere inkomens.

Argues the government does not properly implement the two adopted Van Vliet motions, questions the evidence basis and the budgetary distribution, and suggests dropping the condition of an existing complex.
Member Van Vliet reads that the government does not properly implement the two adopted Van Vliet motions.
Het lid Van Vliet leest dat de regering de twee aangenomen moties Van Vliet niet naar behoren uitvoert.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill extending and expanding the rental-landlord levy reliefs may proceed to the House, but asked for a reasoned justification for a new exemption for purchased units in mixed complexes, for a finding that two measures are not state aid, and for simpler accessibility of the scheme. The minister's reply accepted most points, added justification and clarifications to the explanatory memorandum, and adopted the redactional suggestions.
concerns: The Council asked for a reasoned justification for why a tax incentive is needed for purchases in shrinking regions, which the minister accepted by limiting the exemption to complexes where the landlord already owns units and adding explanation.

The Council asked for a reasoned finding that the new exemption and the other measure are not state aid under the DAEB exemption; the minister added an estimate of maximum compensation but did not clearly settle the state-aid qualification.
