The Council questioned combining two fiscal instruments for demolition in shrinking regions, and the minister justified the combination by pointing to their different purposes.
The Council asked for a clearer and simpler definition of complex and a simpler regime, and the minister clarified the physical-connection criterion and noted the administrative burden figures.

The Council warned that raising the tax-free threshold from ten to twenty-five dwellings could be seen as selective aid to small landlords, and the minister revised the explanatory memorandum to address this.
The Council asked for the scheme's complex cross-references to be simplified or tabulated, and a table was added to the explanatory memorandum; redactional corrections were also adopted.

34575.s: The bill makes technical and substantive amendments to the Zorgverzekeringswet and the Wet op de zorgtoeslag, including renaming bodies to Zorginstituut and adjusting the composition and appointment rules of the Zorginstituut's commission, which the Zorginstituut itself appoints and dismisses. It also changes the deadline in the Zorgtoeslag law from 15 to 22 days and sets rules on the timing of its entry into force relative to another act.
34575.j: The memorandum gives no substantive justification for the delegation of commission costs or entry-into-force powers; it only describes the renaming of the former College zorgverzekeringen to Instituut voor Zorg.
q: By ministerial regulation the reimbursement of travel and accommodation costs and other allowances for members of the commission are determined.
Bij ministeriële regeling worden de vergoeding van reis- en verblijfkosten en verdere vergoedingen aan de leden van de commissie vastgesteld.
d: ARTIKEL I, E (artikel 59a, derde lid Zvw)
reimbursement of travel and other costs for commission members
entry into force by royal decree, possibly differing per article

parties: Asks whether insurers can meet the earlier premium deadline and what effects this has on contracting between insurers and providers.
Has the government considered the consequences for health insurers if they must announce their premium a week earlier?
Heeft de regering zich vergewist van de consequenties voor zorgverzekeraars als zij hun premie een week eerder bekend moeten maken?
Supports the earlier premium announcement for correct health care allowance setting but asks how contracting completion and early information for citizens will be encouraged.
These members agree on the importance of correctly setting the health care allowance and are therefore positive about the bill.
Genoemde leden zijn het eens met het belang van een juiste vaststelling van de zorgtoeslag, en zijn daarom positief over het voorliggend wetsvoorstel.
Questions how the government will enforce the earlier deadline given insurers' non-compliance, and asks for an overview of follow-up on recommendations regarding the Zorginstituut's dual roles.
They ask how the government will enforce the earlier deadline.
Zij vragen hoe de regering het vervroegen van de termijn gaat handhaven.
Asks why the bill was not tested for regulatory burden as Actal advised and why it was tested for fraud risk, requesting calculation of one-off costs.
The CDA members ask why the bill was not tested for regulatory burden.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom het wetsvoorstel niet is getoetst op regeldruk.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill (Verzamelwet Zvw 2016) may proceed, but that the use of the Wrr urgency procedure in the commencement decree needed a substantive justification, otherwise it should be removed. The government reply states the urgency procedure has been deleted and that the revised bill and explanatory memorandum were sent to parliament, with redactional remarks incorporated.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the option to apply the Wrr urgency procedure (art. 12 Wrr) lacked a substantive justification, since the commencement date was unknown and the reason given was insufficient; the government deleted the urgency procedure.
Redactional remarks on references to the Zorginstituut/CAK, the cross-reference in article I(F) and the insertion in article I(G) were incorporated.

34584.s: The bill amends the Wet inburgering to add a participatieverklaring (participation declaration) track, administered by municipalities, as a separate first part of the civic integration exam with its own one-year deadline, and to legally establish municipal maatschappelijke begeleiding (social guidance) for asylum migrants and family members. It adds new fines for missing these deadlines and expands the Minister's and municipalities' data-exchange powers, with implementing rules and exemptions largely left to the Minister and general administrative orders.
34584.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary for practical detail and flexibility, citing the need to avoid over-specifying discretionary assessments and noting the Raad van State advice on the bill.
q: Therefore it is unavoidable that national law leaves a certain discretionary power to, in this case, the Minister and municipalities as implementers of the Wet inburgering.
Derhalve is het onvermijdelijk dat het nationale recht een zekere discretionaire bevoegdheid overlaat aan, in dit geval, de Minister en gemeenten als uitvoerders van de Wet inburgering.
d: deadline extensions, exam administration, content, costs, certificates and examination committee for the civic integration exam
Minister or designated body grants quality mark to course providers pending rules on certificates
content and form of maatschappelijke begeleiding (social guidance)
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 6, eerste en tweede lid)
Minister exempts migrants from exam parts or the whole obligation on medical, mental or effort grounds
p: The Minister decides exemptions from exam parts based on the migrant's demonstrated efforts, a discretionary assessment with limited statutory criteria.
Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 7a en 7b) and Artikel 8
The Minister may extend deadlines where the migrant shows no fault, and further extensions are set by general administrative order."
Artikel I, onderdelen J en N (artikel 28-30, 34)
The Minister imposes administrative fines for late completion of the participation track, with annual repeat fines while it remains incomplete, and fine ceilings are set by statute."
Municipalities are given a statutory duty to provide social guidance to asylum migrants and family members, with content set by general administrative order."
Artikel II and III (ISI data access; Artikel 47, 49, 50 Wet inburgering)
Municipalities and the Minister gain expanded access to personal data in the ISI for the participation track and social guidance, limited by a necessity test."

parties: Asks how municipal discretion over content and sanctions for non-completion are bounded, how data exchange is safeguarded, and what happens if the declaration is signed but not honoured.
How far does this policy discretion extend? Does it apply only to implementation or also to content?
Hoe ver strekt deze beleidsvrijheid? Ziet die alleen op de uitvoering of ook op de inhoud?
Asks about the unilateral nature of the declaration and whether it serves political participation of newcomers, and who funds the process.
What are the considerations for a unilateral declaration instead of a mutual contract in which the municipality commits to facilities enabling optimal participation of newcomers?
Wat zijn de overwegingen voor een eenzijdige verklaring in plaats van een wederzijds contract waarbij de gemeente tekent voor faciliteiten die optimale participatie van nieuwkomers mogelijk maken?
Questions the mandatory character, the fines for non-completion, the cost borne by migrants, and the data access granted to municipalities.
It is not clear to the SP faction what this entails.[regarding necessary personal data for municipalities]
Het is voor de SP-fractie niet duidelijk wat dit inhoudt.
Supports the declaration in principle but wants clarity on its precise wording, its legal framing, the separate fine basis, and the rules for municipal guidance versus municipal discretion.
It is not clear to the CDA faction why the government chooses a separate legal basis for the administrative fine.
Het is de leden van de CDA-fractie niet duidelijk waarom de regering hierbij kiest wordt voor een aparte grondslag voor de bestuurlijke boete.
Objects to repeated fines without limit, which the Adviescommissie Vreemdelingenzaken deems disproportionate, and to vague core values that may conflict with conscience.
repeatedly imposing fines without any limit is, according to the Advisory Committee on Immigration Affairs, neither proportionate nor efficient
het herhaaldelijk opleggen van boetes – zonder enige begrenzing – volgens de Adviescommissie Vreemdelingenzaken niet proportioneel en niet efficiënt is
Asks why the core elements and the programme are not fixed in statute rather than delegated, and what the purpose of enforcement is.
why it was not chosen to lay down the main elements of the participation declaration and the content of the programme at statutory level?
waarom er niet voor is gekozen de hoofdelementen van de participatieverklaring en de inhoud van het traject op wetsniveau vast te leggen?

Has serious doubts about necessity and effectiveness of the signed declaration, the lack of clear core values, equal application to native Dutch citizens, and cost borne by migrants despite the Council of State advice.
They do, however, have serious reservations about the usefulness and necessity of signing a participation declaration.
Zij hebben echter ernstige bedenkingen bij de nut en noodzaak van het ondertekenen van een participatieverklaring
Objects to the lack of statutory definition of the declaration's essentials and the ambiguity about freedom of opinion, and asks that municipal responsibility and time limits be more tightly bounded.
They ask why the government has refrained from this [setting the essentials of the declaration in formal law].
Zij vragen waarom de regering hiervan af heeft gezien

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill introducing a participation declaration track into the Wet inburgering be adapted: its core elements should be set in law, the relation to the basic integration exam abroad clarified, and the costs for integration-obliged migrants reconsidered. The government's reply rejected the core-elements objection, accepted clarifying the relation to the basic exam and the cost explanation in the explanatory memorandum, and kept the cost burden on family migrants.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that the main elements of the participation declaration track, as a component of the integration exam, should be set out in the law itself rather than delegated to the Besluit inburgering.
The Afdeling advises that integration-obliged migrants should not bear the costs of the participation declaration track given their limited financial means.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to explain how the participation track relates to the basic integration exam taken abroad, to avoid duplication.
The Afdeling notes that the grounds for awarding a quality mark to course institutions were unclear, and the government clarified them in the bill.

34593.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Bellingwedde and Vlagtwedde and establishes a new municipality of Westerwolde from their territory, with transitional designations for tax, joint-arrangement and utility matters. It also amends the housing market and safety-region acts to reflect the merger and sets the entry-into-force date by royal decree.
34593.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the merger by better balance between task burden and resources and a sound financial position of the new municipality, without justifying any delegation specifically.
q: A municipal enlargement will not increase the task load, so a better balance between task burden and resources will arise.
Een gemeentelijke opschaling zal het takenpakket niet verzwaren, waardoor er een betere balans tussen taakzwaarte en hulpbronnen zal ontstaan.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: The VVD sees the voluntary merger as unproblematic and has no comments or questions.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make comments or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
The PvdA welcomes the bottom-up, voluntary character of the merger and asks questions about workload and the administrative organisations.
The PvdA members are of the view that the proposal for merger is initiated bottom-up and that the merger is voluntary.
De aan het woord zijnde leden zijn van mening dat de aanzet voor het voorstel tot samenvoeging «van onderop» voorop staat, evenals de vrijwilligheid van de samenvoeging.
The CDA asks the government to explain how the new municipality will have direct democratic legitimacy for regional tasks, as the Raad van State raised.
In this regard these members ask the government to elaborate on the Council of State's question about direct democratic legitimacy.
Deze leden vragen de regering in dit verband nader in te gaan op de vraag van de Raad van State naar rechtstreekse democratische legitimatie.
The SGP asks whether the municipality's size and number of kernels support its long-term administrative capacity and whether the financial situation is secure in the long run.
Is the government of the opinion that this is also guaranteed for the medium and long term?
Is de regering van mening dat dit ook de middellange en lange termijn is gewaarborgd?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill merging Bellingwedde and Vlagtwedde may proceed but asked for a sound justification of the 'bestuurskracht' and 'duurzaamheid' criteria, noting that reliance on regional partnerships means indirect democratic legitimation in the long term. The minister's reply argues that strategic regional tasks do not undermine the new municipality's capacity and that the explanatory memorandum has been clarified accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum did not clearly show that the merger yields a municipality fit for a future-proof administrative structure, so the justification of bestuurskracht and duurzaamheid had to be strengthened.

Reliance on regional partnerships for strategic decisions means democratic legitimation is indirect and not guaranteed in the longer term, which the reply addresses only by arguing that strategic tasks do not reduce capacity.

34629.s: The bill amends the Dutch BIG Act (regulation of healthcare professions) to modernise disciplinary law, require publication of BIG numbers, widen disciplinary powers including a broad professional ban and an inspector's power to order immediate cessation of practice, and introduce changes to complaint procedures, fees and penalties. It also makes related amendments to the Geneesmiddelenwet, Criminal Code and other laws.
34629.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by patient safety, the need for quick intervention against dangerous practitioners, and gaps in existing enforcement such as limited inspector powers and the inability to act against suspended practitioners.
q: To intervene quickly against practitioners who have shown seriously blameworthy conduct, where public health requires that their actions first be reviewed by the disciplinary judge

Om snel in te grijpen bij beroepsbeoefenaren die blijk hebben gegeven van ernstig laakbare gedrag waarvan het belang van de volksgezondheid verlangt dat hun handelen eerst wordt getoetst door de tuchtrechter
d: cases and manner in which practitioners must disclose their BIG number
identifying data to be recorded and made public in the register
rules on fees charged for applying for a declaration of equivalence
Minister may change the complaint filing fee in line with consumer price index
rules on reimbursement of complainant costs and enforcement of tuchtcollege decisions
salary categories and other working conditions of tuchtcollege chairs
rules on aggregated overview of complaints for the inspector
p: Adds a broad professional ban and conditional measures, expanding the tuchtcollege's sanction powers over practitioners while requiring subsidiarity and proportionality.
Allows the inspector to impose an immediate last to cease professional activities for eight weeks before any tuchtcollege hearing, a power exercised by the executive without prior judicial decision.
Gives the regional tuchtcollege power on inspector's motion to impose special guarantees or removal for unfitness, with consultation possible for inspectors.
Allows the Minister to impose penalty orders on practitioners directly without judicial involvement.
Extends the Minister's power to impose administrative fines up to the third category for a wider range of conduct.
Changes appointment of tuchtcollege members from life to six-year terms and shifts appointments to the Minister.

parties: Asks about timing of the amvb on BIG-number display and whether a breadth-limited ban could be narrowed, and about the length of the eight-week LOB term.
The term after which the LOB lapses is now eight weeks.
De termijn waarna de LOB verloopt is nu acht weken.
Asks for transparency on lobbying and the reasons for dropping laser treatment as a reserved act, and asks whether a mixed disciplinary body could be considered.
What are the possibilities for notifications of changes in registrations, so that employers are informed of an annotation on a care provider?

Wat zijn hiernaast de mogelijkheden voor bepaalde meldingen bij veranderingen in de registraties binnen de registers, zodat bijvoorbeeld werkgevers op de hoogte worden gesteld van een aantekening van een zorgverlener?
Opposes introducing court fees that could deter patient complaints, and asks about protecting patients from quacks and whether the Inspectorate has capacity to supervise BIG-number display.
The SP members oppose the government's plan to introduce court fees in the Wet BIG.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn er op tegen dat de regering griffierecht wil invoeren in de Wet BIG.
Asks whether the LOB review by the administrative court is only marginal, what remedies exist if an LOB is wrongly imposed, and how disciplinary and administrative tracks interact.
If so, would it not be better for the administrative judge to be able to review the decision fully?
Zo ja, is het niet beter dat de bestuursrechter een volledige toetsing van het besluit kan doen?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised sending the health-profession bill (Wet BIG amendments) to parliament after revisions, objecting to the IGZ's power to impose immediate bans on practice without prompt judicial review by the disciplinary judge, to delegation of which professions may perform reserved acts and of exemptions from reserved acts by AMvB, and to the new disciplinary norm and the filing fee. The minister's reply largely followed the advice on delegation and the disciplinary norm but kept the disciplinary judge for review of the ban and justified the filing fee.
concerns: The Council of State held that the immediate practice ban by the IGZ should be reviewed promptly by the disciplinary judge; the government did not accept this and preferred administrative court review.
Delegating by AMvB the designation of professions allowed to perform reserved acts was judged to belong in the law; the government dropped this delegation.
The AMvB power to exempt acts from the reserved-acts rules was insufficiently motivated; the government withdrew this general delegation.
The additional disciplinary norm in subsection 1 of article 47 was redundant and was removed.
The filing fee needed better justification; the government added reasoning in the explanatory memorandum but kept the fee.
Editorial remarks on the explanatory memorandum were taken into account.

34656.s: The bill amends the Dutch primary education acts (WPO and WPO BES) to make it easier to convert, relocate or expand schools without meeting the founding norm, and to adjust closure and split-norm timing. It also amends the Medezeggenschap act so parents and staff must be consulted before school mergers or closures.
34656.j: The memorandum justifies the wider ministerial discretion as a deliberate loosening of the earlier founding norm to keep diverse schooling viable amid pupil decline, limiting refusals to two situations as protection against excessive ministerial power.
q: As protection against an overly broad power of the Minister, the possibility of granting applications in the fifth paragraph is however restricted.
Als bescherming tegen een al te ruime bevoegdheid van de Minister wordt de mogelijkheid tot inwilliging van aanvragen in het vijfde lid wel ingeperkt.
d: Artikel I, A (art. 84 WPO), para 4 letter b
publication of split closure norms by ministerial regulation
p: Artikel I, A (art. 84 WPO), para 2 and 3

The Minister may grant conversion, expansion or relocation of schools that would otherwise fail the founding norm, changing 'can permit' to 'may decide to permit', with limits on refusal grounds only in two situations.
Split founding and closure norms take effect earlier, from 1 August, removing the five-year timing link and deadline for municipal decisions.
Artikel III, A (art. 76 Wet primair onderwijs BES)
The Minister may permit conversion, relocation or expansion of schools in Caribbean Netherlands, with the requirement of an island council decision lifted for some cases.
Artikel II (art. 15 Wet medezeggenschap op scholen)
Parents and staff must be consulted before the governing body decides on school mergers, transfers or closure, strengthening participation.

parties: Asks whether regional area plans exist, their legal status, and how municipalities participate and how new initiatives fit existing plans.
To what extent do municipalities have a say in drawing up an area plan?
In hoeverre hebben gemeenten een stem in de totstandkoming van een gebiedsplan?
Welcomes greater flexibility for school boards but asks whether guarantees exist to preserve sufficient public education and whether conditions are equal for special and public schools.
at the same time ask whether guarantees have been built into these plans to preserve sufficient public education
vragen tegelijk of er in deze plannen garanties zijn ingebouwd voor het behoud van voldoende openbaar onderwijs
Questions the broad, non-exhaustive ministerial discretion in article 84 WPO and the risk of arbitrariness and unequal treatment of schools, echoing the Council of State.
How is (the appearance of) arbitrariness prevented and how is equal treatment of all schools guaranteed?
Hoe wordt (de schijn van) willekeur voorkomen en hoe wordt geborgd dat alle scholen gelijk worden behandeld?
Asks for research evidence that current school supply does not match parental wishes and questions whether the bill is necessary given parents' strong preferences.
Can the government demonstrate with research that the existing school supply insufficiently matches parents' wishes?
Kan de regering met onderzoek aantonen dat het bestaande scholenaanbod onvoldoende aansluit op de wensen van ouders?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised against the proposed mandatory consultation and planning duty for primary school boards on future education supply, arguing it is ineffective given school competition and hard to enforce, and asked for justification of the broader ministerial power to approve school grounds changes. The government's reply accepted removing the consultation and planning duty and narrowed the minister's power in line with the advice.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the effectiveness of a mandatory consultation and planning duty for school boards and advises removing it, which the government accepted.
The Afdeling notes that enforcing a shared consultation duty is difficult, and the government's reply accepts the removal of that duty.

The Afdeling finds the minister's broadened power to approve changes to school grounds insufficiently limited, allowing schools to escape the closure norm, and the government narrowed the provisions accordingly.
The Afdeling gives redactional remarks, which the government adopted, including a correction to a cross-reference in article I.

The Afdeling asks for consistency between the bill text and explanatory memorandum on regional delineation and for attention to the evaluation of the Wet voorzieningenplanning, and the regional delineation remarks were overtaken by the removal of the consultation duty.

34674.s: The bill amends the Pensioenwet and the Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling on a range of technical and some substantive points, including mandatory supervisory boards for larger company pension funds, electronic information provision, variable pension options, and a procedure change for amending occupational pension schemes. It also gives accountability bodies of occupational pension funds advisory rights and a right to appeal to the Amsterdam Enterprise Chamber, aligning them with other pension funds.
34674.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical details and says the procedure change is not needed to guarantee the required support, since representativeness is already checked every five years.
q: Under Article 11 Wvb the occupational pension association must in any case demonstrate at least every five years that it is still sufficiently representative.
Op grond van artikel 11 Wvb dient de beroepspensioenvereniging immers al ten minste vijfjaarlijks aan te tonen nog voldoende representatief te zijn.
d: I H (Pensioenwet art. 63, new fourth paragraph); II I (Wvb art. 75, new fourth paragraph)
further rules on variable pension payments
procedure for announcing amendments to occupational pension scheme
p: Gives accountability bodies of occupational pension funds a right to appeal to the Enterprise Chamber against fund decisions that conflict with their advice.
Requires a supervisory board for company pension funds above EUR 1 billion, strengthening internal oversight.

parties: Asks whether the threshold of 1 billion euro for raad van toezicht, replacing external visitation committees, was based on a sound evaluation before the change is adopted.
Is the government willing to revise this change and first have a thorough evaluation carried out before this decision is discussed in the House?
Is de regering bereid om deze wijziging te herzien en eerst een gedegen evaluatie uit te laten voeren, alvorens dit besluit in de Kamer te bespreken?
Asks whether participants who consented to electronic information by mistake can still opt back into paper communication, and questions the terminology used for consent.
Additionally, the CDA members ask whether there is also a way back.
Daarnaast vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie of er ook een weg terug mogelijk is.
Asks how the central bank DNB would be able to prohibit mergers or splits on prudential grounds and how the regulator's request for an explicit notification rule is being handled.
Can the government explain what it thinks about this?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe zij hierover denkt?
Asks whether pension providers may switch to electronic information without first informing participants in writing, which would allow them to object.
The pension provider must inform participants in writing in advance if it intends to provide information electronically.
De pensioenuitvoerder dient deelnemers vooraf schriftelijk te informeren als zij voornemens is informatie elektronisch te verschaffen.
Asks that participants, including those without a computer, must explicitly and clearly consent to electronic information provision, and that paper information continue otherwise.
These members believe that participants – including those who cannot use a computer themselves – must always explicitly and clearly consent to electronic information provision.
Deze leden vinden dat deelnemers – ook degenen die zelf geen computer kunnen gebruiken – altijd expliciet en op heldere en eenvoudige wijze moeten instemmen met elektronische informatieverstrekking.
Asks for factual data on how many objections were filed on the pension regulation changes and how many funds face recovery periods over five years.
The PVV members ask why this approach was chosen and how many pension funds may face a recovery period of more than five years.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen waarom voor deze uitwerking is gekozen en hoeveel pensioenfondsen mogelijk met een hersteltermijn van meer dan vijf jaar worden geconfronteerd.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises sending the Verzamelwet pensioenen 2017 to parliament, but says the proposed extension of the recovery period for the minimum required own funds needs a sound justification, since six yearly measurement points before action risks slow recovery. The Staatssecretaris replies that the memorie van toelichting was clarified: raising the number of measurement points from five to six is not an extension of the intended period.
concerns: The Afdeling considers that extending the trigger from five to six consecutive measurement points may not ensure adequate and timely recovery, and asks for a reasoned justification.

34725-V.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by adjusting expenditure, revenue and commitment figures across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and gives retroactive effect to the end of the 2016 budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34737.s: The bill amends article 6 of the Dutch International Crimes Act to criminalise deliberately using starvation of civilians as a method of warfare, including deliberately impeding humanitarian relief supplies, in non-international armed conflicts. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
34737.j: The memorandum justifies the change by pointing to advice from the CAVV and the Council of State, its alignment with the Rome Statute, and the government's constitutional duty to advance international law; it does not justify any delegation or new executive power.
q: At the international level such a national extension gives direction and may in time prove to be a forerunner for a comparable amendment of the Rome Statute.
Op internationaal niveau geeft een dergelijke nationale uitbreiding richting en kan het op termijn een voorloper blijken voor een vergelijkbare wijziging van het Statuut van Rome.

parties: Questions whether the bill has any material effect and why the government abandoned its prior caution on international criminal law, while asking for the Raad van State and prosecution views.
It therefore takes a great deal of effort – if I may put it so homely – but materially it achieves nothing.
Het kost dus heel veel moeite – als ik het zo huiselijk mag zeggen – maar het levert materiaal gezien niets op.
Supports criminalising the conduct but doubts enforceability, especially evidence gathering and whether Dutch jurisdiction alone allows investigation involving non-state actors.
How can this law, especially with a view to gathering evidence, actually be enforced?
Hoe kan deze wet, vooral met het oog op bewijsvergaring, daadwerkelijk gehandhaafd worden?
Welcomes the bill as implementing the Sjoerdsma motion and asks how the government will promote change in customary international law and the Rome Statute.
The D66 members have studied this proposal with enthusiasm, which implements the Sjoerdsma motion that asked over two years ago to criminalise obstructing humanitarian aid.

De leden van de D66-fractie hebben met enthousiasme kennisgenomen van voorliggend voorstel waarmee uitvoering gegeven wordt aan de motie-Sjoerdsma die ruim twee jaar geleden vroeg om het belemmeren van humanitaire hulp strafbaar te stellen.

Supports the bill as a leading step for Dutch international law, but asks who qualifies as perpetrator, including omission, negligence and incidental effects, and about foreign experience and capacity.
The members speaking have questions about who will be classified as perpetrator and how far this extends.
De aan het woord zijnde leden hebben vragen over wie er zal worden aangemerkt als dader en hoe ver dit strekt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the amendment to the Wet internationale misdrijven (extending the criminalisation of obstructing humanitarian aid to non-international armed conflicts) be split off into a separate bill, since it is a principled change of course that does not suit an omnibus procedural bill. The government followed this advice and submitted two amended bills to parliament.
concerns: A principled extension of international crimes law beyond the ICC Statute does not belong in an omnibus procedural bill and should be a separate bill with fuller debate.
The bill's title does not mention the Wim amendment, which is the most significant substantive element, and some redactional changes were made.

34746.s: The bill strengthens criminal law and criminal procedure against terrorism by adding terrorism-related disqualification of voting rights, higher penalties for terrorist intent, and a general duty to report known terrorist offences. It also allows pre-trial detention without serious suspicion for up to thirty days and DNA sampling without serious suspicion for suspects of terrorist offences.
34746.j: The memorandum justifies the measures as necessary to prevent gaps in investigative powers against terrorism, while noting that judges must apply the detention power carefully and that the NVvR advice was followed by limiting detention without serious objections to ten-day periods up to thirty days.
q: It concerns extending the possibility to take suspects of terrorist offences into pre-trial detention, widening the possibilities to take cell material for DNA research from suspects of terrorist offences, and introducing a broad reporting duty for everyone who knows of terrorist offences, including their preparation.

Het gaat om het verlengen van de mogelijkheid om verdachten van terroristische misdrijven in voorlopige hechtenis te nemen, het verruimen van mogelijkheden om celmateriaal ten behoeve van DNA-onderzoek af te nemen bij verdachten van terroristische misdrijven en de invoering van een brede aangifteplicht voor een ieder die kennis draagt van terroristische misdrijven, inclusief de voorbereiding daarvan.
p: Pre-trial detention without serious objections is allowed for suspects of terrorist offences for up to thirty days in total, decided by the court rather than the executive, which expands prosecutorial reach over suspects' liberty.
Body and DNA examinations of suspects held for terrorism no longer require serious objections against the suspect.
A general duty to report known terrorist offences is imposed on everyone, extending investigative demands on citizens.

parties: Asks whether the imam title could be misused as a cover to invoke the privilege from reporting duties, and how the risk will be addressed.
These members ask how the risk is assessed that the title imam will be misused as a cover, in the sense that persons could invoke the privilege merely by calling themselves imam.

Deze leden vragen hoe het risico ingeschat wordt dat de titel imam misbruikt zal worden als dekmantel, in de zin dat personen zich kunnen beroepen op het verschoningsrecht enkel door zich imam te noemen.
Asks for examples and clarity on which preparatory acts fall under the new offences and where the lower limit of the reporting duty lies, so that the judiciary can apply them.
These members ask the government to indicate where the lower limit lies and what may reasonably be expected of the citizen regarding knowledge of preparation for a terrorist offence.

Deze leden vragen de regering aan te geven waar de ondergrens ligt en wat er in redelijkheid van de burger kan worden verlangd wat betreft het weet hebben van een voorbereiding op een terroristisch misdrijf.
Doubts the necessity and effectiveness of extending pre-trial detention without serious suspicion and of the broader reporting duty, given risks to fundamental rights, privacy and false reports.

They have doubts whether the necessity for this extension of pre-trial detention is sufficiently substantiated, so that it does not conflict with, among others, article 15 of the Constitution, article 5 ECHR and article 9 ICCPR.

Zij hebben twijfels of de noodzaak voor deze uitbreiding van de mogelijkheid tot voorlopige hechtenis voldoende is onderbouwd, zodat deze niet ingaat tegen onder andere artikel 15 van de Grondwet, artikel 5 van het Europees Verdrag tot bescherming van de Rechten van de Mens en de Fundamentele Vrijheden (hierna: EVRM) en artikel 9 van het Internationaal Verdrag betreffende Burger en Politieke Rechten (hierna: IVBRPR).
Demands concrete cases showing necessity of extended detention, asks how it fits the ECtHR requirement of verifiable facts, and raises concerns about insufficient judicial review and proportionality.
The aforementioned members ask how the measure relates to this requirement that a suspicion must be based on verifiable facts.
Voornoemde leden vragen hoe de maatregel zich verhoudt tot dit vereiste.
Asks whether terrorism suspects were released in past years for lack of strong suspicion, and whether they later proved to warrant longer detention.
Were terrorism suspects actually released of whom it later appeared they should have remained in pre-trial detention longer?
Zijn er daadwerkelijk terrorismeverdachten vrijgelaten waarvan achteraf bleek dat die beter langer in voorlopige hechtenis hadden kunnen blijven?
Asks for narrower delimitation of terrorism offences eligible for extended detention and how judicial review of grounds for detention will be applied in practice.
Can the government explain how this will concretely take shape?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten hoe dit concreet vorm krijgt?
Questions whether a 30-day extension is proportionate and whether judges face an adequate dilemma; supports limiting DNA sampling to suspects in custody.
The aforementioned members ask whether the 30-day period, considering the requirements of proportionality, can adequately be managed.
Voornoemde leden vragen of de termijn van 30 dagen, de eisen van proportionaliteit in ogenschouw nemende, adequaat het hoofd kan worden geboden.
Asks how many times the extended detention would have been used in the past, and whether DNA powers anticipate a planned Code of Criminal Procedure change.
They ask whether this is correct.
Asks how the practice of releasing suspects during investigation works and where bottlenecks arise, and asks why the government speaks of almost all cases.
Can the government precisely (for example in a table) indicate how practice currently is, where the bottlenecks arise and how this is solved by this proposal?
Kan de regering precies (bijvoorbeeld in een schema) aangeven hoe de praktijk nu is, waar de knelpunten zich voordoen en hoe dit opgelost is met dit voorstel?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against sending the counter-terrorism bill to parliament until its concerns on the necessity of criminalising presence in terror zones, extended pre-trial detention without serious suspicion, and DNA sampling are addressed. The government's reply removed the terror-zone offence and defended the other measures with additional justification.
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity of criminalising unauthorised presence in terror-controlled areas insufficiently justified given the new exit ban and the adequacy of existing criminal law; the government dropped this element.
The Afdeling found the extension of pre-trial detention without serious suspicion (up to 44 days) insufficiently justified; the government defended it with additional reasoning but kept the proposal.
The Afdeling questioned the compatibility of compulsory DNA sampling without serious suspicion with Article 8 ECHR; the government argued proportionality and kept the measure.

The Afdeling objected that the 'rechtens te respecteren belang' consent criterion is vague, arbitrary and unsuited to criminal law; the government accepted the Afdeling's point in substance by removing the element.
The Afdeling flagged that criminalising training and financing of terrorism as preparatory offences could create overlapping offences; the government adjusted the provisions.

34755.s: The bill amends the Dutch VAT Act 1968 to implement EU Directive 2016/1065 on the VAT treatment of vouchers, adding definitions of single-purpose and multi-purpose vouchers and new rules on when supply occurs. It takes effect on 1 January 2019 and applies to vouchers issued after 31 December 2018.
q: Thus it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

parties: Asks about the reasons for the distinction between single- and multi-purpose vouchers, the practical consequences for consumers, the room left by the directive, and the administrative burden on business.
Why was a distinction between single-purpose and multi-purpose vouchers chosen in the first place?
Waarom is er sowieso gekozen voor een onderscheid tussen enkelvoudige en meervoudige vouchers?
Questions the logic of taxing single-purpose vouchers at sale, the definition of monetary value, and possible misuse across member states.
The CDA members, however, consider it more logical not to tax vouchers at all.
De leden van de CDA-fractie achten het echter logischer om vouchers niet te belasten.
Welcomes the uniform EU treatment but asks who will test case by case whether an instrument still qualifies as a voucher, and asks about cross-border use and effects on consumers.
These members ask who will carry out this assessment and how it will take place.
Deze leden vragen wie deze toetsing zal uitvoeren en hoe deze toetsing zal plaatsvinden.
Asks whether the directive gives enough clarity for issuers and holders to know what is a voucher and whether tax avoidance with discount, entry and travel vouchers can continue.
Can tax avoidance continue as long as no clarification is provided for discount vouchers, entry tickets and travel tickets?
Kan, zolang er ten aanzien van bijvoorbeeld kortingvouchers, toegangsbewijzen en vervoersbewijzen geen verduidelijking wordt aangebracht, belastingontwijking blijven plaatsvinden?

34764.s: The bill makes the conscription framework (Kaderwet dienstplicht and Wet gewetensbezwaren militaire dienst) gender-neutral so that conscription applies to women as well as men, and adds a transitional exemption for women aged 17 or older at entry into force. It also replaces the nahang (post-adoption) procedure for the general administrative measure under article 17 with a voorhang (pre-adoption) procedure.
34764.j: The memorandum justifies the voorhang change by saying it gives parliament more room for effective debate and avoids unnecessary delay in implementing regulations.
q: This offers more room for effective parliamentary debate on setting the grounds for deferment, exemption or dispensation from conscription.
Dit biedt meer ruimte voor een effectief parlementair debat over het bepalen van de uitstel- vrijstellings- of ontheffingsgronden van de dienstplicht.
d: deferment, exemption and dispensation rules for conscription
entry into force by royal decree
p: The procedure for the exemption-rules AMvB is changed from nahang to voorhang, giving parliament an opportunity to comment before the draft is finalised.

parties: Asks how the government would weigh the situation where both parents of a child are called up at the same time, and what solution it envisages.
They are however curious whether the government already has in mind how a weighing will be made in such situations.
Zij zijn echter wel benieuwd of de regering al voor ogen heeft hoe er een afweging gemaakt zal worden in dergelijke situaties.
Notes the bill is largely symbolic since reactivation is not foreseen, prefers prioritising problems in the professional army, and asks whether the law could serve as basis for a social service duty.
They would rather have seen the government address the serious bottlenecks and shortcomings in the professional armed forces with greater priority.
Zij hadden liever gezien dat de regering de ernstige knelpunten en tekortkomingen bij de professionele krijgsmacht met meer prioriteit had aangepakt.
Supports replacing the nahang with a voorhang procedure but asks why a stronger voorhang procedure was not chosen given the sensitivity and importance of democratic control.

These members ask however, given the heavy sensitivity of the matter and the importance of democratic control over it, why the government did not choose a heavy voorhang procedure and whether it is willing to do so after all.

Deze leden vragen echter, gelet op de zware gevoeligheid van de materie en het belang van democratische controle daarop, waarom de regering niet heeft gekozen voor een zware voorhangprocedure en of de regering bereid is dit alsnog te doen.
Raises practical and political questions about mobilisation, selection criteria for call-ups, and the number of conscripts needed, and questions the analogy between defence and the labour market.
The SP members have a number of questions about the political and practical consequences of introducing conscription, which seems likely to amount to a mass mobilisation.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben een aantal vragen over de politieke en praktische gevolgen van een invoering van de dienstplicht, wat op een massamobilisatie lijkt te zullen neerkomen.
Welcomes the bill and the planned general rules on deferral, exemption and release, and supports the voorhang procedure for more parliamentary debate.
This also applies to the choice for a voorhang procedure, which provides more room for effective parliamentary debate on determining the grounds for deferral, exemption or release from conscription.

Dit geldt ook voor de keuze voor een voorhangprocedure welke meer ruimte voor een effectief parlementair debat over het bepalen van de uitstel- vrijstellings- of ontheffingsgronden van de dienstplicht.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised submitting the bill extending conscription to women, but asked for the explanatory memorandum to be expanded on the relation to articles 1 and 98 of the Constitution. The government's reply states the memorandum was supplemented with a fuller justification as advised and adopted the redactional remark.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should justify the extension of conscription to women in relation to articles 1 and 98 of the Constitution, including the reinterpretation of article 98.
A redactional remark on the placement of article 3(3) of the Kaderwet dienstplicht was adopted, moving it into transitional law as a new article III.

34782.s: The bill amends the Wet openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba and the Kieswet to create an electoral college in each Caribbean public body that will elect members of the Eerste Kamer together with provincial councillors in the European Netherlands. It sets membership rules, incompatibilities, election procedures, candidate registration, and appeal routes to the Gemeenschappelijk Hof.
34782.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated remuneration and code-of-conduct rules as pragmatic, given the limited task of the electoral college, and states that the amended provisions implement the constitutional amendment.
q: The members of the electoral college receive a remuneration set by the island council by island ordinance, as referred to in article 121, first paragraph, parts a and b.
De leden van het kiescollege ontvangen een door de eilandsraad bij eilandsverordening vastgestelde vergoeding als bedoeld in 121, eerste lid, onderdelen a en b.
d: remuneration of electoral college members set by island council ordinance
code of conduct for electoral college adopted by island council

parties: Asks whether a code of conduct for the electoral colleges is needed, what it would contain, who sets it, and whether extra meetings and allowances are justified given the limited tasks of the colleges.
These members favour an arrangement for the election of these colleges that is as efficient as possible.
Deze leden zijn voorstander van een zo efficiënt mogelijke regeling voor de verkiezing van deze colleges.

Regrets that the debate on the Senate electoral colleges overlaps with the debate on island self-government and asks about the informal consultation, the critical island government advice, and the consequences if a college does not comply or take part.
These members regret that the debate on the design of the voting rights for the Senate overlaps with the debate on the degree of self-government of the islands.
De leden van de CDA-fractie betreuren het, dat de discussie over de vormgeving van het kiesrecht voor de Eerste Kamer samenloopt met de discussie over de mate van zelfbestuur van de eilanden.
Doubts whether the independence of electoral college members is sufficiently safeguarded given that fewer incompatible functions are excluded because of the small island populations.
These members understand that this may pose a problem but do wonder whether independence can be sufficiently guaranteed.
Deze leden begrijpen dat dit een probleem kan vormen maar vragen zich wel af of de onafhankelijkheid voldoende gewaarborgd kan worden.

34809.s: The bill inserts a new article 78a into the Dutch Personal Data Protection Act allowing the Data Protection Authority to ask the Council of State's administrative jurisdiction division to declare a European Commission adequacy or model-clause decision valid, so that doubts about such decisions can be referred to the EU Court of Justice following the Schrems ruling. It sets out the procedure, party status, the possibility of staying the request pending another referral, and excludes appeal against such a stay.
34809.j: The memorandum justifies the new procedure as necessary to comply with the Schrems ruling, which requires national supervisory authorities to be able to bring doubts about Commission decisions before a national court for referral to the EU Court of Justice.
q: The new first paragraph of article 78a enables the Data Protection Authority, where it has investigated at the request of an interested party a transfer of personal data to a country outside the European Union, to submit to the Council of State a request to declare such a Commission decision valid.

Het nieuw voorgestelde eerste lid van artikel 78a maakt het voor de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens mogelijk om in gevallen waarin het op verzoek van een belanghebbende een onderzoek heeft ingesteld betreffende doorgifte van persoonsgegevens naar een land buiten de Europese Unie
p: Gives the Data Protection Authority a new procedural power to bring the validity of EU adequacy decisions before the Council of State, with the court retaining control over the outcome and the referral to the EU Court of Justice.

parties: Asks whether the new court route for the AP is meaningful, since it will rarely if ever be used, and whether the procedure is sufficient.

Is the conclusion then justified that the bill creates a separate legal route for the AP to bring a complaint about the invalidity of a decision under the above article before the court, while in practice this route will rarely if ever be used?

Is de conclusie dan gerechtvaardigd dat het wetsvoorstel een aparte rechtsgang creëert voor de AP om een klacht inzake de ongeldigheid van een besluit op grond van bovenstaand artikel aan de rechter voor te leggen, terwijl deze rechtsgang in de praktijk zelden tot nooit zal worden gebruikt?

Questions why the Administrative Jurisdiction Division is not made exclusively competent for preliminary questions, asks how supervisory independence fits with standard contractual clauses, and asks about the AP's negative advice and whether there were temporary measures.
These members ask whether this could not provide the desired clarity.
Deze leden vragen of dit niet voor gewenste overzichtelijkheid zou kunnen zorgen.

Argues that a formal finding that data is safe in third countries is insufficient and that supervision must be real, and asks whether the consumer bears too much of the initiative and whether the government can itself challenge adequacy decisions.
The Schrems judgment shows that a formal finding that personal data in third countries is in safe hands is not enough; it must actually be possible to establish this.

De Hofuitspraak in de zaak-Schrems laat zien dat niet volstaan kan worden met een formele vaststelling dat persoonsgegevens in derde landen in veilige handen zijn, maar dat dit daadwerkelijk moet kunnen worden vastgesteld.

Questions why the AP faces so many hurdles, such as no own-motion request and no obligation for the court to refer questions, asks about the AP's investigative and enforcement powers abroad, and argues citizens' privacy should be the criterion for assessing procedures.
These members ask why so many hurdles are imposed on the AP.
Deze leden vragen waarom er zoveel drempels worden opgelegd voor de AP.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill giving the Data Protection Authority a standalone route to challenge an adequacy decision should drop the obligation for the Administrative Jurisdiction Division to refer questions to the CJEU and drop the 'reasonable doubt' criterion. The government's reply followed both points and amended the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The mandatory preliminary reference obligation in the bill cannot be imposed by national law since it already follows from Article 267 TFEU and CJEU case law, so it should be dropped.
The mandatory referral rule removes the national court's discretion to decide not to refer, for example where the case has become moot, and should be removed.
The 'reasonable doubt' criterion departs from the wording of the Schrems judgment, which speaks only of doubt, and should be replaced.
The possible dicta in the sixth paragraph should be expressed more clearly.

34827.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Haarlemmerliede en Spaarnwoude and Haarlemmermeer into a new municipality named Haarlemmermeer, effective on a date set by royal decree. It also removes the merged municipalities from the electoral districts, housing market, judicial district and safety region tables and assigns the new municipality for transitional legal purposes.
q: We have considered that it is desirable to merge the municipalities of Haarlemmerliede en Spaarnwoude and Haarlemmermeer into the new municipality of Haarlemmermeer.
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is de gemeenten Haarlemmerliede en Spaarnwoude en Haarlemmermeer samen te voegen tot de nieuwe gemeente Haarlemmermeer
d: date of entry into force of the law

parties: Asks why the merger did not include a boundary change with Haarlem for Spaarndam-Oost, given some unrest about this part of the bill.
Can the government explain why this merger did not opt for a boundary change with Haarlem regarding Spaarndam-Oost?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten waarom er bij deze herindeling niet is gekozen voor een grenswijziging met Haarlem ten aanzien van Spaarndam-Oost?
Objects that the herindelingsadvies and the province's zienswijze were not attached to the explanatory memorandum and asks that they be sent to the Chamber.
They are of the view that publication on a website cannot be equated with submission to the House of Representatives.](see note)
Zij zijn van mening dat publicatie op een website niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met indiening bij de Tweede Kamer.
Notes the bottom-up process and the creation of a capable municipality, and asks a few questions about the position of Spaarndam-Oost.
These members read that the reorganisation took place from the bottom up and that the reorganisation advice was adopted by a majority of votes in all municipalities.
Deze leden lezen dat de herindeling van onderop heeft plaatsgevonden en het herindelingsadvies in alle gemeenten met een meerderheid van stemmen is vastgesteld.
Asks how inhabitants, civil society and local politics were involved in the proposal, and how accessibility of facilities will be guaranteed after the merger.

These members ask the government to further explain how the residents, civil society organisations and local politics of the municipalities concerned were involved in the preparation of the municipal reorganisation proposal.

Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken zijn geweest bij de totstandkoming van het voorstel tot gemeentelijke herindeling.
Requires local support and asks whether a majority of residents supports the merger and why no citizen consultation was held, questioning whether the merger is effectively forced.
According to the SP members, reorganisations should only take place from the bottom up, if there is support from the population.
Herindelingen zouden volgens de leden van de SP-fractie alleen plaats moeten vinden van onderaf, als hiervoor steun is van de bevolking.
Asks about the preference of Spaarndam residents for Haarlem, their orientation toward Haarlem versus Haarlemmermeer, and why no boundary correction was included.
Why does the bill not provide for the boundary correction advocated by the elected village council of Spaarndam during the hearing in the House of Representatives?
Waarom voorziet het wetsvoorstel niet in de door de gekozen dorpsraad van Spaarndam tijdens de hoorzitting in de Tweede Kamer bepleite grenscorrectie?
Asks how residents of Spaarndam-Oost were involved in decision-making, for an estimate of support there, and the effects of a possible boundary correction.
In what way were the residents of Spaarndam-Oost involved in the decision-making?
Op welke wijze zijn de bewoners van Spaarndam-Oost betrokken bij de besluitvorming?

34836.s: The bill repeals five laws governing Dutch ship nationality and bareboat charter registration, replacing their requirements with a new Rijkswet nationaliteit zeeschepen, and amends numerous laws to replace the term 'Dutch law/flag' with 'law in force for the Netherlands / flag of the Kingdom'. It also approves the Regeling vergoeding schade door olieverontreiniging BES.
34836.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the subordinate regulation by stating that existing lower regulations will be re-issued by general administrative order or ministerial regulation where they are not to lapse.
q: If the lower regulations are not to lapse, they will be re-issued by general administrative order or by ministerial regulation.
Indien de lagere regelgeving niet dient te vervallen, zal deze bij algemene maatregel van bestuur dan wel bij ministeriële regeling worden omgehangen.
d: rules on handling of bodies of persons who died aboard ships
eligibility criteria for registration of vessels; refers to ministerial implementing rules under the new Rijkswet
p: Approves the Regeling vergoeding schade door olieverontreiniging BES by statute, giving parliament a say over the compensation scheme.

parties: Asks whether the Minister's room to deregister ships is sufficiently substantiated after the Raad van State's comments, and whether nationality can be revoked for offences by vessels such as Greenpeace's Arctic Sunrise.

After reading pages 3 and 9 of the explanatory memorandum, find the proposal sufficiently substantiated following the Raad van State's comments, and ask that the Rijkswet and its aims be implemented with force, in particular the room the Minister receives to apply deregistration in the register.

vinden, na het lezen van bladzijde 3 en 9 van de memorie van toelichting, het voorstel naar aanleiding van de opmerkingen van de Raad van State voldoende onderbouwd na de toelichting en verzoeken met kracht invulling te geven aan de Rijkswet en haar doelen en met name de ruimte die de Minister krijgt om doorhaling in het register toe te passen.

Notes that the Raad van State's objections, including the insufficient justification for the Minister's deregistration power and the distinction between nationality grant and registration, were not addressed in the bill, and asks for further motivation.
In particular, the criticism that the justification for the distinction between granting nationality and registration is insufficient has not been answered.
Met name de kritiek dat de motivering van het onderscheid tussen nationaliteitsverlening en teboekstelling onvoldoende is, is niet beantwoord.
Asks whether social security under Dutch law remains guaranteed after reflagging a ship to a non-Kingdom flag, and why the amendment to Civil Code article 7:695 is not implemented simultaneously.
Can the government also explain whether, under the current bill, social security remains guaranteed under Dutch law when a ship is reflagged to a flag other than that of the Kingdom?

Kan de regering tevens toelichten of onder het huidige wetsvoorstel de sociale zekerheid conform Nederlands recht gewaarborgd blijft bij de uitvlagging van een schip naar een vlag anders dan die van het Koninkrijk?

34845-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget of the Dutch States General (parliament), adjusting appropriations for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and related items by a second supplementary budget. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 December 2017.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget of the States General (IIA) for the year 2017
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten Generaal (IIA), voor het jaar 2017

34854.s: The bill repeals the Wet raadgevend referendum, which provides for a national advisory referendum, and makes consequential amendments to the Algemene wet bestuursrecht and the Tijdelijke experimentenwet stembiljetten. It excludes the repealing act itself from referendum eligibility and includes transitional rules for referendum procedures already underway.
34854.j: The memorandum justifies repeal by the coalition agreement's finding that the advisory referendum did not deliver what was expected, and argues the repealing act should logically not itself be referendable.
p: Repeals the national advisory referendum law, removing a citizen-initiated instrument for consulting the public on legislation.
Expressly excludes the repealing act from referendum eligibility, so the executive's bill cannot be put to a popular vote.

parties: Supports abolition, arguing referendums do not fit representative democracy, while asking how citizen involvement in policymaking can be broadened.
The referendum instrument does not fit within the system of representative democracy.
Het instrument referendum past niet in het stelsel van de representatieve democratie.
Opposes abolition, demanding justification for the claim that the referendum failed and asking why it was not improved rather than repealed.
The referendum is a very important and essential element within a democracy and completes the representative system we know in the Netherlands.
Het referendum is een heel belangrijk en essentieel element binnen een democratie en vormt de vervolmaking van het representatieve stelsel dat we in Nederland kennen.
Views referendums as no alternative to democratic decision-making and asks why the repeal bill was made non-referendable.
These members believe a referendum is no alternative to democratic decision-making, as it does not fit representative democracy and weakens the role of parliament.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat een referendum geen alternatief is voor democratische besluitvorming, omdat het niet past bij de vertegenwoordigende democratie en de rol van het parlement verzwakt.
Notes the repeal implements the coalition agreement without comment on checks.
They note that this implements the agreement on this promptly.
Zij constateren dat daarmee voortvarend uitvoering wordt gegeven aan de afspraak daarover
Asks why repeal precedes any evaluation of the act and why the repeal bill is not referendable, seeking better citizen involvement.
They ask the government to further justify why it wants to repeal the act now while no thorough evaluation has taken place.
Zij vragen de regering om nader te motiveren waarom de regering de wet nu al wil intrekken terwijl er nog geen grondige evaluatie heeft plaatsgevonden.
Questions the cabinet's evidence that citizens felt less influence and why it did not await the statutory evaluation or the second referendum.
Why was there no waiting for the second referendum, to be held on 21 March?
Waarom is niet gewacht tot het tweede referendum, dat op 21 maart wordt gehouden?
Regards the advisory referendum as a valuable complement to representative democracy and questions the repeal and the absence of an evaluation.
Unlike the government, these members consider the advisory referendum a meaningful complement to representative democracy.
In tegenstelling tot de regering achten deze leden het raadgevend referendum wel een zinvolle aanvulling op representatieve democratie.
Has always opposed the advisory referendum and supports the repeal, with no further questions.
The ChristenUnie faction has never been in favour of the advisory referendum.
De fractie van de ChristenUnie is nooit voorstander geweest van het raadgevend referendum
Opposes repeal and calls for a binding corrective referendum so that the outcome of consultations is respected.
The PvdD members believe that concrete steps must now be taken toward a proposal for a binding corrective referendum.
De leden van de PvdD-fractie zijn van mening dat juist daarom nu concrete stappen genomen moeten worden om te komen tot een voorstel voor een bindend correctief referendum.
Strongly favours referendums as a complement, questions the haste before evaluation and the Staatscommissie report, and criticises the non-referendable designation.
Does the minister agree with 50PLUS that abolishing the advisory referendum reduces trust in democracy?
Is de Minister het met de fractie van 50PLUS eens dat met het afschaffen van het raadgevend referendum het vertrouwen in de democratie afneemt?
Opposed the original act on constitutional grounds (free mandate of MPs) but questions whether repeal after a short period harms trust in representative democracy.
Furthermore, these members ask whether introducing and then abolishing such a law in a relatively short time does not harm trust in representative democracy.
Vervolgens vragen deze leden of het in betrekkelijk korte tijd invoeren en weer afschaffen van een dergelijke wet niet juist het vertrouwen in de representatieve democratie schaadt?
Questions the legality of declaring the repeal bill non-referendable without a statutory basis and whether the cabinet may evade a legal obligation.
Is it not unlawful to declare this bill non-referendable merely by referring to an advice of the Council of State rather than to a statute?
Is het niet onwettelijk om dit wetsvoorstel niet referendabel te verklaren door alleen te verwijzen naar een advies van de Raad van State en niet te verwijzen naar een wet?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the government further justify the proposed repeal of the Wet raadgevend referendum, particularly the role of the turnout threshold and the broader context of the coalition agreement, and revise the reasoning for excluding referendability of the repeal law. The government's reply accepted these points, removed the turnout-threshold passage from the explanatory memorandum, expanded the justification with the coalition agreement context, and added reasoning for excluding referendability.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the government to further justify the necessity of repealing the Wrr, including the role of the turnout threshold and the broader context of the coalition agreement and parliamentary system.
The Afdeling advised revising the explanatory memorandum's reasoning on the turnout threshold, which the government addressed by deleting the relevant sentence.

The Afdeling advised adjusting the reasoning for excluding referendability of the repeal law to align with the government's earlier position on repealing the Tijdelijke referendumwet, which the government addressed by adding argumentation.

34872.s: The bill caps the number of regional public media institutions at one per province, with two allowed in Zuid-Holland, by amending article 2.62 of the Mediawet 2008. It takes effect the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 16 December 2017, using the emergency exception of the Wet raadgevend referendum.
34872.j: The memorandum justifies bypassing the normal entry-into-force policy and retroactivity by the urgency of capping regional media institutions.
q: The urgency has led to choosing entry into force bypassing the policy on fixed moments of change, and invoking the exception provision of the Referendum Act.

De urgentie leidt ertoe dat is gekozen voor inwerkingtreding met voorbijgaan aan het beleid over de vaste verandermomenten, en dat een beroep wordt gedaan op de uitzonderingsbepaling van de Wet raadgevend referendum.
p: The bill sidesteps the regular consultation and fixed-moment policy for entry into force by invoking the referendum act's exception, and gives retroactive effect to 2017.

parties: Supports the aim of efficiency but asks whether media quality stays high without competitors and how the Commissariaat voor de Media would choose between candidates.
The members ask the government to elaborate on the situation in which more than one rpmi in a province meets the requirements for designation.
De leden vragen de regering nader in te gaan op de situatie waarin in een provincie meer dan één rmpi voldoet aan de eisen voor aanwijzing.
Asks for justification of the retroactive cap and for details of the Commissariaat's procedure and whether appeal or objection is possible against its decisions.
Is an appeal or objection possible against a decision of the Commissariaat voor de Media, the members ask.
Is tegen een besluit van het Commissariaat voor de Media beroep of bezwaar mogelijk, zo vragen de genoemde leden.
Accepts the bill but asks whether the Commissariaat is equipped for a transparent, non-discriminatory procedure and questions the five-year term and consequences for continuity.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill capping regional public media institutions at one per province, with retroactive effect to 16 December 2017, raising procedural concerns about selection among competing applicants and the justification for retroactivity. The minister's reply states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on the selection procedure and the retroactivity rationale, and removed a proposed interprovincial consultation provision after IPO feedback.
concerns: Retroactive effect to 16 December 2017 requires a clearer justification in the explanatory memorandum, which the government added.
The procedure the Commissariaat must follow when choosing between several eligible regional institutions was not described and needed to be explained, which the government did.

34935.s: The bill amends the Antarctic Protection Act to allow licensed non-scientific visits to historic sites and monuments inside designated specially protected Antarctic areas, to extend the licensing requirement to organisers with limited formal ties to the Netherlands, and to create a legal basis for designating Dutch international observers. It also clarifies that licensing obligations do not apply where another Protocol party authorises the activity.
34935.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the ministerial designation power as a transparency measure and as a controlled way to meet organisers' wishes, with designation conditional on area-specific considerations.
q: If an ASPA meets the conditions set out in this bill, these can be designated by ministerial regulation.
Indien een ASPA voldoet aan de voorwaarden die in dit wetsvoorstel zijn opgenomen, kunnen deze bij ministeriële regeling worden aangewezen.
d: designation of specially protected Antarctic areas open to non-scientific visits
appointment of Dutch nationals as international observers
p: Prohibitions on Antarctic activities no longer apply where another Protocol party licenses the activity and that licence covers the relevant act, reducing Dutch licensing control over such activities.
Licensing requirement does not apply to activities organised from another Protocol state that has given permission, extending reliance on foreign authorisation.
I.D (art. 9, first paragraph, under d, WbA)

Authorises ministers to permit non-scientific entry into designated specially protected areas through a licence, with designation limited to areas whose management plan explicitly allows such activities.</description_en>

parties: Asks how enforcement of the permit requirement will be practically organised given the remote location, and about its costs compared with other treaty states.
They have a single question about the documents on the agenda.]Asks how enforcement will be practically organised given the remote location and what it costs.]
Zij hebben over de geagendeerde stukken een enkele vraag.
Supports preventing activities outside international and national rules, but asks whether evasion of the permit requirement is known and how non-party states' activities will be addressed.
The CDA members agree that as far as possible activities, scientific and non-scientific, must be prevented from taking place outside international and national laws and regulations.

De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn het ermee eens dat zoveel mogelijk voorkomen moet worden dat wetenschappelijke en niet-wetenschappelijke activiteiten buiten internationale en nationale wet- en regelgeving kunnen plaatsvinden.
Asks for details on permit conditions, how often designations will be reviewed and by whom, and proposes periodic evaluation of environmental effects.

These members would like an explanation of how often an access designation for non-scientific purposes will be reviewed in light of renewed concrete circumstances and by which party those circumstances are determined.

Deze leden ontvangen graag een toelichting hoe vaak een toewijzing tot toegankelijkheid voor niet-wetenschappelijke doeleinden herzien zal worden aan de hand van de vernieuwde concrete omstandigheden en door welke partij deze concrete omstandigheden worden bepaald.
Argues nature protection must not be subordinated to tourism interests, asks how a return to the old permit regime would be possible and how monitoring will work, and requests annual interim reports.

These members ask what the possibilities are for returning to the old situation regarding the granting of permits, should it turn out that the current proposal has nonetheless led to more tourism, pollution or damage to nature.

Deze leden vragen wat de mogelijkheden zijn om terug te keren naar de oude situatie omtrent het verlenen van vergunningen, zodra zou blijken dat het huidige voorstel alsnog heeft geleid tot meer toerisme, vervuiling of aantasting van de natuur.

34950-V.s: The bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (budget chapter V) through a supplementary budget law (slotwet), setting out the adjusted expenditure and revenue figures by policy article. It also fixes that the budget figures are stated in thousands of euros and that the law takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2017
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2017

34971.s: The bill requires health insurers to give insured persons a permanent representative body with a consent right over an insurer's participation rules and an advisory right over the annual care purchasing policy, with the insurer obliged to give reasons for departing from advice. It assigns oversight of the insurers' procedural obligations to the courts rather than the NZa, while the NZa keeps oversight of the remaining duties.
34971.j: The memorandum justifies the new rules by the need to increase insured persons' influence over insurer policy, which earlier consultation found insufficient, and explains the choice to leave enforcement to civil courts and the insurer's supervisory board.
q: Supervision of non-compliance with the statutory obligations is assigned to the NZa, except insofar as the obligations concern the insurer's duties toward the representative body or the application of the participation scheme.

Het toezicht op het niet naleven van de wettelijke verplichtingen wordt, behalve voor zover het gaat om verplichtingen van de zorgverzekeraars jegens de vertegenwoordiging of het toepassen van de inspraakregeling, gelegd bij de NZa.
d: minimum guarantees for insured-person representation (set by insurer statutes)
insurer's written participation scheme for insured persons
composition and election rules of the representative body in statutes
p: Gives insured persons, through a representative body, a consent right over the participation scheme and an advisory right over care purchasing policy, while the insurer keeps final decision authority.
Artikel I, C (art. 115 Zvw) and Artikel II, A (art. 16 Wmg)
Leaves enforcement of the insurers' duties toward their representative body to the civil courts and removes NZa supervision of those duties, shifting enforcement away from the regulator.

parties: Asks how influence of insured persons relates to switching insurers and ensures that consultation cannot endanger insurers' solvency or DNB supervision requirements.
According to the VVD faction, consultation may never lead to the health insurer getting into financial difficulties or failing Solvency II requirements or DNB supervisory requirements.

Inspraak kan en mag volgens de leden van de VVD-fractie er nooit toe leiden dat de zorgverzekeraar in financiële problemen kan komen, dan wel niet meer kan voldoen aan de Solvency II-eisen en/of eisen vanuit De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) (als toezichthouder).

Asks how role confusion with other insurer bodies and the risk of the representative body being seen as co-policymaker under financial supervision law are prevented, and what the NZa's supervisory role is.

Following the Council of State's advice, the CDA faction asks how it is ensured that the room to give the representative body consultation on more matters cannot make it appear a co-policymaker under the Financial Supervision Act.
