Deze leden vragen, in navolging van het advies van de Raad van State, hoe geborgd wordt dat de ruimte die gelaten wordt om de vertegenwoordiging op meer onderdelen inspraak te geven er niet toe kan leiden dat de vertegenwoordiging gezien kan worden als (mede)beleidsbepalers in de zin van de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft).
Asks how representatives of insured persons will be equipped and trained, and how representativeness is secured.
The D66 faction reads that current representatives of insured persons feel generally insufficiently equipped to exercise their powers well.

De leden van de D66-fractie lezen dat huidige vertegenwoordigingen van verzekerden, zoals leden- en verzekerdenraden, zich in het algemeen onvoldoende geëquipeerd voelen om hun bevoegdheden goed te kunnen uitoefenen.

Wants insured persons' influence to go further, asks why consultation is limited to two policy areas and an advisory rather than consent right on procurement policy, and how less digitally literate insured persons are included.
They support the importance of a strengthened position for insured persons and would like to see their influence within health insurers extend even further.
Zij onderschrijven het belang van een versterkte positie van verzekerden en zouden graag zien dat hun invloed binnen zorgverzekeraars nog verder zou strekken.

Views insurers as too powerful and insufficiently controlled; argues the bill does too little for oversight and correction, lacks specified consequences for consultation outcomes, and that the government's limited consent and advisory rights and exclusion of board appointments are inadequate.
According to these members, this bill contributes insufficiently to better control and correction of health insurers.
Dit wetsvoorstel draagt volgens deze leden onvoldoende bij aan een betere controle op- en bijsturing van zorgverzekeraars.

Welcomes greater insured influence but asks how existing general member meetings' powers relate to new representative bodies, how transparency and deadlines work, and how disputes should be settled without going straight to court.
These members find it important that insured persons gain more influence over their own health insurer's policy and are pleased with the steps the government is now taking.
Genoemde leden vinden het belangrijk dat verzekerden meer invloed krijgen op het beleid van hun eigen zorgverzekeraar en zijn verheugd met de stappen die de regering nu zet.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill strengthening insured persons' influence over health insurers' policy, raising concerns about the balance between private and public law, the exclusion of civil-court remedies for disputes, and whether representatives could be deemed policymakers under the Wft. The minister's nader rapport accepts the civil-court route, clarifies the explanatory memorandum on policymaker status, and makes several textual changes, though it keeps the bill unchanged on policymaker status.
concerns: The NZa should not be tasked with adjudicating private disputes between insurers and the patient representation; these must go to the civil court, so the bill was amended with a new article 115 Zvw.
The explanatory memorandum should explain the balance between private functioning of insurers and the growing number of public-law requirements.

The scope of insured persons' influence must be clearly delimited so representatives are not treated as (co)policymakers subject to Wft suitability and integrity requirements; the government clarified the memorandum but did not change the bill.
The new public-law conditions on private insurers must be justified as necessary for the general interest under Solvency II art. 206; the memorandum was expanded to argue this.

34980.s: The bill amends the Primary Education BES Act to restructure funding for primary schools in Caribbean Netherlands, folding the special-needs and personnel budgets into general per-school and per-pupil amounts. It adds ministerial power to grant supplementary funding to specific schools and delegates the detailed funding rules and amounts to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
34980.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed because funding amounts change yearly and within a year, so a ministerial regulation is more practical than statute.
q: Given that the funding amounts change every year and can even change within a year, a ministerial regulation was chosen.
Gezien het feit dat de bekostigingsbedragen jaarlijks wisselen, en ook binnen een jaar nog kunnen veranderen, is gekozen voor een ministeriële regeling.
d: further rules for supplementary funding of special-needs schools
amounts of personnel funding per school and per pupil
cases and conditions for supplementary personnel funding
p: The Minister may grant supplementary funding to specific schools on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba with no statutory criteria beyond the island care plan reference.
Separate statutory grounds for personnel and labour-market budgets are repealed and folded into general funding, reducing the visibility of these amounts in the statute.

parties: Asks whether schools receive the same amount or a differentiated allocation, and whether amounts adjust when the number of disadvantaged pupils rises.
Do the schools hereby all receive the same amount, or is there a differentiated allocation?
Krijgen de scholen hierdoor allemaal hetzelfde bedrag of is er sprake van een gedifferentieerde verdeling?
Asks whether all schools face the same degree of educational disadvantage and whether the structural problems of Caribbean Netherlands call for intensified disadvantage policy.
The members therefore ask whether the specific, structural problems of Caribbean Netherlands do not call for an intensification of educational disadvantage policy on the BES islands.
De leden vragen daarom of de specifieke, structurele problemen van Caribisch Nederland niet vragen om een intensivering van het onderwijsachterstandenbeleid op de BES-eilanden.
Asks how the bill relates to the ongoing parliamentary preparatory group on alternatives to the lump sum, and requests a detailed overview of funding per school under each model.
The members are therefore curious how this bill amendment relates to this process.
De leden zijn dan ook benieuwd hoe deze wetswijziging zich verhoudt tot dit proces.

35088.s: The bill amends the Dutch Basisregistratie Ondergrond Act to shift the operational manager designation to ministerial regulation, make the Minister of BZK responsible for authentic model commissioning and quality control, and introduce annual self-checks by source holders. It also allows Ministers to set further rules by ministerial regulation on model creation, the source holder portal, and self-control reporting.
35088.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as providing flexibility so the government's information system can develop without frequent statutory amendments.
q: Some flexibility is desired to ensure that the government's information management can develop coherently and respond to changes, without frequent statutory amendments being necessary to follow that development.

Enige flexibiliteit is gewenst om ervoor te zorgen dat de informatiehuishouding van de overheid zich samenhangend kan ontwikkelen en kan inspelen op wijzigingen, zonder dat voor het volgen van die ontwikkeling met regelmaat wetswijzigingen noodzakelijk zijn.
d: designation of the operational manager of the basic registration
mandate of powers in articles 33, 34 and 35 to the manager
further rules on making and updating authentic models
designation of source holder portal manager and rules on delivery of source documents
elements and manner of annual self-control and reporting by source holders
p: The responsible Minister assigns model creation to a party of their choice and may set further rules by regulation, with the Minister of BZK retaining stewardship responsibility.
Source holders self-check annually and report results to the Minister, who publishes them, with details set by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks what tasks the manager designated by ministerial regulation will have and whether the role will sit inside or outside the ministry, which bears on accountability.
It is proposed that the management of the basic registration subsurface not be assigned in the law to a named manager, but that this manager be designated by ministerial regulation.
Voorgesteld wordt om het beheer van de basisregistratie ondergrond niet in de wet op te dragen aan een bij naam genoemde beheerder, maar die beheerder bij ministeriële regeling aan te wijzen.
Asks whether all soil contaminations will be included in the BRO, what additional administrative burdens arise, and what the relation to the Omgevingswet is.
The members of the CDA group are curious whether all soil contaminations will be included in the BRO.
De leden van de CDA fractie zijn benieuwd of bodemverontreinigingen allen in de BRO opgenomen worden.
Asks how data quality is assured, whether external control and reporting exists beyond annual self-checks, and questions the phasing and priority given to registering contaminated soil.
Can the government explain how the quality of information is safeguarded? Is there external control and reporting alongside the 'self-check'?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe de kwaliteit van informatie wordt geborgd? Is er sprake van externe controle en rapportage naast de «zelfcontrole»?

35196.s: The bill approves by statute a royal decree of 14 February 2019 that amends the Decree excluding deduction of turnover tax 1968, as required by Article 16 of the Turnover Tax Act 1968. It consists of a single article approving the decree and an order for its publication in the Staatsblad.
35196.j: The memorandum states the decree must be approved by law under Article 16 of the Turnover Tax Act, with the Council of State advising and no further justification given.
q: the royal decree of 14 February 2019 amending the Decree excluding deduction of turnover tax 1968 must be approved by law under Article 16 of the Turnover Tax Act 1968

het koninklijk besluit van 14 februari 2019 tot wijziging van het Besluit uitsluiting aftrek omzetbelasting 1968 ingevolge artikel 16 van de Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968 bij wet dient te worden goedgekeurd
d: amendment of turnover tax deduction exclusion decree via royal decree

35200-IX.s: This is a budget amendment bill (Slotwet) for 2018 that adjusts the departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA), setting realised figures against the budget. It also states that the adjustments are set in thousands of euros and enter into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2018 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd

35259.s: The bill amends the Wet internationale misdrijven to add three new war-crime categories (biological and chemical weapons, fragment weapons not detectable by X-ray, and blinding laser weapons) to the list of punishable acts, implementing a 2017 amendment to the Rome Statute. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Thus it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in joint consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill implementing the 2017 amendment to Article 8 of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court, raising no substantive remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) therefore required no changes, as no concerns were raised.

35268.s: The bill amends the Mediawet 2008 by adding a new section that automatically extends by one year the concession of the national public media service NPO and the recognitions and recognition periods that expire on 31 December 2020. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, and no explanatory memorandum is attached.
q: are, to the extent applicable and deviating from this act, extended by operation of law by one year.
worden, voor zover van toepassing in afwijking van deze wet, van rechtswege met een jaar verlengd.

parties: Asks only about the reference date for counting broadcaster membership and whether the government will accommodate the broadcasters' request to keep 31 December 2019.
Can the government give a final update on whether the request will be granted and when clarity will be provided, the members ask.
Kan de regering een laatste stand van zaken geven of aan het verzoek tegemoet wordt gekomen en wanneer hier duidelijkheid over komt, zo vragen de genoemde leden.

Understands the one-year extension but asks for an exhaustive list of measures, a timetable to be sent to the Chamber before plenary debate, and clarity on new membership-related criteria the government has not yet formulated.
Can the government send the Chamber, before the plenary debate on this amendment, a timetable for the proposed changes that must be in place for the new concession period, the members ask.

Kan de regering voor de plenaire behandeling van de onderhavige wetswijziging een tijdpad voor de voorgestelde wijzigingen, die voor de nieuwe concessieperiode doorgevoerd dienen te zijn, aan de Kamer doen toekomen, zo vragen de leden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft bill extending the current concession and recognitions of the national public media service by one year, and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister replies that the proposal gives no cause for substantive remarks and notes an added Kamerstuk reference in the explanatory memorandum.

35349.s: The bill strengthens victims' positions in criminal proceedings by extending their speaking rights to relatives and other persons, adding information rights on the execution of measures, and introducing a general obligation for suspects in serious cases to attend hearings in person, with judicial discretion to waive it. It also adds a victim's right to speak at TBS extension and PIJ hearings on protective conditions, and allows the court to order a suspect's appearance at judgment.
35349.j: The memorandum justifies the appearance obligation by reference to contradictory procedure, truth-finding, public accountability and victims' recognition, and adds a waiver to meet advisory criticism.
q: With this bill I express the desirability that in more serious cases mandatory presence should be the statutory starting point, without depending on such an order.

Met dit wetsvoorstel geef ik uitdrukking aan de wenselijkheid dat in de ernstigere zaken de verplichte aanwezigheid het wettelijk uitgangspunt moet zijn, zonder daarbij afhankelijk te zijn van een dergelijk bevel.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 51ca, achtste lid Sv)
support and translation of victim notifications on enforcement
p: Introduces a general duty for suspects in serious cases to attend the hearing in person, with the court able to waive it for weighty interests, shifting procedural autonomy of suspects toward the court rather than the executive.
Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 51ca, achtste lid Sv)
Gives victims a right to object before the investigating judge when the Minister for Legal Protection refuses a request on enforcement information.

parties: Supports strengthening victims' position but asks for strict application of the exception to the appearance duty and questions the tbs speaking right, which may raise unmet expectations.
If the victim does not wish the suspect to be present and this is not necessary for the proceedings, the members ask for strict oversight of the exception ground.
Indien het slachtoffer niet wenst dat de verdachte aanwezig is en dit ook niet noodzakelijk is voor het proces, vragen de aan het woord zijnde leden streng toe te zien op de uitzonderingsgrond.
Asks the government to justify the appearance duty against the presumption of innocence and the limited value of tbs speaking rights.

Understands the appearance duty for serious offences but warns of raised expectations, secondary victimisation, and questions whether a dedicated legal duty is urgently needed given existing judicial powers.
At the same time these members ask whether there is an urgent need for such an appearance duty; the criminal judge can already order the suspect's presence.
Tegelijkertijd vragen deze leden of er een dringende noodzaak voor een dergelijke verschijningsplicht bestaat; ook nu al kan de strafrechter de aanwezigheid van verdachte bevelen.
Questions the added value and practical burden of the appearance duty, the limitation to detained suspects, and whether victims' wishes not to face the suspect are protected.
Do the disadvantages of this proposal really outweigh the existing situation?
Wegen de nadelen van dit voorstel wel op tegenover de bestaande situatie?
Welcomes the broader circle of persons entitled to speak and asks how eligibility is tested and whether a decision not to speak can be challenged.
However these members ask how it is tested whether a person had a close personal relationship with the victim.
Wel vragen deze leden hoe er wordt getoetst of een persoon in nauwe persoonlijke betrekking heeft gestaan met het slachtoffer.
Welcomes the victim-wish exception and the room for tailored judicial decisions, but asks whether arbitrariness in exempting detained suspects with suspended custody can be avoided.
Does the government see no possibilities to nonetheless prevent this form of arbitrariness?
Ziet de regering geen mogelijkheden om deze vorm van willekeur toch te voorkomen?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on the Wet uitbreiding slachtofferrechten, raising objections to a mandatory appearance of detained suspects in serious sex or violent crimes (recommending a broader exception) and to a victim speaking right at tbs and PIJ extension hearings (recommending deletion). The government's reply accepted a broader exception and added clarifications, but kept the tbs/PIJ speaking right, justifying it with victim voice and information-provision arguments.
concerns: The Council argued the mandatory appearance may conflict with victims' wishes and recommended a broader exception ground, which the government adopted in part by adding a criterion allowing the judge to waive appearance.

The Council asked for clarification of the scope of serious sex and violence offences, the meaning of 'in verband met de zaak', exclusion of regie and pro forma hearings, and the relation between exception grounds, and the government revised the text accordingly.
The Council found the necessity of a victim speaking right at tbs and PIJ extension hearings not demonstrated and recommended deleting it; the government rejected this and kept the provision.

35350-III.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services (IIIC) in a second supplementary budget. It adjusts appropriations and receipts through reallocations and cuts, with no new delegated rule-making or power shifts.
q: The budget of the CTIVD has been adjusted by €273,000 through a reduction of €300,000 for facility arrangements and an increase of €27,000 through a transfer from another ministry.

Het budget van de CTIVD is bijgesteld met € 273.000 door een verlaging van het budget met € 300.000 in verband met facilitaire voorzieningen en een verhoging van het budget van € 27.000 door een overboeking van een ander ministerie.

35358.s: The bill implements the revised Posted Workers Directive (EU) 2018/957 in Dutch law, extending mandatory minimum working conditions to posted workers after 12 or 18 months, including pay and allowances, and redefining what counts as minimum wage. It also amends the Wet AVV, the Wml, the Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering and transport law, and sets transitional rules and a phased commencement, with some rules to be set by general administrative order (AMvB).
35358.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative order power as a way to keep the option open for later extension to non-generally-binding CAOs if circumstances require, while noting current administrative costs outweigh benefits.
q: Because it cannot be ruled out that circumstances will later warrant using this option, the possibility from the revised directive to extend to non-generally-binding CAOs is implemented in the seventh paragraph.

Omdat niet kan worden uitgesloten dat de omstandigheden op een later moment wel aanleiding geven van deze mogelijkheid gebruik te maken, is ervoor gekozen om deze mogelijkheid uit de herzieningsrichtlijn, van uitbreiding naar niet algemeen verbindend verklaarde cao's, wel te implementeren in het zevende lid.
d: Artikel II, onderdeel B (Wet arbeidsvoorwaarden gedetacheerde werknemers, art. 2a, zevende lid)
further rules on which non-generally-binding CAO terms apply to posted workers
Artikel IV, onderdeel B (Wet AVV, art. 2a, zevende lid)
conditions under which non-generally-binding terms apply to posted workers and employers
Artikel IV, onderdeel B (Wet AVV, art. 2a, eerste lid, onderdeel a)
additional conditions designated by general administrative order as guaranteed terms
p: Artikel II, onderdeel A (art. 2, lid 3) en Artikel VII
The employer may unilaterally extend the twelve-month period to eighteen months by notifying the Minister, with the Inspectorate able to challenge the claim afterwards.

parties: Asks for scope figures and detail on how the SVB notification duty and its online portal will work, and whether reports can be motivated or fed back to tackle violations.
They also ask to explain the relationship between the chosen instruments and to address specifically how the notification duty at the Social Insurance Bank (SVB) will take shape.
Zij vragen daarbij ook de relatie toe te lichten tussen de gekozen instrumenten en daarbij specifiek in te gaan op de wijze waarop de meldplicht bij de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) vorm krijgt.
Argues the directive extends EU control over national social policy and that the real fix is reinstating work permits; does not raise a check on the executive as such.
The only real solution is to reintroduce work permits.
De enige echte oplossing is het opnieuw invoeren van tewerkstellingsvergunningen.
Questions the Council of State's criticism of the unexamined motivated notification for extending the initial period and asks whether the extension is limited by criteria and review.
An extension of six months without criteria and review (only a notification duty) implies that an initial period of eighteen months could equally have been chosen.
Verlenging met zes maanden zonder criteria en toetsing (alleen een meldplicht) impliceert dat evengoed voor een initiële periode van achttien maanden had kunnen worden gekozen.
Strongly supports the aim but asks whether the reversed burden of proof on allowances and the scope of motivated extensions and the Court of Justice ruling are adequately limited.
They ask what room the directive offers to set further conditions on the initial twelve-month period and on the conditional extension to eighteen months.
Zij vragen welke ruimte de richtlijn biedt om nadere voorwaarden te stellen aan de initiële periode van twaalf maanden en aan de voorwaardelijke verlenging naar achttien maanden.

Expects the bill to leave wage competition largely in place, since it applies only to generally binding collective agreements and excludes pension premiums, and asks whether a broader interpretation is possible.
First, because the act applies only to generally binding collective agreements.
Ten eerste omdat de wet alleen van toepassing is op algemeen verbindend verklaarde cao's.
Argues the bill will not end abuses of posted and migrant labour and calls for a fundamental debate on labour migration, including the excluded transport sector.
More is needed to regulate labour migration and tackle abuses in housing and working conditions.
Er is meer nodig om arbeidsmigratie te reguleren en de misstanden in woon- en werkomstandigheden aan te pakken.
Asks why the bill bases equal treatment only on generally binding agreements and why it does not require motivation for prolonged postings or itemisation of allowances, to prevent abuse.
Does the government agree with the PvdA that a mandatory justification for continued posting could help prevent abuses?
Is de regering met de PvdA-fractie van mening dat een verplichte motivering van voortdurende detachering zou kunnen bijdragen aan de preventie van misstanden.
Worries that workers posted without generally binding agreements fall back to minimum rules, and that a notification-only extension and chained posting under changing employers may go unchecked.
How does the government intend to ensure that extension after twelve months and continuation after eighteen months are genuinely well justified and checked?
Hoe wil de regering ervoor zorgen dat verlenging na twaalf maanden en voortzetting na achttien maanden daadwerkelijk goed gemotiveerd en gecontroleerd wordt?
Asks why the notification procedure is so simple without a minimal form of motivation, which could help detect misuse, and how other member states design it.
Why does the government choose a very simple procedure and not require a minimal form of motivation with which risks of misuse could be better identified?
Waarom kiest de regering voor een erg simpele procedure en wordt niet een minimale vorm van motivering vereist waarmee risico’s van oneigenlijk gebruik beter kunnen worden onder kend?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Dutch implementation bill for the revised Posted Workers Directive, raising concerns about the procedure for extending the twelve-month hard-core period to eighteen months and about transitional rules for ongoing postings. The minister's reply accepted the need for clearer notification and motivation, redesigned the extension as a simple online procedure, and adopted a transitional regime for postings started before implementation, though the Raad's point on immediate applicability of the motivation requirement was only partly accommodated.
concerns: The Afdeling found unclear how the SVB would process the motivated notification of extension and what must be motivated, and the government clarified the procedure and built the motivation into the online notification form.

The Afdeling objected that the transitional rule delaying the motivation requirement for existing postings lacks basis in the directive, and the government retained a transitional regime justified by legal certainty while narrowing its scope.
The Afdeling's redactional remarks on the transposition table and cross-references were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

35367.s: The bill adds a new article 2:114b to the Dutch Civil Code allowing the board of a listed company to invoke a cooling-off period of up to 250 days, during which shareholders cannot appoint, suspend or dismiss directors or supervisory board members, subject to supervisory board approval and review by the Enterprise Chamber. It also codifies that the board determines company policy and strategy.
35367.j: The memorandum justifies the cooling-off period as necessary so the board can make a careful policy decision free from shareholder pressure, citing the proportionality and legitimate-interest analysis of the Council of State.
q: To guarantee that directors and supervisory board members base their strategy decisions on the company's interest rather than the risk of dismissal, invoking the cooling-off period suspends the general meeting's power to dismiss directors and supervisory board members.

Om te waarborgen dat bestuurders en commissarissen zich bij het bepalen van de strategie laten leiden door het belang van de vennootschap en de met haar verbonden onderneming en niet door de kans op ontslag, heeft het inroepen van de bedenktijd tot gevolg dat de bevoegdheid van de algemene vergadering tot ontslag van bestuurders en commissarissen is opgeschort.
p: The board may invoke a cooling-off period that suspends shareholders' power to appoint, suspend or dismiss directors and supervisory board members for up to 250 days, subject to supervisory board approval and Enterprise Chamber review.
The board is expressly charged with determining the company's policy and strategy, codifying existing case law on board authority over strategy.

parties: Asks how the Ondernemingskamer would test whether the grounds for invoking the reflection period are 'wezenlijk in strijd' with the company's interest, and what the court must weigh.
What elements must the judge weigh to review this when a request is made to end the reflection period?
Welke elementen moet de rechter meewegen om dit te toetsen bij een verzoek tot beëindiging van de bedenktijd?
Asks for clarity on the timing of invoking the reflection period and whether the Ondernemingskamer should handle its review with urgency or within set deadlines.
These members ask whether it would not be more logical for the review of the reflection period to be subject to clear deadlines, for example at least six weeks, so the hearing can be prepared calmly.

Voornoemde leden vragen of het niet logischer is dat de behandeling van de toets of de bedenktijd omkleed is met duidelijke termijnen, bijvoorbeeld minimaal zes weken zodat de zitting in rust kan worden voorbereid.
Argues that court access to request ending the reflection period should not be limited to shareholders with the statutory 3% threshold, since statutes may set lower thresholds for agenda rights.
Under this arrangement some shareholders could be denied access to the judge while that group can still put the reflection period on the agenda.
Door deze regeling kan een deel van de aandeelhouders de toegang tot de rechter worden ontzegd, terwijl die groep wel de bedenktijd kan agenderen.
Questions whether the bill upsets the checks and balances on shareholders and whether shareholders wrongly hindered by the reflection period need stronger legal protection.
Can the government indicate whether, and if so how, the bill should be accompanied by strengthening the legal position of shareholders unlawfully hindered by the proposed statutory reflection period?

Kan de regering aangeven of, en zo ja hoe, het wetsvoorstel geflankeerd moet worden met een versterking van de rechtspositie van aandeelhouders die onrechtmatig door het inroepen van de voorgestelde wettelijke bedenktermijn gehinderd worden?

Questions the scope of the trigger conditions and asks why works councils and employees have no role in invoking or ending the reflection period, and whether works councils get adequate time to advise on director appointments.
These members ask the government whether this is always complied with.
Voornoemde leden vragen de regering of hier wel altijd aan wordt voldaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill introducing a bedenktijd (cooling-off period of up to 250 days) for boards of listed companies, raising the relation to the responstijd in the Corporate Governance Code and the limited judicial review by the Ondernemingskamer, including proportionality of the period's duration. The government's nader rapport accepts the advice, adds a ground for the Ondernemingskamer to end the period, and clarifies the procedures in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The review of the Ondernemingskamer covered only whether conditions were met at invocation, not the duration of the bedenktijd; the government extended review to allow termination when the period is no longer reasonably needed.
The necessity and added value of the bedenktijd alongside the existing responstijd needed further motivation, which the government supplied in the explanatory memorandum.
The bedenktijd may restrict free movement of capital and establishment, requiring justification and strict necessity and proportionality, which the advice noted as background.
Clarification that the enquête procedure cannot review the bedenktijd during its term, with the explanatory memorandum adjusted accordingly.

35394.s: The bill amends the Participatiewet and related laws to make wage-cost subsidies (loonkostensubsidie) simpler and more effective for people with work limitations, including a new earnings disregard for subsidised work, a trial-placement option, and a one-year exception to the four-week job-search period for certain young people. It also amends the Ziektewet and Wet arbeid en zorg so that sickness and related benefits are multiplied by the established wage value of the worker.
35394.j: The memorandum justifies the broad delegation to lower regulation by the need for uniform wage-value assessment and harmonised personal support across municipalities, while noting that binding minimum requirements will be set.
q: Given the importance the government attaches to tailored personal support and harmonisation of personal support and other work facilities, it is further proposed to extend the existing delegation power to give further detail by general administrative order.

Gezien het belang dat de regering hecht aan persoonlijke ondersteuning op maat en harmonisering van persoonlijke ondersteuning en andere werkvoorzieningen wordt verder voorgesteld om de bestaande delegatiemogelijkheid om bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere uitwerking te geven
d: municipal ordinance on subsidy administration, trial placements, personal support and facilities
rules on target group, wage value, personal support, integral support and facilities
further rules on sickness benefit multiplied by wage value
further rules on benefit multiplied by wage value
further rules on benefit multiplied by wage value
p: Municipalities decide, after investigation, whether support is necessary and in what amount, with an appealable decision for the person concerned.
I.H (Art. 31, 2nd para, new items z and aa)
Municipal discretion, based on individual circumstances, to decide whether an earnings disregard continues beyond twelve months.
Subsidy decision is taken by the municipality within fixed time limits after determining wage value.

parties: Asks how the explicit wage-cost subsidy rules relate to municipal freedom to choose the best-fitting support and whether a refused support decision can be substantively reviewed.
However, these members ask how it will be made clear to people entitled to support what rights they have and how they can claim them.
Wel vragen deze leden op welke wijze duidelijk wordt gemaakt aan mensen met het recht op ondersteuning welk recht ze hebben en hoe ze daar aanspraak op kunnen maken.
Asks which delegation provisions the government will submit to a pre-consultation procedure so that parliament can express its views.
Can the government indicate for which delegation provisions it intends to give the House the opportunity to express wishes and reservations through a pre-consultation procedure?
Kan de regering aangeven bij welke delegatiebepalingen zij voornemens is de Kamer de mogelijkheid te geven om wensen en bedenkingen via een voorhangprocedure kenbaar te maken?
Asks for timelines and for the evaluation of the Participatiewet to be followed up, and asks how the Council of State advice is addressed.
Is the government willing to include this bill in an evaluation to keep following the effects of the intended policy?
Is de regering bereid om dit wetsvoorstel mee te nemen in een evaluatie om te blijven volgen wat de effecten zijn van het voorgenomen beleid?
Questions why the government sets aside the SCP evaluation's conclusions that obligations and sanctions do not activate people.
These members ask the government why it sets this conclusion aside?
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom zij deze conclusie naast zich neer legt?
Raises the Council of State's sharp criticism, asks whether a right to a job coach is enforceable against reluctant municipalities, and questions unpaid trial placements.
The SP members are concerned about the strong criticism from the Council of State and ask how it is being addressed.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben zorgen over de forse kritiek van de Raad van State en vragen hoe hiermee omgegaan wordt.
Argues the bill ignores the SCP's critical final evaluation and asks whether sanctions should be imposed only when they demonstrably aid reintegration.
Is the government willing to impose sanctions and obligations only when they demonstrably contribute to reintegration?
Is de regering bereid alleen sancties en verplichtingen op te leggen wanneer deze aantoonbaar bijdragen aan re-integratie?
Asks why the bill proceeds despite the evaluation and Council of State advice, and whether a fundamental reconsideration of the system is needed.
Can the government further justify why the bill is nevertheless being pursued, when a fundamental reconsideration of the system may be needed?
Kan de regering nader onderbouwen waarom het wetsvoorstel alsnog wordt doorgezet, terwijl er misschien wel een fundamentele bezinning op het stelsel nodig is?
Asks whether the bill respects the existing administrative relationship between central government and municipalities and whether the right to request support is too rigid.
On this part of the bill too, these members ask for justification of the extent to which the administrative relations between central government and municipalities are sufficiently respected.
Ook bij dit onderdeel van het wetsvoorstel vragen deze leden te onderbouwen in welke mate de bestuurlijke verhoudingen tussen rijksoverheid en gemeenten voldoende worden gerespecteerd.
Asks whether granting workers a right to request support risks juridification and whether such a right makes sense without a specific workplace.
These members further ask how the government assesses the risk of juridification.
Voorts vragen deze leden hoe de regering het risico op juridisering beoordeelt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against submitting the Breed Offensief bill on employment support for people with work disabilities (loonkostensubsidie, persoonlijke ondersteuning, verordeningsplicht) unless revised, citing the Participatiewet evaluation, municipal discretion and open delegation. The government's nader rapport defends the bill, explains the evaluation's relevance, narrows the delegation grounds and clarifies several provisions.
concerns: The open delegation for an algemene maatregel van bestuur was too broad; the government narrowed the delegation grounds to limited, named subjects.

The Afdeling questioned whether harmonisation of implementation is the most effective means, and asked for alternatives; the government defended necessity and pointed to other measures and an alternative financing model being explored.

Harmonisation and the verordeningsplicht were said to conflict with municipal discretion and individual maatwerk; the government argued a balance was struck and maatwerk remains, but clarified some provisions.

The Afdeling asked that the bill be reconsidered in light of the Participatiewet evaluation and that the consequences be developed in interbestuurlijk overleg with municipalities; the government added a reflection on the evaluation and points to ongoing consultation without a structural revision.
Concerns about the balance of powers between national government and municipalities in decentralised social domain policy were raised as background.

35439.s: The bill introduces more differentiated court filing fees (griffierechten) for civil claims and petitions up to €5,000 by splitting the existing tiers, and adds an indexation mechanism allowing the Minister for Legal Protection to adjust the amounts by regulation based on the consumer price index. The explanatory memorandum justifies the change by the burden high fees place on small businesses and on debtors who must reimburse them.
35439.j: The memorandum justifies the fee changes by the decline in lower-value cases and the hardship of fees for small businesses and debtors, and states that the fee system will be evaluated.
q: The court fee system requires ongoing attention and the effects of this bill will therefore be evaluated.
Het griffierechtenstelsel vergt voortdurende aandacht en de gevolgen van dit wetsvoorstel zullen dan ook worden geëvalueerd.
d: adjusting court fee amounts for consumer price index

parties: Worries that the number of court cases will increase and asks about expected caseload and out-of-court dispute resolution such as mediation.
These members are, however, concerned about the expected increase in the number of court cases.
Deze leden zijn wel bezorgd over de verwachte toename van het aantal rechtszaken.
Welcomes the bill as widening access to justice for smaller claims and has no further questions.
They are pleased to receive this bill so that access to justice for people with smaller money claims can be increased.
Zij zijn verheugd dit wetsvoorstel te ontvangen zodat de toegang tot het recht voor mensen, bij kleine(re) geldvorderingen vergroot kan worden.

Supports the bill as a first step but argues fees above EUR 5,000 may be disproportionate and asks why the court's advice to hold off on increases was not followed; asks for evaluation within two years.
These members believe access to the judge must actually be possible for everyone and consider the level of court fees at present to be too great a limitation.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat de toegang tot de rechter voor iedereen daadwerkelijk mogelijk moet zijn en menen dat de hoogte van de griffierechten op dit moment een te grote beperking is.
Regrets that legal persons gain most while natural persons see little benefit or higher fees, and argues for progressive fees so large companies contribute proportionally more.
Argues fees are too high across the board, asks for a judicial hardship clause for those unable to pay, and questions budget neutrality as the starting point.
The 'entry ticket to the courtroom' must not become too expensive; if the threshold is too high, people cannot obtain their right.
Het «toegangskaartje voor de rechtszaal» mag niet te duur worden, als de drempel te hoog wordt kunnen mensen hun recht niet halen.
Welcomes the bill as better balancing fees and claim size within the debt-relief approach, and asks whether the whole fee system should be reviewed.
These members believe the bill helps lower the threshold for citizens and small and medium enterprises to go to court for low money claims.

Voornoemde leden zijn van mening dat het wetsvoorstel bijdraagt aan het verlagen van de drempel voor burgers en midden- en kleinbedrijven (MKB) om de gang naar de rechter te maken bij lage geldvorderingen.
Asks whether a threshold amount plus percentage was considered to avoid sudden jumps in fees.
They have the impression that, even with the introduction of more categories, there is still a stepwise increase in court fees.
Zij hebben namelijk de indruk dat – ook bij de invoering van meer categorieën nog sprake is van schoksgewijze verhoging van de griffierechten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Wet griffierechten burgerlijke zaken to introduce multiple court fee categories for lower money claims. The Afdeling had no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer without changes, so no government reply was needed.

35457.s: The bill adopts temporary COVID-19 measures: it lets bailiffs treat personal service of writs as impossible while RIVM guidelines apply, allows Loodsenwet bodies to hold digital meetings, and lowers tax and collection interest rates to 0.01%. It also sets rates by general administrative order (AMvB) and lets the minister, via KB, set commencement and retroactive dates.
35457.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rate-setting by the need for flexibility to raise rates once the COVID-19 crisis no longer requires the reduction.
q: To retain some flexibility regarding the timing of raising the interest rates, it is proposed that from a moment set by royal decree the rates are set by general administrative order.

Om enige mate van flexibiliteit te bewaren ten aanzien van het moment waarop de rentepercentages worden verhoogd, wordt voorgesteld te bepalen dat de vaststelling van de rentepercentages vanaf een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen moment bij algemene maatregel van bestuur plaatsvindt.
d: Artikel 3 (Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen, art. 30hb, lid C)
collection interest rate percentages, retroactive to 1 June 2020
repeal of digital meeting provisions by royal decree
commencement, retroactive effect and expiry date of the act by royal decree
publication of regulations via NOTAM instead of Staatscourant
p: Tax interest rates for each tax may be set by general administrative order rather than fixed in the statute.
Collection interest rates are set by general administrative order and may be made retroactive to 1 June 2020.
Personal service of writs is deemed impossible while RIVM guidelines apply, retroactive to 16 March 2020, expiring 1 September 2020 unless extended.

parties: Supports resuming activities during the coronavirus crisis and wants the legislation to keep pace with current events, without raising checks.
These members consider it important that, in connection with the coronavirus crisis, as many activities as possible can resume that this legislation makes possible again.
Deze leden achten het van belang dat in verband met de coronacrisis zo veel mogelijk activiteiten weer hervat kunnen worden die door deze wetgeving weer mogelijk gemaakt worden.
Asks whether bailiffs must still first try personal service and questions the discretion given to bailiffs, and asks about the interest rate delegation and its reversal.
The CDA members ask the government to confirm that this does not mean the bailiff need not first try to serve the writ on the person in person.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering of bevestigd kan worden dat dit niet betekent dat de deurwaarder niet eerst moet trachten om het exploot aan de persoon uit te reiken.

Worries that the bill gives too much room to dispense with personal service, which weakens the goal of reaching the addressee, and asks what requirements apply to stating the reason for impossibility.
These members wonder whether this proposed statutory text does not give too much room to dispense entirely with service in person.
Deze leden vragen zich af of deze voorgestelde wetstekst niet te veel ruimte biedt om volledig af te zien van betekening in persoon.
Supports a practical approach to letterbox service but asks why the measure is not temporary and whether it should be limited to one year or evaluated.
These members do ask the government why this measure is not temporary in nature.
Deze leden vragen de regering wel waarom deze maatregel niet van tijdelijke aard is.
Questions whether bailiffs should be left to judge when in-person service is possible, asks for additional safeguards and verifiability, and raises risks for debtors in weaker neighbourhoods.
Is it correct that it is left to the bailiff to judge whether service in person is (still) possible?
Is het correct dat het wordt overgelaten aan de deurwaarder om in te schatten of (toch) in persoon kan worden betekend?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that a combined bill mixing amendments to the Rijksoctrooiwet with ordinary-law amendments be split, that non-temporary changes (interest rates, Luchtvaartwet BES) be time-limited, that a fixed expiry date replace a royal-decree expiry, and that retroactivity not be given to a delegation basis. The government reply accepted splitting off the patent provision, kept the permanent Luchtvaartwet BES change explaining it as a necessary omission, and adjusted the expiry and retroactivity provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling advised splitting the bill because a rijkswet should not combine with ordinary-law amendments; the government split off the Rijksoctrooiwet provision into a separate bill.

The Afdeling advised time-limiting non-temporary changes to interest rates and the Luchtvaartwet BES; the government kept the Luchtvaartwet change as deliberately permanent and only the rate-setting change is framed as limited in time.
The Afdeling advised a fixed expiry date instead of a royal-decree date; the government replaced it with a 1 September 2020 expiry with a limited extension mechanism.

The Afdeling advised against retroactive effect for the delegation basis of the invorderingsrente; the government removed the retroactivity from article 29 IW 1990 except for the rate-setting regulation itself.

35466.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by a third supplementary budget for the employment and economy emergency package and the SURE COVID-19 measure, adjusting obligations, expenditure and revenue across policy articles. It takes effect on 1 June 2020 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
35466.j: The memorandum justifies extending tax-collection suspensions and penalty reductions by the COVID-19 crisis measures already taken in the first supplementary budget.
q: The extension leads to a downward adjustment of fines and settlements, taking into account an update of the estimated revenue reduction resulting from the COVID-19 measures taken earlier.

De verlenging leidt tot een neerwaartse bijstelling van de boetes en schikkingen, waarbij rekening is gehouden met een actualisatie van de geraamde ontvangstenverlaging als gevolg van de eerder genomen COVID-19-maatregelen.

35470-X.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (slotwet) amending the Ministry of Defence's departmental budget statement and the agency budget statement for 2019, mainly to record technical, accounting and control-finding adjustments. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This bill contains technical implementation changes, accounting-related changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

35493.s: This is a supplementary budget bill amending the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, mainly to fund COVID-19 measures in the form of an incidental supplementary budget. The bill sets the budget in thousands of euros, takes effect on 15 June 2020 and sets out the budget tables by policy article.
35493.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by referring to COVID-19 measures and the minister's use of the emergency procurement exception 'dwingende spoed' to acquire goods and services directly from one market party.
q: VWS may, in tenders, invoke the exception ground of 'imperative urgency', so that goods and services may be acquired directly from a single market party.
Zo mag VWS bij aanbestedingen een beroep doen op de uitzonderingsgrond «»dwingende spoed», zodat goederen en diensten direct bij één marktpartij mogen worden verworven.

35529.s: The bill authorises the State to co-found Invest International B.V., a holding company for financing and development activities abroad that supports Dutch businesses and international projects. It sets out its tasks, financial management, competition and state-aid safeguards, oversight by the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development, and delegation of further tasks and rules by general administrative order.
35529.j: The memorandum justifies the holding structure and ministerial steering powers by the need for flexibility across differing tasks and the public interest in continuity of subsidy schemes.
q: Invest International is not an administrative body within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act and is not vested with public authority under any other law.
Invest International is geen bestuursorgaan in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht en is niet met openbaar gezag bekleed in de zin van enige andere wet
d: assigning further tasks to Invest International and cost compensation rules
further rules on Invest International's tasks
rules on market conduct, including banning or restricting certain activities
mandate and power of attorney from the minister to grant subsidies and transfers
p: The minister may consent to Invest International undertaking activities beyond its statutory tasks, attaching conditions, with approval given in line with cabinet opinion rather than parliament.
The minister may issue binding directions to stop market-distorting activity and may act at the company's cost if it fails to comply.
Invest International is not an administrative body under the General Administrative Law Act, so decisions on investments are channelled to civil courts rather than administrative courts.
Conservatory attachment against Invest International requires a hearing of the affected party except where it concerns only assets.

parties: Supports the bank's aims and asks about evaluation timing, the investment-capacity assessment framework, and coordination with EU funds.
The VVD members first want to note that they are strongly in favour of better facilitating and supporting Dutch companies with international ambitions
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen allereerst opgemerkt hebben dat zij een groot voorstander zijn van het beter faciliteren en ondersteunen van Nederlandse bedrijven met internationale ambities
Urges speed but asks for transparent reporting of applications and rejections, a clearer parliamentary role, and an Algemene Rekenkamer role in the first evaluation.
The CDA members ask the government to adopt the same arrangements for Invest International and to provide a role for the Algemene Rekenkamer in the first evaluation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om dezelfde afspraken over te nemen voor Invest International en daarbij een rol voor de Algemene Rekenkamer in te richten bij de eerste evaluatie.
Questions the use of ODA funds for Dutch economic benefit, the determination of the rate-of-return norm, and independent competition oversight.
The D66 members consider it important that thorough independent oversight takes place in the area of competition.
De leden van de D66-fractie achten het van belang dat er gedegen onafhankelijk toezicht plaatsvindt op het gebied van mededinging.
Worries that IMVO conditions sit only in a side agreement with unclear legal status, lack binding sanctions, and may not protect local populations and vulnerable groups.
They are concerned about the unclear legal status of this agreement and find the role of IMVO in establishing the investment fund too limited.
Zij maken zich zorgen om de onduidelijke juridische status van deze overeenkomst, en vinden de rol van IMVO in de oprichting van het investeringsfonds te summier.
Asks for guarantees against financing harmful sectors and IMVO violators, clear sanctions, and enforceable standards, noting OECD and UNGP guidelines are not enforceable in practice.
Practice, including at FMO and the Dutch export credit insurer, has shown that the UNGPs and OECD guidelines are ultimately not enforceable.
Ook heeft de praktijk, onder andere bij FMO en de Nederlandse exportkredietverzekeraar, geleerd dat de UNGPs en OESO-richtlijnen uiteindelijk niet afdwingbaar zijn.
Asks whether the side agreement on IMVO can be invoked, how the allocation process stays transparent, and how the Tweede Kamer can check the agreement.
How can the House of Representatives check the supplementary agreement on IMVO?
Hoe kan de Tweede Kamer de aanvullende overeenkomst over IMVO controleren?
Questions the state's role in facilitating internationalisation given serious reservations from advisory bodies, and notes not all advice was adopted.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Machtigingswet for Invest International, a joint venture of the State (51%) and FMO (49%), raising serious concerns about governance complexity, the vagueness of the purpose clause, and the undefined normrendement, and advised against submitting the bill unless revised. The minister's nader rapport defends the chosen structure, narrows the purpose clause and clarifies governance and the normrendement, but does not change the basic governance design.
concerns: The Afdeling found the governance and steering structure of Invest International, combining an investment task, a development task and a regulatory task across subsidiaries with FMO as co-shareholder, overly complex and unclear in its lines of accountability; the government kept the design but clarified responsibilities.

The Afdeling considered the statutory purpose clause too broad to be distinguishing and advised a narrower delimitation in the bill itself; the government narrowed the wording with respect to the Dutch economy and global challenges.

The Afdeling asked why a close cooperation with RVO or a cooperation protocol, as with Atradius DSB, could not achieve the goal instead of a new joint venture with FMO; the government rejected this alternative.

The Afdeling noted the normrendement for the capital injection was left undefined, which is essential for the additionality room and the classification as a financial transaction; the government explained the positive return requirement but deferred setting the norm.

35538.s: The bill adds a temporary article 6d to the Public Health Act allowing a COVID-19 exposure-notification app (CoronaMelder) to be used in support of GGD contact tracing, with a limited data list, deletion rules, a ban on compelling use, and a criminal offence for misuse. It also adds enforcement and investigation powers for designated officials and sets the provisions to lapse six months after entry into force, with the possibility of earlier or later lapse by royal decree.
35538.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need for a smart control strategy during the COVID-19 epidemic and by the statutory public-health tasks of the Minister and GGD, while stressing strict purpose limitation and a sunset.
q: Following the Council of State's advice, article 6d, first paragraph, specifies that CoronaMelder can give early insight into possible infection by recording which users were near each other and warning them.
Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Raad van State is in artikel 6d, eerste lid, gespecificeerd dat met CoronaMelder vroegtijdig zicht kan worden verkregen op een mogelijke infectie met het virus.
d: royal decree setting earlier or later lapse of provisions
ministerial designation of officials for supervision and investigation
designation of officials from other ministries (royal decree with voorhang)
p: Allows the Minister to deploy a contact-notification app and process health and location-related data for public health purposes, with the purpose and data categories limited in the text.
Designates the Minister as controller and the municipal health service as the body handling data-subject rights, with a one-month decision deadline.
Creates supervisory and investigative powers for designated officials and a criminal offence for breaching the anti-misuse ban, with no judicial review limitation stated.

parties: Insists app use must stay voluntary, with no direct or indirect coercion, and questions how data held by Apple and Google will be handled.
For these members, an important point is that use of the app is voluntary, also after installing the app.
Voor deze leden is een belangrijk gegeven dat het gebruik van de app vrijwillig is, ook na het installeren van de app.
Sceptical of how the app was introduced and asks whether the government will guarantee that voluntariness will never be turned into compulsion.
Can the government guarantee that at no point will the government propose turning the voluntary nature of the app into compulsion?
Kan de regering garanderen dat er op geen enkel moment vanuit de regering een voorstel komt om de vrijwilligheid van de app om te zetten in dwang?
Demands careful parliamentary treatment of intrusive technology and asks about measurement and evaluation of societal impact.
These members believe that, despite these exceptional times, the deployment of such intrusive technology requires careful parliamentary consideration.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat, ondanks deze uitzonderlijke tijden, de inzet van dergelijke ingrijpende technologie een zorgvuldige parlementaire behandeling vereist.
Questions whether the app is too heavy a privacy intrusion given its inaccuracy and the proportionality of its effectiveness.
But is this app perhaps too heavy a means given its inaccuracy and the risks of carelessness in the notification process around it?
Maar is deze app misschien niet een te zwaar middel gezien de onnauwkeurigheid ervan en gezien alle risico's op onzorgvuldigheden in het meldingsproces eromheen?
Asks the government to halt the nationwide rollout until the bill is passed and broader rights-balancing is done, citing the Minister's earlier commitment to parliament.
These members ask the government to halt the rollout of the app until the treatment of this bill has been completed.
Deze leden vragen de regering de uitrol van de app stop te zetten tot de behandeling van deze wet is afgerond.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Temporary COVID-19 notification app law, raising points on legal basis, purpose specification, further data-use limits, GGD controller roles, subdelegation, parliamentary involvement, interoperability and deactivation criteria. The government's reply largely accepted the advice, adding clarifications and amendments, though it declined to create an interoperability legal basis at this stage.
concerns: The Afdeling advised specifying the processing purpose more precisely; the government adopted the suggested wording in article 6d.1.
The Afdeling advised explicitly excluding further use of personal data beyond the stated purpose in the statute; the government added this in article 6d.3.
The Afdeling advised that retention periods and data-subject rights be regulated at AMvB level rather than left to subdelegation; the government instead placed these directly in the statute.
The Afdeling asked for parliamentary involvement (voorhang) before early repeal of provisions by royal decree; the government accepted this.
The Afdeling noted that a statutory basis is not strictly necessary given consent, but urged timely legislation; the government agreed consent suffices and offered to consult the House.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of controller responsibilities between the Minister and GGDs; the government explained the division and expanded the memorandum.
The Afdeling asked for an explicit legal basis for interoperability with other EU apps; the government declined for now, deferring it to a future bill.

35547.s: The bill reduces the number of regional disciplinary colleges for individual healthcare professionals from five to three (Amsterdam, 's-Hertogenbosch, Zwolle) and adjusts jurisdiction, membership, substitute rules and secretary positions accordingly. It also amends the Caribbean medical disciplinary act, removing the Minister's power to dismiss disciplinary judges and aligning appointment rules with the Netherlands, and makes several smaller changes to the BIG Act.
35547.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations on grounds of efficiency and the need for practical detail, such as a more specific pharmacist field of expertise and jurisdiction boundaries set by general administrative order.
q: It is proposed to bring disciplinary law in the Caribbean Netherlands in line with that of European Netherlands: as stated, dismissal for disciplinary reasons may only be imposed by the Supreme Court.

Voorgesteld wordt het tuchtrecht van Caribisch Nederland gelijk te trekken met het tuchtrecht van Europees Nederland: als gezegd kan ontslag om disciplinaire redenen enkel worden opgelegd door de Hoge Raad.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel B (artikel 23 Wet BIG)
activities within pharmacist's field of expertise
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel D (artikel 53, tweede lid Wet BIG)
division of Europe into regional disciplinary college jurisdictions
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel U (artikel 91 Wet BIG)
pre-publication (voorhang) period for AMvB under arts 8, 34, 40
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel V (artikel 92 Wet BIG)
treatment by foreign military health professionals in the Netherlands
transitional rules for pending regional college procedures
p: ARTIKEL II, onderdeel B (artikel 10 Wet medisch tuchtrecht BES)
Removes the Minister's power to dismiss disciplinary judges as a disciplinary measure, restoring independence of the tribunal, with dismissal for misconduct reserved to the Hoge Raad.
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel I (artikel 55ter Wet BIG)
Allows the chairs of the colleges jointly to set internal rules on panel composition, which is internal organisation rather than executive power.
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel H (artikel 55 lid 3 Wet BIG)
Excludes mandate for decisions on tribunal appointments, protecting the status of the disciplinary judiciary from delegation.

parties: Asks about other changes stemming from the second evaluation of the BIG Act and about the distance to disciplinary colleges given the mandatory appearance requirement.
How has it been examined that a (possibly) longer travel distance combined with the appearance requirement will create a barrier for patients and/or complainants to start a procedure?
Hoe is onderzocht dat een (mogelijk) langere reisafstand in combinatie met de verschijningsplicht een drempel gaat opleveren voor patiënten en/of klagers om een procedure te starten?
Questions the necessity of the reform, the costs of an unlimited number of members, and the reduced consultation with representative professional bodies before amending general administrative orders.

Is the government willing to include in the law that, prior to this internet consultation, timely consultation with the representative professional organisations of the profession concerned takes place?

Is de regering bereid om in de wet op te nemen dat voorafgaand aan deze internetconsultatie, tijdig overlegd wordt met de representatieve beroepsorganisaties van het beroep waarop de maatregel betrekking heeft?

Accepts the goal of better specialist expertise in complex complaints but wants concrete evidence of problems and objects to shortening the pre-publication period and dropping consultation with professional bodies.
Does the government not consider it reasonable to involve and timely consult the representative professional organisations concerned on each of these aspects?
Ligt het volgens de regering niet in de rede de representatieve beroepsorganisaties waarop de maatregel betrekking heeft bij elk van deze aspecten te betrekken en tijdig te consulteren?
Worries that fewer colleges and the appearance requirement will deter patients from complaining, and asks whether digital appearance should be allowed.
Could it be a solution to also allow appearance digitally?
Zou het een oplossing kunnen zijn om verschijning ook digitaal toe te staan?
Argues that access to justice must be available to everyone, opposes closing locations before the bill is passed, and asks who can decide relocation and what happens to staff.
The SP members are concerned about the proposal to establish fewer disciplinary colleges, because they believe the right must be accessible to everyone.
Genoemde leden zijn bezorgd over het voorstel om minder tuchtcolleges in te stellen, omdat zij vinden dat het recht voor iedereen toegankelijk moet zijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Wet BIG on regional disciplinary colleges has no substantive objections, only redactional remarks, and advised submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport reports that the redactional remarks were adopted, along with a supplement to the explanatory memorandum on 2019 complaint figures.
concerns: The Afdeling asked to explain Article I parts B and C in the explanatory memorandum, align the pre-consultation provision with the drafting guidelines, and avoid a legal fiction by reformulating Article I part C.

35556.s: The bill amends the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen so that the Arbeidsongeschiktheidsfonds premium is differentiated by employer size, with a lower rate for small employers capped at 2 percentage points below the high rate. It also lets employers who outsource their self-insured benefit payments calculate premiums on those benefits separately, and makes a conforming change to the Zorgverzekeringswet.
35556.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the percentages are set by ministerial regulation as currently done, and that the small-employer criteria can be filled in by general administrative order, for example in cases of takeover or new employers.
q: By general administrative order it is regulated which employers are regarded as small employers for the application of this article.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt geregeld welke werkgevers voor de toepassing van dit artikel worden aangemerkt als kleine werkgevers.
d: percentages of differentiated Aof premium for employers
which employers count as small employers and additional criteria

parties: Asks why the definition of a small employer is delegated to an AMvB rather than set in the statute itself.
Why was it chosen to include a delegation provision to define a small employer for this law, the VVD members ask.
Waarom is ervoor gekozen een delegatiebepaling op te nemen om de definitie van een kleine werkgever voor deze wet vast te leggen, zo vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Asks what additional criteria the AMvB will set for small employers and why, questioning the scope of the delegation.

By general administrative order (AMvB) it will be regulated which employers may be designated as small employers for the application of this article.](Wat zijn die aanvullende criteria, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.)
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) wordt geregeld welke werkgevers voor de toepassing van dit artikel kunnen worden aangemerkt als kleine werk gevers.
Questions the government's response to the Raad van State's comments on the 25-employee threshold, which they consider insufficiently justified.
These members are of the view that the government's response to the Raad van State's comments is not sufficiently substantiated.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat de reactie hierop vanuit de regering op de opmerkingen van de Raad van State niet voldoende worden onderbouwd.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised no substantive objections to the bill differentiating WFSV premiums for employers by size and adapting cumulative calculation, and only a drafting remark on the lack of alignment with the existing three-tier size classification. The minister's reply explains the choice for a two-category Aof premium as aimed at helping small employers, consistent with agreements with employers, and the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the government to explain why the differentiated Aof premium does not align with the existing three-tier employer size classification used for the Werkhervattingskas.

35574.s: The bill amends the Awir, Wet IB 2001, Wet kinderopvang and Wet op de zorgtoeslag to improve the workability of income-dependent benefits, notably by making the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen discretionally reduce recoveries, requiring it to offer a right to comment (zienswijze) before adverse decisions, and tightening partner rules. It also widens the agency's power to demand information from third parties, makes partner-status decisions appealable, and removes the bar on debt forgiveness so it is governed by ministerial regulation.
35574.j: The memorandum justifies the discretionary powers as enabling proportionate, tailored decisions and reducing objections and appeals, and the debt-forgiveness rules as a lex specialis needed for administrative feasibility.
q: To strengthen the human dimension and the practical legal protection of citizens, the cabinet proposes various measures.
Om de menselijke maat en de praktische rechtsbescherming van burgers te versterken stelt het kabinet diverse maatregelen voor.
d: rules on payment deferral and debt forgiveness for recoveries and fines
Artikel IV, onderdeel J (art. 38 lid 2 Awir)
which bodies must proactively supply data to the tax administration and the rules for doing so
Artikel IV, onderdeel C (art. 26 lid 3 Awir)
cases in which final recovery decisions are revised in the beneficiary's favour
Artikel IV, onderdeel A (art. 3 Awir, vijfde lid)
rules set for partner-status exception request conditions via ministerial regulation
p: Requires the tax administration to give beneficiaries a chance to comment before adverse decisions that may be disproportionate.
Artikel IV, onderdeel C (art. 26 lid 2 Awir)
Gives the tax administration discretion to recover less than the full amount where full recovery would be disproportionate.
Artikel IV, onderdeel F, G, H (art. 31, 31bis Awir)
Moves debt forgiveness from a blanket prohibition to rules set by ministerial regulation, with temporary exclusion of other forgiveness powers.
Expands the agency's power to compel information from third parties, including proactive duties, with a cost-reimbursement right.
Allows the agency to set benefit amounts ex officio when information is not supplied after a reminder.
Artikel I (art. 1.2 Wet IB 2001) and Artikel IV, onderdeel A
Makes decisions on partner-status exception requests appealable by objection and appeal.

parties: Asks how discretion to match recoveries in special circumstances will be defined and how belanghebbenden will be informed of the option.
Asks what safeguards prevent arbitrariness when recoveries are moderated and how capacity and fraud enforcement are maintained.
Can the government also indicate what safeguards exist to prevent arbitrariness arising from moderation of the recovery?
Kan de regering voorts aangeven welke waarborgen er zijn die voorkomen dat er willekeur ontstaat bij matiging van de terugvordering?
Questions the proposed third-party data obligations as unbounded and asks for the government to reconsider them, plus a four-week response period for information requests.
Asks how the government will communicate the bill's consequences in understandable language and how third-party information requests will be limited and verified.
Asks how it is ensured that the broader information basis serves to help citizens rather than to expand fraud control on them.
The GroenLinks members ask how it will be ensured that the broader legal basis for the Tax Administration's information requests serves only to help the citizen.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen hoe geborgd gaat worden dat de uitgebreidere grondslag voor informatieopvraging van de Belastingdienst enkel tot dienst heeft dat de burger geholpen wordt.

Calls the mandatory third-party data sharing disproportionate and in breach of human rights treaties, asks for it to be removed from the law, and questions the lack of a proper legal basis for confidentiality.
It continues on the path of exorbitant and disproportionate mandatory data sharing by childcare institutions with the Tax Administration/Benefits Service.
Het gaat door op de weg van exorbitante en disproportionele verplichte gegevensdeling door kinderopvanginstellingen met de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen.
Asks why codification of proportional recovery is needed, whether it changes existing case law, and whether it can apply to older cases and to healthcare and housing allowances.
The PvdA members ask why codification is necessary and what difference this codification makes compared with current case law.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom codificatie nodig is, en wat deze codificatie voor verschil betekent ten opzichte van de huidige jurisprudentie.
Argues the bill does not reduce the underlying complexity of the system and that the claimed simplification is merely symptom treatment with added controls.
The 50PLUS members are of the view that the present bill does not remove the complexity of the system at all.
De leden van de fractie van 50PLUS zijn van mening dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel de complexiteit van het stelsel helemaal niet wegneemt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the nota van wijziging on the childcare allowance work requirement exception for detention should be adjusted or explained, since its criterion differs from the existing housing allowance exception. The Staatssecretaris replied that the differences stem from the separate legal frameworks and the aim of preventing high reclaims, and added a clarifying passage to the explanatory notes.
concerns: The Afdeling asked to explain why the detention exception for the childcare allowance does not mirror the existing housing allowance exception, and the government explained this and added a clarifying passage without changing the nota van wijziging text.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wet verbetering uitvoerbaarheid toeslagen, raising concerns about the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen capacity to implement the practical measures, the matiging (reduction) of recovery under article 26 Awir, and the partner definition and income calculation under article 3 Awir. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, clarified the explanatory memorandum on recovery and partner rules, and made drafting corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts whether the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen has enough capacity to carry out the proposed measures without serious risks; the government accepts the risks as acceptable and adds explanatory text on implementation timing.

The Afdeling notes that the matiging power in article 26(2) Awir is not limited to exceptional cases in the statute and that a delegation basis would be needed to frame it in a ministerial regulation; the government clarifies the memorandum and drops the incorrect delegation reference.

The Afdeling finds the partner definition change breaks the link with the fiscal partner concept without adequate motivation; the government adds a reasoned weighing of pros and cons in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling observes that the change to the partner income calculation lacks adequate calculation rules in article 8 Awir and that the end of partnership is not addressed; the government clarifies the explanatory memorandum on income apportionment.
The Afdeling makes several drafting remarks on wording in article IV and article VI, which the government adopts.

35619.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Landerd and Uden and establishes a new municipality, Maashorst, covering their territory, with transitional designations for certain legal rules.
