It also amends several statutes (fertiliser law, housing market law, judicial districts, safety regions) to replace the old municipality names with Maashorst and sets entry into force by royal decree.
35619.j: The memorandum justifies the bill only by the municipalities' sound financial starting position, shown in a financial scan, and does not justify any delegation.
q: Both municipalities have a structural and real balance in their budgets.
Bij beide gemeenten is sprake van een structureel en reëel evenwicht in de begroting.
d: fixing the date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks about durability of the merger, lack of broad support, and whether splitting toward Oss or Meijerijstad was examined.
The VVD members ask to what extent this reorganization is durable.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen in hoeverre deze herindeling duurzaam is.
Questions why substantive objections in 60 submissions were set aside by reference to a prior council decision, and asks for the herindelingsadvies to be added as annexes.

Does the government share the CDA members' view that substantive arguments against a reorganization in the proposed form must be assessed on their merits, and that a reference to an earlier council decision is not sufficient?

Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de CDA-fractie, dat inhoudelijke argumenten tegen een herindeling in de voorgestelde vorm inhoudelijk beoordeeld moeten worden en dat een verwijzing naar een eerder genomen raadsbesluit niet volstaat?
Asks the government to respond in depth to objections from residents of Schaijk and Reek and to explain citizen involvement in the choices.
They therefore consider it important that the government responds extensively in its reaction to the objections raised by part of the residents.
Zij vinden het daarom van belang dat de regering in haar reactie uitgebreid ingaat op de bezwaren die door een deel van de bewoners zijn ingebracht.
Asks how resistance in Uden fits with the requirement that mergers come from below, what benefits residents gain, and why more bestuurskracht is needed and no referendum held in all municipalities.
The SP members read that there is resistance in Uden among others. How does this relate to the condition that reorganizations must come from below?
De leden van de SP-fractie lezen dat er weerstand is in onder andere Uden. Hoe verhoudt zich dit tot de voorwaarde dat herindelingen van onderaf moeten komen?
Asks whether the views of the individual kernen were polled and why Schaijk's group preferring Oss was not taken into account.
Does the government share the PvdA members' view that it is important to consider not only the wish of a majority of the Landerd council, but also the separate views of the kernen involved?

Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de PvdA-fractie dat het niet alleen van belang is om rekening te houden met de wens van een meerderheid van de gemeenteraad van Landerd, maar dat mede gezien de ogenschijnlijke verschillen van mening over dit onderwerp, ook de afzonderlijke meningen van de betrokken kernen van belang zijn om tot een weloverwogen besluitvorming te kunnen komen?
Supports the merger but asks what was done to broaden support in Schaijk and Reek, whether a local poll was held, and whether the government will endorse kernen- and dorpendemocratie.
These members ask whether this call will also come from the government.
Genoemde leden vragen of deze oproep ook vanuit de regering zal klinken.
Questions the necessity of Schaijk for bestuurskracht and the reasoning on the advisory process for the naming, and asks why stronger consequences were not attached to insufficient care.
These members ask why the government has not attached stronger consequences to the conclusion that the process was insufficiently careful on this point.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering geen sterkere consequenties heeft verbonden aan de conclusie dat het proces op dit punt onvoldoende zorgvuldig is verlopen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill merging Landerd and Uden into Maashorst needs a stronger justification of regional cohesion, especially why neighbouring Oss, Bernheze and Boekel were not included. The government replied that the municipalities made a sound assessment, relying on the merger advice and the province, and added clarifying text to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling requires a supporting justification that the merged municipality contributes to regional cohesion and that regional problems can be tackled better, including why neighbouring municipalities were excluded.

35628.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Civil Code to require listed large companies to balance gender representation on their boards and supervisory boards, through a binding ingroeiquotum for supervisory board and non-executive director appointments and a target-setting and reporting duty for companies that miss two of the thresholds. The law is to be evaluated after five years and lapses eight years after entry into force.
35628.j: The memorandum justifies the quota as correcting an unequal situation and notes that the Ondernemingskamer appoints supervisory directors in its own judgment in the company's interest, without any new executive discretion.
q: The bill is evaluated after five years and has a sunset provision: eight years after entry into force the growth quota and the target-figure scheme lapse.
Het wetsvoorstel wordt na vijf jaar geëvalueerd en kent een horizonbepaling: acht jaar na inwerkingtreding vervallen het ingroeiquotum en de streefcijferregeling.
d: timing of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks whether the quota conflicts with the equality principle and what legal framework defines exceptional cases allowing non-compliant appointments for two years.

After all, an appointment of a person who does not contribute to a more balanced ratio between men and women on the supervisory board is contrary to the law and therefore void, these members point out.

Immers, een benoeming van een persoon die niet bijdraagt aan een evenwichtiger verhouding tussen mannen en vrouwen in de raad van commissarissen in strijd, is met de wet en daarmee nietig, zo informeren deze leden.
Asks about the development of the monitoring infrastructure and the precise statutory role of the SER, which only has a reporting duty in the bill.
Furthermore, these members ask what exactly the statutory task of the SER is in this context, since the bill only lays down reporting to the SER.
Voorts vragen deze leden wat precies de wettelijke taak van de SER in dit verband is, nu in het wetsvoorstel alleen het rapporteren aan de SER is vastgelegd.
Supports a balanced gender distribution and asks about extending the quota to management boards, foundations and the public sector, and about the evaluation design.
They endorse the importance of a more balanced representation of men and women, not only at the top but at all levels of business, government and science.
Zij onderschrijven het belang van een meer evenwichtige vertegenwoordiging van mannen en vrouwen, niet alleen in de top, maar in alle lagen van het bedrijfsleven, de overheid en de wetenschap.
Finds the quota not ambitious enough compared with Norway and asks about monitoring, sanctions and inclusive workplace measures, with concern that no supervisory body will monitor compliance.
They read that the expectation is that the scheme will be sufficiently complied with. These members have concerns about this.
Zij lezen dat de verwachting is dat de regeling voldoende zal worden nageleefd. Deze leden hebben daar zorgen over.

Notes the Council of State and the Human Rights Institute doubt compatibility with CJEU case law and asks how the government will handle a case reaching the Court, and what sanctions and enforcement are envisaged.
These members find that the questions posed by the Council of State on this subject have not been sufficiently answered.
Deze leden vinden dat de vragen opgesteld door de Raad van State over dit onderwerp onvoldoende zijn beantwoord.
Supports binding quotas but asks how circumvention through selection in the procedure will be prevented and proposes requiring disclosure of selection procedures to shareholders.

These members would therefore like to see that, for a proposal to shareholders to appoint a commissioner who does not contribute to a more balanced m/f ratio, the board is obliged to give insight into the procedure used.

Voornoemde leden zouden daarom graag zien dat bij een voorstel aan de aandeelhouders tot benoeming van een commissaris die niet bijdraagt aan het evenwichtiger maken van de m/v-balans in de raad het bestuur, verplicht wordt om inzage te geven in de gehanteerde procedure.

Argues a statutory quota is a serious intrusion on private-law freedoms, that the government wrongly equates equality of outcome with equal treatment, that the empirical basis is weak, and questions the proportionality and the government's override of CJEU case law.

These members find that a statutorily enforced quota based on sex or any other ground for the board and supervisory board of commercial legal persons constitutes a serious infringement on private-law freedoms.

Deze leden vinden dat een wettelijk afgedwongen quotum op grond van geslacht of welke grond dan ook voor het bestuur en de raad van commissarissen van commerciële rechtspersonen een ernstige inbreuk maakt op de privaatrechtelijke vrijheden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending Book 2 of the Civil Code to require gender-balanced boards and supervisory boards of large companies, with a one-third absolute quota that it judged in tension with EU equal-treatment case law and raised concerns on sanctions and monitoring by the SER. The government's reply defends the absolute quota under the UN Women's Convention and the SER advice, clarifies nullity consequences, adds explanation on the SER's supporting role, and amends the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The absolute quota is in tension with CJEU case law on positive action and the Afdeling advised consulting the Commission; the government declined consultation but amended the memorandum to clarify the relationship.

The Afdeling asked how nullity of an appointment coexists with validity of decisions taken with a nullly appointed member, and what legal consequences follow; the government explained the rationale and amended the memorandum.

The Afdeling suggested considering additional sanctions such as withholding fees or a public register; the government pointed to the existing limitation regime and deferred the question to evaluation.
The Afdeling asked for clarity on the SER's role, responsibilities, powers and monitoring/enforcement mechanism; the government clarified the SER's facilitating role and amended the memorandum.

35646.s: The bill requires associations and foundations to disclose, on request, the origin, purpose and size of donations from outside the EU/EEA, and lets the mayor, the public prosecutor and listed agencies request donor information (including personal data of substantial donors), with a court-ordered management ban as sanction. It also obliges foundations to deposit a balance sheet and statement of income and expenditure with the trade register, accessible to listed oversight bodies.
35646.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the risk of undue foreign influence and financial misuse, and by existing public order and supervisory tasks, while narrowing the original scope after criticism from the Council of State.
q: To this end, the mayor, the public prosecution service and other specifically designated government bodies are given the power to make targeted inquiries at a civil society organisation about foreign donations and, if these prove substantial, further inquiries into the identity of the donor.

Daartoe krijgen de burgemeester, het openbaar ministerie (hierna ook: OM) en andere specifiek aangewezen overheidsinstanties de bevoegdheid om bij een maatschappelijke organisatie gericht navraag te kunnen doen naar buitenlandse giften en, als deze substantieel blijken, verdere navraag te doen naar de persoon van de donateur.
d: rules on form of information and anonymous donations
p: Mayors gain discretionary power to demand donation information and personal data from associations for public order purposes, with a court-ordered management ban as sanction for serious non-cooperation.
The public prosecutor gains a general power to request donation data from all associations, not only foundations, when there is serious doubt about compliance with law or statutes.
Listed agencies such as the AIVD, MIVD, tax authority and police gain access to foundations' deposited financial statements, a limited expansion of their inspection powers.

parties: Welcomes the bill as a first step but asks what the 'horizontal and intrinsically coherent' regime means and whether prohibition powers should follow transparency; also asks whether information obtained by the prosecutor could be used against the organisation (self-incrimination).
They see this as an important first step, because besides exposing financing flows, the ability to impose sanctions is also necessary to dry up flows linked to undue influence.

Zij zien dit als een belangrijke eerste stap omdat naast het blootleggen ook het kunnen nemen van sancties noodzakelijk is om financieringsstromen die gepaard gaan met ongewenste beïnvloeding droog te leggen.

Asks how donation data will reveal donor intent, whether the regime can be circumvented via intermediaries, and whether cumulative transparency demands could unduly restrict freedom of association and the legal-person regime.

There is a risk that all instruments introduced to combat these three problems are individually useful but together result in a far-reaching restriction of freedom of organisation or of the law on legal persons.

Het risico bestaat dat alle instrumenten die geïntroduceerd worden om bovengenoemde drie uitwassen te bestrijden afzonderlijk van nut zijn, maar tezamen een vergaande inperking van vrijheid van organisatie of het rechtspersonenrecht tot gevolg hebben.

Broadly positive after the Council of State advice, but questions proportionality given few problematic religious institutions versus roughly 357,000 organisations, the basis for the EUR 4,500 threshold, and whether a risk assessment was done.
The said members question the scope taken in drafting the measures.
Voornoemde leden zetten vraagtekens bij de ruimte die is genomen bij het opstellen van de maatregelen.
Asks how enforcement will respect the Constitution and European law, whether a balance-sheet statement really shows origin of funds, and what remedies organisations have against information demands.
What legal remedies are open to civil-society organisations to oppose such a demand?
Welke rechtsmiddelen staan voor maatschappelijke organisaties open om zich tegen een dergelijke vordering te verzetten?
Asks why large donations from EU member states need not be disclosed and how payment constructions routing money via EU states are prevented from evading the rule.

These members also ask the government to address the Council of State's question of how it is prevented that payment constructions are used so the payment cannot be traced to a country outside the EU.

Daarnaast vragen deze leden de regering nader in te gaan op de vraag van de Afdeling die naar de mening van voornoemde leden de terechte vraag opwerpt hoe wordt voorkomen dat gebruik wordt gemaakt van betaalconstructies.

Supports dropping the general transparency duty but asks what signals of problematic behaviour justify mayoral powers, how this is proven, and for a clear statement of the bill's purpose and effectiveness monitoring.
They ask the government to explain which signals of problematic behaviour it has in mind and how mayors can demonstrate them.
Zij vragen de regering aan te geven nader in te gaan op welke signalen van problematisch gedrag de regering voor ogen heeft en de vraag hoe burgemeesters dit kunnen aantonen.

Supports the aim but warns that 'problematic behaviour' and 'undesirable behaviour' lack a legal definition, risking arbitrary action by mayors, and asks which body controls the process and whether the bill respects the internal organisation of church communities.
No conclusive legal definition can be given of 'undesirable behaviour'. Can the government indicate whether this does not carry the risk of arbitrariness by mayors?
Van «onwenselijk gedrag» is geen sluitende juridische definitie te geven. Kan de regering aangeven of dit niet het risico van willekeur door burgemeesters met zich meebrengt?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a nota van wijziging to the Wet transparantie maatschappelijke organisaties, which would allow the state to seize (vervallenverklaring) goods of civil society organisations undermining the democratic rule of law, with serious objections on property rights, proportionality, legal certainty and free movement of capital. The government reply accepts the objections, drops the vervallenverklaring and terugstorting, replaces them with a court order to cease activities plus supplementary measures, adds a statutory test framework and a two-year time limit, and largely follows the advice.
concerns: The forfeiture measure is a very far-reaching interference with property rights, requiring strong justification and raising doubts about proportionality and foreseeability; the government replaced it with a less intrusive cease-activities order.
Less intrusive alternatives such as a temporary freezing measure could achieve similar effects, and the government adopted a less far-reaching instrument.

The open norm of undermining the democratic rule of law and the notion of clear and imminent threat are vague; the government defends them with reference to article 2:20 BW while clarifying the explanatory memorandum.
The provisional measures lack a statutory test framework for granting, amending or lifting them, which the Afdeling advised to add.
Doubts about the necessity of the terugstorting obligation given its effect, which the government dropped as a provisional measure.

The measures restrict free movement of capital under article 63 TFEU and must be justified; the government argues justification via overriding public interest and proportionality, and adds explanation.
Relation to criminal law safeguards such as the presumption of innocence needed clarification, which the government addressed in the explanatory memorandum.
Redactional comments on wording, the consultation period and the addressee of conservatoir beslag were incorporated.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises against proceeding with the Wtmo transparency bill in its current form, citing disproportionate scope, weak effectiveness, fundamental rights concerns, free capital movement problems, and privacy issues, and recommends first conducting a thorough analysis of existing powers. The government's reply (nader rapport) is included but the portion available is cut off before the full response to each point.
concerns: The scope of the transparency obligation covering around 357,000 organisations is considered far too broad and not justified by an actual, serious threat.
Donation rules can easily be circumvented via intermediaries, so their effectiveness is doubtful.
Restrictions on freedom of association, freedom of education and property rights under the ECHR are insufficiently justified.
The measures restrict free movement of capital under Article 63 TFEU and the reciprocity principle is not a recognised justification.
Broad powers for the mayor and other authorities to process special personal data lack adequate necessity and proportionality justification under the GDPR and EU Charter.
Existing powers and information-sharing arrangements have not been analysed, so the added value of the new measures is unproven.

35650-X.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (second supplementary budget), adjusting expenditure, commitments and revenue across the policy and non-policy articles. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively from 1 December 2020.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2020
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2020

35664.s: This omnibus bill amends several transport, environment and planning statutes, mainly with technical changes: maximum appointment terms for board members of public-law bodies (zbo's) are shortened to four years, rail safety and accreditation rules are updated, and some fee and oversight grounds are added. The memorandum describes the changes as largely technical with little regulatory burden on citizens and businesses.
35664.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical alignment with EU rules and practical needs, noting that the amendments have little burden for citizens and businesses.
q: This concerns only the public-law zbo's.
Het gaat hierbij enkel om de publiekrechtelijke zbo's.
d: designating national accreditation body for rail assessment bodies
security requirements for trains through Channel Tunnel and reporting method
VIII, onderdeel D (artikel 8a.1 lid 5 Wet luchtvaart)
fee amounts for exemption applications at airports
rules on ministerial oversight of ACNL
municipal council rules on permit quality and enforcement
designation of EU Ecolabel body and attached conditions
designation of bodies performing conformity assessment
fees charged by the inspectorate in Caribbean Netherlands
p: Allows the minister to request additional verifications of subsystems with an EC verification declaration where non-compliance is found.
Allows the minister to suspend or withdraw an airspace certificate under the EU basic regulation.
I, onderdeel A (artikel 4.4 lid 3 Aanvullingswet grondeigendom)
Keeps old law applicable for expropriation under the Waterwet for activities already implemented, which can limit the use of newer rules against affected owners.

parties: No further questions or remarks on the bill.
These members have no further questions or comments on this.
Deze leden hebben hierover geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen.
Asks why the government departs from the Kaderwet zbo on appointment terms, and asks about the possibility of a third term for zbo board members.
These members ask the government why it deviates from the Kaderwet zbo for the Ministry of IenW, which precisely leaves room to set zbo appointment terms freely.](#)

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering waarom zij voor het Ministerie van IenW afwijkt van de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen (zbo), die juist de ruimte geeft om de benoemingstermijnen van zbo’s vrij te laten.
Asks for an overview showing how current rules are converted into the new law on a policy-neutral basis, especially for the Omgevingswet.
These members ask the government whether an overview can be made clearly showing how current rules are converted into the new law(s) on a policy-neutral basis.
Deze leden vragen de regering wel of er een overzicht gemaakt kan worden waarin duidelijk wordt weergegeven hoe de huidige regels beleidsneutraal worden omgezet naar de nieuwe wet(ten).
Finds the government's justification for harmonising zbo board terms insufficient, questions why it is not applied government-wide, and asks about Brexit effects on rail border security.
As far as the ChristenUnie members are concerned, this is insufficient justification to restrict the currently possible tailored appointment terms for zbo board members.
Wat de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie betreft is dit onvoldoende onderbouwing om het nu mogelijke maatwerk voor benoemingsduren voor bestuurders van zbo's te beperken.
Asks whether the bill can allow farm vehicles to be registered in the name of a maatschap (partnership).
These members would like to know whether the government is willing, through this bill, to make it possible for farm vehicles to also be registered in the name of a maatschap.
Deze leden horen graag of de regering bereid is via het voorliggende wetsvoorstel mogelijk te maken dat landbouwvoertuigen ook op naam van een maatschap geregistreerd kunnen worden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Verzamelwet IenW 2020, raising concerns about harmonising board-term limits for zbo's under the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management without addressing the Kaderwet zbo's, and about the lack of justification for a ministerial regulation, information statute and reporting duty for ACNL. The government's reply accepts the need for more justification, explains the harmonisation goal and states the ministerial regulation will not be used to assign new supervisory powers, while dropping the separate information statute and reporting requirement.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should explain the relationship between the harmonised board-term limits and the Kaderwet zbo's, which left term limits open.
The explanatory memorandum should address whether differences in board-term arrangements are justified for individual zbo's and respond to their objections.
The necessity of a separate information statute and periodic reporting duty for ACNL, given existing powers under article 20 of the Kaderwet zbo's, must be justified or the provision dropped.
Supervisory tasks and powers should not be regulated by ministerial regulation; the purpose of the regulation must be clarified.

35673.s: The bill requires employers, intermediaries and temporary-work agencies to adopt a documented recruitment and selection procedure aimed at preventing labour-market discrimination, with a duty to verify that outsourced parties and automated systems do the same. It gives the Inspectorate SZW enforcement and fining powers and provides for public disclosure of fines for non-compliance.
35673.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to adapt the recruitment standard as scientific insight and professional practice develop, and says the Inspectorate will use a phased approach to avoid mere box-ticking.
q: The cabinet considers it very important to regulate this supervisory power by law.
Het kabinet vindt het wettelijk regelen van deze toezichthoudende bevoegdheid van groot belang.
d: further rules on recruitment procedure documentation
designating other organisations for data exchange
rules on content, timing and manner of publishing fines
further rules on intermediary recruitment procedure
further rules on intermediary verification duties
further rules on temporary-work agency procedure
further rules on temporary-work agency verification
designating other organisations for data exchange and tasks
rules on content, timing and manner of publishing fines
p: Inspectorate may publicly name employers fined for discrimination-prevention breaches, subject to a ten-working-day wait, suspension pending interim relief, and an exception where disclosure would harm supervision.
Inspectorate officials may impose binding compliance requirements on intermediaries and temporary-work agencies with a deadline.

parties: Asks whether placing the duty in the Arbowet rather than equal-treatment law weakens the CRM role and how the inspectorate will define the norm.
Does the government see a possibility of creating an enforcement power for the Inspectie SZW within equal-treatment legislation?
Ziet de regering een mogelijkheid om een handhavingsbevoegdheid voor de Inspectie SZW te creëren binnen de gelijkebehandelingswetgeving
Asks whether employers should get a warning before a fine and public naming, given disproportionate reputational harm.
These members ask the government to respond to criticism from employer and employee organisations that publicising fines could cause disproportionate harm to businesses.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering nader in te gaan op de kritiek van werkgevers- en werknemersorganisaties, dat de voorgestelde openbaar making van opgelegde boetes disproportioneel veel schade kan toebrengen aan bedrijven.
Welcomes a stronger inspectorate role and asks why the equal-treatment framework with a CRM role was not chosen in addition.
These members are pleased that this bill enables supervision of equal opportunities in recruitment and selection, giving the Inspectie SZW a stronger role.
Deze leden zijn verheugd dat met dit wetsvoorstel het toezicht op gelijke kansen bij werving en selectie mogelijk wordt en daarmee de Inspectie SZW een stevigere rol krijgt
Welcomes inspectorate powers but doubts effectiveness since only paper procedures, not practice, can be checked.
Paper is often patient: employers, including temp agencies, can have their recruitment process well arranged on paper yet still discriminate in practice.
papier vaak geduldig is. Werkgevers, waaronder uitzendbureaus, kunnen op papier hun werving- en selectieproces goed geregeld hebben, maar in de praktijk toch discrimineren.
Supports the inspectorate's added powers but criticises supervision limited to paper procedures and asks why individual cases are excluded; also asks about works council monitoring.
These members regret that the proposed law enforces only the paper reality of equal-opportunity supervision in recruitment and selection.
Deze leden betreuren dat in de voorgestelde wet toezicht gelijke kansen bij werving en selectie alleen wordt gehandhaafd op de papieren werkelijkheid.
Fears a tick-box culture and that the Inspectie SZW both sets and enforces the norm, creating excessive authority.
They fear the bill will mainly lead to a tick-box culture, with formalisation and juridification overriding the intended cultural change.
Wel vrezen zij dat het huidige wetsvoorstel vooral gaat leiden tot een «afvinkcultuur» en dat formalisering en juridisering de overhand krijgen
Supports a firm approach but asks for clear, knowable norms for legal certainty and clarification of enforcement and sanctions.
Argues the bill adds burdens and symbolic politics without proven effect, treats employers with distrust, and objects to public naming of fined individuals.
Does the government agree that it has not been proven that these measures actually reduce discrimination in the labour market and that they are therefore a form of symbolic politics?

Is de regering het met de stelling eens dat niet is bewezen dat deze maatregelen ook daadwerkelijk leiden tot vermindering van discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt en daarmee een vorm van symboolpolitiek is?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against the Inspectie SZW enforcing a duty for employers to adopt a non-discrimination recruitment procedure, since the norm is still undeveloped; it recommended placing the rules in the Algemene Wet Gelijke Behandeling instead and to exempt small employers. The government's reply largely rejects moving the rules to equal-treatment law, but accepts clarifying the enforcement sequence, moving core norms into the statute, and raising the small-employer exemption threshold to 25 employees, while deferring the freelancer provision.
concerns: The Afdeling argues that enforcement by the Inspectie requires a concrete, tested norm, which does not yet exist; the government accepts that core elements should be set out in the statute but keeps enforcement with the Inspectie.

The Afdeling doubts that inspectorate enforcement will achieve awareness-raising and risks a box-ticking approach; the government argues enforcement with sanctions is needed for a firm approach that equal-treatment law does not provide.

The Afdeling advises placing the duty in the Algemene Wet Gelijke Behandeling rather than the Arbowet because there is no substantive link to psychosocial workload; the government disagrees and keeps it in the Arbowet.

The Afdeling warns the Inspectie should not both set and enforce the standard; the government confirms the core norms will be set in the law itself, with the Basis Inspectie Module only guiding inspections.
The Afdeling asks that employers with fewer than 50 employees be excluded given administrative burden; the government raises the written-procedure exemption to 25 employees instead of 50.
The Afdeling finds the possibility to extend the duty to freelancers via amvb insufficiently developed; the government drops the delegation basis for now and defers it to the evaluation.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to clarify the relationship with civil-law equal-treatment procedures and CRM complaints; the government adds a clarification.
The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum clarify that an eis tot naleving must precede any sanction; the government confirms and clarifies this.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a nota van wijziging to the Wet toezicht gelijke kansen bij werving en selectie, which adds a duty for intermediaries to report discriminatory requests from clients to the Arbeidsinspectie and to have a procedure for handling them, questioning its added value, effectiveness, internal consistency with individual-case reporting, and the Arbeidsinspectie's capacity. The minister's nader rapport largely rejects these objections, defending the reporting duty and procedure as complementary and explaining the enforcement approach, while making some textual clarifications.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether the reporting duty adds sufficient value beyond existing equal-treatment law and the proposed bill, and asks for a substantive motivation or reconsideration.
The Afdeling doubts the effectiveness of the reporting duty given intermediaries' expertise, contractual dependence, and difficulties of enforcement and evidence.
The Afdeling asks for justification of imposing private enforcement obligations on intermediaries that increase their burden and shift a public norm to private parties.
The Afdeling notes that the Arbeidsinspectie cannot both avoid judging individual discrimination and act on individual reports, and asks for justification of this design.
The Afdeling finds the enforcement capacity and expertise of the Arbeidsinspectie and the resource implications insufficiently motivated.
The Afdeling asks that the text of the proposed articles match the explanatory memorandum on whether suspected discrimination must be reported and on how the procedure relates to the reporting duty.

35682.s: This incidental supplementary budget amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science to add funds for COVID-19 related employment positions (coronabanen) in higher education. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect retroactively from 1 January 2021 or the day after publication.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35691.s: The bill shortens the validity of asylum residence permits for a fixed term to three years for both refugees and subsidiary protection holders, and allows the Immigration Service to extend validity ex officio. It also changes the reference point in article 34 from the date of application to the date of decision, and enters into force by royal decree.
35691.j: The memorandum justifies the shorter three-year validity by preventing subsidiary protection holders from appealing the refugee status decision, and says the regulatory basis is kept so that extension rules can be set in the Vb 2000.
q: The residence permit for a fixed term is granted for three consecutive years.
De verblijfsvergunning voor bepaalde tijd wordt verleend voor drie achtereenvolgende jaren.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A.2 (artikel 28, tweede lid Vreemdelingenwet 2000)
rules on extension of validity of asylum residence permit
p: Artikel I, onderdeel A.1 (artikel 28, eerste lid, onderdeel f)
Gives the Immigration Service the discretionary power to extend residence permit validity ex officio, which may limit the permit holder's own procedural role in securing extension.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division gave a negative opinion on the bill shortening asylum residence permits from five to three years, finding the justification insufficient, unclear added value, and added costs for the IND, legal aid and courts. The government's reply rejects the objections, keeps the bill unchanged, and argues the three-year check adds value by stressing the temporariness of the permit.
concerns: The Council finds the justification (aligning with other EU states and preventing Dutch attractiveness to asylum seekers) does not carry the proposal and lacks supporting research and figures.
The Council considers it unclear what the proposal adds to existing possibilities to end asylum residence, since permits can already be withdrawn at any time.

The Council points to extra costs and workload for the IND, legal aid and the judiciary, and possible unrest for permit holders from re-assessment; the government answers that the IND will be resourced and the burden is limited.

35763.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adding 3,825,008 thousand euro in mutations for the fourth incidental supplementary budget on COVID-19 measures. It takes effect on 12 March 2021 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35772.s: The bill amends the Wet basisregistratie personen (Wet BRP) to give the Minister of BZK a supporting task for municipal colleges in checking whether persons are correctly registered at addresses, including power to receive reports from agencies and designated third parties, process data including health data, and run profiling analyses that generate signals for address investigations. Results are fed back to the colleges and the Minister, with detailed rules on data and analysis methods set by AMvB and ministerial regulation.
35772.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to improve the quality of address registration, citing transparency, minimal data processing and proportionality, and notes the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises the Minister's task.
q: By or pursuant to a general order in council it is determined which categories of data form part of a signal.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt bepaald welke categorieën van gegevens onderdeel uitmaken van een signaal.
d: designation of administrative bodies reporting doubts on address data
categories of additional data to be provided to the Minister
designation of third parties that may report to the Minister
rules on data processing and analysis methods
time limits for municipal reporting back to the Minister
categories of data exchanged between Minister and colleges
p: Gives the Minister power to process personal data, including health data, in performing the supporting task.
Allows the Minister to analyse data via profiles and pattern research to generate address-investigation signals, with detailed rules deferred to lower regulation.
Routes reports of address doubts from agencies and third parties directly to the Minister instead of the municipal college, bypassing the usual channel.

parties: Asks how much discretion municipal colleges have to act on ministerial signals, who designates third parties that may report, and on what basis profiles and algorithms select addresses.
Which consequence is given to a signal is therefore up to the college, that is the allocation of responsibility.
Welk gevolg aan een signaal wordt gegeven, is dus aan het college, zo is de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling.
Stresses minimal data processing and meaningful human intervention and asks how privacy is safeguarded compared to SyRI, and whether third-party reports could wrongly label citizens.
They do however consider it important that meaningful human intervention is always guaranteed and the principle of minimal data processing is observed.
Wel vinden zij het daarbij van belang dat steeds de betekenisvolle menselijke tussenkomst is gewaarborgd en het beginsel van minimale gegevensverwerking in acht wordt genomen.
Asks how the requirement of meaningful human intervention under GDPR Article 22 is ensured in practice so that decisions do not become de facto fully automated.
Together with the Council of State, the CDA members also attach great value to ensuring this meaningful human intervention.
Met de Raad van State hechten ook de leden van de CDA-fractie er grote waarde aan dat deze betekenisvolle menselijke tussenkomst gewaarborgd is.
Asks whether affected persons are informed of preliminary investigations and whether the statutory deadlines are realistic given large municipalities' concerns.
Is it correct that people are not informed of a preliminary investigation, and that they only receive this information if they specifically ask for it?
Klopt het dat mensen niet op de hoogte worden gebracht van een vooronderzoek, en dat zij deze gegevens alleen krijgen als zij hier specifiek om vragen?

Questions the proportionality and effectiveness of the central facility, the selection criteria and possible discriminatory profiling, and how citizens can object to investigations based on ministerial signals.
Can it be ruled out that selection takes place on the basis of discriminatory data?
Kan worden uitgesloten dat hierbij op basis van discriminatoire gegevens wordt geselecteerd?
Rejects the bill outright, arguing it reinforces systematic government distrust of citizens, risks processing special personal data, and lacks capacity to guarantee human scale and rights.
Het lid wijst het voorstel af.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet basisregistratie personen to give the minister an address-quality support role for municipalities, raising concerns about meaningful human intervention in profiling, delegation of analysis methods, and the scope of the special-category data basis. The government reply accepts the special-category limitation and clarifies the human intervention and delegation points, without amending the bill on the first point.
concerns: Meaningful human intervention in profiling should be secured in the law itself, so that a minister's signal does not automatically lead to a college decision; the government did not amend the bill but relied on AVG Article 22 and clarified the practice in the explanatory memorandum.

The bill's delegation of analysis methods and decision rules to AMvB or ministerial regulation lacked clarity about which elements go where and why subdelegation is necessary; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
The basis for processing special categories of personal data should be limited to the specific categories needed; the government restricted it to health data.

35781.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, adding a supplementary incidental allocation of 27.5 million euros for a compensation scheme for the fireworks sector. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively from 31 March 2021.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management XII for the year 2021
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat XII voor het jaar 2021

35790.s: The bill amends Article 13 of the Constitution, replacing the protection of the privacy of letters, telephone and telegraph with a right to respect for correspondence and telecommunications secrecy. It permits restrictions in cases set by law with judicial authorization or, in the interest of national security, by or with authorization of persons designated by law.
35790.j: The memorandum gives no detailed justification for the national security authorization; it only refers to earlier documents and parliamentary debates.
q: by or with authorization of those designated for that purpose by law
door of met machtiging van hen die daartoe bij de wet zijn aangewezen
d: authorizing restrictions on privacy of correspondence for national security
p: Allows restriction of communications secrecy in the interest of national security by persons designated by law, not only by a judge, reducing citizens' protection against the state.

parties: Welcomes the technology-neutral wording extending constitutional protection to e-mail and other telecommunications; raises no questions.
With this proposal, e-mail and other forms of telecommunication will also receive constitutional protection.
Met dat voorstel krijgen ook e-mail en andere vormen van telecommunicatie grondwettelijke bescherming.

Asks whether the amended article secures horizontal effect against private parties and how far the security-based intrusion power without judicial review reaches, including for journalists and whistleblowers.
These members ask how broad the discretionary room of a designated person is in assessing whether an intrusion is in the interest of national security.
Deze leden vragen hoe ruim de beoordelingsruimte van een door de wet aangewezene is in de beoordeling of een inbreuk in het belang van de nationale veiligheid is?
Supports extending the scope of the secrecy guarantee to all communication means in a technology-independent formulation.
These members agree with the government that constitutional protection of letter and telecommunication secrecy needs an adequate formulation independent of technological form.

Deze leden onderkennen met de regering, dat de grondwettelijke bescherming van het brief- en telecommunicatiegeheim een adequate formulering behoeft, die onafhankelijk is van de technologische vormgeving.
Has not changed its view since the first reading and raises no further remarks.
They see no reason to make further remarks.
Zij zien geen aanleiding voor het maken van verdere opmerkingen.
Asks whether new developments in citizens' communication security and digital safety, including private market actors, shed new light on the bill's content and purpose.
In that period, new questions and problems have also arisen regarding the protection of communication and the digital security of citizens.
In die periode hebben zich ook nieuwe vragen en problemen voorgedaan als het gaat om de bescherming van de communicatie en de digitale veiligheid van de burger.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a government bill amending the Constitution's provision on the inviolability of letter, telephone and telegraph secrecy, and raised no remarks. The minister's reply accompanies the advice, forwarding the bill to the Tweede Kamer.

35808.s: The bill amends the Public Health Act (Wet publieke gezondheid) to introduce a mandatory home quarantine of up to 14 days for travellers arriving in European Netherlands from designated high-risk areas, with exemptions, a negative test pathway, and a quarantine declaration system. It also extends similar rules to Caribbean Netherlands, adds a court request procedure for travellers to challenge the obligation, and grants mayors power to impose administrative fines.
35808.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated rules and new powers by the need to control the COVID-19 epidemic and prevent importation of new variants, while stating that the emergency framework of the Public Health Act is temporary and subject to necessity, proportionality and parliamentary procedures.
d: quarantine duration, test requirements and further rules on home quarantine
additional exempt categories of persons and time thresholds
quarantine declaration obligations and data to be provided
additional data provision by carriers and regional safety authorities
quarantine obligation for Caribbean Netherlands, with governor exemptions
negative test obligation for travellers not using commercial passenger transport
p: Imposes a compulsory home quarantine on arriving travellers, with duration and exemptions set by ministerial regulation, limiting personal liberty under executive direction.
Provides a fast-track court procedure through which individuals can challenge the applicability of the quarantine obligation within three days, though no appeal lies against the decision.
Allows the Minister and mayors to process and share quarantine-related personal data and passenger details for monitoring and enforcement.
Empowers mayors to impose administrative fines up to the first-category statutory amount to enforce the quarantine obligation.

parties: Wants a full overview of all ministerial regulations and AMvBs and parliament's role via pre- or post-consultation procedures, to preserve democratic legitimacy.
They therefore want to know what parliament's involvement in the various regulations is, and whether a pre-consultation or post-consultation procedure applies.
Daarom willen deze leden weten wat de betrokkenheid van het parlement bij de verschillende regelingen is en in het overzicht opgenomen hebben of er een voorhang- of nahangprocedure is
Raises sharp doubts about effectiveness, proportionality and enforceability of the quarantine obligation, citing Council of State criticism and possible conflict with ECHR and constitutional rights.
These members have critical questions about this bill, in particular its drafting, effectiveness, proportionality, enforceability, privacy.
Deze leden hebben kritische vragen over dit wetsvoorstel, met name over de totstandkoming, effectiviteit, proportionaliteit, handhaafbaarheid, privacy
Opposes quarantine obligation and criminalisation as a heavy measure; questions the vagueness of the 'dangerous variant' criterion and effectiveness.
They believe the government must properly explain to its citizens why quarantine after arrival from risk areas matters, rather than resorting to the heavy tool of criminalisation.
zijn van mening dat de regering haar burgers goed moet uitleggen waarom quarantaine na inreizen uit risicogebieden van belang is, in plaats van te grijpen naar het zware middel van strafbaarstelling
Supports stricter measures but asks about the reliability of negative test certificates, falsification risks and enforcement.
These members point out that many false negative test certificates are now in circulation worldwide.
Deze leden wijzen de regering erop dat er inmiddels (veel) valse negatieve testbewijzen in de wereld in omloop zijn
Criticises use of ministerial regulations for key rules, which makes democratic control nearly impossible for a controversial measure, and asks for objective criteria to be written into the law.
How does the government justify this approach, under which democratic scrutiny is more or less impossible for a controversial subject such as a quarantine obligation?
Hoe verantwoordt de regering deze werkwijze, waarbij de democratische controle min of meer onmogelijk is voor een controversieel onderwerp als een quarantaineverplichting?
Questions whether quarantine is the right solution and how the quality of foreign tests and the exemption for transport workers can be checked.
How can the government set requirements on the quality of tests carried out abroad, and how can compliance be checked?
Hoe kan de regering eisen stellen ten aanzien van de kwaliteit van testen die in het buitenland worden uitgevoerd en hoe kan gecontroleerd worden of er aan die eisen voldaan wordt?
Supports the quarantine obligation in principle but shares the Council of State's concern about precedent and limiting the measure to exceptional situations.
These members also worry about the precedent effect of such restrictive measures on freedom.
maken ook genoemde leden zich zorgen over precedentwerking van dergelijke vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen
Asks why mayors should not be able to grant individual exemptions for urgent cases that cannot be covered in regulations, and for the risks of such a power.
In those cases, these members believe the mayor of the municipality where the person is registered or resides should be able to grant an individual exemption.
In die gevallen zou wat deze leden betreft de burgemeester van de gemeente waar betreffende persoon staat ingeschreven of verblijft, een individuele ontheffing moeten kunnen verlenen
Argues the quarantine obligation does not meet the ECtHR Enhorn standard on deprivation of liberty, since it applies to persons not certainly infected, and questions proportionality.
The SGP members have serious concerns about the proportionality of the measure.
De leden van de SGP-fractie maken zich ernstige zorgen om de proportionaliteit van de maatregel
Asks why a far-reaching statutory change is needed now that many people are vaccinated, and about enforcement capacity of GGD and municipalities.
Why then such a far-reaching legislative change now?
Waarom dan nu een dergelijke ingrijpende wetswijziging?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on 7 April 2021 that the draft amendment to the Wet publieke gezondheid introducing mandatory home quarantine for travellers from high-risk areas lacks adequate justification of necessity, proportionality and effectiveness, and raised concerns on delegation, individual exemptions, legal protection and enforcement for travellers by own vehicle. The minister's reply of 16 April 2021 accepted several points (statutory exemptions, administrative fine, reachability duty, legal protection clarifications) and defended the rest, including the Article 5 ECHR basis and the effectiveness of the scheme.
concerns: The Afdeling doubted whether detention of persons not certainly infected is permissible under Article 5 ECHR; the government argued the text allows it and added supporting justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling found necessity, proportionality and effectiveness of the quarantine obligation insufficiently established given the serious rights restrictions; the government defended it and added a fine and reachability duty.
The Afdeling advised that categories already known to be exempt be placed in the statute itself rather than delegated to a ministerial regulation; the government did so in a new article 58nc.

The Afdeling asked why an individual exemption power exists for Caribbean Netherlands but not for European Netherlands; the government added explanation to the memorandum rather than changing the bill.
The Afdeling asked for concentration of legal protection in one judge given three routes (civil and administrative); the government explained why the split is unavoidable and added clarification.
The Afdeling questioned dispensing with a hearing in the civil summary procedure; the government clarified the circumstances in which hearing may be dispensed with.

The Afdeling doubted whether the negative-test and quarantine-declaration obligation for travellers by own vehicle can be effectively enforced given absence of border controls; the government argued controls and verification are feasible and added explanation.

35817.s: The bill adds a new article 58na to the Public Health Act giving mayors an explicit power to order temporary closure, for up to ten days, of public or private places where a SARS-CoV-2 outbreak occurs, on advice of the municipal health service. Places of worship and constitutionally protected buildings may only be closed if public health requires it, after the religious community has been given the chance to act first.
35817.j: The memorandum justifies the new power by the serious risk of immediate virus spread and the need for quick action, and because existing powers are too unspecific and split between different authorities.
q: This bill therefore provides that the mayor receives an explicit power to order the temporary closure of a public or private place in the event of an outbreak of the virus.

Dit wetsvoorstel regelt daarom dat de burgemeester een expliciete bevoegdheid krijgt op grond waarvan hij in het geval van een uitbraak van het virus de tijdelijke sluiting van een publieke of besloten plaats kan bevelen
p: Mayors gain an explicit discretionary power to close public and private places for up to ten days after an outbreak, subject to a municipal health service advice and proportionality and subsidiarity tests.

Closure of places of worship under article 6(2) of the Constitution is allowed only where public health requires it, after the religious community has been given the opportunity to take measures itself.

parties: Asks how necessity and proportionality will be assessed and whether less intrusive means are always tried first, and seeks data on past cases.
Can the government guarantee that less far-reaching means are always considered first?
Kan de regering garanderen dat altijd eerst gekeken wordt naar minder vergaande middelen?
Asks how the GGD assesses ongoing transmission, the evidentiary basis for closure advice, privacy of reporters, and why no causal link to non-compliance is required.
Why were the three cumulative criteria chosen rather than non-compliance, as the motion requested?
Waarom is gekozen voor de voorgaande drie cumulatieve criteria en niet voor het niet-naleven, zoals ook in de motie werd verzocht?
Considers the bill untimely since the crisis will soon end, doubts its proportionality given existing instruments, and asks for overviews of existing powers and sanctions.
These members consider the bill untimely as the corona crisis will soon be behind us and have considerable critical questions.
Deze leden achten het wetsvoorstel ontijdig gezien de coronacrisis snel achter ons zal liggen en hebben nog de nodige kritische vragen.
Asks whether mayors may deviate from GGD advice, what other interests they may weigh, and why religious-building safeguards are not applied to other locations.
The CDA members ask whether the mayor can and may in appropriate cases deviate from the GGD advice.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de burgemeester in voorkomende gevallen kan en mag afwijken van het advies van de GGD.
Asks why mayors cannot extend closure beyond ten days, which proportionality criteria apply, and what happens to workers and migrant workers who lose jobs and housing.
Can the government explain why no room is given to a mayor to extend closure beyond ten days if they find it necessary?
Kan de regering uitleggen waarom er geen ruimte wordt geboden aan een burgemeester om de sluiting langer te maken dan de tien dagen, mochten zij dat nodig vinden?

Demands a mandatory reporting duty for companies with clusters as the motion asked, criticizes inconsistent enforcement at slaughterhouses, and questions the absence of a causal link to non-compliance and the ten-day cap.
These members ask the government to actually implement the adopted Ouwehand motion and introduce a reporting duty for companies with COVID-19 clusters among employees.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering de aangenomen motie Ouwehand daadwerkelijk uit te voeren en een meldplicht in te stellen voor bedrijven met covid-19 clusters onder de medewerkers.
Questions necessity given vaccination and the end date of the temporary law, the risk of under-reporting, scope for schools and care locations, and the appeal procedure and urgency for injunctions.
The ChristenUnie members ask why the government did not choose to emphasise the temporary nature of this law in the bill title.
Allereerst vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie waarom de regering er niet voor heeft gekozen in de titel van het wetsvoorstel de tijdelijkheid van deze wet te benadrukken.

Questions why the power is needed now when no clear practical examples exist, asks about the risk of closure based on three infections, and objects to dropping the exemption for freedom of religion and belief.
Is the necessity sufficiently substantiated when after more than a year of practical experience no clear examples are available?
Is de noodzaak voldoende te onderbouwen wanneer na ruim een jaar praktijkervaring geen duidelijke voorbeelden voorhanden zijn?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft amendment to the Wet publieke gezondheid giving mayors power to close public or private places for up to ten days after a SARS-CoV-2 outbreak, objecting to the legal basis, the exemption for places of worship under article 6(2) of the Constitution, and the fixed ten-day closure period. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the advice, adding a specific legal basis (article 58na Wpg) and extending the closure power to places of worship, but declines to allow extension of closures beyond ten days.
concerns: Emergency powers under the Gemeentewet cannot adequately serve as a legal basis for measures restricting constitutional fundamental rights, so a specific statutory basis is needed.
The exemption for places of worship and secular buildings under article 6(2) of the Constitution lacks justification and should be removed so the closure power applies to them too.
The fixed maximum closure period of ten days should be extendable where the causes of an outbreak, such as ventilation, have not been remedied.
The explanatory memorandum should better explain how the proposed closure power relates to existing powers and enforcement instruments.

35830-X.s: This bill adopts the final budget adjustment (Slotwet) for the Ministry of Defence's 2020 departmental budget and the agency budget for Paresto, changing expenditure, commitment and revenue amounts to reflect realised figures. It is a technical budget law setting out realised versus planned amounts by article and states that the changes take effect from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
35830-X.j: The memorandum explains the budget changes as technical implementation adjustments, accounting changes and results of control findings, without justifying any delegation or new powers.
q: This bill contains technical implementation changes, accounting-type changes or changes arising from control findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

35844.s: The bill sets a unified legal framework for handling human biological material (collection, storage, transfer, use and destruction), including donor consent rules, exceptions for research, quality control and criminal investigation, and a role for ethics review committees. It amends several related laws (Embryo Act, Blood Supply Act, Organ Donation Act, Burial Act, Code of Criminal Procedure) and designates the Health Inspectorate as supervisor.
35844.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative order powers by the need for flexibility as sensitive applications may change over time and to avoid legal uncertainty for citizens.
q: Because of the great practical significance of this exception to the consent requirement and for legal certainty for citizens, following the advice of the Council of State, the possibility is provided to set further rules by general administrative order.

Vanwege de grote praktische betekenis van deze uitzondering op het toestemmingsvereiste en vanuit het oogpunt van rechtszekerheid voor de burger is, naar aanleiding van het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State, voorzien in de mogelijkheid om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere regels te kunnen stellen
d: prohibited purposes for handling body material
designation of sensitive applications and extra rules
further rules on information duties to donors
further rules on research exception to consent
rules for use of material collected before the act
p: Allows prosecutors to seize stored body material from third-party custodians without donor consent for serious offences, subject to a rechter-commissaris authorisation and several cumulative conditions.
Lets a general administrative order designate sensitive applications, with no parliamentary involvement, shaping the consent requirements that apply.

parties: Asks why the framework is needed, how it relates to other laws, and whether delegation via AMvBs undermines the goal of harmonised rules; also asks how misuse by beheerders is prevented.
The government further states that self-regulation by the field through guidelines and codes of conduct is insufficient to secure donor control over and careful handling of body material.

Er wordt daarnaast door de regering gesteld dat de zelfregulering door het veld via handreikingen en gedragscodes onvoldoende is om de zeggenschap over en zorgvuldige omgang met lichaamsmateriaal te borgen.

Objects to the lack of a new internet consultation, asks for full lists of consulted parties, and expresses strong reservations about the criminal-investigation exception, questioning its necessity and fit with the bill's principles.
Doubts the bill achieves its aim of better donor control, finds the regulation fragmented, and asks for clarity on consent procedures, registration, exceptions and the scope of criminal-law powers.
These members see this bill as a complex whole where it is uncertain whether its aim, improving donor and next-of-kin control over body material, will be achieved.

Genoemde leden zien dit wetsvoorstel als een complex geheel waarbij het maar de vraag is of het doel, namelijk het verbeteren van de zeggenschap over lichaamsmateriaal voor donoren en nabestaanden, wel gehaald wordt.

Asks whether sensitive applications should be fixed in statute rather than AMvB, whether AMvBs will always be pre-consulted with parliament, and how donors can object or appeal decisions not to destroy material.
These members therefore ask why the government does not want to involve parliament when it is determined that a particular application is no longer considered sensitive.
Deze leden vragen dan ook waarom de regering het parlement er niet bij wil betrekken op momenten dat bepaald wordt dat een bepaalde toepassing als niet meer sensitief gezien wordt.
Asks for concrete examples of problems under current rules and about commercial testing providers and the status of cell lines derived from donor material.
The SP members read that current regulation, or its absence, means there is currently no adequate legal framework.
De leden van de SP-fractie lezen dat de huidige regelgeving, of het ontbreken daarvan, ervoor zorgt dat er nu geen adequaat juridisch kader is.
Questions the delegation of sensitive applications to AMvB rather than statute, the ease of becoming a beheerder, and whether the bill fits practice and international obligations.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government why the already known sensitive applications have not been designated at statutory level.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering waarom de reeds bekende sensitieve toepassingen niet op wetsniveau zijn benoemd.

Asks for concrete practical explanation, whether the bill enables applications currently prohibited, and urges that sensitive applications be set by statute, not AMvB, to avoid bypassing ethical debate.
They would find it undesirable if the debate on weighty ethical questions could simply be bypassed through an amendment via an AMvB.
Zij zouden het onwenselijk vinden als het debat over zwaarwegende ethische vraagstukken door middel van een wijziging via een AMvB eenvoudigweg kan worden omzeild.
Asks whether sensitive applications should be fixed in detailed regulation or handled through a national assessment framework that keeps pace with science.
Has the government considered instead working with a national assessment framework, in which the context of use of body material and data guides whether additional safeguards are needed?

Heeft de regering overwogen om in plaats daarvan te werken met een nationaal beoordelingskader, waarin de context van het gebruik van lichaamsmateriaal en data leidend is bij de beoordeling of aanvullende waarborgen noodzakelijk zijn?

Asks which sensitive applications are already known and whether they can be fixed in the statute rather than by AMvB, and probes the risk of commercial involvement being insufficiently disclosed to donors.

These members ask whether applications already known could not be fixed at statutory level now, since a immortal cell line has also been chosen to be fixed at statutory level as a sensitive application.

Deze leden vragen of die toepassingen die nu al bekend zijn niet alvast op wetsniveau kunnen worden vastgelegd, aangezien er ook voor gekozen is om een onsterfelijke cellijn op wetsniveau als sensitieve toepassing vast te leggen.
Objects to replacing explicit consent with an informed opt-out and asks for concept AMvBs to be shared before plenary debate.
The SGP members are not happy that the control regime has been changed into an 'informed opt-out'.
De leden van de SGP-fractie zijn er niet gelukkig mee dat het zeggenschapsregime is gewijzigd in een «geïnformeerde opt-out».
Asks how donors' control is safeguarded against commercial interests and how the proportionality of the rights infringement under EVRM Article 8 is justified.
Can the government further explain which safeguards are built into the bill and in practice to ensure donors' control does not become subordinate to commercial interests?

Kan de regering nader toelichten welke waarborgen er in het wetsvoorstel en in de praktijk zijn ingebouwd om erop toe te zien dat de zeggenschap van donoren niet ondergeschikt raakt aan commerciële belangen?
Asks whether certain uses should be banned outright, how donors with limited literacy are informed, and whether understanding of consent is checked.
Furthermore, these members ask whether and how it is checked that people have been informed and have understood what they have or have not consented to.
Daarnaast vragen deze leden of en hoe wordt gecontroleerd of mensen geïnformeerd zijn en hebben begrepen waar ze al dan niet mee hebben ingestemd.
Argues that secondary use without explicit consent requires higher safeguards to protect donor control and asks how sufficient information will be ensured.
Does the government share the view that higher safeguards must therefore be set to protect donor control?
Deelt de regering de zienswijze dat hierdoor hogere waarborgen gesteld moeten worden om de zeggenschap van de donor te waarborgen?
Has no questions for the State Secretary.
The members have no questions for the State Secretary.
De leden hebben geen vragen aan de Staatssecretaris.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the second amendment to the Dutch bill on handling body material for purposes other than treatment or diagnosis (Wet zeggenschap lichaamsmateriaal), raising concerns about the relationship with the EHDS Regulation, the overriding prohibition, and the legal basis for further processing of health data. The Secretary of State replied that the explanatory memorandum has been clarified and that the legal basis for the processing can be found in legitimate interest under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, without a separate statutory basis.
concerns: The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify how the national data regime relates to the directly applicable EHDS Regulation and the overriding prohibition, and what the necessity of the additional access route is; the government clarified the text but denied that Article 17a is an implementation of the EHDS.

The Council held that the legal basis for further processing by the manager and user cannot be found in the treatment agreement and advised a separate statutory basis; the government held that Article 6(1)(f) GDPR applies directly and no further statutory elaboration is needed.

The Council asked that the explanatory memorandum further motivate that the conditions of necessity and proportionality for the processing are met; the government added this motivation in the explanatory memorandum.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the draft Wet zeggenschap lichaamsmateriaal, which would allow reuse of body material for research and other purposes, and found that the bill falls short in safeguarding donor consent, notably for scientific research exemptions, criminal-justice use, delegation for sensitive applications, and feasibility for custodians. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted most points, adding a necessity criterion and pseudonymisation requirement, moving the sensitive-applications list into delegated regulation, and adjusting the information duties and the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling found the exemption from consent for scientific research insufficiently safeguards donors' control over body material, since the bill leaves key concepts to codes of conduct; the government added necessity and pseudonymisation criteria to Article 17.

The vague 'onevenredige inspanning' criterion and unspecified conditions for objecting need clearer statutory guidance; the government added a delegation basis and clarified the objection route in the information duty, but kept much detail for general administrative orders and codes.

The Afdeling questioned how far the Inspectie voor Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd is bound by field standards in its supervision; the government clarified in the explanatory memorandum that the inspectorate takes them into account.

The Afdeling advised moving the criminal-justice use rules to the Wetboek van Strafvordering; the government kept them in the bill for systematic reasons and clarified the explanatory memorandum instead.

The Afdeling advised listing the sensitive applications in the statute itself rather than leaving them to delegated regulation; the government declined to list them in the law, preferring flexibility via an algemene maatregel van bestuur.

The Afdeling asked for an explicit assessment of whether custodian duties are practically feasible, especially for smaller custodians; the government added explanation in the regulatory-burden section and said it expects knowledge sharing and ministry facilitation.
The Afdeling advised improving the explanatory memorandum's readability with a table of contents, a reading guide, and restructuring; several drafting corrections in the bill were made.

35850-V.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by a first supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It takes effect the day after publication and is retroactive to 1 June 2021.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2021
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2021

35853.s: The bill makes technical amendments and clarifications to the Public Health Act (Wpg) concerning the processing of personal data for COVID-19 access certificates, including adding RIVM to the bodies allowed to process data. It also adds an enabling clause to Article 6ba allowing EU-based rules on necessary personal data processing, with the article lapsing by royal decree.
35853.j: The memorandum justifies the RIVM's role and detailed data rules by the Minister's public-interest task under the Wpg and by the need for RIVM to deliver vaccination data.
q: The data processing by the Minister of VWS will be further elaborated by ministerial regulation.
Bij ministeriële regeling wordt de gegevensverwerking door de Minister van VWS nader uitgewerkt.
d: rules on necessary processing of personal data including health data
personal data processed for coronatoegangsbewijzen by minister, RIVM and other bodies
entry into force by royal decree
p: Allows ministerial rules to govern necessary processing of sensitive health data, extending executive discretion over personal data.

parties: Asks how the guarantee is secured that data cannot be exchanged or read for the certificate without the person's consent, and what is stored and where.
Said members first want the guarantee that the data cannot be exchanged or read for the DCC without the person's own consent.
Genoemde leden willen allereerst de garantie dat de gegevens niet uitgewisseld dan wel uitgelezen kunnen worden voor het DCC zonder de toestemming van de persoon zelf.
Demands clear limits on when privacy-sensitive data may be used, questions why an additional law was needed, and asks about the right to erasure and consent for CIMS data.
They are of the view that it must be clearly described in which circumstances privacy-sensitive data may be used and when not.
Zij zijn van mening dat duidelijk moet worden omschreven in welke omstandigheden privacygevoelige gegevens gebruikt kunnen worden en wanneer niet.
Asks about the temporariness of the measures, whether a DPIA was carried out, and which parties receive data to issue certificates.
Has a general Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA, as referred to in article 35 of the GDPR) been carried out on this bill?
Is er een algehele Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA, zoals bedoeld in artikel 35 van de AVG) op onderhavig wetsvoorstel uitgevoerd?
Asks whether parts of the EU regulation could lapse earlier than 1 July 2022 and whether it could remain in force without being used, in relation to the sunset clause in article 6ba.
The members of the SGP faction ask whether it is also possible and/or conceivable that (parts of) the regulation lapse earlier than 1 July 2022.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen of het ook mogelijk en/of denkbaar is dat (delen van) de verordening eerder komt/komen te vervallen dan 1 juli 2022.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Public Health Act (Wpg) on COVID-19 access certificates, asking for a sunset clause for article 6ba, a fuller account of how persons not in the CIMS can prove vaccination, and clarification of the relationship between the CoronaCheck app and the EU Digital COVID Certificate, which contains more personal data. The minister's reply states that the advice was followed: a sunset provision was added, the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on proof of vaccination and on the app, and an article-by-article explanation was added.
concerns: Article 6ba should have a sunset provision, since it implements the EU regulation and should lapse with it, and the government added a lapse clause.

Persons not registered in the CIMS, including those vaccinated abroad, need a clear way to demonstrate vaccination, and the explanatory memorandum should address this; the government supplemented paragraph 2.3.
The EU certificate contains more personal data than the national certificate, and the relationship between the two in the app must be explained; the government supplemented paragraph 2.1.
The explanatory memorandum needs an article-by-article explanation of article I, part A, which the government added.

35871.s: The bill raises the statutory maximum prison sentence for manslaughter (doodslag) from fifteen to twenty-five years by amending articles 10 and 287 of the Dutch Criminal Code.
