It is intended to reflect changed societal views and give judges more room to sentence the most serious cases proportionately, with no new investigative powers attached.
35871.j: The memorandum justifies the increase by pointing to a perceived sentencing gap between manslaughter and murder after the Supreme Court's 2012 tightening of the evidentiary standard for murder, and to signalling societal disapproval.
q: The increase in the penalty threshold aims to reflect this societal judgement and give the judge sufficient scope to proportionately sentence even the most serious cases of manslaughter.
De verhoging van de strafbedreiging wil dit maatschappelijk oordeel weerspiegelen, en de rechter voldoende armslag geven om ook de ernstigste gevallen van doodslag proportioneel te kunnen bestraffen.

parties: Supports the increase in the maximum penalty and asks whether the stricter proof requirements for premeditation since 2012 are stricter than in neighbouring countries; no check-related concern raised.

Questions the disproportionate size of the increase, the demissionary status of the government, and the risk of undermining the statutory system of general maxima; asks for a more fundamental justification.
Supports the need to raise the maximum penalty for manslaughter and has no further questions.
They endorse the need to raise the maximum penalty for manslaughter.
Zij onderschrijven de noodzaak om het strafmaximum voor doodslag te verhogen.
Asks why the increase is necessary given judges already sentence manslaughter more heavily, questions the focus on retribution, and asks about the absolute versus relative approach to the gap.
If judges have started sentencing manslaughter more heavily, why does the government still consider raising the statutory maximum necessary?
Als rechters doodslag hoger zijn gaan straffen, waarom meent de regering dat een verhoging van het strafmaximum dan toch nodig is?
Demands a thorough jurisprudence analysis to establish whether judges themselves feel the maxima are constraining and whether the increase should be limited to 20 years, as advised by legal bodies.
In the view of these members, a careful jurisprudence study of the considerations judges currently use in sentencing gives better insight.
Een nauwgezet jurisprudentieonderzoek naar de vigerende overwegingen in de strafbepaling van strafrechters geeft naar het oordeel van deze leden beter inzicht.

Asks why 25 years rather than the 20 years advised by the NVvR, questions the systematic coherence with terrorism-related manslaughter and the punitive spiral, and asks about the government's response to the advice on net sentences.
Why was a maximum of 25 years chosen? Why not 20 years, as the NVvR also advises?
Waarom is er gekozen voor een maximumstraf van 25 jaar? Waarom niet 20 jaar, zoals ook de NVvR adviseert?

Notes the Raad van State and NVvR concern that the recidivism and concurrence increase by one third cannot be fully applied, and asks how this will be handled and whether the maximum temporary sentence should be raised instead.
These members believe that the inability to fully apply the recidivism and concurrence rules does not do justice to the seriousness of the offence.
Deze leden menen dat het ontbreken van de mogelijkheid om deze recidive- en samenloopregeling in volle omvang toe te passen geen recht doet aan de ernst van het misdrijf.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill raising the maximum penalty for manslaughter from 15 to 25 years needs further justification on its fit with the general penalty-maxima system, the size of the increase, and its expected effectiveness. The government's reply argues the increase is justified after the Hoge Raad's 2012 change in murder case law, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the increase from 15 to 25 years is justified and asked for a reasoned explanation of the size of the increase relative to murder.

The Afdeling found the government's reply on effectiveness unconvincing, given that longer detention under the Wet straffen en beschermen may be offset by judges adjusting sentences, and asked for further explanation.
The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum be supplemented on the relation to the general penalty system and the Wet straffen en beschermen, which the government did.

35880.s: The bill creates a screening regime requiring prior notification and, where needed, ministerial review and approval of acquisitions of control or significant influence in Dutch vital providers and companies active in sensitive technology, to protect national security. It lets the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate prohibit transactions or impose conditions and sets out the risk criteria, ancillary powers, and legal consequences of non-compliance.
35880.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need for timely national security screening that ex post supervision cannot provide, and by the flexibility needed to respond to technological change.
q: Without ex ante screening after notification of an acquisition involving a vital provider, but instead a model such as ex post supervision, unacceptable national security risks could already arise.

Zou er geen ex ante toetsing worden toegepast na een melding van een verwervingsactiviteit met betrekking tot een vitale aanbieder, maar een ander model (zoals toezicht ex post), dan kunnen er al onaanvaardbare risico's voor de nationale veiligheid ontstaan.
d: designating additional categories of vital providers
designating categories of target companies for significant-influence thresholds
detailed rules on conditions and requirements in screening decisions
designating criminal offences relevant to risk assessment
rules on timing and proceeds of forced divestment
rules on manner and period for compliance with orders to unwind
providing information on practical application on request
p: Acquisitions are prohibited pending a Minister's decision, giving the executive broad discretion to block transactions on national security grounds.
The Minister may appoint persons who can issue binding instructions to the target company or acquirer, and instructions are shielded from liability.
The Minister may impose broad conditions, forced divestment and bans on business arrangements, with discretion tied to a national security assessment.
The Minister may irrevocably authorise himself to sell shares on behalf of an acquirer when a divestment order is not complied with.
Rights attached to acquired shares are suspended in several situations, including while a reassessment is pending.
The Minister may reassess previously cleared transactions when new facts arise, with the decision taken in line with cabinet view.

parties: Asks how the bill avoids overlap with sector-specific screening, how sensitive technology is defined and extended, and whether investments can be unwound after approval.
Which definition of sensitive technology is used in this bill?
Welke definitie van sensitieve technologie wordt gehanteerd in dit wetsvoorstel?
Stresses legal certainty for companies and asks the government to clarify which measures apply to which risks, possibly via example cases.
At the same time they consider it important to give companies as much clarity and thus legal certainty in advance as possible.
Tegelijkertijd vinden zij dat het belangrijk is om bedrijven vooraf zoveel mogelijk verduidelijking en daarmee rechtszekerheid te geven.
Asks how sensitive technologies are added by general administrative order, how vital processes are chosen, and how the minister's broad discretion is accounted for.
Argues that social harm from foreign ownership extends beyond national security and questions which vital processes are excluded from the bill.
These members however hold that social harm is not caused solely by losing control over providers of vital processes, to which this bill is limited.

Deze leden zijn echter van mening dat sociaalmaatschappelijke schade niet enkel wordt veroorzaakt door het verliezen van zeggenschap in aanbieders van vitale processen waartoe dit wetsvoorstel zich beperkt.
Notes the bill grants far-reaching powers to intervene in corporate decisions and asks for precise definitions, criteria, supervision, objection routes and enforceability against foreign parties.
At the same time they note that the bill creates far-reaching powers to intervene in corporate decisions.
Tegelijkertijd stellen zij vast dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel verregaande bevoegdheden schept om in te grijpen in ondernemingsbesluiten.
Supports the bill's goal and asks how it helps prevent companies such as ASML from becoming pawns of geopolitical rivalry.
They endorse the goal of this bill.
Zij onderschrijven het doel van dit wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet veiligheidstoets investeringen, fusies en overnames, finding the bill's problem analysis thin, its instruments insufficiently linked to specific risks, and its delegation and definitions unclear, and advised reconsidering the bill. The government's nader rapport accepts a number of points, narrows the scope (dropping suppliers of vital providers and limiting some measures to sensitive technology), moves key elements into law, but maintains the core design as a general safety-net screening mechanism.
concerns: Insufficient clarity on which measures apply to which risks and activities creates legal uncertainty for investors and target companies; government clarified categories and narrowed scope but kept a general safety-net approach.

Key elements such as risk factors, conditions and vital provider designation were delegated to lower regulation; government moved vital provider designation and risk factors into the statute but kept delegation for sensitive technology.
Effectiveness and necessity of several instruments (criminal record, financial instability, relocation, licences) not adequately analysed; government added analysis but disputed the core objection.
Measures not tied to specific activities and risks may be disproportionate; government restricted some measures to sensitive technology and added proportionality reasoning.
Relationship to higher law, including free movement of capital and freedom of establishment, required further justification, which the government expanded in the memorie van toelichting.
Unclear definitions and cross-references make the bill hard to apply in practice; government restructured chapters, added definitions and reduced cross-references.

Overlap with sector-specific screening, the Wbni definition of vital provider, and the separate EU screening implementation law and duplicate administrative burdens; government clarified priority rules and aligned definitions.

35907.s: The bill amends the Wft and Faillissementswet to implement EU Directive 2019/2162 on covered bonds, requiring banks to obtain DNB permission before issuing covered bonds and setting conditions on cover pools, reporting and supervision. It also protects covered bond holders from acceleration or changes to their rights when the issuing bank is declared bankrupt or resolved.
35907.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to detail EU directive requirements and to keep existing regulatory practice in place.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further rules may be laid down regarding the conditions referred to in the third paragraph.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de voorwaarden, bedoeld in het derde lid.
d: conditions for DNB permission to issue covered bonds
rules on cover pool and assets to include, and expected wind-down costs
details of information to be provided to DNB on request
p: DNB is given a permit-granting role over covered bond programmes with statutory criteria for granting permission.

parties: Asks for safeguards of the internal cover pool monitor set out in a general administrative order and whether it will be submitted to parliament.
These members therefore ask the government about the safeguards of the internal cover pool monitor to be elaborated in a general administrative order.
Deze leden vragen de regering daarom naar de waarborgen van de interne dekkingspoolmonitor die worden uitgewerkt per algemene maatregel van bestuur.
Asks what happens when bonds are issued without the competent supervisor's approval and where the 105 percent threshold comes from.
These members ask the government what the consequences are if covered bonds are issued by banks without approval from the designated supervisor.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering wat de gevolgen zijn als er gedekte obligaties worden uitgegeven door banken zonder toestemming van de aangewezen toezichthouder.
Questions whether covered bonds are too risky and carry too low a risk weight, and whether DNB builds in enough security.
These members ask the government whether DNB builds in enough security for covered bonds.
Deze leden vragen de regering of DNB wel genoeg zekerheid inbouwt bij gedekte obligaties
Asks about the consequences of missing the implementation deadline, possible infringement proceedings, and how DNB was involved in technical changes.
Can the government explain this further?
Kan de regering dit nader toelichten?
Asks for the reason the implementation deadline was exceeded and the planning for lower-level regulation.
What is the reason for this?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised the bill implementing the EU covered bonds directive (amending the Wft and Faillissementswet) to proceed, with no substantive remarks, only editorial comments that were adopted. The government's reply (nader rapport) confirms the editorial changes and adds two legal bases for DNB information gathering plus technical corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling made editorial remarks on cross-references in articles 3:33b and 3:33ba, which were incorporated.

35916.s: The bill amends the Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens to implement EU regulation 2019/816 (Ecris-TCN) and directive 2019/884 on exchanging criminal records on third-country nationals. It allows Ecris-TCN use for purposes beyond criminal prosecution, such as background checks, and changes data-subject access rules, including shifting from inspection to an overview and extending response periods.
35916.j: The memorandum justifies the new uses and delegation as required to implement binding EU regulation and directive, with the delegation moved for overview purposes.
q: The Minister uses Ecris-TCN for criminal proceedings and additionally for the following purposes
Onze Minister maakt gebruik van Ecris-TCN ten behoeve van de strafrechtspleging en daarnaast voor de volgende doelen
d: rules on requesting and receiving criminal data from other EU member states
p: Allows the Minister to use Ecris-TCN for background screening purposes beyond criminal prosecution, enlarging executive use of criminal records data.
Replaces the citizen's right to inspect their criminal data with a right to an overview and extends the response period from four to six weeks.

parties: Asks how often Ecris was used for third-country nationals, why fingerprints and facial images are omitted, and how Brexit affects implementation.
How often in the past five years has Ecris been used with regard to third-country nationals?
Hoe vaak in de afgelopen vijf jaar is gebruik gemaakt van Ecris ten aanzien van onderdanen van een derde land?
Asks why a right to an extract is introduced only for justice data and not for other personal data, and questions the practical burden and use of the system.
These members wish to ask the government why no right to an extract is introduced for other types of personal data processed under the Wjsg, leaving only a right of access.

Deze leden willen de regering vragen waarom ten aanzien van andersoortige persoonsgegevens die binnen de reikwijdte van de Wjsg worden verwerkt geen recht op een uittreksel wordt ingevoerd en hier alleen een recht op inzage blijft bestaan.
Warns of growing centralisation of EU databases and expanding powers and registrations, and asks about procedural safeguards such as a maximum time limit for extracts.
The risk exists that increasingly far-reaching powers and registrations will become mandatory in an ever larger and more centralised database, the CDA members believe.
Het risico bestaat dat er steeds verdergaande bevoegdheden en registraties verplicht gaan worden in een steeds grotere en verder gecentraliseerde database, zo menen de leden van de CDA-fractie.
Objects to unequal treatment between EU citizens with and without a second non-European nationality, asking for legitimation under the non-discrimination principle.
But by including persons with dual nationality, they are subjected to a different regime than EU citizens who do not hold a second, non-European nationality.
Maar met het opnemen van persoon met een dubbele nationaliteit worden zij aan een ander regime blootgesteld dan EU-ingezeten die niet over een tweede, niet-Europese nationaliteit beschikken.
Asks on what legal basis second nationalities are received, registered and shared despite not being registered in the BRP, and whether discrimination on nationality is avoided.
In general terms: how does the government ensure that this proposal also does not lead to unequal treatment of (groups of) persons with dual or multiple nationality?
In algemene zin: hoe waarborgt de regering dat ook dit voorstel niet leidt tot een ongelijke behandeling van (groepen) personen met een dubbele of meervoudige nationaliteit?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division raised no substantive remarks on the draft law implementing EU rules on the European Criminal Records Information System, and advised submitting it to parliament. The minister's reply declines the only redactional remark, to split the transposition table by paragraph of the EU regulation and directive, arguing it would make the table considerably longer without benefit.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the transposition table in the explanatory memorandum be split out by paragraph of the EU articles, which the government declined as unnecessary and less clear.

35925-IIA.s: This bill formally adopts the 2022 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Staten-Generaal (parliament), setting expenditure and receipts for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint interparliamentary activities in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes the parliamentary budget articles and their financial effects, without delegating rule-making power to the executive.
q: Article 1 The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2022 is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State gave a blank opinion (no remarks) on the 2022 budget bill for the States General (IIA), advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport reports only technical changes to some budgets, and no substantive concerns were raised.

35943.s: The bill amends the Long-term Care Act (Wlz) with a set of technical and policy changes: registration of insured persons with Wlz-implementers including those living abroad, a broader right to informal care-support, extended duration limits for care in preferred institutions, a new data-sharing duty to care providers, and removal of obsolete subsidy schemes. It largely consists of repair and alignment amendments.
35943.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by citing administrative burden on Wlz-implementers, coordination problems between Wlz and Zvw care, and the need to repair existing regulation, with the subsidy schemes already having ended.
q: This part can lapse because the subsidy scheme ended in 2017.
Dit onderdeel kan vervallen omdat de subsidieregeling per 2017 is beëindigd.
d: ARTIKEL I, B (art. 2.2.1, eerste lid, onderdeel b)
designation of regions for insured persons living abroad
forms of care by other providers within full home care package
extension of transitional care period by Wlz-implementer or care office
p: Removes the fixed thirteen-week limit on temporary care and lets the Wlz-implementer or care office extend it, after consultation with the insured person, until a preferred place is available.
Allows Wlz-implementers and the CIZ to disclose health data on request to care providers under the Zvw, limited to what is necessary to establish whether care is covered by the insured package.

parties: Asks how client privacy is protected in the data-sharing query function and how long sensitive data will be retained.
Said members find it important that citizens' privacy is guaranteed when special personal data are shared.
Genoemde leden vinden belangrijk dat de privacy van burgers wordt gewaarborgd wanneer het om het delen van bijzondere persoonsgegevens gaat.
Questions the retroactive effect of the home-help change and how client privacy and independence of client support are safeguarded.
Can it be indicated how clients' privacy is safeguarded?
Kan worden aangegeven hoe de privacy van cliënten wordt geborgd?
Doubts the independence of client support when provided by Wlz insurers themselves and fears new fragmentation between Wmo and Wlz.
However, these members question the independence of advice and support from client support provided by Wlz implementing bodies.
Wel zetten deze leden hun vraagtekens bij de onafhankelijkheid van de adviezen en ondersteuning van cliëntondersteuning vanuit de Wlz-uitvoerders.
Asks how the government guarantees the independence of client support and how the boundary of who qualifies is defined in practice.
Further, said members ask how the government guarantees the independence of client support.
Verder vragen genoemde leden hoe de regering de onafhankelijkheid van de cliëntenondersteuning borgt?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that a retroactivity clause in the Wlz amendment bill lacked adequate justification and should be either substantiated or dropped. The minister's reply accepted the advice, specified the retroactive provisions, and removed the dental care component.
concerns: Retroactive effect was granted without a sufficient reason; the Afdeling advised regulating retroactivity definitively with a supporting motivation or dropping it.

35961.s: The bill amends the Public Health Act so that corona access certificates can be required, by ministerial regulation, for non-essential retail and non-essential services in public places. The explanatory memorandum says this is needed to limit virus transmission, is subject to proportionality and subsidiarity limits, and is preceded by OMT advice and socio-economic reflection before any regulation is made.
35961.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to curb transmission, citing OMT advice, and by the requirement that use be necessary, proportionate and subsidiary under article 58b(2) Wpg.
q: A balance must be struck, among other things, as to whether the measure meets the principles of proportionality and subsidiarity.
Er dient dan onder meer afgewogen te worden of de maatregel voldoet aan de beginselen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit.
d: ARTIKEL I B (artikel 58ra, eerste lid, onderdelen f en g Wpg)
where corona access certificates are used in non-essential retail and services in public places
p: ARTIKEL I B (artikel 58ra, eerste lid, onderdelen f en g Wpg)

Allows the minister, by ministerial regulation, to require access certificates for non-essential retail and services, restricting citizens' access to public activities without new parliamentary decision on each use.

parties: Asks why a ministerial regulation rather than an AMvB is used and how the Staten-Generaal can influence its many implementation choices, and stresses proportionality.
How are the States General involved in the ministerial regulation and how can they still influence it, given the many choices and variations in deployment that are possible?
Hoe worden de Staten-Generaal betrokken bij de ministeriële regeling en hoe kunnen ze daar nog invloed op uitoefenen, ook al omdat er veel keuzemogelijkheden en variaties aan inzet mogelijk zijn?
Asks whether the definition of essential versus non-essential places should be left to the regulation and whether courts could still dispute these terms.
Furthermore, these members ask the government to what extent a court could still discuss the definition of the terms essential versus non-essential?
Daarnaast vragen deze leden de regering in hoeverre er bij een rechter nog discussie kan ontstaan over de definitie van de termen essentieel versus niet-essentieel?
Says the figures rest on calculations the Chamber does not receive, so it cannot exercise its control under Article 68 of the Constitution.
The Chamber therefore cannot verify these figures under Article 68 of the Constitution.
De Kamer kan deze cijfers derhalve niet volgens artikel 68 van de Grondwet controleren.
Questions the effectiveness of the certificate given record infections and asks why it is proportionate to require it even in playgrounds affecting children.
Finds the justification of necessity, proportionality and duration too thin, and says the rushed treatment undermines parliament's controlling role.
The controlling role of parliament is hereby at stake.
De controlerende rol van het parlement komt hiermee in het geding.
Argues the medical basis is weak, creates social division, and asks for a hard sunset clause to guarantee temporariness.

The JA21 members ask whether the government realises that the socio-social, psychosocial, economic and political consequences of extending the scope of the certificate are so large that, even if this amendment proceeds, the intended temporariness must at least be guaranteed by a hard time limit.

De leden van de fractie van JA21 vragen of de regering zich realiseert dat de sociaal-maatschappelijke, psychosociale, economische en politieke gevolgen van het uitbreiden van het toepassingsbereik van het coronatoegangsbewijs dermate groot zijn dat zelfs wanneer deze wetswijziging doorgang vindt, de beoogde tijdelijkheid in ieder geval dient te zijn gewaarborgd door het opnemen van een harde termijn.
Asks what 'necessary' means and calls for a prompt evaluation of effectiveness before expanding the certificate, given the rise in infections.
The BBB member therefore thinks a prompt evaluation is necessary and a condition before proceeding to expand the corona entry pass.
Het lid van de BBB-fractie denkt daarom dat een spoedige evaluatie noodzakelijk is en een voorwaarde alvorens over te kunnen gaan tot uitbreiding van de coronatoegangspas.
Questions why the urgent procedure was needed when the government could have prepared over the past six months.
If the caretaker cabinet now considers this bill necessary, why have no preparations been made over the past six months and why was this bill suddenly submitted urgently to the Chamber?

Als het demissionaire kabinet het onderhavige wetsvoorstel nu nodig acht, waarom zijn de afgelopen zes maanden daarvoor dan geen voorbereidingen getroffen en waarom is dit wetsvoorstel ineens met spoed bij de Kamer ingediend?
Asks at which point the certificate would no longer suffice and stricter measures would be needed, and how non-covered sectors would still be controlled.
Can the government indicate at what point an entry certificate is no longer sufficient and stricter measures are needed?
Kan de regering aangeven op welk moment een coronatoegangsbewijs niet meer afdoende is en wel de meer beperkende maatregelen nodig zijn?
Asks for further substantiation of the claim that the certificate reduces risk outside events, and about mask rules and free testing.
These members therefore ask for further substantiation of the claim that the entry certificate reduces the risk of infection in other places where people gather, such as non-essential retail.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen derhalve een nadere onderbouwing van de stelling dat het coronatoegangsbewijs het risico op besmettingen reduceert op andere plekken waar mensen samenkomen, zoals in niet-essentiële detailhandel.
Argues that the broader certificate creates a false sense of safety, spreads infections among vaccinated people, and that effective basic measures are preferred.
Does the government agree with the BIJ1 member that more effective measures can be taken to halt the spread of the coronavirus?
Is de regering het eens met het lid van de fractie van BIJ1 dat er effectievere maatregelen kunnen worden genomen om de verspreiding van het coronavirus een halt toe te roepen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill extending the use of COVID-19 access certificates (coronatoegangsbewijzen) to non-essential retail and non-essential services in public places, accepting the public-health rationale but raising concerns about proportionality justification, coherence with other measures, scope clarity and implementability, and asking for a fuller explanatory memorandum. The Minister's nader rapport accepts the advice, adds a new section on implementation and administrative burden, and explains that concrete application will be set by ministerial regulation with flexibility.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to better motivate proportionality, including the effect on unvaccinated persons and the alternatives, which the government added to paragraph 4.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of how the extended certificate relates to other measures and their relative effectiveness; the government explained the case-by-case weighing but did not fully set out the interaction.

The Afdeling found the division into essential and non-essential categories somewhat arbitrary and asked for clearer, more consistent scope; the government kept the distinction but promised clear communication.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of feasibility, especially for small shops, given no consultation took place; a new section on implementation and administrative burden was added.
The Afdeling requested that the explanatory memorandum provide more insight into the criteria for possible differentiation under the ministerial regulation.

35970.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adding a 13th incidental supplementary budget for COVID-19 measures in amounts in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 19 November 2021 and makes no changes to statutory powers.
35970.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to COVID-19 measures, VAT changes on vaccines, and lower-than-expected uptake of care bonuses, without invoking new executive powers.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36069.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport through a fifth supplementary budget, adding €56.83 million in spending to the curative care article. The explanatory memorandum notes the ministry awards an emergency contract directly to a hospital network to take patients from neighbouring countries.
36069.j: The memorandum justifies direct award of a contract by reference to urgent necessity and a provision of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 allowing it.
q: To take over patients from neighbouring countries as quickly as possible, VWS awards this contract directly to the LNAZ because there is compelling urgency.
Om zo snel mogelijk patiënten vanuit buurlanden te kunnen overnemen, gunt VWS deze opdracht direct aan het LNAZ aangezien hier sprake is van dwingende spoed.

36078.s: The bill amends the transitional provisions of the Wet inburgering 2021 so that, for people still under the Wet inburgering 2013, the executive can by general administrative order grant more favourable rules on exemptions, deadline extensions, loan repayment and means testing. It also adds a power to set rules on offering guidance to speed up completion of integration obligations.
36078.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by pointing to hardship in the Wi 2013 'alles of niets' repayment rule already found disproportionate by courts, and by the need for legal certainty in naming the subjects that may be regulated.
q: This proposal provides a delegation basis so that the Besluit inburgering 2021 can provide for DUO to apply this ex officio.
Dit voorstel voorziet in een delegatiegrondslag, zodat in het Besluit inburgering 2021 kan worden voorzien in een ambtshalve toepassing hiervan door DUO.
d: favourable rules on exemptions, deadline extensions, loan repayment relief and means testing for Wi 2013 integrants
rules on offering guidance to integration obligors to speed up completion
further technical rules for proper execution of the transitional provisions
p: Allows the executive to depart by decree from Wi 2013 rules on exemptions, extensions and repayment, but only in the beneficiary's favour and within the listed subjects.

parties: Asks about the scope of the young-newcomer exemption, the effects of reducing exam attempts and retroactive loan relief, and the risk of unequal treatment between municipalities.

Does the government agree with the VVD that all status holders, especially young newcomers after education, must be sufficiently prepared to participate fully in Dutch society so they do not fall between two stools?

Is de regering het met de leden van de VVD-fractie eens dat alle statushouders, en met name jonge nieuwkomers na het volgen van onderwijs voldoende voorbereid moeten zijn om volwaardig te kunnen participeren binnen de Nederlandse samenleving om zo niet tussen wal en schip te vallen?

Supports the exemption for young newcomers but asks why retroactive effect is not applied to ex officio income assessment and why the hardship clause was dropped, and asks for proactive government outreach to inburgeraars.

These members ask whether the government has considered actively helping inburgering obligees and drawing attention to their rights when they may qualify for deferral, exemption, extension or other mitigating measures.

Deze leden vragen daarom of de regering heeft overwogen om inburgeringplichtigen vanuit de overheid actief te helpen en rechten onder de aandacht te brengen wanneer zij mogelijk in aanmerking komen voor uitstel, ontheffing, verlenging, vrijstelling of andere verzachtende maatregelen.
Asks about the estimated extra costs of municipal support for Wi2013 inburgeraars and whether municipalities will actively approach them.
The PVV asks the government what the estimated additional annual costs are of the proposed social guidance for Wi2013 inburgeraars up to 2027.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering wat de geschatte extra kosten zijn voor de voorgestelde mogelijkheid tot maatschappelijke begeleiding van inburgeraars Wi2013 per jaar tot 2027.
Welcomes that municipalities can better take individual circumstances into account, and asks about implementation costs, data exchange and the hardship clause.
They are pleased that this bill enables municipalities to better take into account the individual circumstances of inburgeraars.
Zij zijn verheugd dat gemeenten door dit wetsvoorstel beter in staat worden gesteld om rekening te houden met de individuele omstandigheden van de inburgeraars.

Regrets dropping the hardship clause, argues it gives legal certainty, questions the ex officio income assessment not applying retroactively, and asks whether pending litigation over loan repayment will be withdrawn.
The GroenLinks members deeply regret that the hardship clause was dropped from the latest version of the bill.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie betreuren ten zeerste dat de hardheidsclausule is komen te vervallen in de laatste versie van het wetsvoorstel.

Asks how the new delegation bases relate to a recent Raad van State ruling, for how many people the retroactive effect applies, and when lower regulation will follow; notes the Raad van State tension with keeping the 2013 Act in force.
Can the government explain the significance of these new legal bases in relation to the recent Raad van State ruling?
Kan de regering nader toelichten wat de betekenis is van deze nieuwe grondslagen in relatie tot de recente uitspraak van de Raad van State 11 ?
Asks whether municipal support remains feasible and affordable, whether data exchange between VNG and DUO is arranged, and that the evaluation of Wi2021 include these changes.
On the role of municipalities, the BBB member asks whether the support remains feasible and affordable.
Met betrekking tot de rol van de gemeenten vraagt het lid van de BBB-fractie zich af of de ondersteuning uitvoerbaar en betaalbaar blijft.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division accepts the bill's aims of softening transitional rules for Wet inburgering 2013 participants but asks the explanatory memorandum to justify why earlier objections to softer transitional law no longer apply and to clarify the scope and implementation consequences of the delegation powers. The minister's reply states the explanatory memorandum has been expanded and specified, that retroactive effect is added for debt forgiveness and is under study with DUO for other parts, and that the text was adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must explain why earlier objections to softer transitional rules (legal inequality, arbitrariness, legal uncertainty) no longer apply; the minister added clarification that the changes are softenings of the Wi 2013 regime.

The bill and explanatory memorandum insufficiently account for the implementation consequences of the delegation powers, as DUO and VNG make feasibility depend on lower regulation; the minister expanded the memorandum and is consulting DUO, but the bill itself was only partly adjusted.
The scope of the proposed delegation grounds for more favourable rules by AMvB is insufficiently clear; the minister specified the intended effects and groups concerned in the memorandum.

The bill has no retroactive effect unless intended, and the conditions must be clear; retroactive effect was added for debt forgiveness, with other items retroactive only to a date still to be determined depending on DUO feasibility.

36087.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB), adding a second incidental supplementary budget related to LNG import capacity at Eemshaven. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect from 17 March 2022, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB), all for the year 2022
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB), alle voor het jaar 2022

36100-IX.s: This Slotwet amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the 2021 budget of the National Debt (IXA) to reflect realised spending, income and commitments. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Following the 2021 audit, the Tax and Customs Administration revised downward its committed and outstanding obligations on the external staffing instrument by EUR 96 million.
De Belastingdienst heeft naar aanleiding van de accountantscontrole 2021 de aangegane en openstaande verplichtingen op het instrument «externe inhuur» voor € 96 mln. naar beneden bijgesteld.

36120-IV.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statements of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (Koninkrijksrelaties) and the BES-fonds, with first supplementary budget changes of 1,084 thousand euro in expenditure items and 4,926 thousand euro for the BES-fonds. It also sets the entry-into-force and retroactive effective date of 1 June 2022.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of Kingdom Relations and of the BES-fund, both for the year 2022
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties en van het BES-fonds, beide voor het jaar 2022

36120-VI.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security (VI) and the related agency budgets, mainly to fund asylum intake, Ukrainian refugee reception and counterterrorism and enforcement measures. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no shift of power to the executive, and only adjusts budget amounts and entry into force.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security (VI) for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the relevant statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (VI) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36159.s: The bill amends the Opiumwet to add a new List IA covering chemical structure groups of new psychoactive substances (NPS) and to prohibit their production, trade and possession. It also creates an exemption for industrial uses, lets the executive add or remove structure groups by general administrative order (AMvB), extends criminal penalties and investigative powers, and requires an evaluation report within five years.
36159.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB route as technical and necessary to respond quickly to new NPS variants, and notes that the Raad van State and NOvA raised legal-certainty concerns that were partly addressed by publishing the AMvB in the Staatsblad.
q: By general administrative order, a substance group may be added to List IA if two or more substances in that group are or are being added to List I.

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kan aan de bij deze wet behorende lijst IA een stofgroep worden toegevoegd indien twee of meer substanties die deel uitmaken van die stofgroep zijn of worden toegevoegd aan de bij deze wet behorende lijst I.
d: adding substance groups to List IA
removing substance groups from List IA
designating uses or products exempt from the prohibition
Artikel 8, lid 3 and 4 (via Art. I H)
minister grants exemptions for research, instruction, industrial use
Minister of LNV may provide personal data on hemp cultivation to investigating officers
p: The minister can add or remove whole substance groups from the criminal list by AMvB without a statute amendment, subject only to the condition that two substances in the group are already listed on List I.
Criminal liability extends to preparatory acts and to broadly described structure groups, with possession and trade offences and up to six years' imprisonment, expanding prosecutorial reach.[AT]
Artikel 9, lid 5 en Artikel 13b (via Art. I K, Q)
Investigative and administrative powers, including data sharing on hemp cultivation and mayoral closure orders, are extended to the new substance groups.[AT]

parties: Supports the changes but asks whether health risks of the new substances will be mapped and the Chamber informed, and how the ban will be communicated and monitored.
The members read that the precise health risks of these new substances have not yet been mapped but that it is plausible they can cause serious health damage.
De leden lezen dat de precieze gezondheidsrisico’s van deze nieuwe middelen nog niet in kaart zijn gebracht maar dat het aannemelijk is dat ze ernstige gezondheidsschade kunnen opleveren.

Questions the proportionality and evidence base of a generic ban, asks why the RIVM was not re-consulted, and asks for an evaluation framework; raises legality and rights-related questions about enforcement.
The D66 members find that the health risks of NPS have not been sufficiently mapped.
De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat de gezondheidsrisico’s van NPS-en onvoldoende in kaart zijn gebracht.
Supports the aim but asks why a ministerial-regulation route was not kept for urgent listing, whether the AMvB should be pre-submitted to parliament, and how risk assessments are timed.
The CDA members ask whether the government considered submitting the AMvB referred to in the second paragraph of the proposed Article 3aa to parliament for prior review.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering heeft overwogen om de AMvB, zoals bedoeld onder het tweede lid van het nieuw voorgestelde artikel 3aa voor te hangen bij het parlement.

Argues the list is a broad generic ban with a very wide criminal provision not clearly tied to proven harm; asks for scientific grounding, a precursor catch-all, and a broader review of drug classification.
In essence this bill is a generic ban on certain substance groups.
In essentie is dit wetsvoorstel een generiek verbod op bepaalde stofgroepen.
Raises the legality principle, noting that the Raad van State and others found tension with it, and asks how monitoring and proportionality will be ensured.
The GroenLinks members believe that safeguarding the legality principle is crucial.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn van mening dat het waarborgen van het legaliteitsbeginsel cruciaal is.
Strongly supports the bill to curb synthetic drug production and asks about the selection criteria, sentencing differences, and progress on earlier motions.
The ChristenUnie members fully support the aim of the law to curb the production and trade of new psychoactive substances.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie staan volledig achter het doel van de wet om de productie van en de handel in nieuwe psychoactieve stoffen tegen te gaan.
Supports swift banning but worries that three groups are not exhaustive, that producers will evade the ban, and that CAM risk assessments are slow and may have been done on thin data.
Asks whether harmless substances may be wrongly caught, and whether citizens can know which substances are banned, citing the Raad van State's call for proper public information.
To achieve the preventive aim, from the citizen's perspective it is important that clear communication takes place about which specific substances fall under the generic ban.

Om het preventieve doel te bereiken, is het daarom vanuit het perspectief van de burger van belang dat duidelijke communicatie plaatsvindt over welke concrete stoffen onder het generieke verbod vallen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill adding a third list (IA) to the Opiumwet to ban three chemical groups of new psychoactive substances generically, raising concerns on effectiveness, public health evidence, EU free movement justification, public order, and the lack of an evaluation clause. The government's nader rapport accepted most remarks, amending the explanatory memorandum, delisting provisions and adding an evaluation clause.
concerns: The Afdeling found the bill's effectiveness and efficiency insufficiently motivated, particularly the selection of broad substance groups and the lack of information on expected non-harmful substances caught by the ban.
The Afdeling found the explanatory memorandum did not explain how the RIVM 2012 conclusions against a generic ban were weighed, nor why RIVM was not asked to advise again.
The Afdeling found the justification for restricting free movement of goods under EU law (public health and public order) insufficiently substantiated, including scientific evidence of harm.
The Afdeling noted the public order justification required a fuller explanation of why the measure was necessary given the serious threat criterion.
The Afdeling advised that a substance group should be removed from list IA when it no longer meets the inclusion criteria, rather than leaving that to discretion.
The Afdeling advised including an evaluation clause after five years to assess intended and unintended effects of the bill.

36168.s: The bill adds a new article to the Aviation Act obliging the operators of Schiphol and nationally significant airports, and the civil operator at military airports, to supply on the Minister's request any data needed for the Minister's tasks and powers, within a reasonable period set by the Minister. It also makes several technical corrections, including a deadline extension for a review under Title 8A.
36168.j: The memorandum justifies the new information duty by the need for the Minister to obtain information quickly in exceptional cases to develop policy and exercise statutory tasks, noting it is expected to be used only rarely and that business-confidential data stays protected.
q: The article provides that the operators are obliged, at the request of the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, to supply information necessary for the fulfilment of his tasks and powers under the Aviation Act.

Het artikel regelt dat de exploitanten op verzoek van de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat verplicht zijn om informatie aan te leveren die noodzakelijk is voor de vervulling van zijn taken en bevoegdheden zoals neergelegd in de Wet luchtvaart.
d: manner and reasonable deadline for supplying requested data
p: The Minister gains a new power to demand operational, safety, environmental and usage data from airport operators, limited to what is necessary for the Minister's statutory tasks and to use only for those tasks, with confidentiality protection for business data.

parties: Asks why a statutory information duty is needed when operators have always complied, the scope of data, and possible fines or licence withdrawal if information is not provided on time.
These members want to know why this was nevertheless chosen and how much support there is among airport operators for continuing to voluntarily comply with information requests.
Deze leden willen weten waarom hier toch voor is gekozen en hoe het draagvlak onder luchthavenexploitanten is om vrijwillig te blijven voldoen aan informatieverzoeken.

Asks about the Council of State's view that the information duty is far-reaching, whether purpose limitation on use of collected information can be relaxed, and whether the scope can be framed with clear criteria.
The Council of State considers the proposed information duty far-reaching.
De Raad van State vindt de voorgestelde informatieplicht verstrekkend.
Supports the aim of stronger government steering but questions whether operators could invoke business confidentiality to avoid providing potentially adverse information.
These members do not think it wise to let airport operators themselves decide when something counts as business-confidential information.
Het lijkt deze leden niet verstandig om de luchthavenexploitanten zelf te laten bepalen wanneer iets als «bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie» moet worden beschouwd.

Welcomes the minister taking greater responsibility and needing binding access to all relevant information to weigh public interests against sector interests, and expects accountability to parliament.

For this it is very important that the Minister can also choose against the direct interest of the aviation sector, and that is only possible if operators are obliged to supply all relevant information.
Daarvoor is het van groot belang dat de Minister ook kan kiezen tegen het directe belang van de luchtvaartsector, en dat kan alleen als deze verplicht is om alle relevante informatie te leveren.
Criticises the lack of climate measures in the bill, the many past failures in environmental impact assessments, and asks why information duties cover only environment, safety and economy.
These members consider this an irresponsible choice and more than a missed opportunity.
Deze leden vinden dit een onverantwoorde keuze en meer dan een gemiste kans.
The VVD asks why the information obligation has no evaluation, what cases trigger it, how business information is protected, whether it is proportionate, and how other countries regulate this.
These members want to know why this has not been provided for and whether an evaluation of the information obligation will come.
Deze leden willen weten waarom dit niet is voorzien en of er een evaluatie van de informatieplicht komt.
The GroenLinks faction has taken note of the amendment and has no new questions.
The members of the GroenLinks faction have taken note of the further amendment and have no new questions about it.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de nadere wijziging en hebben hier geen nieuwe vragen over.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum to the bill introducing an information duty for civil airport operators should justify the choice for a statutory duty, address less far-reaching alternatives, specify the tasks and powers for which information is needed, and explain how the new duty relates to existing information obligations in the Wet luchtvaart. In its reply, the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management states that the memorandum was supplemented on these points, including the alternatives considered, the legal basis for the duty, and the distinction from existing obligations, and that the wording was adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to justify why a statutory information duty is necessary and to consider alternatives and less far-reaching forms; the memorandum was supplemented to explain that no less intrusive alternatives were identified.

The Afdeling asked for clarity on which concrete tasks and powers of the minister the information duty serves and whether these provide a sufficient basis; the memorandum was supplemented with specific Wet luchtvaart articles for environment, safety and economy.
The Afdeling suggested adding 'bij of krachtens deze wet' in article 8a.53a, first paragraph, which was adopted.

36177.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations through a second incidental supplementary budget, mainly to fund staff deployed for emergency asylum seeker reception. It takes effect on 26 July 2022, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
36177.j: The memorandum justifies the bypass by invoking the emergency provision of article 2.27(2) Comptabiliteitswet and notes the House was informed by letter on 26 July 2022.
q: This is done in accordance with paragraph 2 of article 2.27 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
Hiermee wordt gehandeld conform lid 2 van artikel 2.27 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016.
p: The explanatory memorandum says the government invoked article 2.27(2) of the Comptabiliteitswet to create the budget spending before parliament approved the supplementary budget, bypassing prior parliamentary authorisation, though it informed the House by letter beforehand.

36250-III.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) and the Commission for the Oversight of Intelligence and Security Services (IIIC) through a second supplementary budget. It raises General Affairs' receipts by 500 thousand euros, mainly from charging cabinet formation costs to the House of Representatives, and cuts the oversight commission's spending by 500 thousand euros due to delayed staffing expansion.
q: The expansion of the CTIVD has been delayed because the urgent bill has not yet been submitted to the House of Representatives.
De uitbreiding van de CTIVD is vertraagd doordat de spoedwet nog niet is aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer.

36267.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/2121 on cross-border conversions, mergers and divisions by amending Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code, including new rules for cross-border mergers and divisions, creditor and shareholder protections, and an expanded notarial fraud-check role. It also amends the Wet op het notarisambt so the notary can refuse to issue certificates where a cross-border operation serves unlawful or fraudulent purposes.
36267.j: The memorandum justifies the new notarial and KNB powers as necessary to implement the directive's requirement of a competent authority checking the legality of cross-border operations.
q: This further investigation takes place when the notary has serious doubts whether the cross-border operation was set up for unlawful or fraudulent purposes.
Dit nader onderzoek vindt plaats wanneer de notaris ernstige twijfels heeft of de grensoverschrijdende verrichting is opgezet voor onrechtmatige of frauduleuze doeleinden
d: KNB regulation giving further content to notarial fraud investigation in cross-border operations
p: Notaries gain additional powers to investigate and refuse certificates for cross-border operations suspected of fraud, with notary decisions subject to stated reasons and deadlines.

parties: Asks whether the fraud check should be assigned to a public body rather than notaries, and how digital implementation and legal basis for data processing are ensured.
Suggestions to assign the fraud check to a government body, for example Dienst Justis or the Chamber of Commerce (KvK), have not been examined.
Suggesties om de fraudetoets bij een overheidsinstantie te beleggen, bijvoorbeeld Dienst Justis of de Kamer van Koophandel (KvK), zijn niet onderzocht
Welcomes strengthened rights of stakeholders such as workers, shareholders and creditors, while asking about the scope and expected effects of the bill.
Asks whether the bill will substantially increase cross-border conversions, the regulatory burden, and court caseload, and whether delays arise from the interim solution.
These members ask the government whether it expects the bill to substantially increase the number of cross-border conversions.
Deze leden vragen aan de regering of zij verwacht dat middels dit wetsvoorstel de hoeveelheid grensoverschrijdende omzettingen daarmee ook grootschalig zal toenemen.
Worries about shell companies, tax and labour-law evasion, and asks that unions and works councils get free, accurate register information and that workers get longer consultation periods.
For these members it is important that workers are involved in decision-making under the law, the merger conduct rules and their articles of association.
Het is wat deze leden betreft belangrijk dat werknemers op grond van de wet, de Fusiegedragsregels en hun statuten worden betrokken bij besluitvorming.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division raised concerns about the implementation of the EU directive on cross-border conversions, mergers and divisions, including digital registration delays at the Chamber of Commerce, missing fiscal flanking measures, unclear effects on other legal fields, the wording of the fraud test, and language requirements for documentation. The minister's reply largely accepted these points by adding interim solutions, a timeline for separate fiscal measures, clarifications in the explanatory memorandum, and removing the 'onrechtmatig' qualifier, while keeping the bill's text unchanged.
concerns: Digital registration at the Chamber of Commerce may not be ready by implementation date, so interim solutions and a timeline were requested; the reply adds an interim manual procedure but leaves the bill text unchanged.

Lack of fiscal analysis and flanking measures for cross-border conversions creates legal uncertainty; the reply promises a separate bill with a target date of 1 January 2025 but gives only broad outlines.

Effects of cross-border conversion on social security, working conditions and supervision should be explained in the explanatory memorandum; the reply added clarification on continuity of legal personality and employment law.
The term 'onrechtmatig' added in brackets to 'omzeiling' in the explanatory memorandum is inconsistent with the directive and bill; the reply removed it.
The fraud test by the notary should clarify whether fiscal fraud is covered; the reply states the test does not extend to fiscal aspects and the memorandum was supplemented accordingly.

The explanatory memorandum should clarify language requirements for documentation such as the merger proposal; the reply clarified that Dutch is required and no alternative language is permitted for the proposal and articles amendment.

36276.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act so that the Amsterdam academic hospital becomes linked to both the public and the private University of Amsterdam, merging the academic hospitals there into a private-law foundation (Amsterdam UMC). It also changes governance rules for private academic hospitals, making their boards set rules in consultation with the affiliated universities, and transfers the assets and liabilities of the public AMC hospital to the new private entity.
36276.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to the need for more coordination between universities and academic hospitals and by stating that a general rule for mergers is deliberately not included, so future mergers still require a law change with parliamentary control.
q: As a result, future plans that substantially affect cooperation between public universities and academic hospitals in this way can again only proceed through an amendment of the law and the parliamentary control that goes with it.

Het gevolg is dat toekomstige plannen die de samenwerking tussen openbare universiteiten en academische ziekenhuizen op die manier ingrijpend raken wederom alleen via een wijziging van de wet, en de parlementaire controle die daarbij past, doorgang kunnen vinden.
d: conditions for private academic hospitals as funding conditions
p: Governance rules for private academic hospitals are set by their own boards in consultation with universities, removing the minister's role in appointing, suspending and dismissing supervisory board members.
The transfer of AMC assets and liabilities to the new Amsterdam entity happens by operation of law through the bill itself.

parties: Asks about the timeline for a broader legal framework for UMCs, the financing flows to Amsterdam UMC, and the reasons for delayed entry into force; no explicit check concern raised.
The VVD members have some questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben enkele vragen.

Asks for justification of the need for embedding UMCs in law and for information on the governance, decision-making and conflicts of interest of medical specialists, and asks what 'in afstemming met' means in the new rules.
These members therefore ask whether the government can briefly state the purpose and necessity of this and which goals must be achieved by including UMCs in the law.
Deze leden vragen daarom of de regering (kort) kan aangeven wat de nut en noodzaak hiervan is en welke doelen behaald moeten worden door het in de wet opnemen van UMC's.
Positive about the bill in its current form and supports a full merger of the two hospitals, asking how the human scale will be safeguarded for patients and students.
The PvdA members are positive about the intention of this bill in its current form.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie staan positief tegenover de bedoeling van dit wetsvoorstel in zijn huidige vorm.

Questions the construct of turning a public institution into a private one, asks why the reverse route was not chosen, and asks whether the minister can still exercise responsibility for the education system with reduced involvement.

Asks why the statutory rules on appointment, suspension and dismissal of management and supervisory board members, and the minister's role in appointing supervisory board members, will not apply to the Amsterdam UMC.

A consequence of this is that the statutory rules on appointment, suspension and dismissal of the management and supervisory board members will not apply, and the minister will have no role in appointing supervisory board members.

Een gevolg hiervan is dat de wettelijke voorschriften inzake benoeming, schorsing en ontslag van de leden van de raad van bestuur en van de raad van toezicht niet zullen gelden en dat de Minister geen rol heeft bij benoemingen van de leden van de raad van toezicht.
Sees no obstacle to a single organisation provided quality of care comes first and staff are not greatly burdened, conditionally accepting the merger.
The members therefore see no obstacle to giving this legal form as a single organisation with one system of working and one management structure, provided the quality of care always takes priority.

De leden zien dan ook geen belemmering om dit ook juridisch vorm te geven in de vorm van één organisatie met één systeem van werken en één leidinggevende structuur, mits de kwaliteit van de zorg altijd prioriteit krijgt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill merging the two Amsterdam academic hospitals and loosening the one-to-one university-hospital tie should be better justified in scope and timeline, given that the broader UMC legal framework is postponed. The minister's reply defends limiting the change to Amsterdam, extends the joint policy and executive body provisions to mixed arrangements, and sets out a 2023 exploration timeline.
concerns: The Council questioned why the bill includes UMC-related provisions while the broader UMC framework is postponed, and asked for a clearer timeline; the minister added clarification and a 2023 exploration timeline but kept the provisions.

The Council asked for a justification of why the one-to-one university-hospital relationship is loosened only for Amsterdam, questioning whether physical proximity is decisive; the minister argued the Amsterdam case is special and no general rule is needed.
Technical corrections and typographical errors in the bill and explanatory memorandum were made ex officio.

36285.s: The bill assigns the Authoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) supervision and enforcement of EU Regulation 2019/1150 on fairness and transparency for business users of online intermediation services, including power to impose binding conduct orders, penalty orders and administrative fines up to 10% of turnover. It also clarifies in the Civil Code and Code of Civil Procedure how collective actions under Article 14 of the regulation relate to Dutch rules.
36285.j: The memorandum justifies the new ACM powers by the risk that civil enforcement and out-of-court dispute resolution will not function effectively, leaving harm to business users unremedied.
q: The risk therefore exists that infringements by platforms against entrepreneurs remain «unpunished» and that harm to the collective interests of entrepreneurs persists.
Het risico bestaat dus dat inbreuken van platforms jegens ondernemers «onbestraft» blijven en dat daardoor schade aan de collectieve belangen van ondernemers blijft bestaan.
d: binding conduct orders imposed by ACM
penalty orders and administrative fines by ACM
p: ACM may impose binding conduct orders before any violation is established, a preventive power over platforms.
ACM may impose penalty orders and fines up to 10% of turnover, subject to appeal to the Rotterdam court and College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.

parties: Asks what assessment framework the ACM will use to decide when the impact of an individual signal justifies action, and how effective the bill is against foreign platforms.
The VVD members ask what assessment framework the ACM will use to determine whether the impact is so large for other entrepreneurs.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen welk afwegingskader de ACM zal hanteren bij het bepalen of de impact dusdanig groot is voor andere ondernemers?
Asks whether ACM action and collective action are sufficient to protect entrepreneurs who may refrain from going to court because of dependence on platforms.
Is the ACM's focus on collective action sufficient to secure the position of entrepreneurs against powerful multinationals, which these online intermediation services sometimes are?
Is de inzet van de ACM op collectieve actie voldoende om de positie van ondernemers te borgen tegenover machtige multinationals, wat deze onlinetussenhandelsdiensten soms zijn?
Supports a public supervisor but worries about fragmented national enforcement, unequal playing field in Europe and the need for EU-level norm interpretation.
These members support the intention to appoint a public supervisor to effectively supervise the conduct of online platforms towards their business users.
Deze leden steunen het voornemen om een publieke toezichthouder aan te stellen om effectief toezicht te houden op het gedrag van online platforms ten aanzien van hun zakelijke gebruikers.
Asks whether the threshold for small entrepreneurs to report to the ACM is too high and whether the ACM has sufficient capacity.
In that context they ask the government whether the threshold for small entrepreneurs to report to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) may not be too high.
In dat kader vragen zij de regering of de drempel voor kleine ondernemers om melding te maken bij de Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM) niet te groot kan zijn.
Asks whether Dutch courts should have jurisdiction over foreign P2B violations and over admissibility of representative organisations, and how the ACM can act when cases run abroad.

The ChristenUnie members ask the government, from the perspective of consumer protection and protection of (third-party) providers through collective action, to address the desirability of giving Dutch judges jurisdiction over P2B Regulation violations that took place abroad.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering om uit het oogpunt van consumentenbescherming en bescherming van (derde-)aanbieders middels het instellen van een collectieve actie in te gaan op de wenselijkheid om aan Nederlandse rechters de bevoegdheid toe te kennen om zich uit te spreken over schendingen van de P2B-verordening die hebben plaatsgevonden in het buitenland.
Asks whether the scope of the regulation is proportionate and whether the ACM has enforcement capacity.
Is there capacity within the ACM for this and how does the ACM stand in this regard?
Is er hiervoor binnen de ACM capaciteit en hoe staat de ACM hierin?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the bill establishing public supervision and enforcement by the ACM of the P2B regulation, raising concerns about overlapping, extraterritorial national supervision regimes and the lack of budgeted resources for the ACM. The government's reply accepts the need for EU-level coordination, commits to raising it in regular consultation, and adds the required funding of 5 fte (EUR 620,000) to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: Advice to take the initiative at EU level to coordinate how public supervision of the P2B regulation is organised, given the risk of a patchwork of national regimes; the government agrees on the need but points to existing regular consultation rather than new initiative.
Advice to take into account the relationship with forthcoming EU digital regulation (DMA and DSA) in the explanatory memorandum, which the government added.
Advice to explain the financial consequences for the ACM as required by the Comptabiliteitswet, which the government addressed by adding structural funding to the explanatory memorandum.

36339.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2021/2118 amending the motor vehicle liability insurance directive into Dutch law, amending the Wet aansprakelijkheidsverzekering motorrijtuigen and the Wft. It extends compulsory insurance and cross-border claims handling, creates a Waarborgfonds Motorverkeer role when insurers become insolvent, and lets an AMvB exclude certain low-risk vehicles from the insurance obligation and designate countries for coverage.
36339.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB power by the need for flexibility as innovation in light electric vehicles develops, and notes monitoring of damage claims to decide whether insurance obligations remain necessary.
q: To prevent the insurance obligation from going further than necessary, this bill provides a basis to exclude such motor vehicles from the scope of the WAM by general administrative order.

Om te voorkomen dat de verzekeringsplicht verder gaat dan noodzakelijk is, voorziet dit wetsvoorstel in een grondslag om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur dergelijke motorrijtuigen alsnog van de reikwijdte van de WAM uit te sluiten.
d: exclude low-risk vehicles from motor vehicle definition
designate countries for cross-border insurance coverage
further rules on fund tasks and reimbursement procedure
further rules on fund tasks and reimbursement procedure
p: An AMvB may exclude certain low-risk vehicles from the compulsory insurance regime, with the criteria set by the directive.

parties: Asks which vehicles (e-bikes, fatbikes, speed pedelecs, e-scooters) fall under compulsory insurance after the bill, how enforcement works, and how exemptions for low-risk vehicles are determined.
These members ask whether, after this implementing act takes effect, there will be an insurance obligation for the electric scooter.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of er na invoering van deze implementatiewet een verzekeringsplicht is voor de elektrische step.

Asks about the boundaries of the insurance obligation given new mobility vehicles, who bears damage caused by uninsured vehicles, and whether the government will reflect on broader liability insurance.
For whose account does the damage come in that case, ask these members.
Voor wiens rekening komt de schade in dat geval, vragen deze leden.
Asks how the directive is being implemented in other EU member states, especially neighbouring countries, and how future implementation will take shape.
These members are curious how the introduction of the directive is proceeding in other EU member states, particularly in the countries around the Netherlands.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd naar hoe de invoering van de richtlijn in andere EU-lidstaten verloopt, met name in de landen om Nederland heen.

Questions the government's choice not to use the maximum room to exempt certain vehicles, asks for justification of the lack of need for exemptions, and asks how exemptions for low-risk vehicles will be interpreted and how automatic enforcement and fines will change.
Why is the maximum use not made of the possibility to grant an exemption from the insurance obligation for vehicles used exclusively in areas with restricted access?

Waarom wordt er niet maximaal gebruikgemaakt van de mogelijkheid om een vrijstelling te verlenen van de verzekeringsplicht voor voertuigen die uitsluitend worden gebruikt in gebieden met beperkte toegang?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State had no remarks on the draft Implementation Act for the sixth motor vehicle insurance directive and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) notes minor clarifications, notably on insolvency-fund financing and the limitation period for claims against the Waarborgfonds Motorverkeer.

36357.s: This omnibus bill amends several health-sector statutes (Alcohol Act, Youth Act, Tobacco Act, Health Care Market Regulation Act, Health Insurance Act and others) mostly with technical corrections. Its substantive core creates a new Health Insurance Act article 68b allowing reimbursement of care costs for persons who become insured retroactively under EU/UK rules, with the amount and procedure to be set by ministerial regulation.
36357.j: The memorandum justifies the subdelegation in the Alcohol Act and the new reimbursement power by the detailed nature of the rules and the practical need to handle a small number of complex cases through ministerial regulation.
q: Given the detailed elaboration of this, it is considered desirable to allow subdelegation in article 11d, second paragraph, of the Alcohol Act.
Gelet op de gedetailleerde uitwerking hiervan, wordt het wenselijk geacht om in artikel 11d, tweede lid, van de Alcoholwet subdelegatie mogelijk te maken.
d: social hygiene requirements for diplomas, now also by ministerial regulation
application, amount, conditions and payment of reimbursement and contribution, data processing
retroactive effect of insurance beyond the civil code limit
indexation of registration and recognition fees by representative professional bodies without ministerial approval
notice in the Staatscourant of application of EU device regulation provisions
p: Gives the CAK discretion to decide reimbursement and set contributions, with key rules left to ministerial regulation and a right of objection and appeal against its decisions.
ARTIKEL IX B (Zvw art. 68b, lid 9 en 10)
Allows a ministerial regulation to set a different decision period and allows retroactive insurance in departure from the Civil Code, with objection and appeal still open.
ARTIKEL XIX (Wet op de zorgtoeslag art. 5, lid 3 en 4)
Deems affected persons to have filed timely applications for care allowance, departing from the general general income-dependent rules in favor of administrative decision-making."},{

parties: Asks why the tobacco-law changes are not listed among the substantive amendments and asks about the expected effect of the online sales ban on smoking.
The VVD members note that the changes in Article III (Tobacco and Smoking Products Act) are substantive but are not mentioned in the list of substantive changes in the introduction.

De leden van de VVD-fractie merken op dat de wijzigingen in Artikel III (Tabaks- en rookwarenwet) inhoudelijke wijzigingen betreffen maar dat deze niet in worden genoemd in de opsomming van de inhoudelijke wijzigingen in de inleiding.
Asks whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens will be consulted before a ministerial regulation sets further rules on processing personal data, and asks about legal protection against a CAK decision.
Can the government commit that, before this regulation takes effect, advice will first be sought from the Dutch Data Protection Authority?
Kan de regering toezeggen dat alvorens deze regeling in te laten gaan, eerst advies daarover wordt ingewonnen bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens?
Asks why the tobacco-law amendment is omitted from the list of substantive changes and requests an explanation.
The PVV members want to know why Article III, amendment of the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act, is not included in the list of substantive changes.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten waarom artikel III, wijziging van de Tabaks- en rookwarenwet, niet in de opsomming van de inhoudelijke wijzigingen is opgenomen.

Questions the broad delegation under the medical devices article, asking whether reuse of single-use devices can proceed without per-patient request and whether the change is open-ended, and asks about the impact of administrative burden on small providers.
May devices that have once been within a care institution also be reused if safety is guaranteed?
Mogen hiermee middelen die eenmaal binnen een zorginstelling zijn ook opnieuw inzet worden als de veiligheid is gegarandeerd?
Supports making the health-insurance extension optional on request to avoid large back payments for people, but asks whether tax and premium back payments will also arise.
This prevents, among other things, people from being confronted with high back payments.
Dit voorkomt onder andere dat mensen geconfronteerd worden met hoge nabetalingen.

Questions the workability of the annual public accountability duty for small first-line providers stemming from the Ellemeet amendment and asks whether it should be reversed; also asks for technical clarification of who is responsible for sports prostheses.
