This accountability obligation, arising from the Ellemeet amendment, appears to encounter many barriers at small first-line care providers.
Deze verantwoordingsplicht, die voortkomt uit het amendement Ellemeet c.s., blijkt op veel drempels te stuiten bij kleine zorgaanbieders in de eerste lijn.
Asks why the tobacco-law amendment is not listed among the substantive changes in the explanatory memorandum introduction.

The BBB member asks the government to explain why Article III, amendment of the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act, is not included in the list of substantive changes in the introduction to the explanatory memorandum.

Het lid van de BBB-fractie vraagt de regering om toe te lichten waarom Artikel III, wijziging van de Tabaks- en rookwarenwet, in de inleiding van de memorie van toelichting niet in de opsomming van de inhoudelijke wijzigingen is opgenomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Verzamelwet VWS 2023, noting that the proposed expanded definition of cross-border distance selling under the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act was unclear about which foreign affiliates and Dutch subsidiaries fall under the planned sales ban, and advised clarifying this in the explanatory memorandum. The minister's reply accepts the point, explains how the establishment criterion applies to foreign branches, subsidiaries and factual activities in the Netherlands, and amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The scope of the cross-border distance selling definition and ban is unclear for foreign affiliates, Dutch subsidiaries and wholly foreign companies with Dutch activities, which affects enforcement.

36375.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to clarify that persons threatened with environmental damage may request the competent authority to take preventive or remedial measures, implementing Directive 2004/35/EC on environmental liability. It also adds a right for such persons to appeal the authority's decisions to the administrative court, and removes the separate mention of government bodies from the list of persons who may make such requests.
36375.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to complete implementation of the EU Environmental Liability Directive, which requires access to a court for persons threatened with environmental damage.
q: By legally ensuring that natural and legal persons threatened with environmental damage have access to the administrative court in all cases
Door wettelijk te verzekeren dat natuurlijke en rechtspersonen die milieuschade dreigen te lijden, in alle gevallen toegang tot de bestuursrechter hebben
p: Artikel I, onderdeel A (artikel 17.15, eerste lid, Wet milieubeheer)
Extends the standing of persons threatened with environmental damage to request measures from the competent authority, widening citizens' ability to trigger executive action.
Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 20.2 Wet milieubeheer)
Gives persons threatened with environmental damage a right to appeal decisions on measures to the administrative court regardless of standing as interested party.

parties: Asks how the amendment fits the Council of State's earlier ruling on non-parties appealing environmental decisions and why interpretation was chosen over other means.
Can the government explain how this relates to the Council of State's May 2021 ruling, which showed that non-stakeholders can appeal an environmental decision?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe dit zich verhoudt tot de uitspraak van de Raad van State uit mei 2021, waaruit bleek dat niet-belanghebbenden in beroep kunnen gaan bij een omgevingsbesluit?
Stresses that persons suffering or threatening environmental harm must be able to claim their rights and request enforcement, and asks what the amendment changes for their position.
For these members it is essential that persons who suffer or threaten to suffer environmental damage can obtain their right and ask the competent authority for enforcement.
Voor deze leden is het essentieel dat personen die onder milieuschade lijden of dreigen te lijden hun recht kunnen halen en het bevoegd gezag kunnen verzoeken om handhaving.
Asks whether the precautionary principle is anchored in the Environmental Management Act and whether it should be written in, and whether air quality targets should be legally binding.
Does the government intend to legally anchor the targets of the Clean Air Agreement in the Environmental Management Act?
Is de regering van plan om in de Wet milieubeheer de doelen uit het SLA wettelijk te verankeren?
Asks what counts as threatened environmental damage, how it must be substantiated to withstand objection or appeal, and for foreign case law on successful use of the provision.
They ask the government how this must be substantiated so that it can withstand an objection or appeal procedure.
Zij vragen op welke wijze dit onderbouwd moet worden, zodat dit stand kan houden in een bezwaar- of beroepsprocedure.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft bill amending the Environmental Management Act to implement the Environmental Liability Directive, and advises submitting it to the House of Representatives. The government's reply (nader rapport) reports minor changes: removal of a clause referring to article 8:1 of the General Administrative Law Act and addition of a concurrence provision.
concerns: The Afdeling had no substantive remarks; the government made minor drafting changes, removing a clause on article 8:1 Awb and adding a concurrence provision in article II.

36384.s: The bill amends the Wet tijdelijke tolheffing Blankenburgverbinding en ViA15 and the Tunnelwet Westerschelde to implement the revised Eurovignette Directive, mainly by adding a ban on discrimination by nationality, establishment, registration or origin/destination of transport in toll charging and renaming a ministry. It also changes the wording of the exemption rules and sets a payment deadline by ministerial regulation derogating from the general administrative law default.
36384.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation for the payment deadline by noting that the Awb already contains a standard term, so the change is technical.
q: By ministerial regulation a term may be set, departing from article 4:112 of the General Administrative Law Act, within which the holder must pay after a reminder.
Bij ministeriële regeling kan, in afwijking van artikel 4:112 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht, een termijn worden gesteld
d: payment deadline after reminder for toll

parties: Supports harmonised EU policy and the explicit ban on nationality-based discrimination in the toll laws, and has no further remarks or questions.
It is therefore a good development that this prohibition is explicitly adopted in the Westerschelde Tunnel Act and the Temporary Toll Levy Blankenburg Connection and ViA15 Act (Wet TTH).
Het is derhalve een goede ontwikkeling dat het verbod hierop expliciet overgenomen wordt in de Tunnelwet Westerschelde en de Wet tijdelijke tolheffing Blankenburgverbinding en ViA15 (Wet TTH).
Calls the use of the exemption from CO2-class toll differentiation a precarious process and asks about communication with the European Commission and the associated risks.
The members of the CDA faction consider the use of the exception not to differentiate the toll rate by CO₂ emission class a precarious process.
De leden van de CDA-fractie achten het gebruik van de uitzondering om het toltarief niet te differentiëren naar CO₂-emissieklasse een precair proces.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill's invocation of the Eurovignette directive's exemption from CO2-based toll differentiation for the Blankenburgverbinding and ViA15 needs a fuller justification and renewed notification to the Commission. The minister's reply argues the exemption conditions are met until the truck charge starts, has the Commission's confirmation, and has adjusted the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification that the conditions of the Eurovignette exemption are met and renewed notification to the Commission; the government argues the conditions are met until the truck charge starts, the Commission has confirmed this, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of the explanatory memorandum on use of the exemption, which the government addressed by adding and amending passages.

36393.s: The bill makes multilingual day-care (German, English or French for up to 50% of the daily opening time) structurally permitted in childcare centres, replacing the previous annual-basis rule and the buitenschoolse opvang definition. It adds a power to set by general administrative order (AMvB) conditions for temporary deviation from the 50% daily maximum in cases of illness, holiday or other leave.
36393.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB delegation as a way to avoid overly rigid rules in incidental situations such as staff illness or leave, and notes that conditions will be set in the Besluit kwaliteit kinderopvang.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further rules are laid down on the conditions for deviating from the percentage referred to in the fourth paragraph.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld omtrent de voorwaarden voor afwijking van het percentage als bedoeld in het vierde lid.
d: conditions for temporary deviation from 50% daily maximum

parties: Doubts the urgency of the bill given Raad van State and VNG concerns and asks for justification and whether an evaluation clause should be added.
Given these concerns and the partly unadopted advice of the Council of State, the VVD members doubt the need to pass the amendment urgently.
Gezien deze zorgen en de gedeeltelijk niet overgenomen adviezen van de Raad van State twijfelen de leden van de VVD-fractie aan de noodzaak om de wetswijziging met spoed door te voeren.
Questions the necessity of the bill and asks why it should not wait for the outcomes of the evaluation studies, given their limited scope.
Why does the government not first await the results of these studies, so that a sound assessment of necessity and need can take place before this bill is submitted?
Waarom wacht de regering niet eerst de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken af, zodat er een gedegen afweging over nut en noodzaak kan plaatsvinden, alvorens dit wetsvoorstel in te dienen?

Supports permanent anchoring but asks whether languages should be set in an AMvB rather than the statute, whether an extra evaluation is needed, and how inconsistent local GGD enforcement will be prevented.

Specifically on multilingualism, these members ask how the government intends to prevent local GGD health services from interpreting the rules so differently that some violations lead to a fine in one municipality but not in another.

Specifiek over meertaligheid vragen deze leden hoe de regering wil voorkomen dat ook op het gebied van meertaligheid verschillende lokale gemeentelijke gezondheidsorganisaties (GGD's) de regels op een dermate andere manier uitleggen dat sommige overtredingen in de ene gemeente wel en in een andere gemeente niet tot een boete leiden.
Asks whether other languages will be facilitated and about likely regional differences in access to multilingual care.
To what extent does the government expect regional differences to arise in access to multilingual childcare?
In hoeverre verwacht de regering dat er regionale verschillen ontstaan wat betreft de toegang tot meertalige opvang?
Asks whether multilingual care will be facilitated in other languages and about likely regional differences in access.
Is the government intending to make multilingual care possible in other languages? Why or why not?
Is de regering voornemens mogelijk te maken meertalige opvang te faciliteren in andere talen? Waarom wel of niet?
Accepts multilingual care in principle but insists on priority for Dutch language development and asks about staffing challenges and whether further languages would require a statutory amendment.
The child's development in Dutch language proficiency should be given priority.
De ontwikkeling van het kind in de Nederlandse taalvaardigheid dient prioriteit te krijgen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill on structural multilingual daycare in childcare centres (English, French or German for up to fifty percent of opening hours) is supported in principle but should explain why quality requirements for multilingual and other-language childcare are not harmonised at the same time, and should address how accessible such care will be in practice given risks of segregation. The minister's reply largely accepts the point on accessibility and explains that the quality requirements for other-language childcare need more time and will follow by 1 January 2025.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the government to motivate why quality requirements for multilingual daycare are not harmonised in parallel with those for other-language childcare, creating two regimes until January 2025; the reply explains timing constraints but does not fully motivate the choice.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address how accessibility of multilingual daycare will work in practice, given the risk of segregation by income and education level; the reply adds clarifying text on accessibility and parental choice.

36429.s: The bill lowers the own contribution (basishuur) in the rent allowance (huurtoeslag) from 1 January 2024 by fixed annual amounts subtracted from the norm rent, with amounts declining over the years to 2029. It is a statutory reduction because the government cannot yet lower norm rents by general administrative order.
36429.j: The memorandum explains the reduction is set in statute because lowering norm rents by general administrative order is not yet possible.
q: It is not yet possible to lower the norm rents by general administrative order (a deduction) to arrive at the basishuur.
Het is nog niet mogelijk om de normhuren bij algemene maatregel van bestuur te verlagen (een afslag) om zo tot de basishuur te komen.

parties: Asks the government to explain the effect of the bill on the poverty trap and marginal pressure.
The VVD members ask whether the government can explain what effect the bill has on the poverty trap and marginal pressure.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering kan toelichten wat het effect is van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel op de armoedeval en de marginale druk.
Sees the bill as an important improvement in purchasing power for many rent-allowance households.
The SP members see in the bill an important improvement in purchasing power for many households receiving rent allowance.
De leden van de SP-fractie zien in het wetsvoorstel een belangrijke verbetering voor de koopkracht voor veel huishoudens die een huurtoeslag ontvangen.
Questions whether an income-related allowance is the best tool against poverty and asks why alternative parameter choices were not made, while considering the measure insufficient.
At the same time these members ask, as with the child-related budget, whether raising an income-dependent allowance is the best means of reducing poverty.
Tegelijkertijd vragen deze leden – net als bij het kindgebonden budget – of het verhogen van een inkomensafhankelijke toeslag het beste middel is om de armoede te verlagen.
Asks whether the bill was integrated with the Wet vereenvoudiging huurtoeslag given the overlap.
Has the government considered integrating this bill with another bill before the House, namely the Wet vereenvoudiging huurtoeslag?
Heeft de regering overwogen het onderhavige wetsvoorstel te integreren met een ander wetsvoorstel dat in de Kamer voorligt, namelijk de Wet vereenvoudiging huurtoeslag?
Questions the design of the phased reduction, the causal link between general and child poverty, and the distribution of the relief across households.
On what is that one-to-one causality between general and child poverty based?
Waarop is die één op één causaliteit tussen algemene en kinderarmoede gebaseerd?
Notes the 14% budget increase in a context of wanting to reform or restrict the benefits system, and asks about alternatives outside the allowance system.
While there is a broad desire to reform and/or restrict the allowance system.
Dit terwijl er een brede wens leeft om het toeslagenstelsel te hervormen en/of in te perken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet verlaging eigen bijdrage huurtoeslag for 2024 and later, raising no remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's accompanying letter transmits the advice and bill to the King without any further substantive reply.

36435-V.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for 2023, adjusting appropriations and receipts for policy articles and non-policy articles as set out in the attached statement. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 19 September 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken voor het jaar 2023

36447.s: The bill amends the Dutch Caribbean Aviation Act (Luchtvaartwet BES) to create a regulatory framework for unmanned aircraft flights on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, classifying them into open, specific and certified categories. It replaces the Minister with 'Onze Minister' throughout, and adds article 15 allowing rules by general administrative order (AMvB), zones designated by ministerial regulation, and exemptions granted by the Minister.
36447.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for an operation-based, proportionate, risk-based framework developed with an expert group and the island authorities, and by the need to implement details in lower regulation.
q: Under the third paragraph, geographic zones may be designated above which flights with unmanned aircraft in certain or all categories or subcategories are restricted, prohibited or subject to prior permission.

Op grond van het derde lid kunnen geografische gebieden (zones) worden aangewezen waarboven vluchten met onbemande luchtvaartuigen in bepaalde of alle categorieën of subcategorieën worden beperkt, verboden of onderworpen aan voorafgaande toestemming.
d: rules for flights of unmanned aircraft in open, specific and certified categories
subcategories, air traffic participation, and authorisation procedure for unmanned flights
designation of geographic zones restricting, prohibiting or conditioning unmanned flights
minister may grant exemptions or dispensations from the rules for flights of general interest
p: The minister may grant exemptions from the unmanned flight rules where necessary for a statutory task, with conditions attached, without parliamentary involvement.

parties: Asks whether the government will act on the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport's request to review the planned AMvB and ministerial regulation, and asks about the extra costs for operators.
The PVV members note that the ILT asks the government to have the planned general administrative orders (AMvB) and the ministerial regulation reviewed.
De leden van de PVV-fractie constateren dat de ILT de regering verzoekt om een toets te laten doen op de geplande algemene maatregelen van bestuur (AMvB) en de ministeriële regeling.
Has read the bill with interest and has no further questions.
The VVD members have read the bill with interest and have no further questions about it.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover geen verdere vragen.
Has no questions or comments on the bill.
The NSC members have read the bill with interest and have no questions or comments.
De leden van de NSC-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen vragen of opmerkingen.
Asks why detailed rules are left to lower regulation rather than formal law, whether the ILT was consulted, and how enforcement, oversight and the certified category will be monitored.
They note that the bill provides the framework and that further rules will not be laid down in formal legislation.
Zij nemen er kennis van dat het onderhavige wetsvoorstel het kader vormt en dat verdere regelgeving niet in formele wetgeving wordt vastgelegd.
Asks whether the list of four considerations is exhaustive, why EU rules were judged too heavy, and why all drone owners must register online.
The BBB members ask the government to explain why current European drone regulation was considered too burdensome to introduce on the BES islands.

De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen aan de regering of zij nader kan toelichten waarom de huidige Europese regelgeving voor onbemande luchtvaartuigen te zwaar zou zijn bevonden om in te voeren op de BES-eilanden?
Asks whether and how the government will act on the ILT's request to review the planned AMvB and ministerial regulation.
The CDA members, like the PVV, would like to know whether and how the government will act on the ILT's request to have the planned AMvBs and the ministerial regulation reviewed.

De leden van de CDA-fractie horen, net als de PVV-fractie, graag of en zo ja hoe de regering uitvoering gaat geven aan het verzoek van de ILT om een toets te laten doen op de geplande AMvB’s en de ministeriële regeling.

v.summary: The Raad van State Afdeling advisering issued an advisory opinion on a bill amending the Luchtvaartwet BES to introduce a regulatory framework for unmanned aircraft flights on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, finding no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport confirms that the opinion gave no reason for substantive remarks and that only minor textual additions were made to the explanatory memorandum.

36483.s: The bill gives the Minister of Health (VWS) a direct steering power over the director of public health of the municipal health service (GGD) to take medical-operational measures during an epidemic of a group A infectious disease or a direct threat of one, and adds a basis for general rules on how municipal health services carry out infectious disease control tasks and for a specific grant covering their costs. It also extends the cost-reimbursement rule to these measures and provides a separate steering regime for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
36483.j: The memorandum justifies the direct steering power by the need for speed, agility and uniformity in crisis control during an epidemic that cannot be fought at regional level, and notes that a limited list of activities would leave gaps.
q: This is to promote the speed and agility of crisis control and better ensure uniformity in the implementation of medical-operational facilities.
Dit om de snelheid en wendbaarheid van de crisisbestrijding te bevorderen en de uniformiteit beter te borgen in de uitvoering van de medisch-operationele voorzieningen
d: Minister directs the director of public health to take medical-operational facilities
Specifying which facilities count as medical-operational facilities
Rules on how municipal executives have GGD carry out infectious disease control tasks
Practical rules on how municipal executives have GGD carry out tasks, e.g. ICT
Rules on height, granting, settlement and reclaiming of the specific grant
p: The Minister can bypass the veiligheidsregio chair and directly order the director of public health to take medical-operational measures during an epidemic, with only an immediate notification duty to the regional chair.
Extends the national cost-reimbursement rule to measures ordered directly on the director of public health.

In Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba the Minister can steer the executive college directly, bypassing the island governor's usual role, and the memorandum notes this may limit differentiation through emergency ordinances.

parties: Considers the amendment premature before the COVID evaluation is finished, and worries that local municipal council input is lost in collective measures.
local input through the municipal council is important for public support for collective measures.
lokale inspraak, middels de gemeenteraad, belangrijk is voor het draagvlak van collectieve maatregelen
Supports the amendment but asks whether the warm/cold phase distinction is clear and whether regional flexibility remains.
Does this room remain with this bill?
Blijft deze ruimte bestaan met dit wetsvoorstel?
Supports the bill but asks for written recording of decisions when the Minister steers, and for clarity on the link with the crisis emergency law.
They ask the government whether, when there is decision-making rather than mere information provision, explicit written minutes are kept.
Zij vragen de regering of wanneer er sprake is van besluitvorming in plaats van enkel informatievoorziening, er wel expliciet schriftelijke verslaglegging plaatsvindt.
Asks whether additional measures are needed for uniform execution and how responsibilities of DPG, safety region chair and mayor are divided.
how the link between the Wpg and Wvr does justice to the different powers of the DPG, safety council chair and mayor.
hoe bij de aansluiting tussen de Wpg en Wvr recht wordt gedaan aan de verschillende bevoegdheden DPG, voorzitter veiligheidsraad en burgemeester
Asks how the OVV recommendation on safeguarding the independent position of administrators and experts is implemented in the bill.
ask the government how this recommendation is followed up in the amendment proposal.
vragen de regering op welke manier deze aanbeveling wordt opgevolgd in het wijzigingsvoorstel
Worries that the state gains more control over individual medical decisions, undermining patients' right to self-determination, and that regional flexibility must be kept.
patients have the right to self-determination and the right to choose the care they want.
patiënten het recht op zelfbeschikking hebben en het recht om zelf de zorg te kiezen die zij wensen
Asks for a planning update on further tranches, why the existing steering option was not used during COVID, and clarity on the definition of medical-operational facilities.
ask whether the government agrees with the OVV that this option existed.
vragen of de regering het met de OVV eens is dat deze mogelijkheid bestond
Asks how broad the Minister's power is, and objects to limiting GGD autonomy on purely financial grounds without consulting GGDs and municipalities.
Was this weighing also discussed with the GGDs and municipalities, and if so, do they agree with this limitation of their autonomy?
Is bij deze afweging ook overlegd met de GGD'en en de gemeenten en zo ja, zijn die het met deze beperking van hun autonomie eens?
Supports the aim but asks for the decision framework, epidemiological threshold for direct steering, regional differentiation, and clarity on democratic control.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Public Health Act to give the Minister of VWS direct steering power over the GGD public health director and a basis for national rules on infectious disease control, recommending narrowing overlapping powers, requiring consultation before directions in the cold phase, and limiting rule-making to A-diseases. The government's reply largely accepts the recommendation to remove steering of the safety region chair on medical-operational facilities and to add a consultation duty, while defending the broad rule-making basis for all infectious diseases.
concerns: Steering of the safety region chair and of the GGD director on medical-operational facilities should not overlap; the chair's steering power on these matters was removed.

Direct ministerial instruction to the GGD director in the cold phase should be preceded by rule-making and consultation; the government added a consultation duty but limits the instrument to crisis phase.

Rule-making basis should be limited to A-infectious diseases because municipal autonomy makes ministerial rules for B1, B2 and C diseases inappropriate; the government keeps the broad basis for efficiency and IT standardisation reasons.

36546.s: The bill amends the Youth Act and related laws to improve availability of youth care and certified institutions by requiring municipalities to form regional Jeugdregio cooperation, have the Dutch healthcare authority (NZa/zorgautoriteit) investigate and signal shortages, and impose internal supervisory boards, financial transparency and annual public reporting on providers. It gives the NZa new supervisory, instruction, fine and enforcement powers and delegates detailed rules (regio-indeling, service lists, derivatives, board structure) to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
36546.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for a proportionate, workable and flexible regulatory framework given the diversity of providers and the need to ensure availability of specialised youth care.
q: Concretely, areas can be designated by general administrative order (amvb) within which municipalities must cooperate for the performance of tasks assigned to them under the Youth Act and other laws.

Concreet kunnen bij algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) gebieden worden aangewezen waarbinnen gemeenten moeten samenwerken met het oog op de uitvoering van de aan de gemeenten bij of krachtens de Jeugdwet en andere wetten opgedragen taken.
d: youth care forms to be contracted or subsidised regionally or cross-regionally
administrative processes for contracting and subsidies
mandatory national contracting organisation for specific youth care forms
detailed requirements for internal supervisory board structure
which financial derivatives providers may use and under what conditions
content and format of financial accountability and publication
data the healthcare authority provides to municipalities and regions
categories of data and personal data the authority may collect and retain
categories of personal data the authority may share with other bodies
authority may publish instructions immediately in urgent cases, overriding normal open-government procedures
p: Gives the national healthcare authority broad powers to investigate, signal and direct municipalities and regions on youth care supply, shifting power from local government to a national regulator.
Authorises the healthcare authority to issue instructions, penalty payments and administrative fines of up to EUR 500,000 against youth providers and certified institutions.
Allows the authority to publish instructions immediately, without hearing interested parties or waiting for the normal period, when availability of youth care is at stake.
Extends the authority's access to information, including limited health and criminal-law personal data of young people and parents, for supervision and early warning.
Obliges municipalities to form regions and delegate contracting powers to a Jeugdregio, with the Ministers able to direct regional bodies on youth care.

parties: Asks whether the bill's regional cooperation instruments will work and how national and regional youth care providers will be financed, and raises concern about the delegation provision and continuity of care.
Various organisations indicate that, for the sake of continuity and availability of care, the delegation provision should in fact be handled promptly, contrary to the government's wish.

Diverse organisaties geven aan dat er in verband met de continuïteit en beschikbaarheid van de zorg, in tegenstelling tot de wens van de regering, er juist voortvarend omgegaan zou moeten worden met de delegatiebepaling.
Questions whether the regional procurement model and the AMvB-based list of care forms are sufficiently democratically controlled, and whether a children's rights check has been carried out.
Can the government explain why it was chosen to lay this down in an AMvB rather than in this bill?
Kan de regering uitleggen waarom er gekozen is om dit in een AMvB vast te leggen en niet in dit wetsvoorstel?
Asks for concrete justification of each new power the bill grants and for a timeline on when the Chamber can expect a bill on the scope of the youth care obligation.
The VVD asks the government to explain explicitly, for each power this proposal offers, its usefulness and necessity, and to justify why the government currently has too few powers.
De leden vragen de regering om per bevoegdheid die dit voorstel biedt expliciet het nut en noodzaak nader toe te lichten en te verklaren waarom de regering nu te weinig bevoegdheden heeft.
Warns the bill could increase coercive youth care and out-of-home placements, may conflict with the IVRK and EVRM, and that the child's voice must always be heard.
For the NSC members it is of great importance that out-of-home placement and coerced youth care are prevented as much as possible through new legislation.
Voor de leden van de NSC-fractie is het van groot belang dat uithuisplaatsing en gedwongen jeugdhulpverlening met nieuwe wetgeving zoveel mogelijk wordt voorkomen.
Welcomes the bill as contributing to future-proof youth care and asks for clarification of regional cooperation and the planned lower regulation.
These members are of the view that it is essential that the most vulnerable children and young people also have access to good and, where needed, specialist youth care.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het essentieel is dat ook de meest kwetsbaren kinderen en jongeren toegang hebben tot goede en – waar nodig – specialistische jeugdzorg.
Sees regional procurement as an improvement but worries that democratic control by councils and the Chamber will be weaker, and asks why commercial providers and budget ceilings are not removed.
Asks how the Jeugdregio will be constituted, the criteria for regional robustness, and the degree of council involvement, and questions the Raad van State advice that was not adopted.
Can the government elaborate on the form and composition of this Jeugdregio, as well as the manner of appointment and the degree of participation of municipal councils?
Kan de regering nader ingaan op de vorm en samenstelling van deze Jeugdregio, alsmede de wijze van aanstelling en de mate van inspraak van gemeenteraden hierbij?
Questions the bill's length and complexity, the tension with decentralisation principles, and whether regional cooperation truly addresses access problems rather than labour shortages.
These members point out that the government itself states in section 3.3.2 that municipal councils will be further removed and will find it harder to steer.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat de regering zelf in paragraaf 3.3.2 stelt dat de gemeenteraden meer op afstand komen te staan en dat zij minder gemakkelijk kunnen sturen.
Asks what effects the bill will have on other forms of youth care and how to prevent an attraction effect toward more intensive care.
How does the government intend to prevent the bill from having an attraction effect toward more intensive forms of youth care?
Op welke manier wil de regering voorkomen dat het wetsvoorstel een aanzuigende werking op de zwaardere vormen van jeugdzorg tot gevolg heeft?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid jeugdzorg, raising concerns about the vagueness of 'beschikbaarheid', the choice against national financing, the level of delegation to ministerial regulations, the proportionality of governance requirements for youth care providers, and the NZa's tasks. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, adjusting the bill (e.g. moving key provisions to AMvB, adding Minister BZK co-signature, removing 'in ieder geval', clarifying NZa roles) while rejecting others such as national financing and the removal of the interne toezichthouder requirement.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clarity on the core concept of 'beschikbaarheid' and its scope beyond existing municipal duties; the government clarified the term in the bill and memorandum.

The Afdeling asked why specialist youth care is not procured and financed nationally by the Rijk; the government rejected this alternative, keeping regional and national collaboration under municipal responsibility.
The Afdeling criticised delegating core provisions (youth care types, regio-indeling) to ministerial regulation; the government moved them to AMvB with voorhang procedure.

The Afdeling advised that the Minister of BZK co-sign the regulations on tasks and regional division given her responsibility for intergovernmental relations; the government adopted co-signature for the AMvB on regional division.

The Afdeling found the mandatory internal supervisor for youth care providers with more than ten staff disproportionate and advised raising the threshold; the government considered it proportionate and kept it.

The Afdeling advised differentiating open annual reporting requirements by provider size and reconsidering the lack of phased-in transition; the government added size differentiation to the reporting rules but kept no postponement.
The Afdeling asked for clarity on NZa's advisory versus supervisory roles and the norms for early warning; the government clarified NZa's advisory role and warning procedure in the memorandum.

The Afdeling objected that processing special personal data by ministerial regulation insufficiently respects Article 10 of the Constitution; the government defended ministerial regulation while adding safeguards and explanation.

36550-X.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (first supplementary budget), raising total expenditure commitments and expenditure by about 858.6 million euro and 66.3 million euro in mutations, with a reallocation of funds between articles. It also sets the unit of account in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 June 2024.
36550-X.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by interdepartmental budget transfers and lower spending due to personnel shortfalls, without any delegation of power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2024
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2024

36555.s: The bill amends the Higher Education and Research Act to require ministerial consent before a degree programme or track may be taught in a language other than Dutch, adds language policy duties for institutions, and allows admission caps on programmes for capacity reasons, including differentiated caps against non-EEA students. It also revises the rules for ministerial withdrawal or restriction of consent for foreign-language teaching and sets an evaluation obligation.
36555.j: The memorandum justifies the new consent and admission powers by the need to safeguard the quality and accessibility of higher education amid internationalisation and capacity shortages, and as the minister's stewardship responsibility.
d: rules on implementing duty to promote students' Dutch language proficiency
Artikel I, E (art. 6.3, vijfde en zesde lid)
criteria and procedure for assessing consent for foreign-language programmes
programmes deemed evidently efficient to teach in another language, exempted from the Dutch-language rule
further rules on differentiated admission caps
further rules on emergency admission caps
differentiated admission caps for certain programmes
p: The minister gains a consent requirement over foreign-language programmes, decided on criteria set by amvb and advised by a committee, with a reasoned-departure duty.
The minister may withdraw or restrict previously granted consent for foreign-language teaching if conditions are no longer met, with appeal only to the Council of State.
Institutions may set maximum intake and differentiate between EEA and non-EEA applicants, including emergency caps on short notice, subject to notification and appeal."}],

parties: Expresses some support but keeps open questions, especially on sanctions for non-compliance with the language provision in the WHW.
Mainly on sanctions for poor compliance with article 7.2(c) WHW, but first these members will put some other points to the government.
Voornamelijk inzake sancties bij een slechte naleving van artikel 7.2 lid c WHW, maar eerst zullen deze leden wat andere punten aan de regering voorleggen.
Worries the bill and budget cuts will harm science, internationalisation and regional labour markets, and asks for tailored treatment for regions and a longer transition period.
These members have great concerns about the new coalition's plans on science, research and education.
Deze leden hebben grote zorgen over de plannen van de nieuwe coalitie omtrent wetenschap, onderzoek en onderwijs.
Broadly supports the measures but asks for information on the numerus fixus use, premaster rules and differences between hbo and wo.
These members broadly endorse the proposed measures but naturally have additional questions.
Zij onderschrijven in grote de lijnen de voorgestelde maatregelen, maar hebben vanzelfsprekend nog aanvullende vragen.
Asks what the bill's effects will be, whether students can complete programmes started in another language, and how institutions will be financially affected.
Is it now guaranteed that all students can at least complete their programme?
Is nu gegarandeerd dat alle studenten hun opleiding in ieder geval kunnen afmaken?
Asks about the omkeerregeling for mbo, the basis for expected rising demand after the urennorm change, and room for accessibility for lower-income international students.
They ask the government why the reversal scheme is not part of the law.
Zij vragen de regering waarom de omkeerregeling geen onderdeel is van de wet.
Agrees with the committee questions and supports strengthening Dutch language use in higher education.
These members see the need to ensure that Dutch as a language is preserved and strengthened in hbo and wo.
Deze leden zien de noodzaak om te borgen dat het Nederlands als taal in het hbo en wo behouden blijft en wordt versterkt.
Questions the many delegation provisions and whether the act's scope can be overseen, and asks about the perverse funding incentive and labour market needs.
The bill contains various delegation provisions, namely seven. The CDA members find this a lot.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat diverse delegatiebepalingen, namelijk zeven. Dit vinden de leden van de CDA-fractie veel.
Fears heavy administrative burden and insufficient attention to regional differences, asking how funding will avoid closures in sparsely populated areas.
They do fear that the new doelmatigheid framework creates a huge administrative burden that still does not adequately reflect the specific circumstances of certain regions and institutions.

Zij vrezen wel dat het nieuwe kader voor doelmatigheid een enorme lastendruk oplevert die uiteindelijk nog niet voldoende recht doet aan de specifieke omstandigheden van bepaalde regio's en instellingen.
Welcomes the bill, seeing it as important for keeping Dutch in education and for greater grip on student flows, while asking about funding effects.
In that context they welcome the bill.
In dat kader verwelkomen zij het wetsvoorstel.
Worries about reputational damage abroad, quality effects of planned budget cuts, and a possible repeat of Denmark and UK style restrictions.
Asks about the relationship between self-regulation by institutions and the bill, and about outcomes if cluster applications fail, raising unclear procedural safeguards.
Can the government explain how self-regulation and the bill relate to each other?
Kan de regering uitleggen hoe zelfregie en het wetsvoorstel zich tot elkaar verhouden?
Concerned that delegation to lower regulation limits the role of the House after the bill is passed and asks for more clarity before plenary debate.
The role of the House is limited after adoption of this bill.
De rol van de Kamer is na aanneming van dit wetsvoorstel beperkt.
Asks for impact studies and inventories before the bill is voted on and questions the legal basis and justification for categorical exemptions.
These members consider it very important to know the effects of this bill before it is voted on.
De leden van de D66-fractie vinden het van groot belang te weten wat de effecten zijn van dit wetsvoorstel voordat over dit wetsvoorstel wordt gestemd.
Questions whether stakeholders including unions and works councils are sufficiently consulted and whether the bill is legally sound given top-down steering.
Does the government think it is legally tenable to steer from above which fields may see growth in international intake?
Denkt de regering dat het juridisch houdbaar is om van bovenaf te sturen op welke vakgebieden wel groei van internationale instroom mag plaatsvinden?
Requests a prior-consultation clause (voorhang) so Parliament can review the general administrative order that will determine how the law works.
They also request that the government add a prior-consultation provision to this bill.
Tevens verzoeken zij de regering om in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel een voorhangbepaling toe te voegen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wet internationalisering in balans, which introduces tools to curb international student inflows, an evaluation test for English-taught programmes, and stronger Dutch-language policy, while raising concerns about legal certainty, proportionality, personnel availability, the hbo/wo distinction, financing of the expanded language duty, EU-law justification, and the mbo reversal scheme. The minister's nader rapport accepts many points, adds cluster-application and consultation obligations, a clearer ultima-remedium framing and an explicit EU-law justification, rejects overgangsfinanciering and the hbo exemption, and drops the mbo reversal scheme.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the ultimum-remedium character of the evaluation of existing English-taught programmes be expressed in the statutory text; the government clarified it in the explanatory memorandum but kept intervention as last resort tied to refusal and withdrawal rather than the test itself.

The Afdeling asked that the preference for joint cluster applications and an obligation to consult be written into the law; the government added these to article 6.4 WHW but left the precise clustering to the sector.

The Afdeling noted that the statutory criteria did not clearly allow personnel availability to be weighed; the government removed it as a standalone criterion and clarified its role in setting transition periods.

The Afdeling questioned whether the language measure is indirect discrimination against EU citizens; the government justified it under articles 18 and 21 TFEU with protection of Dutch language and culture.

The Afdeling asked for justification of the differentiation between EEA and non-EEA students in fixus measures; the government explained the test of significant share and risk of displacement in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked whether the numerus fixus per 2025–2026 via the budget amendment is feasible given DUO and Studielink testing; the government only noted that implementation depends on institutions' system readiness.
The Afdeling asked for overgangsfinanciering for institutions losing English-taught programmes; the government declined, relying on transition periods and the T-2 funding system.

The Afdeling advised exempting hbo or applying a lighter regime given its limited internationalisation; the government refused the exemption but acknowledged the differences and promised a tailored elaboration.
The Afdeling asked that the cost estimate of the expanded Dutch-language duty be improved and that additional funding be provided; the government considered it covered by the existing lump sum.
The Afdeling asked for the mbo reversal scheme to be removed as it is only loosely connected; the government dropped it from the bill.
The Afdeling asked for consultation of the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak on court consequences; the government reported informal contact and judged formal advice unnecessary.

36582.s: The bill amends the Participatiewet and the IOAW, IOAZ and related welfare laws to ease benefit rules: it extends income disregards for people who work alongside benefits, adds a buffer budget, broadens 'maatschappelijke participatie' as a duty, and gives municipalities and the SVB more discretion, including 'kan' clauses, backdated benefits and a wider experiment article. It also harmonises rules for young people, partner norms and asset treatment, and simplifies income and identity verification.
36582.j: The memorandum justifies the new discretion and delegations by saying rigid rules cause hardship and that individual cases need tailored solutions that general rules cannot capture.
q: Behind that power lies the recognition that situations may arise in which the basic rule chafes, but that those situations cannot be captured in general rules.
Achter die bevoegdheid gaat de erkenning schuil dat er situaties kunnen optreden waarin de basisregel knelt, maar dat die situaties niet in algemene regels zijn te vervatten.
d: Art. I.N (art. 20 Pw, new para 3-4) and Art. I.P (art. 24a Pw)
municipal discretion to raise norms for young people and single parents
Art. I.L (art. 18 Pw, para 7) and Art. II.H / III.I (IOAW/IOAZ art. 20 para 5)
rules on benefit reduction for non-compliance with obligations, possibly waiving reduction
rules on reducing social assistance for non-compliance, SVB may waive reduction
rules on how income is taken into account, deductions, holiday allowance and technical errors
exemptions from listed articles via general administrative order for pilot/experiment purposes
municipal experiments deviating from listed articles, extended to five years and maatschappelijke participatie
p: Art. I.L (art. 18 Pw) and Art. I.EE (art. 47c Pw)
Benefit sanctions become subject to executive-determined rules via general administrative order, with discretion to waive reductions.
Experiment article extended in scope and duration, allowing municipalities to deviate from listed statutory provisions for up to five years.
Art. I.Y (art. 41 Pw, para 11-12) and Art. I.BB (art. 44 Pw, para 5)
Municipalities gain discretion to accept late applications and to grant benefits up to three months retroactively based on individual circumstances.

parties: Argues the Participatiewet is too complex and harsh, that citizens are treated as fraudsters, and that proactive provision of benefits and clear rules are needed.
People cannot get by on their benefit, are treated as fraudsters in advance and often have little prospect.
Mensen komen niet rond van hun uitkering, worden bij voorbaat behandeld als fraudeur en hebben vaak weinig perspectief.
Welcomes a shift from distrust to trust and questions why the four-week search period is kept as a discretionary rule rather than abolished, asking for a clear rationale.
Municipalities get the option not to apply the four-week search period for young people if there is a reason for it.
Gemeenten krijgen de mogelijkheid de zoektermijn voor jongeren van vier weken niet toe te passen als daar een reden voor is.
Asks how the gift exemption threshold of 1,200 euro was chosen and how the duty to record gifts fits realistic expectations of citizens' capacity.
Can the government reflect on how this relates to realistic expectations regarding people's capacity to act?
Kan de regering reflecteren op de vraag hoe dit zich verhoudt tot realistische verwachtingen ten aanzien van het doenvermogen?
Argues distrust and coercive measures harm benefit recipients, that retaining the duty to disclose gifts breeds distrust, and that kan-provisions create unequal treatment across municipalities.
By distrusting people on benefits who need help and using coercive measures to get them into the labour market, no one is helped.
Door mensen met een bijstandsuitkering en die hulp nodig hebben te wantrouwen en dwangmaatregelen te gebruiken om ze op de arbeidsmarkt te krijgen, wordt niemand geholpen.
Asks how discretion exercised through the human scale will be applied, how citizens can object, and where citizens can turn for legal protection if municipalities go too far.
They ask where residents can turn if municipalities go too far, and whether that is only with the same municipality or elsewhere too.
Zij vragen waar inwoners terecht kunnen als gemeenten hierin te ver gaan, en of dat alleen bij diezelfde gemeente is, of ook ergens anders.
Asks how officials are supported and checked to apply the wider discretion in balance without arbitrariness, and questions the risk of political colour influencing use of the kan-provision.
Regarding the balance between needed discretion and the risk of arbitrariness, these members ask how implementers are supported and equipped to apply the law in balance.
Ten aanzien van de balans tussen benodigde ruimte en het risico op willekeur vragen deze leden op welke manier uitvoerders worden ondersteund en toegerust om de wet in balans toe te passen.
Asks for clear concrete grounds for the kan-provision on the search period and whether municipalities will be monitored, and whether gift exemptions could become income policy by municipalities.
Do municipalities have guidelines for this that also ensure limited differences between municipalities?
Hebben gemeenten handvaten hiervoor, die ook zorgen voor beperkte verschillen tussen gemeenten?
Asks how the balance between trust and human scale on one side and citizens' duties on the other is secured, and what the timeline is for further steps.
These members ask the government to elaborate on the intended balance between trust and human scale on the one hand and responsibility and duties of citizens on the other.
Deze leden vragen de regering nader in te gaan op het beoogde evenwicht tussen vertrouwen en menselijke maat enerzijds en verantwoordelijkheid en plichten van de burger anderzijds.
Asks how the notion of trust is anchored in the law and in its implementation.
These members ask the government to what extent the concept of 'trust' is anchored in the Participatiewet.
Deze leden vragen de regering in hoeverre het begrip «vertrouwen» verankerd is in de Participatiewet.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill adjusting the Participatiewet to balance benefit security, reintegration and enforcement, raising concerns on labour market access, municipal implementability, a categorical special assistance enabling clause, and the spouse exception. The minister's reply accepts most points, including adding a feasibility section and broader labour-market analysis, but withdraws the categorical assistance enabling clause.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for explanation of the bill's effects on labour market access and a fundamental rethink of participation policy (spoor 2); the reply adds clarification in the explanatory memorandum and a broader spoor 2 framing.

The Afdeling finds the feasibility and personnel and financial consequences for municipalities insufficiently explained; the reply adds a feasibility section but defers financial detail to lower regulation.
The Afdeling finds the statutory basis for categorical special assistance by AMvB insufficiently motivated and lacking safeguards; the government withdraws the provision from the bill.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to justify keeping the exception for first-degree relatives in the cohabitation rule under the equality principle; the reply gives a rationale for maintaining it.

36609.s: The bill amends the Dutch Minimum Tax Act 2024 to align it with internationally agreed administrative guidance, covering qualifying instruments, currency conversion, joint ventures, transitional rules and hybrid arrangements. It also adds delegations for detailed rules via AMvB or ministerial regulation and extends some filing, payment and penalty deadlines for transitional years.
36609.j: The memorandum justifies the new delegations by saying the detailed rules are needed for consistency with the July 2023 OECD administrative guidance and that moving an existing delegation to the correct article is logical.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further rules are laid down on determining the value of the lessee's rights of use.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden nadere regels gesteld over het bepalen van de waarde van gebruiksrechten van de lessee
d: defining material competitive distortion for domestic top-up tax
valuing lessee right-of-use assets in operating leases
purchase price adjustments in qualifying financial accounting
local accounting standards where prescribed by a state's law

parties: Asks how the bill is ensured to be fully consistent with the Dutch legal order and whether it tests against legal certainty, proportionality and equality.
These members ask how it is ensured that this legislative amendment is fully in line with the Dutch legal order?
Deze leden vragen hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat deze wetswijziging volledig in overeenstemming is met de Nederlandse rechtsorde?
Supports tackling tax avoidance but asks for information on the Geerdink motion, evaluation of tax schemes and a promised letter on refundable tax credits.
Notes critical voices on Pillar Two and asks for more careful legislation, clarity on administrative guidance, and supports consultation of the Council of State via an AMvB.
The VVD members further support changing a ministerial regulation into a general administrative order so that the Council of State can also issue an advice.
De leden van de VVD-fractie ondersteunen voorts de wijziging van een ministeriële regeling naar een algemene maatregel van bestuur, zodat ook de Raad van State een advies kan uitbrengen.
Supports the minimum tax but asks how inconsistent entry into force and retroactivity across jurisdictions will be handled and what happens in cases of double taxation.
These members ask whether the Dutch application of the rules then remains unchanged because of this fact.
Deze leden vragen of de Nederlandse toepassing van de regels dan ongewijzigd van toepassing blijft door dit feit.

36613-X.s: This bill amends the 2024 Ministry of Defence budget schedules, including the agency and budget fund schedules, adding about 8.97 billion euro to the defence materiel budget fund and reallocating funds across defence articles. It makes the amendments effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 17 September 2024.
q: The change of EUR 8,965.1 million concerns the contribution from the Defence budget chapter X to chapter K, the Defence Materiel Budget Fund, for expenditure to be accounted for through the fund.

De mutatie van € 8.965,1 miljoen betreft de bĳdrage vanuit de begroting Hoofdstuk X Defensie aan hoofdstuk K Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds ten behoeve van uitgaven die op het fonds worden verantwoord.

36618.s: The bill amends the Meststoffenwet to bring manure production ceilings in line with the EU derogation decision, lowering the national and sectoral manure production caps and raising the levies (afroming) on phosphate, pig and poultry production rights when rights transfer or farms change hands. It also adds delegation grounds allowing the sectoral ceilings, the afroming percentages and related rules to be set later by general administrative order (AMvB) and ministerial regulation.
36618.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to adjust ceilings and percentages quickly without a lengthy legislative procedure, and notes the 30 percent cap limits the executive's room.
q: The cabinet considers that undesirable. The design of the delegation basis ensures that the percentage cannot be set higher than 30%.
Het kabinet acht dat onwenselijk. Met de vormgeving van de delegatiegrondslag is geborgd dat het percentage niet hoger kan worden vastgesteld dan 30%.
d: Artikel II, onderdeel A (artikel 18a, tweede–vierde lid)
maximum annual manure production per livestock sector
Artikel II, onderdelen B en C (artikelen 32 and 32a)
percentage of production rights that is afgeroomd on transfer
Artikel II, onderdeel D (artikel 33, eerste en achtste lid)
afroming percentage on farm transfer, capped at 30 percent
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 33, zesde en zevende lid)
rules on notification of farm transfers and exceptions to afroming
Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 32, vierde lid)
conditions or limits on notification of transfers of pig or poultry rights
p: Key quantitative ceilings and afroming percentages move from statute to AMvB, so future changes no longer require a legislative procedure, though the 30 percent cap is fixed in the bill.
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 33) and artikel 32a
The bill clarifies and extends the afroming obligation on farm transfers and gives the minister power to set notification rules and exceptions by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks how the government expects to stay under the manure ceiling and whether the excretion correction will be applied in 2024 and the levy will be scaled back if ceilings are not exceeded.

The PVV members ask whether the government can explain how it arrived at the expectation that the Netherlands will not stay under the manure production ceiling, taking into account farms that stop and the excretion correction for dairy cattle.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of de regering kenbaar kan maken hoe tot de verwachting is gekomen dat Nederland niet onder het mestproductieplafond blijft, daarbij meewegend de bedrijven die stoppen evenals de excretiecorrectie bij melkvee.

Doubts the effectiveness of the measures, notes a residual phosphate gap, and questions why the government lowered levy percentages despite the Raad van State ruling that earlier percentages were insufficient.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members are surprised that the government chose to lower the levy percentages while the Council of State ruled in August that even the old percentages were insufficient.

De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie zijn verbaasd dat de regering ervoor heeft gekozen om de afromingspercentages te verlagen terwijl de RvS in augustus oordeelde dat ook de oude percentages onvoldoende waren.
Asks for justification of the sectoral split and whether the Chamber can be involved, suggesting a post-adoption (nahang) procedure for AMvB-set ceilings.
They ask the government whether this delegation basis can provide for conditional delegation whereby an adopted AMvB is submitted to the Chamber via a post-adoption procedure.
Zij vragen de regering of deze delegatiegrondslag kan voorzien in een voorwaardelijke delegatie waarbij een vastgestelde AMvB via een nahang aan de Kamer wordt overlegd.
Asks which pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure will involve parliament in changing sectoral ceilings by AMvB, and asks about the generic cut risk and exemption of grondgebonden dairy farms.
These members ask the Minister which pre-consultation procedure she envisages for this delegation basis to involve parliament in changing the sectoral manure production ceilings.
Deze leden vragen de Minister welke voorhangprocedure zij voor ogen heeft bij deze delegatiegrondslag om het parlement te betrekken bij het wijzigen van de sectorale mestproductieplafonds.
Asks about the risk of infringement and loss of derogation if the national ceiling is exceeded, and about the basis for the assumed 65 percent uptake of the cessation schemes.
They ask the government to explain from when and on what basis there is a risk of infringement proceedings.
Zij vragen de regering toe te lichten vanaf wanneer en op basis waarvan er een risico is op ingebrekestelling.
Strongly objects to levies on animal rights in pig and poultry sectors and to levies on farms switching legal form, arguing it limits the choice of legal vehicle.
These members consider the proposal to go very far.
Deze leden vinden het voorstel erg ver gaan.

Warns that levies on leasing will endanger farms dependent on leased rights, asks for a practical test, and objects to the wide delegation for changing ceilings and levy percentages without a voorhang provision.
The SGP members have serious doubts about the broad delegation basis to change both sectoral ceilings and levy percentages.
De leden van de SGP-fractie zetten grote vraagtekens bij de ruime delegatiegrondslag om zowel sectorplafonds als afromingspercentages te wijzigen.
Accepts the necessity of the amendment but asks for justification of the sectoral percentages and for measures in sectors without rights systems such as veal and goat farming.
They recognise that the changes are necessary and that the consequences for farmers in the Netherlands can be serious.
Zij onderkennen dat de wijzigingen noodzakelijk zijn en dat de gevolgen voor veehouders in Nederland serieus kunnen zijn.

Argues the plan is a further weakening of earlier proposals, that the cause of the manure problem is not addressed, and that expanding manure spreading near Natura 2000 areas may breach water and habitat rules.
The PvdD members have noted with disappointment the amendment to the Meststoffenwet.
De leden van de PvdD-fractie hebben met teleurstelling kennisgenomen van de wijziging van de Meststoffenwet.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill amending the Fertilisers Act to implement the maximum manure production ceilings in the EU derogation decision for 2025, raising concerns about whether the proposed 30% levy is sufficient and proportionate across sectors, and advised against submitting it unless amended. The minister's reply adopts the advice by revising the sectoral ceilings and levy percentages (30% dairy, 25% pigs, 15% poultry) and clarifying the measures, while acknowledging the dairy sector may still fall short and that further measures may be needed.
concerns: The Council doubted whether the proposed levy measures alone would reduce manure production below the 2025 EU ceiling and asked for reasoned justification or additional measures.
The Council argued that applying the same 30% levy across dairy, pig and poultry sectors, despite different reduction needs, was legally vulnerable and required reasoned justification.

36636.s: The bill replaces Book 1, Chapter 10, and Books 7 and 8 of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure on the enforcement of criminal decisions, assigning enforcement responsibility primarily to the Minister and setting out detailed rules on supervision, conditional sentences, detention, parole, the raadkamer procedures, and remedies. It is largely a technical restructuring that clarifies the division of tasks between the Minister and the public prosecution service.
36636.j: The memorandum justifies the Minister's enforcement responsibility by pointing to the practice and need for a clear, person-focused and effective enforcement system, and states that the detailed regulation is technical and not policy-changing.
q: The enforcement of criminal decisions, criminal-procedure decisions involving deprivation of liberty and other criminal-procedure decisions takes place through Our Minister.
De tenuitvoerlegging van strafrechtelijke beslissingen, strafvorderlijke beslissingen tot vrijheidsbeneming en andere strafvorderlijke beslissingen vindt plaats door Onze Minister.
d: Minister may delegate exercise of his powers to civil servants under his responsibility
Minister may give general or specific enforcement orders to police and other officials
Algemene maatregel van bestuur may set further rules on enforcement and on allocation of fine revenue to public-law bodies
Further rules on suspension and postponement of enforcement, including timing of gratie-related suspension
Further rules on enforcement orders for arrest
Further rules on supervision of compliance including reclassering work
Place and manner of payment or deposit of sums under conditions
Further rules on penal interruption and assessments of placement in forensic institutions
Further rules on decisions setting special conditions for conditional release
p: Assigns enforcement of criminal decisions to the Minister, clarifying existing division of responsibility with the prosecution service.
Allows the prosecutor or assistant prosecutor to order arrest of a conditionally released person on suspicion of breach, subject to rapid judicial review by the rechter-commissaris.
Prosecutor may revoke conditional release on a serious suspicion of breach, with immediate enforceability and a later appeal route.
Allows enforcement of judgments after service of notice even while appeal is pending in some cases, with suspension in other cases.
Gives enforcement officials powers to enter and search premises and to use investigative powers to locate persons subject to enforcement.

parties: Asks whether the burden on courts of the hearing duty for tbs detainees is considerable and how the effectiveness of the extended termination of tbs for foreign nationals will be monitored.
The PVV members ask how the government will monitor the effectiveness of the expanded possibilities to terminate tbs for a foreign national.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven hoe zij de effectiviteit van de uitbreiding van mogelijkheden tot beëindiging van een tbs bij een vreemdeling gaat monitoren.
Asks how the Public Prosecution Service can execute decisions without an explicit statutory basis and whether unclear responsibilities caused problems in practice.

These members therefore understand that clarification is needed on this point, but what does it mean that the Public Prosecution Service carries out this part of enforcement without that explicit statutory basis?

Deze leden begrijpen daarom dat het op dit punt nodig is om verduidelijking te bieden, maar wat betekent het dat het OM zonder die expliciete wettelijke grondslag dit deel van de tenuitvoerlegging verzorgt?

Asks why the government did not share the judiciary's concerns about increased workload and whether the College's advice was followed, and questions the grounds for the new complaint option before Dutch courts.

The College states that alignment with current practice and agreed working arrangements between the Minister and the College should be the main guide, and that sufficient room must be left for further development of the division of responsibilities.

Het College stelt dat er vooral dient te worden aangesloten bij de huidige praktijk en gemaakte werkafspraken tussen de Minister en het College, en dat er voldoende ruimte moet worden gegeven voor de verdere ontwikkeling van de verdeling en verschuiving van verantwoordelijkheden.
Asks what supervision by designated bodies other than the reclassering actually involves and whether capacity and information-sharing consequences were considered.
From the statutory text and explanatory memorandum it is insufficiently clear what this supervision means.
Uit de wettekst en memorie van toelichting wordt onvoldoende duidelijk wat met dit toezicht wordt bedoeld.
Asks why the government did not add substitute community service to the options for unpaid fines, given WODC research showing lower recidivism and costs.
Can the government explain why it did not choose to do so?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom zij daar niet voor heeft gekozen?
Asks whether the CJIB should have a discretionary power to waive set-off in hardship cases and whether the court should keep the option to lift a freedom-restricting measure in exceptional cases.
If this article were abolished, the judge would have the option of lifting the measure in exceptional cases.
Bij het opheffen van dit artikel zou de rechter de optie hebben om de maatregel bij uitzondering op te heffen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Second Vaststellingswet Wetboek van Strafvordering, which moves enforcement and international cooperation rules into the new Code, raising points on an overview of substantive changes, the hearing duty for terbeschikkingstelling extensions, conditions on strafonderbreking, and the undefined term 'werkdagen'. The government's nader rapport reports that it followed all four points, adding an overview, restoring a hearing duty in adapted form, clarifying strafonderbreking, and replacing werkdagen with days, plus two restored provisions.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum's general part should include a bulleted overview of the main substantive changes, which the government added.
Removing the hearing duty for terbeschikkingstelling extensions needed justification or a tailored hearing duty; the government reinstated a hearing duty with an exception for those unable to appear.
Strafonderbreking conditions and their relation to the nature of the institution need clarification in the explanatory memorandum, which was added.
The undefined term 'werkdagen' creates legal uncertainty and should be replaced by days or weeks, which the government did.

36663.s: The bill amends the Dutch and Caribbean compulsory education laws to tighten rules on school absence, require schools to adopt absence policies and register absence, and share absence data with municipalities and partnerships. It also revises the procedure for exemption from compulsory education on physical or psychological grounds, requiring a school-career advice and allowing exemptions of longer than one year.
36663.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation of data-delivery and information-sharing rules by reference to the need for detailed technical arrangements and consultation with stakeholders, and notes that details will be set in an algemene maatregel van bestuur.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further rules will be laid down on the manner in which information about absence is provided.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur zullen nadere regels worden gesteld over de wijze waarop de informatieverstrekking over verzuim plaatsvindt.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 21b, vierde lid, Leerplichtwet 1969)
manner and retention period of absence data delivery and information sharing
Artikel II, onderdeel F (artikel 33a, derde lid, Leerplichtwet BES)
manner and retention period of absence data delivery and information sharing for Caribbean Netherlands
Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 20, tweede lid, Leerplichtwet 1969)
manner of informing partnerships about unregistered school-age youth
p: Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 7 Leerplichtwet 1969); Artikel II, onderdeel D

Exemption on physical or psychological grounds now requires a school-advice and may be granted for longer periods, shifting the procedure's design toward professional and school discretion rather than annual parental renewal.
Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 21b); Artikel VI, onderdeel A (artikel 5a WPO)
Student absence data are shared with the Minister and municipalities and partnerships for supervision and coordination, with privacy limits set in the bill."

parties: Doubts the bill will tackle the thuiszitters problem; questions whether registration and monitoring address root causes and asks for justification of budget cuts.
Nevertheless, they have doubts whether the bill will be sufficient to tackle the problem.
Niettemin hebben zij twijfels of het wetsvoorstel zal voldoen om de problematiek aan te pakken.
Strongly supports the aim of preventing truancy and dropout and welcomes the initiative.
Truancy and dropout have major consequences for young people and ultimately for society, so these members are glad with the government's initiative.
Schoolverzuim en uitval kennen grote consequenties voor jongeren zelf en uiteindelijk voor de maatschappij en deze leden zijn daarom blij met het initiatief van de regering in deze.
Worries about rising teacher workload from the bill and questions whether aggregated data helps individual passend onderwijs; not yet convinced it is the most suitable instrument.
That said, the NSC members are not yet convinced that the bill is the most suitable means to that end under current circumstances.
Dit alles laat onverlet dat de leden van de fractie van NSC nog niet overtuigd zijn dat het onderhavige wetsvoorstel daartoe ook onder huidige omstandigheden het meest verkiesbare middel is.
Finds the bill procedural and focused on registration rather than realising the right to education; questions the vague 'signaal zorgelijk verzuim' and rights protection for parents and pupils.
What legal protection do parents and pupils have, and what actions can they take if such a signal is wrongly given?
Welke rechtsbescherming krijgen zijn en welke acties kunnen zij ondernemen indien er ten onrechte een dergelijk signaal wordt gegeven?
Questions the assumption that registration alone prevents truancy and raises concerns about sharing health-related data with DUO without a clear legal basis under the AVG.
Sharing health data requires a legal basis under the GDPR, which is currently insufficiently addressed.
Voor het delen van gezondheidsgegevens is op basis van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) een wettelijke grondslag vereist, wat momenteel onvoldoende wordt belicht.
Echoes the Raad van State concern that extensive delegation to an AMvB limits parliamentary involvement and undermines the primacy of the legislator.
This comes at the expense of the primacy of the legislature.
Dit gaat ten koste van het primaat van de wetgever.
Argues the bill overemphasises registration and data sharing, ignoring root causes; asks how it avoids bureaucratic approach and how schools are supported.
The bill places strong emphasis on registration and data sharing as a means to tackle school truancy.
Het wetsvoorstel legt een sterke nadruk op registratie en gegevensdeling als middel om schoolverzuim tegen te gaan.

Questions the effectiveness of the measures and the added value of mandatory registration; questions the legal basis of medezeggenschap consent on truancy policy and the justification for the 16-hour criterion.
Why should the legislator force registration of situations that it itself regards as legitimate forms of absence?
Waarom zou de wetgever moeten dwingen tot het registreren van situaties die door de wetgever zelf als legitieme vormen van verzuim worden beschouwd?

Asks whether the government will introduce a voorhang procedure for the AMvB on data delivery and retention to increase parliamentary control, and questions the legal basis for the signal of concerning absence.
Is the government willing to introduce a pre-consultation procedure after all, so that parliamentary control can be increased?
Is de regering bereid alsnog een voorhangprocedure in te stellen, zodat de parlementaire controle kan worden vergroot?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on the Wet terugdringen verzuim, which aims to reduce school truancy and stay-at-home youth through stricter attendance policies, registration and data sharing, and narrower exemptions from compulsory education.
