It raises concerns about the effectiveness of the measures for stay-at-home youth, overly broad delegation, the need for a practice analysis, and the exemption procedure and Caribbean Netherlands application; the government's reply accepts many points, moving core elements into the law and clarifying the policy analysis, though it declines to define 'zorgelijk verzuim' or to add a statutory basis for signalling sick leave.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that the proposed measures are shown to be effective in reducing stay-at-home youth, and advises separating the broader truancy goal from a specific analysis of stay-at-home youth.

Broad delegation to an AMvB for core elements of attendance policy and registration leaves much of the obligation undetermined, limiting parliamentary involvement; core elements should be in the law itself.
A thorough analysis of current practice and administrative burden is needed to assess whether the instruments are implementable across education sectors.

The signal of 'zorgelijk verzuim' is undefined in the statute and its relation to criminal prosecution by the leerplichtambtenaar is unclear; the government clarifies the explanatory memorandum but does not define the term in the law.
The Afdeling suggests a statutory basis for signalling long-term sick leave and suspected unlawful absence, which the government declines to adopt.

The vrijstelling procedure should make the advice from the samenwerkingsverband on educational perspective mandatory, and the doctor should consult educational expertise where needed; the government made the advice mandatory.
The application to the Caribbean Netherlands needs fuller consultation, implementability analysis and steps before entry into force; the explanatory memorandum has been supplemented.

36690.s: The bill approves, for the European part of the Netherlands, the Framework Agreement on Partnership and Cooperation between the EU and its member states and the government of Malaysia, concluded in Brussels on 14 December 2022. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
36690.j: The memorandum explains the mixed character of the agreement and states that it contains no provisions binding on individuals under articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
q: In the government's view, the treaty contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat het verdrag geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet

parties: Asks how the government views and promotes cooperation with Malaysia and individual ASEAN states on critical raw materials, which the agreement does not mention explicitly.
The VVD members note that the bill does not explicitly refer to cooperation with Malaysia on critical raw materials.
De leden van de VVD-fractie constateren dat in het wetsvoorstel niet expliciet verwezen wordt naar samenwerking met Maleisië op het gebied van kritieke grondstoffen.

Supports strengthening ties with Malaysia and asks the government to use the agreement's dialogue to raise the rights of LGBTIQ+ persons, which is a rights-related point but not a check on the executive.
Can the government commit to using the room within this agreement to raise the rights of LGBTIQ+ persons, these members ask.
Kan de regering toezeggen de ruimte binnen deze overeenkomst te gebruiken om de rechten van lhbtiq+ personen aan de orde te stellen, zo vragen deze leden.
Generally positive about the agreement but asks how its human rights provisions can address Christian persecution and restricted religious freedom in Malaysia.

These members would like to know what tools the values in the preambles and articles 1 and 25 provide to address the persecution of Christians and improve religious freedom for the Christian minority in Malaysia.

Deze leden vragen graag welke handvatten de waarden uit de preambules en de bepalingen van artikel 1 en 25 bieden om christenvervolging aan te pakken en geloofsvrijheid te verbeteren voor de christenminderheid in Maleisië.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it has no remarks on the bill approving the 2022 EU-Malaysia Framework Agreement on partnership and cooperation and recommends submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Foreign Affairs transmitted the advice and, as no remarks were made, the government's reply is limited to forwarding the bill.

36725-IIB.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget statement for the other High Councils of State, the provincial governors' cabinets (Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten) and the Electoral Council, with a first supplementary budget effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 1 June 2025. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and raises spending on the Raad van State and the National Ombudsman, among other items.
36725-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increase for the Raad van State by higher caseloads from Europeanisation of law, more complex cases and an expected rise in incoming cases.
q: For 2026 the estimate has been raised by € 10.9 million, given the number of cases the Council of State will decide.
Voor 2026 is de raming met € 10,9 mln. naar boven bijgesteld, gezien het aantal zaken dat de Raad van State zal afdoen.

36735.s: This omnibus tax bill (Fiscale Verzamelwet 2026) amends numerous tax laws, including income tax, wage tax, corporate tax, VAT, customs, motor vehicle tax and benefit-related rules for the 2026 fiscal policy. It also introduces technical changes such as a formal objection route for VAT zero-assessments, an ANBI reporting portal, and a survivor compensation scheme for the selection-at-the-gate affair.
36735.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies delegations mainly as technical implementation of tax rules and notes that delegated rules are needed for administrative detail, without elaborate reasoning on oversight.
d: ARTIKEL III, onderdeel D (Wet LB 1964, artikel 38r, lid 5 / delegation for partner pension)
partner pension before pension date, lower franchise rules
ARTIKEL V, onderdeel A (Wet OB 1968, artikel 11, lid 9)
VAT exemption extended to profit-seeking institutions
ARTIKEL VI, onderdeel B (Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag, artikel 24a, lid 5)
ARTIKEL VI, onderdeel B (Wet belastingen op milieugrondslag, artikel 24a, lid 6)
ARTIKEL VIII (Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen, artikel 13)
exceptions to electronic communication obligation for groups of parties
ARTIKEL XIV (Wet compensatie wegens selectie aan de poort, artikel 2a)
inspector decides on survivor compensation claims
electronic communication exceptions for groups including ANBI and administrative obligors
ARTIKEL XII, onderdeel B (Provinciewet artikel 222, lid 3)
motor vehicle tax rates used for provincial opcenten
p: ARTIKEL XIV, onderdeel B (Wet compensatie wegens selectie aan de poort, artikel 2a)
The inspector gains discretion to decide survivor compensation claims, which are subject to ordinary appeal before the fiscal court.
Ministerial regulation may create exceptions to the statutory right to choose electronic communication, extending the executive's rule-making over taxpayer communication.
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel B and ARTIKEL IV, onderdelen B-D (bezwaar en beroep limits)

Objections against previously fixed transferable tax amounts are limited to the latest year, narrowing taxpayers' ability to challenge earlier determinations, though judicial review of the current decision remains.

parties: Asks how the inspector's new discretionary power ensures uniform policy and equal treatment, and how the ANBI evaluation with limited data and little oversight can support its conclusions.
In what way does this new discretionary power of the inspector ensure uniformity of policy? And equal treatment?
Op welke manier zorgt deze nieuwe discretionaire bevoegdheid voor eenheid van beleid? En op gelijke behandeling?
Objects that bundling unrelated tax measures in one bill undermines parliamentary scrutiny and the room for judgment of the Chambers, and calls for thematic clustering.
Bundling substantively unrelated topics in one proposal hinders the substantive debate and systematic scrutiny of individual measures.
De bundeling van inhoudelijk niet-samenhangende onderwerpen in een voorstel bemoeilijkt het inhoudelijke debat en de systematische controle op afzonderlijke maatregelen.
Asks whether all required categories for the reduced VAT rate have actually been included and whether further corrections are needed.
The BBB members ask whether all categories that should be included are actually included under the reduced VAT rate.
De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen of alle categorieën die opgenomen dienen te zijn nu ook daadwerkelijk zijn opgenomen onder btw-laag.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on the Fiscale verzamelwet 2026, raising concerns about the lack of coherence among its 22 mostly fiscal measures, the design of the survivors' scheme in the Wet compensatie selectie aan de poort, VAT exemption for winstbeogende bewindvoerders and curatoren, the income-statement requirement for qualifying foreign taxpayers, and ANBI portals. The government's nader rapport largely defends its choices, partly accepting the advice by clarifying explanations and amending the text and explanatory memorandum where indicated.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the omnibus bill lacks coherence and could impair the Eerste Kamer's ability to assess its parts; the government justifies it on thematic and implementation grounds and adds argumentation to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asks for clearer purpose and uniform amounts for the survivors' scheme in the compensation for selection at the gate; the government explains its choices but does not adopt a fixed amount.

The Afdeling questions whether requiring an income statement on request for qualifying foreign taxpayers is proportionate and compatible with free movement; the government amended the text and explanation, retaining the request power with a possibility to prove eligibility otherwise.

The Afdeling asks for a fuller, integrated assessment of the sector impact and reasoning for the VAT exemption for bewindvoerders and curatoren; the government adds explanation on the tariff increase and the reasons for keeping the exemption.
The Afdeling flags possible EU free movement of capital issues from language and access requirements for the ANBI portals; the government will take these into account and amends the explanation.

36744.s: The bill removes the exemption under the Dutch domestic services scheme (Rdah) for workers paid from publicly funded schemes, such as personal budgets (pgb), so that they fall under employment insurance, employment-law protections and related rules. It also amends several Dutch social security, civil code, flexible working and wage tax provisions, adds a five-year evaluation duty and a transitional rule for sick-leave periods.
36744.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial designation of publicly funded schemes because it allows quick adjustment and clarity for employers, workers and implementing bodies, rather than amending the statute each time.
q: The choice to designate publicly funded schemes was made because partial public funding does not always warrant excluding the Rdah, and a ministerial regulation can be adjusted relatively quickly.
Er is gekozen voor aanwijzing van de regelingen voor publieke financiering omdat niet steeds bij (gedeeltelijke) publieke financiering aanleiding is de Rdah niet van toepassing te laten zijn.
d: Artikel I-III, IV, V, VI (exemption clauses)
designating publicly funded schemes excluded from the Rdah exemption

parties: Asks whether the Rdah should be scrapped, whether the scope should cover gastouders and family carers in line with case law, and how sham self-employment via platforms will be prevented.
These members ask whether the government acknowledges that the Rdah was originally intended for private individuals and not for intermediation by commercial platforms.
Deze leden vragen of de regering erkent dat de Rdah oorspronkelijk bedoeld was voor particulieren en niet voor tussenkomst van commerciële platforms.

Worries that turning budget holders into full employers overburdens vulnerable citizens and conflicts with the pgb aim of autonomy, and asks how displacement to contracts for services will be mitigated.
The VVD members ask whether the government can explain how it prevents this expansion of employer obligations from overburdening this vulnerable group of citizens.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven hoe zij voorkomt dat deze vergroting van werkgeversverplichtingen leidt tot overbelasting van deze kwetsbare groep burgers.
Supports extending social security and reducing indirect discrimination of women, but asks whether budget holders receive enough information and whether the added demands on them are not excessive.
In addition, the D66 members ask whether it is desirable that considerably more is now demanded of budget holders through this amendment.
Daarnaast vragen de leden van de D66-fractie of het wenselijk is dat er nu aanzienlijk meer gevraagd wordt van de budgethouders door deze wetswijziging.
Asks whether enforcement capacity is adequate to prevent growth in undeclared work and how many checks on undeclared work in pgb settings currently take place.
Can the government indicate whether enforcement capacity is sufficient to prevent an increase in undeclared work?
Kan de regering aangeven of de handhavingscapaciteiten afdoende zijn om een groei in zwartwerken te voorkomen?
Finds the proposal does not go far enough, questions keeping the Rdah for gastouders given the CRvB ruling on publicly funded work, and asks the government to address that argument.
These members see steps being taken in the right direction, since discrimination in the labour market must be combated, but find the proposed measures do not go far enough.
Deze leden zien dat er stappen worden gezet in de goede richting, aangezien discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt tegen moet worden gegaan, maar vinden de voorgestelde maatregelen niet ver genoeg gaan.
Worried about administrative and regulatory burdens on pgb holders now treated as employers and asks how they can be relieved.

The SGP members are concerned about the administrative and regulatory burden of this bill on pgb holders, since as a result more pgb holders will be considered employers with the associated duties and responsibilities.

De leden van de SGP-fractie maken zich zorgen over de administratieve en regeldrukgevolgen van dit wetsvoorstel voor pgb-houders, aangezien als gevolg van dit voorstel meer pgb-houders worden beschouwd als werkgever met de bijbehorende plichten en verantwoordelijkheden.
Asks whether pgb holders will have to pay employer premiums, reducing their income, and how UWV capacity and additional claims will be handled.

The NSC members ask whether the government can indicate whether and to what extent pgb holders will have to pay employer premiums as a result of this bill and therefore have less money left to live on.

De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven of en in hoeverre pgb-houders door dit wetsvoorstel werkgeverspremies moeten betalen en daardoor onder de streep minder geld overhouden om van te leven.
Questions whether parliament retains real room to decide once ICT systems are already fixed for the start date, and asks how implementation problems will be weighed against those of citizens.
What room for manoeuvre does exist in practice if systems are already locked down before the House can finish its work?
Welke afwegingsruimte bestaat er in de praktijk nog als systemen al zijn dichtgetimmerd voordat de Kamer haar werk kan afronden?
Asks about the financial and organisational burden on the SVB and where the budget holder's own tasks remain, and whether the rules for public and private funded service providers differ.
Which tasks explicitly remain with the budget holder even when the SVB takes over most of the implementation?
Welke taken expliciet bij de budgethouder blijven liggen, ook wanneer de SVB de uitvoering grotendeels overneemt.
Worries that the change endangers the pgb as a full alternative to care in kind for people with chronic illness or disability and questions compatibility with the UN disability convention.
These members are concerned about effects on people with a chronic illness or disability, for whom the pgb instrument is essential to take part in society.
Deze leden maken zich echter zorgen over gevolgen voor mensen met een chronische ziekte of handicap, voor wie het instrument pgb essentieel is om deel te kunnen nemen aan de samenleving.
Asks for postponing the start date to 1 July 2026 for proper parliamentary treatment and preparation, and questions the reach of the change beyond the court ruling.
Therefore these members ask to postpone the entry into force provisionally until 1 July 2026, so that a proper parliamentary treatment and preparation can take place.
Daarom vragen deze leden de inwerkingtreding voorlopig uit te stellen tot 1 juli 2026, zodat er een gedegen wetsbehandeling en voorbereiding van de inwerkingtreding kan plaatsvinden.
Asks why the bill codifies the CRvB ruling more broadly than the court's own earlier, differing case law, and questions whether the changed employer duties are proportionate.
Can the government explain why a broader scope was chosen when codifying this case law?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom bij deze codificatie van jurisprudentie gekozen is voor een ruimere invulling?
Asks whether the government accepts that indirect discrimination against women currently exists and why the chosen scope was preferred over alternatives.
These members ask whether the government substantively endorses that there is currently (a risk of) indirect discrimination against women.
Deze leden vragen of de regering inhoudelijk onderschrijft dat er momenteel sprake is van (een risico op) indirecte discriminatie van vrouwen.
Asks for guarantees of a pgb increase of at least twenty percent and how much funding is reserved for the new employer costs.
These members ask how much money in total is reserved for the rise in pgb budgets resulting from the now mandatory employee insurance premiums and sick-pay.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen hoeveel geld er in totaal is gereserveerd voor de stijging van de pgb’s als gevolg van de nu verplichte premies werknemersverzekeringen en loondoorbetaling bij ziekte.
Asks how budget holders and care workers will be compensated after two years, why some care acts are compensated and others not, and how income loss in the WW will be handled.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members ask whether the government can state what happens after these two years.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven wat er na afloop van deze twee jaar gebeurt.
Highlights unrest among pgb holders caused by poor communication and asks why maximum hourly tariffs are not raised despite higher employer costs.
Why was it chosen not to raise the maximum hourly rate for pgb holders while employer costs rise sharply?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen om de maximale uurvergoeding voor pgb-houders niet te verhogen, terwijl de werkgeverslasten fors stijgen?
Supports the bill as necessary for the social security of care workers but warns that unchanged tariffs would force a choice between less care, lower pay or job loss.
These members stress that this law is absolutely necessary to improve the position of pgb care workers.
Deze leden benadrukken dat deze wet absoluut noodzakelijk is om de positie van pgb-zorgverleners te verbeteren.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division had no substantive remarks on the draft bill amending the Unemployment Benefits Act and other laws to adjust the domestic services scheme, and advised submitting it to the House of Representatives. The minister's reply only notes that the explanatory memorandum was amended to reflect coordination with other state secretaries.

36753.s: The bill amends the DNA Act for convicted persons so that cell material can be taken from suspects held in custody (not minors) rather than only after conviction, stored centrally, and used for DNA profiling if they are convicted or if DNA research is ordered under the Code of Criminal Procedure. It also restricts the Act for minors, adds notice and objection rights (with a 14-day objection window and deletion rules), and adjusts related Code of Criminal Procedure provisions on DNA kinship research and the grounds for storing DNA profiles.
36753.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded and earlier sampling by the need to increase the effectiveness of the DNA Act and by the Commission Hoekstra recommendation, and it argues the measure is proportionate given safeguards such as notice, objection rights and deletion.
q: Having considered that it is desirable to increase the effectiveness of the DNA Act for convicted persons by taking cell material at an earlier stage of the procedure.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is de effectiviteit van de Wet DNA-onderzoek bij veroordeelden te vergroten door op een eerder moment in de procedure celmateriaal af te nemen
d: Artikel I, A (art. 2, lid 6 Wet DNA-onderzoek bij veroordeelden)
rules on taking, storing and destroying cell material
Artikel I, E (art. 5, lid 1 and 2 Wet DNA-onderzoek bij veroordeelden)
requirements for persons taking cell material; regulation of sampling procedure
Artikel II, C (art. 151ba) and D (art. 151da, lid 4 Sv)
rules for processing DNA profiles and cell material
rules for processing DNA profiles and cell material
requirements for investigating officers taking cell material; sampling of blood via amvb
p: Artikel I, A (art. 2 Wet DNA-onderzoek bij veroordeelden)

Introduces mandatory taking of cell material from suspects held in custody for offences under article 67(1) Sv, previously only possible after conviction, with exceptions for minors and prior samples.
Artikel II, D (art. 151da Sv) and H (art. 195g Sv)

Lowers the threshold for DNA kinship research with a single or limited set of profiles so that prior judicial authorisation is no longer required in those cases, and allows resulting profiles to be stored.
Artikel II, C (art. 151ba) and G (art. 195da Sv)
Allows already stored cell material to be used for DNA research by the prosecutor or investigating judge without fresh sampling, with written consent required for non-serious suspects.

parties: Questions whether collection before conviction is proportionate and suggests judicial assessment before collection and a legal remedy against the collection decision.
Supports the aim and asks about the scale of non-collection, the security of sensitive DNA data after a hack at the OM, and the ECHR case law on conservatory collection.
These members emphasise that it is not about determining a DNA profile; it is only about conservatory collection of cell material, which is a relatively limited intrusion.
Deze leden benadrukken dat het niet gaat om het bepalen van een DNA-profiel. Het gaat enkel en alleen om het afnemen van conservatoire celmateriaalafname, wat een relatief beperkte inbreuk is.
Has no further questions at this stage.
These members currently have no further questions.
Deze leden hebben op dit moment geen nadere vragen.
Supports the bill, noting that destruction of material if no conviction protects innocents, and has no questions.
The BBB members support this bill and have no questions for the government.
De leden van de BBB-fractie steunen dit wetsvoorstel en hebben geen vragen aan de regering.
Asks why the existing post-conviction regime remains alongside the new procedure, in which cases the old rules apply, and whether the new collection becomes the norm.
Do these members understand correctly that this means it still does not become the norm to collect cell material from all suspects held in custody for whom collection may be relevant?
Begrijpen deze leden goed dat het hierdoor alsnog niet de norm wordt dat bij alle verdachten die in verzekering worden gesteld en waarbij de afname van belang kan zijn, celmateriaal wordt afgenomen?
Sees a clash between effectiveness and privacy of unconvicted suspects, worries about retention and intrusion, and asks why a remedy against the collection decision is not written into law.
Would it not be wiser to lay this down directly in the law instead of offering the possibility to appeal through other routes?
Is het niet verstandig dit direct in de wet vast te leggen in plaats van het bieden van de mogelijkheid om in beroep te gaan via andere wegen?
Asks how proportionality and effective legal protection are ensured, notes the Council of State's criticism, and asks how suspects are informed of the collection order.
They ask the government how the bill guarantees that suspects are informed of the order to create a DNA profile and receive effective legal protection.

Zij vragen de regering op welke wijze in het voorste gegarandeerd wordt dat verdachten op de hoogte worden gebracht van het bevel tot het opmaken van een DNA-profiel en een effectieve rechtsbescherming ontvangen.
Raises presumption of innocence and privacy concerns, questions retention periods being left to a ministerial decree rather than the law, and asks about the suspect's ability to object.
These members ask, together with the Council of State, whether it is really ensured that suspects' cell material is destroyed after a certain period.
Deze leden vragen, samen met de Afdeling, of hiermee wel goed wordt gewaarborgd dat het celmateriaal van de verdachten na bepaalde tijd wordt vernietigd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on a government bill introducing conservatory collection of cell material (DNA samples) from suspects taken into custody, judging the necessity and proportionality adequately substantiated but requesting updated figures, statutory safeguards on retention periods and destruction, clarity on legal remedies when the DNA order is not personally served, and clearer financial consequences. The government's reply (nader rapport) reports that updated figures were added to the explanatory memorandum, that retention and destruction rules remain in the implementing decree with reasons given, that a specific objection regime was introduced for non-personal service, and that the financial section was expanded.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for current figures to substantiate necessity and proportionality of conservatory DNA collection under privacy rights; the government added recent figures on DNA orders to the memorandum.

The Afdeling suggests statutory anchoring of retention periods and immediate-destruction cases in the Wet DNA-V; the government kept them in the Besluit DNA-onderzoek in strafzaken, arguing higher law does not require a formal statute.
The Afdeling asks for clarity on remedies when the DNA order cannot be personally served; the bill now includes a specific objection regime with a fourteen-day period after service.
The Afdeling asks that the financial consequences and their coverage be made transparent; the financial section of the memorandum was expanded.

36807.s: The bill consolidates and re-implements the Dutch Railways Act (Spoorwegwet) together with the Local Railways Act, transposing EU directives on railway access, safety, interoperability and train driver certification. It sets out a framework law with detailed rules delegated to amvb and ministerial regulations, and reorganises the Nationale Veiligheidsinstantie and the rijksspoorweginfrastructuur management.
36807.j: The memorandum justifies the broad use of delegation by arguing that EU rules change frequently, so lower-level regulation allows faster adaptation without repeated statutory amendments.
q: it may be more desirable and permissible to include a delegation basis than in legislation of purely national origin
het opnemen van een delegatiegrondslag eerder wenselijk en toelaatbaar kan zijn dan bij wetgeving van zuiver nationale herkomst het geval is
d: classification of railways into usage functions A to H
designation and rules for decentral railway infrastructure managers
rules on tasks of the Nationale Veiligheidsinstantie
eligibility and impartiality of infrastructure manager board members
access conditions to service facilities and related fees
framework for track access charges and incentive schemes
rules on allocation of infrastructure capacity
p: The Minister may give directions to the Nationale Veiligheidsinstantie only in writing, with special directions sent to the Staten-Generaal, limiting ministerial control over the safety authority's investigations.
Tasks of the Nationale Veiligheidsinstantie are attributed to its head with rules to be set by general administrative order, with annual reporting required.

parties: Serious concern that framing the bill as a framework law limits parliamentary control, with 79 delegation provisions and no voorhang procedure for key matters such as concession terms and fine levels.
They have great concerns about the chosen design as a framework law and the associated limitation of parliamentary control.
Echter, deze leden hebben grote zorgen over de gekozen vormgeving als kaderwet en de daarmee gepaard gaande beperking van de parlementaire controle.
Asks how parliament can oversee the fragmented body of lower regulation, how delegated rules are controlled, and why voorhang provisions were dropped.
These members also ask to what extent parliament can still properly oversee and control the whole of laws and regulations in this way.
Ook vragen deze leden in hoeverre het parlement het geheel van wet- en regelgeving op deze wijze nog goed kan overzien en controleren.
Wants lower regulation sent to parliament before the bill is decided and asks for justification of the absence of any voorhang procedure despite 79 delegation provisions.
These members would like a further justification from the government for why no delegation provision includes a voorhang procedure in the bill.
Deze leden zouden graag een nadere motivering van de regering ontvangen waarom bij geen enkele delegatiebepaling een voorhangprocedure in het wetsvoorstel is opgenomen.
Asks whether a voorhang procedure will apply to lower regulation and how the lower rules are kept within the bounds of the act.
These members ask the government whether it is willing to apply a voorhang procedure to the lower regulation so that the House can be involved in advance in important substantive choices.
Deze leden vragen de regering of zij bereid is een voorhangprocedure toe te passen bij de lagere regelgeving, zodat de Kamer vooraf kan worden betrokken bij belangrijke inhoudelijke keuzes.
Questions the extent of delegation to lower regulation, following the Raad van State, and asks for a voorhang procedure for the AMvB on capacity allocation and rail safety.
The SGP members question the extent to which regulation is delegated to lower regulation, in line with the comments of the Council of State.
De leden van de SGP-fractie zetten vraagtekens bij de mate waarin de regelgeving gedelegeerd wordt naar lagere regelgeving, in aansluiting op de opmerkingen van Raad van State hierbij.
Asks what removing the HRN exception means for the current HRN concession and allocation after 2035, and how continuity of service will be guaranteed.
The members would like to know what this means for the current HRN concession 2025–2035, especially in light of the European Commission's response.
De leden willen graag weten wat dat betekent voor de huidige HRN-concessie 2025–2035, zeker in het licht van de reactie van de Europese Commissie.
Concerned about NS and ProRail performance and rising ticket prices, asking whether the bill increases influence over these bodies and enables competition.
These members ask whether the bill will ensure more influence can be exerted over NS and/or ProRail, for example when they perform poorly.
Deze leden vragen of het wetsvoorstel er voor zal zorgen dat er meer invloed uitgeoefend kan worden op NS en/of ProRail, bijvoorbeeld wanneer zij slecht presteren.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised on a draft new Railway Act (Spoorwegwet 20..) that consolidates existing railway laws into a framework law, raising concerns about the primacy of the legislature, the level of rule-making (including key choices left to lower regulation), and the independence of the National Safety Authority (NVi) within the ILT. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport reports that the bill was amended to move several key choices into the law itself, to adjust delegation provisions, and to add safeguards on NVi independence, largely accepting the advice.
concerns: Key policy choices and national options must be made in the law itself rather than in lower regulation, respecting the primacy of the legislature; the government moved several such choices (accreditation, licensing, machinist minimum age) into the law.
Delegation grounds must be concretely bounded; the government narrowed several delegation provisions and moved some national choices to amvb level, though some lower-level choices remain.
Various delegation grounds were removed or shortened where EU implementing regulations already contain the rules, and several provisions were clarified.

Independence of the National Safety Authority from the ministry must be guaranteed; the government limited the minister's instruction power under article 1.12 and expanded the explanatory memorandum on safeguards.

36816.s: The bill amends the General Tax Act to give taxpayers a right of access to their tax file, provided proactively via a digital portal at the time a tax assessment or appealable decision is issued, with a phased rollout per tax type and temporary transitional rules. It also amends the Municipalities, Provinces, Water Boards, Water and Aviation Acts to align references, while excluding decentralised taxes from the access right for now.
36816.j: The memorandum justifies the phased approach and secrecy exceptions by operational feasibility for the tax authorities and the need to protect enforcement and third-party privacy, while noting the amendment's scope.
q: If the inspector considers that weighty reasons require secrecy for a document, the content of the document will not be visible in the portal.
Als de inspecteur van oordeel is dat er gewichtige redenen zijn die nopen tot geheimhouding van een stuk, zal de inhoud van het stuk niet zichtbaar zijn in het portaal.
d: designation of national taxes subject to the access right
inspector may withhold access on weighty grounds of secrecy
p: The inspector may withhold parts of the file on weighty grounds of secrecy, with a notation in the portal and possible review in appeal and by the judge.
During the phase-in the inspector may grant access to files before the rollout per tax is designated, on a temporary, optional basis.

parties: The bill limits rather than streamlines the access right; internal documents may be withheld and refusals lose a separate appeal route, leaving citizens without judicial review.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members cannot shake the impression that the bill limits rather than streamlines the access right in the own tax file adopted by amendment in the Tax Plan 2024.

De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie kunnen zich niet aan de indruk onttrekken dat het wetsvoorstel het bij het Belastingplan 2024 bij amendement aangenomen inzagerecht in het eigen fiscaal dossier beperkt in plaats van stroomlijnt.
Focuses on feasibility, costs and the Tax Administration's workload and on how authorised representatives can access files.
The VVD members share the concern about the feasibility of the article for the Tax Administration and Customs.
Deze leden delen de zorg over de uitvoerbaarheid van het artikel voor de Belastingdienst en Douane.
The bill weakens the original amendment's legal protection; without a separate appealable decision on access, the administrative judge can no longer review refusals.
This removes the formal route to have a refusal reviewed by the administrative judge.
Daarmee verdwijnt de formele route om een afwijzing te laten toetsen door de bestuursrechter.

Agrees citizens should see the same documents as the inspector, but asks whether active disclosure goes beyond the amendment and whether citizens lose the ability to object to the information provided.
These members ask whether it is correct that the bill goes further than the Omtzigt amendment intended, because access need not happen on request.
Deze leden vragen of het klopt dat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel verder gaat dan wat beoogd is met het amendement Omtzigt, omdat de inzage niet op verzoek hoeft te gebeuren.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued an opinion on the draft Wet stroomlijning fiscaal inzagerecht, stating it has no remarks and advises submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën's nader rapport notes only minor editorial changes to the explanatory memorandum.

36820-X.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Defence, including a first supplementary budget raising spending authority by about EUR 2.28 billion and a September supplementary budget with further adjustments, applied retroactively from 17 September 2025. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and leaves the expenditure allocations across defence articles to the budget tables.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie voor het jaar 2025

36825.s: The bill adds a new chapter to the Dutch Wabvpz that makes the Minister of Health responsible for operating a national contact point for digital health, allowing health providers to exchange patient health data with providers in other EU member states under EU Directive 2011/24. Exchanges occur only with the patient's consent, and details on data categories, access conditions, suspension of access, and logging are left to general administrative orders (AMvB).
36825.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB route by stating that technical and access conditions are best regulated by general administrative order and that patient consent remains the controlling safeguard.
q: By general administrative order, rules are set on the data referred to in the second paragraph, points a and b, which are exchanged under articles 15q and 15r.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld over de in het tweede lid, onder a en b, bedoelde gegevens, die met toepassing van de artikelen 15q en 15r worden uitgewisseld.
d: data categories exchanged via national contact point
set-up, security and operation of national contact point
conditions for provider access and grounds for suspension or denial
p: The Minister may suspend or deny provider access to the contact point on grounds to be set by AMvB, with no parliamentary involvement specified.

parties: Expresses interest in the bill and states it has no questions for the government at this time.
The said members currently have no questions for the government.
Genoemde leden hebben op dit moment geen vragen aan de regering.
Asks about temporary workload increases for care providers and standardisation of language in cross-border data exchange.
Can the government indicate whether it expects this to recur when the system moves to the EHDS, or whether it is truly a one-off?
Kan de regering aangeven of zij verwacht dat dit weer het geval zal zijn als overgegaan wordt op het systeem in lijn met de EHDS, of is dit echt eenmalig?

Supports better data exchange but presses for safeguards: data minimisation, purpose limitation, opt-out, transparency on retention periods, and why key safeguards are left to lower regulation without a pre-consultation (voorhang).
Why was it not chosen to provide the AMvB with a pre-consultation procedure (voorhang) for this matter?
Waarom is voor dit vraagstuk niet gekozen om de AMvB te voorzien van een voorhang?
Asks how patient consent works, including for unconscious patients in emergencies, and whether care providers meet the high authentication assurance level.
They ask what the rules are when the client is unconscious and there is an emergency.
Zij vragen wat de regels zijn als de cliënt niet bij bewustzijn is en sprake is van spoed.
Has no further questions or comments for the government.
These members have no further questions or comments for the government.
Deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen aan de regering.
Has no questions for the government.
The said members have no questions for the government.
Genoemde leden hebben geen vragen aan de regering.
Asks about the scope of cross-border care, the timeline for implementing legislation, legal limits on access to patient records, and consequences of refusing consent.
Will this be legally delimited so that care professionals without involvement in parts or categories of the patient file also do not gain access to them?
Wordt dit juridisch afgebakend zodat zorgprofessionals die geen betrokkenheid hebben bij onderdelen of categorieën van het persoonsdossier daar ook geen toegang toe krijgen?
Worried about leaks of medical data and misuse via BSN and date of birth; asks what technical and procedural safeguards exist and how consent and data requests are structured.
Does this mean that in a data breach where people's BSN and date of birth are leaked, malicious actors could also gain access to medical data?
Betekent dit dat bij een datalek waarbij het BSN en de geboortedatum van mensen worden gelekt kwaadwillenden ook toegang kunnen krijgen tot medische gegevens?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised clarifying how the bill relates to the EHDS Regulation, including the opt-out system, supervision, data retention period (to be set in law) and joint controllership. The minister's reply accepts the retention-period point by setting a five-year maximum for logs in the bill and promises clarifications in the explanatory memorandum on the other points, while noting that the EHDS implementation law will settle supervision and the opt-out details.
concerns: The retention period for data should be fixed at the level of the statute rather than left to an AMvB; the bill now sets a five-year maximum for logs in law.

The explanatory memorandum should explain how the bill is a necessary interim step toward the EHDS Regulation, especially regarding the opt-out system; the memorandum was supplemented but the minister argues necessity on the basis of implementation lead times.
Changes to the opt-out system under the EHDS and how it affects patient control over health data should be explained; the minister defers detailed rules to the EHDS implementation law.
Supervision by multiple authorities under the layered EHDS structure should be clarified and accountability explained; the minister defers this to the implementing legislation.

Joint controllership between member states should be addressed and essential elements of any arrangement set out in the explanatory memorandum; the minister added the DPIA-based discussion and says the issue will be raised in the eHealth Network.

36843.s: The bill amends the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet to introduce a licensing requirement for asbestos removal, demolition involving asbestos exposure, and designated asbestos processing, implementing EU Directive 2023/2668. It lets the Minister of SZW grant, refuse or revoke licences, including on Bibob integrity grounds, and publishes licensed companies.
36843.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to lower regulation by stating that detailed licence rules affect regulatory burden and that the choice of certification options must still be made, leaving the substance to the Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative measure, rules may be set on the application, grant, amendment, suspension and revocation of the licence.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen regels worden gesteld over de aanvraag, verlening, wijziging, schorsing en intrekking van de vergunning.
d: designation of asbestos processing cases requiring a licence
rules on licence application, grant, amendment, suspension, revocation, validity, scope and conditions
timing and manner of publishing licensed companies' data
electronic submission of information duties via the national Omgevingswet facility
temporary exemption from licence requirement for firms with pending applications
extension of the six-month transitional period
p: The Minister may refuse or revoke a licence on Bibob integrity grounds and request an advisory report from the Bureau Bibob, extending executive discretion over businesses' market access.

Licensing conditions, scope and sanctions are largely left to general administrative measures and ministerial regulation rather than fixed in the statute.Mentioned as deferred detail, the licence regime itself is set in the act.'}],

parties: Asks whether the inspectorate's (ILT) critical advice has been resolved and how enforcement capacity and a transition period will be arranged.
The D66 members have noted the various reservations of the ILT and therefore wonder whether, in response to the explanatory memorandum, the ILT reaches a different advice.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de diverse kanttekeningen van de ILT en vragen zich daarom af of naar aanleiding van de memorie van toelichting de ILT tot een ander advies komt.
Asks how the licensing body will ensure expertise and consistent application of criteria at start-up, and how withdrawal of licences will be justified.

These members ask the government to explain how it ensures that the licensing organisation has sufficient expertise, capacity and clear work processes at entry into force to take timely and consistent decisions.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten op welke wijze zij waarborgt dat de vergunningverlenende organisatie bij inwerkingtreding beschikt over voldoende expertise, capaciteit en duidelijke werkprocessen om tijdig en consistent besluiten te nemen.
Questions the proportionality of the bill relative to administrative burden, the unlicensed treatment of foreign firms and subcontractors, and the lack of an open-ended licence review.

The GroenLinks-PvdA members ask the government whether it agrees that legislation always requires a trade-off between effectiveness and administrative burden, and how effectiveness was concretely weighed in this bill.
Deze leden vragen de regering of zij deelt dat wetgeving altijd een afweging vergt tussen doelbereik en administratieve lasten en hoe het doelbereik in dit wetsvoorstel concreet is meegewogen.

Argues the certification system performs poorly and that certification should not be the central proof of compliance; wants a risk-based alternative with inspectorate-approved methods and warns against loosened enforcement.
Structurally non-compliant and fraudulent companies must be tackled hard and effectively so that safety is truly guaranteed and well-intentioned parties are not disadvantaged.
Tegen structureel overtredende en malafide bedrijven moet hard en effectief worden opgetreden, zodat veiligheid daadwerkelijk wordt gewaarborgd en goedwillende partijen niet worden benadeeld.
Asks how compliance will be monitored after licences are granted for an indefinite period, given poor current compliance, and whether certification loss would end the right to operate.
Given the intention that licences will be valid for an indefinite period, these members ask how it is ensured after granting a licence that companies actually comply with the rules.

Gezien het voornemen dat vergunningen voor onbepaalde tijd geldig zullen zijn, vragen deze leden hoe er na het verlenen van een vergunning op toegezien wordt dat bedrijven zich daadwerkelijk aan de regels houden.

Asks which supervisory body is responsible for what, how coordination among inspectorates is secured, and whether the ILT's finding that the scheme is unenforceable and open to fraud has been addressed.
The JA21 members note that the Human Environment and Transport Inspectorate (ILT) has concluded that the bill is 'not enforceable, not executable and not fraud-proof'.
De leden van de JA21-fractie lezen dat de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) heeft geconcludeerd dat het wetsvoorstel «niet handhaafbaar, niet uitvoerbaar en niet fraudebestendig» is.
Asks why licensing is not extended now to asbestos processing, why no leges are charged, and how the bill's health objective will be evaluated without target figures.
These members ask why the government does not choose to introduce a licensing requirement for processing asbestos now, since processing asbestos is at least as dangerous to health as removing it.

Deze leden vragen waarom de regering er niet voor kiest nu al een vergunningplicht in te voeren voor het bewerken van asbest, aangezien het bewerken van asbest ten minste net zo gevaarlijk is voor de gezondheid als het verwijderen van asbest.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division raised no substantive remarks on the bill amending the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet to introduce a new licensing requirement for certain asbestos work, implementing EU Directive 2023/2668, and advised submitting it. The government's reply (nader rapport) notes that minor additions were made to the bill during drafting of the implementing decree, including extended norm addressees, a broader use of the national facility under the Omgevingswet, and a transitional provision.

36861.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth by adding 163 million euros in commitments and expenditure via an incidental supplementary budget, mainly related to Ternaard. It sets the unit of account in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 28 November of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (XXIII) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (XXIII) voor het jaar 2025

36906.s: The bill implements the revised EU Product Liability Directive 2024/2853 into Dutch Civil Code Books 6 and 7, extending liability to software, digital services, digital manufacturing files and data destruction, and adjusting limitation and expiry periods. It also adds a transitional provision so that products placed on the market before 9 December 2026 remain under the old rules.
36906.j: The memorandum justifies the bill mainly as faithful transposition of the EU directive, with no separate justification for executive powers.
q: This act enters into force at a time to be determined by royal decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks how consumers buying refurbished goods can obtain effective legal protection comparable to new products, and how independent repairers are treated under the liability rules.
Worries that burden-of-proof presumptions could disproportionately burden businesses and blur the line with a reversal of the burden of proof, and asks for minimal-burden implementation.
How does the government assess the risk that in complex cases the line between easing the burden of proof and an actual reversal of the burden blurs?
Hoe beoordeelt de regering het risico dat in complexe zaken de grens tussen verlichting van de bewijspositie en een feitelijke omkering van de bewijslast vervaagt?
Asks how courts should handle evidentiary relief in technically complex cases and how liability for software updates and multiple operators is determined in practice.
Argues that dropping the €500 option to claim from the seller makes it harder for consumers to obtain redress for small damages, and asks how consumer protection is weighed.
These members note that in practice this may mean a deterioration of the consumer's position.
Deze leden constateren dat dit in de praktijk een verslechtering van de positie van de consument kan betekenen.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the draft Implementation Act transposing the revised EU Product Liability Directive 2024/2853 into the Dutch Civil Code, and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes only minor technical amendments, clarifications on the non-use of national sectoral compensation schemes, a update to the explanatory memorandum, and clarification on applying the channelling provision where seller and producer are the same person.

36915-IIA.s: This bill amends the 2026 budget of the Staten-Generaal (the Dutch parliament), raising spending and revenue for the Eerste Kamer and Tweede Kamer by a net amount shown in the attached table. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and gives retroactive effect from 1 June 2026.
36915-IIA.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by extra costs such as the extended renovation of the Binnenhof and higher allowances for departing members, with no new delegated or executive powers.
q: As a result of the extension of the renovation of the Binnenhof until mid-2031, additional budget is required for the user costs in the years 2029 through 2031.
Als gevolg van de verlenging van de renovatie van het Binnenhof tot medio 2031 is aanvullend budget vereist voor de gebruikerskosten in de jaren 2029 tot en met 2031.

36924.s: The bill amends the Wft, Civil Code Book 7, the Whc and the Overgangswet to implement EU Directive 2023/2225 on consumer credit agreements, extending regulation to buy-now-pay-later and other short-term credit. It adds AFM powers including a product-intervention power to ban or restrict harmful credit products, and sets parliamentary-free rules on credit assessment, minors' access, and debt-advice referrals.
36924.j: The memorandum justifies the product-intervention power by consumer protection concerns over harmful credit products and notes that it should be applied sparingly, with the AFM's supervisory costs covered by market parties.
q: The AFM may only deploy this power where other supervisory or enforcement powers do not suffice or are not effective or proportionate to address consumer protection concerns.
De AFM kan deze bevoegdheid o.a. pas inzetten als andere toezichts- of handhavingsbevoegdheden niet volstaan of niet doelmatig of evenredig zijn om de zorgen over consumentenbescherming af te wenden.
d: rules on verification of consumer birth date
p: Gives the AFM power to ban or restrict certain credit products or market practices where other supervisory tools are insufficient, with proportionality and subsidiarity conditions attached.
Empowers the AFM to supervise age verification and processing of special category data for minors' credit access, with monitoring planned.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Implementation Act for the revised Consumer Credit Directive (CCDII), raising concerns that the proposed ban on credit to minors lacked a proper basis in the directive and that the processing of special categories of personal data conflicted with the directive and the intended separation procedure. The government's reply accepted the remarks, shifting the legal basis to Article 6 CCDII and rewording Article 4:34a Wft to prohibit use of special category data in creditworthiness assessments.
concerns: The ban and restriction on credit to minors was based on an inapt provision (creditworthiness assessment) of the directive, and the basis needed clarification; the government moved the basis to Article 6 CCDII and justified it as objective age-based differentiation.

The proposed processing of special category personal data in creditworthiness assessments did not match the stated separation procedure and conflicted with the directive's prohibition on using such data; the wording was amended to forbid use of such data.

36951.s: The bill amends Article 119 of the Constitution so that the Procurator-General at the Supreme Court, rather than parliament or the cabinet, decides whether to prosecute members of the States General, ministers and state secretaries for official offences. It also removes the Supreme Court's exclusive first-and-only-instance jurisdiction over such cases, allowing ordinary appeal.
36951.j: The memorandum justifies removing political discretion and the Supreme Court's single-instance role by citing the Fokkens commission's findings on political motives, the lack of appeal and the impracticability of the existing procedure.
q: Following the Fokkens commission, the government considers it undesirable that the decision whether to prosecute a member of parliament or minister for an official offence be entrusted to political bodies.

In navolging van de commissie-Fokkens vindt de regering het niet wenselijk dat de beslissing om al dan niet over te gaan tot vervolging van een Kamerlid of bewindspersoon wegens een ambtsdelict is opgedragen aan politieke organen.
d: exceptions to Procurator-General prosecution decision set by ordinary law
p: Prosecution decisions move from the political organs (cabinet and Tweede Kamer) to the independent Procurator-General, reducing political control over prosecuting officials and limiting political shielding.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises on two parallel bills to change the procedure for prosecuting ministerial and parliamentary misconduct, supporting constitutional entrenchment and removal of political influence but questioning trial in three instances and the two-track approach, with remarks on investigation and prosecution. The government's reply accepts entrenchment and the removal of political influence, and clarifies that the Procureur-Generaal will direct investigation and prosecution, while the government has not yet fully justified the two-track route and the three-instance trial as requested.
concerns: Political influence on the prosecution decision should be removed from the constitutional procedure, which the government accepts by assigning the order to prosecute to the Procureur-Generaal.

Trial in three instances rather than before the Hoge Raad alone needs better justification given the special character of cases and time concerns, which the government largely defends but the Afdeling found insufficiently convincing.
Key elements of the relationship between state powers should remain anchored in article 119 of the Constitution, which the government endorses.

The two-track approach via the Herzieningswet is questionable because it entrenches political involvement in investigation and prosecution and may reduce urgency for constitutional change, requiring stronger justification.

The explanatory memorandum should clarify how investigation and prosecution will be organised under the amended article 119, including ministerial responsibility and instruction powers, which the government has added.
